```rust
#[test]
fn genesis_duplicate_entry_rejected() {
    let version_hash = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([73; 32]);
    let issuer_key = fixture::genesis_issuer_key(70);
    let mut receipt = fixture::genesis_adoption_receipt(version_hash, &issuer_key);
    let first = receipt.evidence_bundle.chronology_entries[0].clone();
    // A true duplicate: the exact same entry appears twice, so the second
    // copy's predecessor link can never correctly chain to the first.
    receipt.evidence_bundle = fixture::genesis_evidence_bundle(vec![first.clone(), first]);
    receipt.evidence_bundle_hash =
        genesis_evidence_bundle_hash(&receipt.evidence_bundle).expect("recomputed bundle hash");
    let current = CurrentPackageCommitments {
        authorization_target_hash: hash(193),
        prepublication_root: hash(194),
        final_package_root: hash(195),
    };
    let error = verify_genesis_adoption_receipt(&receipt, current).expect_err("duplicate entry");
    match error {
        ProtocolError::GenesisProvenance { path, .. } => {
            assert!(path.ends_with("/chronology_entries/1/predecessor_entry_hash"));
        }
        other => panic!("expected GenesisProvenance on predecessor_entry_hash, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn genesis_reorder_rejected() {
    let version_hash = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([74; 32]);
    let issuer_key = fixture::genesis_issuer_key(71);
    let e1 = fixture::genesis_chronology_entry(
        211,
        HistoricalActKindV1::DesignRecord,
        ProtocolHlc::new(20, 0),
        None,
    );
    let e1_hash =
        domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalActChronologyEntryV1, &e1).expect("e1 hash");
    // e2's predecessor link correctly chains to e1, but e2's own occurred_at
    // (10) is earlier than e1's (20): the chain is valid, the order is not.
    let e2 = fixture::genesis_chronology_entry(
        215,
        HistoricalActKindV1::IndependentReview,
        ProtocolHlc::new(10, 0),
        Some(e1_hash),
    );
    let bundle = fixture::genesis_evidence_bundle(vec![e1, e2]);
    let bundle_hash = genesis_evidence_bundle_hash(&bundle).expect("bundle hash");
    let mut receipt = fixture::genesis_adoption_receipt(version_hash, &issuer_key);
    receipt.evidence_bundle = bundle;
    receipt.evidence_bundle_hash = bundle_hash;
    let current = CurrentPackageCommitments {
        authorization_target_hash: hash(196),
        prepublication_root: hash(197),
        final_package_root: hash(198),
    };
    let error = verify_genesis_adoption_receipt(&receipt, current).expect_err("reorder");
    match error {
        ProtocolError::InvalidOrder { collection, index } => {
            assert_eq!(collection, "genesis_evidence_bundle.chronology_entries");
            assert_eq!(index, 1);
        }
        other => panic!("expected InvalidOrder, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn genesis_artifact_set_mismatch_rejected() {
    let version_hash = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([75; 32]);
    let issuer_key = fixture::genesis_issuer_key(72);
    let mut receipt = fixture::genesis_adoption_receipt(version_hash, &issuer_key);
    let mut artifact_entry_hashes = receipt
        .evidence_bundle
        .historical_artifact_set
        .artifact_entry_hashes
        .clone();
    artifact_entry_hashes.insert(hash(199));
    let mut normalized = HistoricalArtifactSetCommitmentV1 {
        artifact_entry_hashes,
        artifact_set_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
    };
    // The artifact set is self-consistent (its own hash matches its own
    // contents) but no longer matches the chronology entries' real content
    // hashes, which is the cross-check this mutation targets.
    let artifact_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalArtifactSetCommitmentV1,
        &normalized,
    )
    .expect("recomputed artifact set hash");
    normalized.artifact_set_hash = artifact_set_hash;
    receipt.evidence_bundle.historical_artifact_set = normalized;
    receipt.evidence_bundle_hash =
        genesis_evidence_bundle_hash(&receipt.evidence_bundle).expect("recomputed bundle hash");
    let current = CurrentPackageCommitments {
        authorization_target_hash: hash(248),
        prepublication_root: hash(249),
        final_package_root: hash(250),
    };
    let error =
        verify_genesis_adoption_receipt(&receipt, current).expect_err("artifact set mismatch");
    assert!(matches!(
        error,
        ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "genesis_historical_artifact_set",
            ..
        }
    ));
}
```

### Gates 01, 02, and 07: protocol errors and codec owners

Apply each file only at its owning topological gate. Gate 07 is deliberately
after Gate 06 because its public package decoder names the complete package
type. The commands in the canonical gate protocol are the only base, stage,
and commit commands.

**Files:**

- Modify: `crates/decision-forum/Cargo.toml`
- Modify if changed by Cargo: `Cargo.lock`
- Modify: `crates/decision-forum/src/lib.rs`
- Create: `crates/decision-forum/src/protocol/mod.rs`
- Create: `crates/decision-forum/src/protocol/error.rs`
- Create through Gates 01, 02, and 07: `crates/decision-forum/src/protocol/codec/`
- Create: `crates/decision-forum/tests/df_protocol_001_wire.rs`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: workspace-pinned `serde`, `serde_json`, `ciborium`, `thiserror`,
  `uuid`, already-locked exact `serde_path_to_error = "=0.1.20"`, and
  `exo_core::types::Timestamp` conversion only.
- Produces: strict fixed-byte newtypes; recursive duplicate-member rejection;
  JSON transport helpers; float-free, recursively canonicalized CBOR bytes.

- [ ] **Apply these owners only through Gates 01, 02, and 07**

The selected gate's immutable base/list/RED/GREEN/stage/commit contract above
is the only executable procedure for this composite inventory.

```rust
#[test]
fn fixed_bytes_are_hex_in_json_and_bytes_in_cbor() {
```

```rust
    JsonSyntax {
        line: usize,
```

```rust
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, fmt};

use ciborium::value::{CanonicalValue, Value};
use serde::{
    Deserialize, Deserializer, Serialize, Serializer,
    de::{self, DeserializeSeed, MapAccess, SeqAccess, Visitor},
};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::protocol::error::ProtocolError;

macro_rules! fixed_bytes_type {
    ($name:ident, $length:expr, $kind:literal) => {
        #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
        pub struct $name([u8; $length]);

        impl $name {
            pub const ZERO: Self = Self([0; $length]);

            #[must_use]
            pub const fn from_bytes(bytes: [u8; $length]) -> Self {
                Self(bytes)
            }

            #[must_use]
            pub const fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8; $length] {
                &self.0
            }

            pub fn from_hex(field: &'static str, value: &str) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
                let bytes = decode_fixed_hex::<$length>(field, $kind, value)?;
                Ok(Self(bytes))
            }
        }

        impl fmt::Display for $name {
            fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
                write_hex(&self.0, formatter)
            }
        }

        impl fmt::Debug for $name {
            fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
                formatter
                    .debug_tuple(stringify!($name))
                    .field(&self.to_string())
                    .finish()
            }
        }

        impl Serialize for $name {
            fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error>
            where
                S: Serializer,
            {
                if serializer.is_human_readable() {
                    serializer.serialize_str(&self.to_string())
                } else {
                    serializer.serialize_bytes(&self.0)
                }
            }
        }

        impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for $name {
            fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
            where
                D: Deserializer<'de>,
            {
                if deserializer.is_human_readable() {
                    let value = String::deserialize(deserializer)?;
                    Self::from_hex(stringify!($name), &value).map_err(de::Error::custom)
                } else {
                    struct BytesVisitor;
                    impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for BytesVisitor {
                        type Value = [u8; $length];
                        fn expecting(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
                            write!(formatter, "exactly {} bytes", $length)
                        }
                        fn visit_bytes<E>(self, value: &[u8]) -> Result<Self::Value, E>
                        where
                            E: de::Error,
                        {
                            value
                                .try_into()
                                .map_err(|_| E::invalid_length(value.len(), &self))
                        }
                        fn visit_byte_buf<E>(self, value: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Self::Value, E>
                        where
                            E: de::Error,
                        {
                            self.visit_bytes(&value)
                        }
                    }
                    deserializer.deserialize_bytes(BytesVisitor).map(Self)
                }
            }
        }
    };
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct ProtocolUuid([u8; 16]);

impl ProtocolUuid {
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8; 16] {
        &self.0
    }
    pub fn parse(value: &str) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
        let parsed = Uuid::parse_str(value).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidUuid {
            value: value.to_owned(),
        })?;
        let version = parsed.get_version_num();
        if parsed.is_nil()
            || parsed.get_variant() != uuid::Variant::RFC4122
            || !(1..=8).contains(&version)
            || parsed.hyphenated().to_string() != value
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidUuid {
                value: value.to_owned(),
            });
        }
        Ok(Self(*parsed.as_bytes()))
    }

    fn try_from_bytes(bytes: [u8; 16]) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
        let parsed = Uuid::from_bytes(bytes);
        Self::parse(&parsed.hyphenated().to_string())
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for ProtocolUuid {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        Uuid::from_bytes(self.0).hyphenated().fmt(formatter)
    }
}

impl fmt::Debug for ProtocolUuid {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter
            .debug_tuple("ProtocolUuid")
            .field(&self.to_string())
            .finish()
    }
}

impl Serialize for ProtocolUuid {
    fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error>
    where
        S: Serializer,
    {
        if serializer.is_human_readable() {
            serializer.serialize_str(&self.to_string())
        } else {
            serializer.serialize_bytes(&self.0)
        }
    }
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for ProtocolUuid {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        if deserializer.is_human_readable() {
            Self::parse(&String::deserialize(deserializer)?).map_err(de::Error::custom)
        } else {
            let bytes = Vec::<u8>::deserialize(deserializer)?;
            let exact: [u8; 16] = bytes
                .try_into()
                .map_err(|value: Vec<u8>| de::Error::invalid_length(value.len(), &"16 bytes"))?;
            Self::try_from_bytes(exact).map_err(de::Error::custom)
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct Did(String);

impl Did {
    pub fn parse(value: impl Into<String>) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
        let value = value.into();
        let suffix = value
            .strip_prefix("did:exo:")
            .ok_or_else(|| ProtocolError::InvalidDid {
                value: value.clone(),
            })?;
        if suffix.is_empty()
            || !suffix
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b':' | b'-'))
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidDid { value });
        }
        Ok(Self(value))
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for Did {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter.write_str(&self.0)
    }
}

impl fmt::Debug for Did {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter.debug_tuple("Did").field(&self.0).finish()
    }
}

impl Serialize for Did {
    fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error>
    where
        S: Serializer,
    {
        serializer.serialize_str(&self.0)
    }
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for Did {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        Self::parse(String::deserialize(deserializer)?).map_err(de::Error::custom)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct GitObjectId([u8; 20]);

impl GitObjectId {
    pub fn from_sha1_hex(value: &str) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
        decode_fixed_hex::<20>("GitObjectId.digest", "sha1", value)
            .map(Self)
            .map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidGitObjectId {
                value: value.to_owned(),
            })
    }
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8; 20] {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl Serialize for GitObjectId {
    fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error>
    where
        S: Serializer,
    {
        if serializer.is_human_readable() {
            #[derive(Serialize)]
            struct JsonGit<'a> {
                algorithm: &'static str,
                digest: &'a str,
            }
            let digest = self.to_string();
            JsonGit {
                algorithm: "sha1",
                digest: &digest,
            }
            .serialize(serializer)
        } else {
            serializer.serialize_bytes(&self.0)
        }
    }
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for GitObjectId {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        if deserializer.is_human_readable() {
            #[derive(Deserialize)]
            #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
            struct JsonGit {
                algorithm: String,
                digest: String,
            }
            let value = JsonGit::deserialize(deserializer)?;
            if value.algorithm != "sha1" {
                return Err(de::Error::custom("GitObjectId algorithm must be sha1"));
            }
            Self::from_sha1_hex(&value.digest).map_err(de::Error::custom)
        } else {
            let bytes = Vec::<u8>::deserialize(deserializer)?;
            let exact: [u8; 20] = bytes
                .try_into()
                .map_err(|value: Vec<u8>| de::Error::invalid_length(value.len(), &"20 bytes"))?;
            Ok(Self(exact))
        }
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for GitObjectId {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        write_hex(&self.0, formatter)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn decode_strict_json_value(input: &[u8]) -> Result<serde_json::Value, ProtocolError> {
    let mut deserializer = serde_json::Deserializer::from_slice(input);
    let strict = StrictJsonSeed {
        path: "$".to_owned(),
    }
    .deserialize(&mut deserializer)
    .map_err(json_error)?;
    deserializer.end().map_err(json_error)?;
    Ok(strict.0)
}

pub fn canonical_protocol_cbor<T: Serialize + ?Sized>(value: &T) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ProtocolError> {
    let mut value = Value::serialized(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::CborEncoding {
        message: error.to_string(),
    })?;
    canonicalize_value(&mut value, "$".to_owned())?;
    let mut output = Vec::new();
    ciborium::ser::into_writer(&value, &mut output).map_err(|error| {
        ProtocolError::CborEncoding {
            message: error.to_string(),
        }
    })?;
    Ok(output)
}

fn canonicalize_value(value: &mut Value, path: String) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    match value {
        Value::Float(_) => Err(ProtocolError::CborFloatForbidden { path }),
        Value::Array(values) => {
            for (index, child) in values.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                canonicalize_value(child, format!("{path}[{index}]"))?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        Value::Map(entries) => {
            for (key, child) in entries.iter_mut() {
                let key_text = match key {
                    Value::Text(text) => text.clone(),
                    _ => return Err(ProtocolError::NonTextCborMapKey { path }),
                };
                canonicalize_value(child, format!("{path}.{key_text}"))?;
            }
            entries.sort_by(|(left, _), (right, _)| {
                CanonicalValue::from(left.clone()).cmp(&CanonicalValue::from(right.clone()))
            });
            Ok(())
        }
        Value::Tag(_, child) => canonicalize_value(child, path),
        _ => Ok(()),
    }
}

struct StrictJson(serde_json::Value);

struct StrictJsonSeed {
    path: String,
}

impl<'de> DeserializeSeed<'de> for StrictJsonSeed {
    type Value = StrictJson;
    fn deserialize<D>(self, deserializer: D) -> Result<Self::Value, D::Error>
    where
        D: Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        deserializer.deserialize_any(StrictJsonVisitor { path: self.path })
    }
}

struct StrictJsonVisitor {
    path: String,
}

impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for StrictJsonVisitor {
    type Value = StrictJson;

    fn expecting(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter.write_str("a JSON value without duplicate object members")
    }

    fn visit_bool<E>(self, value: bool) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(value.into()))
    }
    fn visit_i64<E>(self, value: i64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(value.into()))
    }
    fn visit_u64<E>(self, value: u64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(value.into()))
    }
    fn visit_f64<E>(self, value: f64) -> Result<Self::Value, E>
    where
        E: de::Error,
    {
        let _ = value;
        Err(E::custom("floating-point JSON numbers are forbidden"))
    }
    fn visit_str<E>(self, value: &str) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(value.to_owned().into()))
    }
    fn visit_string<E>(self, value: String) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(value.into()))
    }
    fn visit_none<E>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(serde_json::Value::Null))
    }
    fn visit_unit<E>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
        Ok(StrictJson(serde_json::Value::Null))
    }

    fn visit_seq<A>(self, mut sequence: A) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error>
    where
        A: SeqAccess<'de>,
    {
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        let mut index = 0usize;
        while let Some(value) = sequence.next_element_seed(StrictJsonSeed {
            path: format!("{}[{index}]", self.path),
        })? {
            values.push(value.0);
            index += 1;
        }
        Ok(StrictJson(values.into()))
    }

    fn visit_map<A>(self, mut map: A) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error>
    where
        A: MapAccess<'de>,
    {
        let mut values = BTreeMap::<String, serde_json::Value>::new();
        while let Some(key) = map.next_key::<String>()? {
            if values.contains_key(&key) {
                return Err(de::Error::custom(format!(
                    "duplicate JSON member `{key}` at object path `{}`",
                    self.path
                )));
            }
            let value = map.next_value_seed(StrictJsonSeed {
                path: format!("{}.{key}", self.path),
            })?;
            values.insert(key, value.0);
        }
        Ok(StrictJson(
            values.into_iter().collect::<serde_json::Map<_, _>>().into(),
        ))
    }
}

fn json_error(error: serde_json::Error) -> ProtocolError {
    let line = error.line();
    let column = error.column();
    let message = error.to_string();
    if let Some(rest) = message.strip_prefix("duplicate JSON member `")
        && let Some((member, rest)) = rest.split_once("` at object path `")
        && let Some((path, _location)) = rest.split_once('`')
    {
        return ProtocolError::DuplicateJsonMember {
            path: path.to_owned(),
            member: member.to_owned(),
        };
    }
    ProtocolError::JsonSyntax {
        line,
        column,
        message,
    }
}

fn decode_fixed_hex<const N: usize>(
    field: &'static str,
    kind: &'static str,
    value: &str,
) -> Result<[u8; N], ProtocolError> {
    if value.len() != N * 2
        || !value
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit() || matches!(byte, b'a'..=b'f'))
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidHex {
            field,
            kind,
            expected_bytes: N,
            value: value.to_owned(),
        });
    }
    let mut output = [0u8; N];
    for (index, pair) in value.as_bytes().chunks_exact(2).enumerate() {
        let pair = std::str::from_utf8(pair).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidHex {
            field,
            kind,
            expected_bytes: N,
            value: value.to_owned(),
        })?;
        output[index] = u8::from_str_radix(pair, 16).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidHex {
            field,
            kind,
            expected_bytes: N,
            value: value.to_owned(),
        })?;
    }
    Ok(output)
}

fn write_hex(bytes: &[u8], formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
    for byte in bytes {
        write!(formatter, "{byte:02x}")?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
macro_rules! signature_envelope {
    ($name:ident) => {
        #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
        #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
        pub struct $name {
            pub algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm,
            pub signing_key_id: ProtocolHash256,
            pub verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey,
            pub signature: Ed25519Signature,
            pub signed_payload_hash: ProtocolHash256,
            pub signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget,
        }
    };
}
```

Append to `codec/mod.rs`:

```rust
use crate::protocol::types::PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1;

fn decode_typed_protocol_json<T>(input: &[u8]) -> Result<T, ProtocolError>
where
    T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned,
{
    let value = decode_strict_json_value(input)?;
    let canonical_json =
        serde_json::to_vec(&value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::JsonProjection {
            message: error.to_string(),
        })?;
    let mut deserializer = serde_json::Deserializer::from_slice(&canonical_json);
    serde_path_to_error::deserialize(&mut deserializer).map_err(|error| {
        let message = error.inner().to_string();
        let mut path = error
            .path()
            .to_string()
            .replace(['.', '['], "/")
            .replace(']', "");
        if path == "." {
            path.clear();
        }
        if let Some(field) = message
            .strip_prefix("missing field `")
            .and_then(|value| value.split('`').next())
        {
            path = format!("{}/{}", path.trim_end_matches('/'), field);
        }
        // serde_path_to_error identifies a BTreeMap value as `?` because the
        // map key is data rather than a struct field. Resource ceilings have a
        // closed key schema and u64 values, so recover the one invalid key from
        // the already duplicate-checked JSON value for an exact transport path.
        if path.trim_start_matches('/') == "protocol_envelope/resource_ceilings/?"
            && let Some(key) = value
                .pointer("/protocol_envelope/resource_ceilings")
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object)
                .and_then(|ceilings| {
                    ceilings
                        .iter()
                        .find(|(_, ceiling)| ceiling.as_u64().is_none())
                        .map(|(key, _)| key.clone())
                })
        {
            path = format!("protocol_envelope/resource_ceilings/{key}");
        }
        ProtocolError::TransportShape {
            path: format!("/{}", path.trim_start_matches('/')),
            expected: std::any::type_name::<T>().to_owned(),
            actual: message,
        }
    })
}

pub fn decode_protocol_json(input: &[u8]) -> Result<PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1, ProtocolError> {
    decode_typed_protocol_json(input)
}

pub fn encode_protocol_json(
    value: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ProtocolError> {
    serde_json::to_vec(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::JsonProjection {
        message: error.to_string(),
    })
}
```

```rust
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

use exo_core::bcts::BctsState;

use crate::protocol::{
    codec::{Did, Ed25519Signature, Ed25519VerificationKey, ProtocolHash256, ProtocolUuid},
    domains::{ProtocolHashDomain, domain_hash},
    error::ProtocolError,
    types::*,
};

const FOUR_PROVIDER_CLASSES: [ProviderClass; 4] = [
    ProviderClass::OpenAI,
    ProviderClass::Anthropic,
    ProviderClass::XAi,
    ProviderClass::AlphabetGoogleGemini,

pub fn validate_protocol_structure(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if package.schema_version != 1 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedSchemaVersion {
            found: package.schema_version,
        });
    }
    validate_identity(&package.protocol_identity, &package.receipt_manifest)?;
    validate_document(&package.protocol_document)?;
    validate_envelope(&package.protocol_envelope)?;
    validate_evidence(&package.evidence_manifest)?;
    validate_review_bundle(&package.review_bundle)?;
    validate_dispositions(&package.disposition_bundle, &package.evidence_manifest)?;
    if package.disposition_bundle.binding_mode == BindingMode::BindingInsideRatifiedEnvelope
        && package.protocol_identity.lifecycle_state != BctsState::Approved
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::MilestoneStateMismatch {
            expected: BctsState::Approved,
            actual: package.protocol_identity.lifecycle_state,
        });
    }
    validate_monitoring_plan(&package.monitoring_plan)?;
    validate_learning(&package.systemic_learning_manifest)?;
    validate_commercial(&package.commercial_boundary)?;
    validate_receipt_manifest(&package.receipt_manifest)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_context_graph(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    computed_version: ProtocolHash256,
    authorization_target: ProtocolHash256,
    prepublication: ProtocolHash256,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let review_bundle_hash =
        domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::ReviewBundleV1, &package.review_bundle)?;
    let envelope_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolEnvelopeV1,
        &package.protocol_envelope,
    )?;
    let council_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::EligibleSetV1,
        &(
            SeatKind::Council,
            &package.disposition_bundle.council_eligible_set,
        ),
    )?;
    let ai_irb_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::EligibleSetV1,
        &(
            SeatKind::AiIrb,
            &package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_eligible_set,
        ),
    )?;

    let mut seats = BTreeMap::new();
    for attestation in package
        .review_bundle
        .council_seat_attestations
        .entries()
        .into_iter()
        .chain(package.review_bundle.ai_irb_seat_attestations.entries())
    {
        if attestation.tenant_id != package.protocol_identity.tenant_id
            || attestation.protocol_id != package.protocol_identity.protocol_id
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/*_seat_attestations/context".to_owned(),
                expected: format!(
                    "tenant={}, protocol={}",
                    package.protocol_identity.tenant_id, package.protocol_identity.protocol_id,
                ),
                actual: format!(
                    "tenant={}, protocol={}",
                    attestation.tenant_id, attestation.protocol_id,
                ),
            });
        }
        let attestation_hash = domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationV1, attestation)?;
        if seats
            .insert(
                attestation.seat_id.clone(),
                (
                    attestation.seat_kind,
                    attestation_hash,
                    attestation.context_manifest_hash,
                    attestation.conflict_declaration_hash,
                    attestation.signing_key_id,
                ),
            )
            .is_some()
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/*_seat_attestations".to_owned(),
                expected: "ten distinct body-specific seat DIDs".to_owned(),
                actual: attestation.seat_id.to_string(),
            });
        }
    }

    let mut assignments = BTreeMap::new();
    for assignment in &package.review_bundle.assignments {
        if assignment.protocol_version_hash != computed_version
            || assignment.blind_assignment_commitment == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
            || assignment.ephemeral_reviewer_key_commitment == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
            || assignment.context_commitment == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
            || assignment.conflict_commitment == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/assignments/context".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("version={computed_version} with nonzero blind commitments"),
                actual: assignment.assignment_id.to_string(),
            });
        }
        if assignments
            .insert(assignment.assignment_id, assignment)
            .is_some()
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/assignments".to_owned(),
                expected: "unique assignment IDs".to_owned(),
                actual: assignment.assignment_id.to_string(),
            });
        }
    }

    let mut reviews_by_assignment = BTreeMap::<ProtocolUuid, usize>::new();
    let mut review_ids = BTreeSet::new();
    for review in &package.review_bundle.signed_reviews {
        let assignment =
            assignments
                .get(&review.assignment_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                    path: "/review_bundle/signed_reviews/assignment_id".to_owned(),
                    expected: "existing assignment".to_owned(),
                    actual: review.assignment_id.to_string(),
                })?;
        *reviews_by_assignment
            .entry(review.assignment_id)
            .or_insert(0) += 1;
        review_ids.insert(review.review_id);
        let signer_known = seats.values().any(|seat| seat.4 == review.signature.signing_key_id);
        if review.protocol_version_hash != computed_version
            || review.authorization_target_hash != authorization_target
            || !signer_known
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/signed_reviews/context".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("version={computed_version}, target={authorization_target}"),
                actual: format!(
                    "version={}, target={}",
                    review.protocol_version_hash, review.authorization_target_hash,
                ),
            });
        }
        let _ = assignment; // keep assignment binding required above
    }
    for assignment_id in assignments.keys() {
        let actual = reviews_by_assignment
            .get(assignment_id)
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(0);
        if actual != 1 {
            return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
                path: format!("/review_bundle/assignments/{assignment_id}/signed_reviews"),
                expected: 1,
                actual,
            });
        }
    }

    let response_hashes = package
        .review_bundle
        .author_responses
        .iter()
        .map(|value| value.content_hash)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let revision_hashes = package
        .review_bundle
        .revision_diffs
        .iter()
        .map(|value| value.content_hash)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let mut resolutions_by_review = BTreeMap::<ProtocolUuid, usize>::new();
    for resolution in &package.review_bundle.resolution_matrix {
        if !review_ids.contains(&resolution.review_id)
            || !response_hashes.contains(&resolution.author_response_hash)
            || !revision_hashes.contains(&resolution.revision_diff_hash)
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/resolution_matrix".to_owned(),
                expected: "existing review, response, and revision".to_owned(),
                actual: resolution.resolution_id.to_string(),
            });
        }
        *resolutions_by_review
            .entry(resolution.review_id)
            .or_insert(0) += 1;
    }
    for review_id in review_ids {
        let actual = resolutions_by_review.get(&review_id).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        if actual != 1 {
            return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
                path: format!("/review_bundle/signed_reviews/{review_id}/resolutions"),
                expected: 1,
                actual,
            });
        }
    }

    validate_present_votes(
        "/disposition_bundle/council_votes",
        SeatKind::Council,
        &package.disposition_bundle.council_eligible_set,
        &package.disposition_bundle.council_votes,
        VoteValidationContext {
            version: computed_version,
            target: authorization_target,
            review_bundle: review_bundle_hash,
            eligible_set: council_set_hash,
        },
    )?;
    validate_present_votes(
        "/disposition_bundle/ai_irb_votes",
        SeatKind::AiIrb,
        &package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_eligible_set,
        &package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_votes,
        VoteValidationContext {
            version: computed_version,
            target: authorization_target,
            review_bundle: review_bundle_hash,
            eligible_set: ai_irb_set_hash,
        },
    )?;
    for chair in &package.disposition_bundle.chair_interventions {
        if chair.protocol_version_hash != computed_version
            || chair.authorization_target_hash != authorization_target
            || chair.scope_hash != envelope_hash
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/chair_interventions/context".to_owned(),
                expected: format!(
                    "version={computed_version}, target={authorization_target}, scope={envelope_hash}"
                ),
                actual: format!(
                    "version={}, target={}, scope={}",
                    chair.protocol_version_hash, chair.authorization_target_hash, chair.scope_hash
                ),
            });
        }
    }
    let publication = package
        .receipt_manifest
        .publication_authorization_receipt
        .as_ref()
        .ok_or_else(|| ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: "/receipt_manifest/publication_authorization_receipt".to_owned(),
            expected: 1,
            actual: 0,
        })?;
    if publication.prepublication_root != prepublication {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/receipt_manifest/publication_authorization_receipt/prepublication_root"
                .to_owned(),
            expected: prepublication.to_string(),
            actual: publication.prepublication_root.to_string(),
        });
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct VoteValidationContext {
    version: ProtocolHash256,
    target: ProtocolHash256,
    review_bundle: ProtocolHash256,
    eligible_set: ProtocolHash256,
}

fn validate_present_votes<V: VoteContext>(
    path: &str,
    seat_kind: SeatKind,
    eligible: &BTreeSet<Did>,
    votes: &[V],
    context: VoteValidationContext,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if votes.len() > eligible.len() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: path.to_owned(),
            expected: eligible.len(),
            actual: votes.len(),
        });
    }
    let actual_seats = votes
        .iter()
        .map(VoteContext::seat_id)
        .cloned()
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    if actual_seats.len() != votes.len()
        || !actual_seats.is_subset(eligible)
        || votes.iter().any(|vote| {
            vote.seat_kind() != seat_kind
                || vote.protocol_version_hash() != context.version
                || vote.authorization_target_hash() != context.target
                || vote.review_bundle_hash() != context.review_bundle
                || vote.eligible_set_hash() != context.eligible_set
        })
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Quorum {
            path: path.to_owned(),
            expected: format!(
                "zero through {} unique eligible {seat_kind:?} signed dispositions with recomputed context",
                eligible.len()
            ),
            actual: format!("{} votes from {} seats", votes.len(), actual_seats.len()),
        });
    }
    Ok(())
}

trait VoteContext {
    fn seat_id(&self) -> &Did;
    fn seat_kind(&self) -> SeatKind;
    fn protocol_version_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256;
    fn authorization_target_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256;
    fn review_bundle_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256;
    fn eligible_set_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256;
}

macro_rules! vote_context {
    ($type:ty) => {
        impl VoteContext for $type {
            fn seat_id(&self) -> &Did {
                &self.seat_id
            }
            fn seat_kind(&self) -> SeatKind {
                self.seat_kind
            }
            fn protocol_version_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256 {
                self.protocol_version_hash
            }
            fn authorization_target_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256 {
                self.authorization_target_hash
            }
            fn review_bundle_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256 {
                self.review_bundle_hash
            }
            fn eligible_set_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256 {
                self.eligible_set_hash
            }
        }
    };
}

pub fn validate_monitoring_plan(plan: &MonitoringPlan) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if !(1..=25).contains(&plan.max_iterations) || plan.repeat_failure_limit != 2 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidLoopBounds {
            max_iterations: plan.max_iterations,
            repeat_failure_limit: plan.repeat_failure_limit,
        });
    }
    required(
        "monitoring_plan.success_stop_condition",
        &plan.success_stop_condition,
    )?;
    if plan.scheduled_interval_hlc_units == 0 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed {
            field: "monitoring_plan.scheduled_interval_hlc_units",
        });
    }
    nonempty_set(
        "monitoring_plan.reporting_destinations",
        &plan.reporting_destinations,
    )?;
    let exact_domains = BTreeSet::from([
        "exo.decision_forum.protocol_event.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.investigator_designation.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.aar_rca_attestation.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.estop_disposition.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.estop_authorization.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.notification_attempt.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.capa_record.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.reset_authorization.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion_disposition.v1".to_owned(),
        "exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion.v1".to_owned(),
    ]);
    if plan.event_payload_type_domains != exact_domains {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidOrder {
            collection: "monitoring_plan.event_payload_type_domains",
            index: 0,
        });
    }
    nonempty_strings(
        "monitoring_plan.adverse_event_definitions",
        &plan.adverse_event_definitions,
    )?;
    nonempty_strings(
        "monitoring_plan.progressive_event_definitions",
        &plan.progressive_event_definitions,
    )?;
    validate_hash_references("monitoring_plan.claim_thresholds", &plan.claim_thresholds)
}

fn validate_identity(
    identity: &ProtocolIdentity,
    receipts: &ReceiptManifest,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    required("protocol_identity.protocol_id", &identity.protocol_id)?;
    required("protocol_identity.tenant_id", &identity.tenant_id)?;
    required("protocol_identity.domain", &identity.domain)?;
    nonzero_hash(
        "protocol_identity.constitutional_hash",
        identity.constitutional_hash,
    )?;
    if identity.version == 0 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed {
            field: "protocol_identity.version",
        });
    }
    if identity.co_pi_dids.len() < 2 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "protocol_identity.co_pi_dids",
        });
    }
    if identity.chair_did != identity.chair_authority.chair_did {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "protocol_identity.chair_authority",
        });
    }
    nonzero_hash(
        "chair_authority.signing_key_id",
        identity.chair_authority.signing_key_id,
    )?;
    nonzero_key(
        "chair_authority.verification_key",
        identity.chair_authority.verification_key,
    )?;
    nonzero_hash(
        "chair_authority.authority_chain_hash",
        identity.chair_authority.authority_chain_hash,
    )?;
    match (
        identity.version,
        identity.prior_version_hash,
        receipts.prior_execution_receipt_chain.as_ref(),
    ) {
        (1, None, None) => Ok(()),
        (1, _, _) => Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence { version: 1 }),
        (version, Some(prior), Some(reference)) if version >= 2 => {
            if prior != reference.prior_protocol_version_hash {
                return Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
                    field: "protocol_identity.prior_version_hash",
                    expected: reference.prior_protocol_version_hash,
                    actual: prior,
                });
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        (version, None, Some(_)) | (version, Some(_), None) => {
            Err(ProtocolError::HalfNullPredecessor { version })
        }
        (version, Some(_), Some(_)) => Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence { version }),
        (version, None, None) => Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence { version }),
    }
}

fn validate_document(document: &ProtocolDocument) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    for (field, value) in [
        (
            "protocol_document.abstract_text",
            document.abstract_text.as_str(),
        ),
        ("protocol_document.purpose", document.purpose.as_str()),
        ("protocol_document.scope", document.scope.as_str()),
        (
            "protocol_document.architecture",
            document.architecture.as_str(),
        ),
        (
            "protocol_document.consent_bailment_basis",
            document.consent_bailment_basis.as_str(),
        ),
        (
            "protocol_document.data_handling",
            document.data_handling.as_str(),
        ),
        ("protocol_document.monitoring", document.monitoring.as_str()),
        (
            "protocol_document.evaluation_method",
            document.evaluation_method.as_str(),
        ),
    ] {
        required(field, value)?;
    }
    for (field, values) in [
        ("protocol_document.methods", &document.methods),
        (
            "protocol_document.implementation_controls",
            &document.implementation_controls,
        ),
        ("protocol_document.risks", &document.risks),
        ("protocol_document.threat_model", &document.threat_model),
        ("protocol_document.stopping_rules", &document.stopping_rules),
        (
            "protocol_document.implementation_test_plan",
            &document.implementation_test_plan,
        ),
        (
            "protocol_document.closeout_criteria",
            &document.closeout_criteria,
        ),
    ] {
        nonempty_strings(field, values)?;
    }
    validate_hash_references("protocol_document.claims", &document.claims)
}

fn validate_envelope(envelope: &ProtocolEnvelope) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    nonempty_set(
        "protocol_envelope.permitted_actions",
        &envelope.permitted_actions,
    )?;
    nonempty_set("protocol_envelope.systems", &envelope.systems)?;
    nonempty_set("protocol_envelope.tenants", &envelope.tenants)?;
    nonempty_set("protocol_envelope.actor_classes", &envelope.actor_classes)?;
    if envelope.resource_ceilings.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "protocol_envelope.resource_ceilings",
        });
    }
    basis_points(
        "protocol_envelope.risk_ceiling_basis_points",
        envelope.risk_ceiling_basis_points,
    )?;
    if envelope.starts_at > envelope.ends_at {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidInterval {
            field: "protocol_envelope",
            start: envelope.starts_at,
            end: envelope.ends_at,
        });
    }
    nonempty_strings("protocol_envelope.phase_ladder", &envelope.phase_ladder)?;
    unique_strings("protocol_envelope.phase_ladder", &envelope.phase_ladder)
}

fn validate_evidence(evidence: &EvidenceManifest) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if evidence.items.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "evidence_manifest.items",
        });
    }
    if evidence.independent_evidence_classes.len() < 2
        || !evidence
            .independent_evidence_classes
            .contains(&IndependentEvidenceClass::IndependentNonProviderEvidence)
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EvidenceFloor {
            path: "/evidence_manifest/independent_evidence_classes".to_owned(),
            expected: "at least two classes including IndependentNonProviderEvidence".to_owned(),
            actual: format!("{:?}", evidence.independent_evidence_classes),
        });
    }
    validate_hash_references("evidence_manifest.items", &evidence.items)?;
    validate_hash_references(
        "evidence_manifest.negative_or_inconclusive_results",
        &evidence.negative_or_inconclusive_results,
    )
}

        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_roster<T>(seat_kind: SeatKind, roster: &T) -> Result<(), ProtocolError>
where
    T: RosterView,
{
    for (attestation, provider) in roster.entries().into_iter().zip([
        ProviderClass::OpenAI,
        ProviderClass::Anthropic,
        ProviderClass::XAi,
        ProviderClass::AlphabetGoogleGemini,
        ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider,
    ]) {
        if attestation.seat_kind != seat_kind || attestation.provider_class != provider {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/review_bundle/roster".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("seat_kind={seat_kind:?}, provider_class={provider:?}"),
                actual: format!(
                    "seat_kind={:?}, provider_class={:?}",
                    attestation.seat_kind, attestation.provider_class,
                ),
            });
        }
        let expected_scope = match seat_kind {
            SeatKind::Council => AuthorityScope::CouncilSeatV1,
            SeatKind::AiIrb => AuthorityScope::AiIrbSeatV1,
        };
        if attestation.authority_scope != expected_scope
            || attestation.valid_from > attestation.valid_until
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidInterval {
                field: "seat_attestation.validity",
                start: attestation.valid_from,
                end: attestation.valid_until,
            });
        }
        if provider == ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider {
            if attestation.independent_control_proof_hash.is_none()
                || !attestation
                    .evidence_classes
                    .contains(&EvidenceClass::IndependentNonProviderEvidence)
            {
                return Err(ProtocolError::EvidenceFloor {
                    path: "/review_bundle/roster/independent_control".to_owned(),
                    expected: "independent proof and IndependentNonProviderEvidence".to_owned(),
                    actual: format!(
                        "proof={}, evidence={:?}",
                        attestation.independent_control_proof_hash.is_some(),
                        attestation.evidence_classes,
                    ),
                });
            }
        } else if attestation.independent_control_proof_hash.is_some() {
            return Err(ProtocolError::EvidenceFloor {
                path: "/review_bundle/roster/provider_control".to_owned(),
                expected: "provider seat has no independent-control proof".to_owned(),
                actual: "independent-control proof supplied".to_owned(),
            });
        }
        signature_shape(
            "SeatAttestationV1",
            SignedPayloadTarget::SeatAttestationV1,
            attestation.signature.signed_payload_target,
            attestation.signature.signing_key_id,
            attestation.signature.verification_key,
            attestation.signature.signature,
            attestation.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

trait RosterView {
    fn entries(&self) -> [&SeatAttestation; 5];
}

impl RosterView for CouncilRoster {
    fn entries(&self) -> [&SeatAttestation; 5] {
        [
            &self.openai,
            &self.anthropic,
            &self.xai,
            &self.alphabet_google_gemini,
            &self.independent_non_provider,
        ]
    }
}

impl RosterView for AiIrbRoster {
    fn entries(&self) -> [&SeatAttestation; 5] {
        [
            &self.openai,
            &self.anthropic,
            &self.xai,
            &self.alphabet_google_gemini,
            &self.independent_non_provider,
        ]
    }
}

fn validate_dispositions(
    dispositions: &DispositionBundle,
    evidence: &EvidenceManifest,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    exact_len(
        "disposition_bundle.council_eligible_set",
        dispositions.council_eligible_set.len(),
        5,
    )?;
    exact_len(
        "disposition_bundle.ai_irb_eligible_set",
        dispositions.ai_irb_eligible_set.len(),
        5,
    )?;
    if dispositions.council_votes.len() > 5
        || dispositions.ai_irb_votes.len() > 5
        || dispositions.ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions.len() > 5
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: "/disposition_bundle/votes".to_owned(),
            expected: 5,
            actual: dispositions
                .council_votes
                .len()
                .max(dispositions.ai_irb_votes.len())
                .max(dispositions.ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions.len()),
        });
    }
    exact_len(
        "disposition_bundle.quorum_proofs",
        dispositions.quorum_proofs.len(),
        2,
    )?;
    exact_len(
        "disposition_bundle.authority_chain",
        dispositions.authority_chain.len(),
        12,
    )?;
    sorted_by(
        "disposition_bundle.council_votes",
        &dispositions.council_votes,
        |value| (value.seat_id.clone(), value.disposition_id),
    )?;
    sorted_by(
        "disposition_bundle.ai_irb_votes",
        &dispositions.ai_irb_votes,
        |value| (value.seat_id.clone(), value.disposition_id),
    )?;
    sorted_by(
        "disposition_bundle.ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions",
        &dispositions.ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions,
        |value| (value.seat_id.clone(), value.disposition_id),
    )?;
    sorted_by(
        "disposition_bundle.quorum_proofs",
        &dispositions.quorum_proofs,
        |value| (value.seat_kind, value.proof_id),
    )?;
    sorted_by(
        "disposition_bundle.authority_chain",
        &dispositions.authority_chain,
        |value| (value.binding_kind, value.scope, value.actor_did.clone()),
    )?;
    if dispositions.binding_mode == BindingMode::BindingInsideRatifiedEnvelope
        && dispositions.quorum_proofs.iter().any(|proof| {
            proof.result != QuorumResult::EligibleUnanimity || proof.approve_count != 5
        })
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Quorum {
            path: "/disposition_bundle/binding_mode".to_owned(),
            expected: "two eligible-unanimity proofs with five approvals".to_owned(),
            actual: format!("{:?}", dispositions.quorum_proofs),
        });
    }
    for proof in &dispositions.quorum_proofs {
        exact_len(
            "quorum_proof.eligible_seat_hashes",
            proof.eligible_seat_hashes.len(),
            5,
        )?;
        if proof.approve_seat_hashes.len() > 5
            || proof.eligible_count != 5
            || proof.required_count != 5
            || usize::from(proof.approve_count) != proof.approve_seat_hashes.len()
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::Quorum {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/quorum_proofs/counts".to_owned(),
                expected: "eligible=required=5 and approve_count equals unique approve set"
                    .to_owned(),
                actual: format!(
                    "eligible={}, required={}, approve={}, approve_set={}",
                    proof.eligible_count,
                    proof.required_count,
                    proof.approve_count,
                    proof.approve_seat_hashes.len(),
                ),
            });
        }
        if proof.provider_classes != BTreeSet::from(FOUR_PROVIDER_CLASSES)
            || proof.evidence_classes != evidence.independent_evidence_classes
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::EvidenceFloor {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/quorum_proofs/floors".to_owned(),
                expected: format!(
                    "providers={FOUR_PROVIDER_CLASSES:?}, evidence={:?}",
                    evidence.independent_evidence_classes
                ),
                actual: format!(
                    "providers={:?}, evidence={:?}",
                    proof.provider_classes, proof.evidence_classes
                ),
            });
        }
        nonzero_hash("quorum_proof.proof_hash", proof.proof_hash)?;
    }
    for vote in &dispositions.council_votes {
        if vote.seat_kind != SeatKind::Council {
            return Err(ProtocolError::SeatKind {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/council_votes/seat_kind".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("{:?}", SeatKind::Council),
                actual: format!("{:?}", vote.seat_kind),
            });
        }
        signature_shape(
            "CouncilDispositionV1",
            SignedPayloadTarget::CouncilDispositionV1,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_target,
            vote.signature.signing_key_id,
            vote.signature.verification_key,
            vote.signature.signature,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for vote in &dispositions.ai_irb_votes {
        if vote.seat_kind != SeatKind::AiIrb {
            return Err(ProtocolError::SeatKind {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/ai_irb_votes/seat_kind".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("{:?}", SeatKind::AiIrb),
                actual: format!("{:?}", vote.seat_kind),
            });
        }
        signature_shape(
            "AiIrbDispositionV1",
            SignedPayloadTarget::AiIrbDispositionV1,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_target,
            vote.signature.signing_key_id,
            vote.signature.verification_key,
            vote.signature.signature,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for vote in &dispositions.ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions {
        if vote.seat_kind != SeatKind::AiIrb {
            return Err(ProtocolError::SeatKind {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions/seat_kind".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("{:?}", SeatKind::AiIrb),
                actual: format!("{:?}", vote.seat_kind),
            });
        }
        signature_shape(
            "AiIrbDispositionV1",
            SignedPayloadTarget::AiIrbDispositionV1,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_target,
            vote.signature.signing_key_id,
            vote.signature.verification_key,
            vote.signature.signature,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for dissent in &dispositions.dissents {
        let expected = match dissent.context {
            DissentContext::Authorization => DissentEffect::AuthorizationBlocked,
            DissentContext::Monitoring => DissentEffect::ChairAlertAndContinuingReview,
        };
        if dissent.effect != expected {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/dissents/effect".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("{expected:?}"),
                actual: format!("{:?}", dissent.effect),
            });
        }
        if dissent.signed_choice == DispositionChoice::Approve
            || (dissent.context == DissentContext::Monitoring
                && dissent.chair_alert_receipt_hash.is_none())
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/dissents/source".to_owned(),
                expected: "negative source and monitoring Chair-alert reference".to_owned(),
                actual: format!("{:?}", dissent),
            });
        }
        signature_shape(
            "DissentV1",
            SignedPayloadTarget::DissentV1,
            dissent.signature.signed_payload_target,
            dissent.signature.signing_key_id,
            dissent.signature.verification_key,
            dissent.signature.signature,
            dissent.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for chair in &dispositions.chair_interventions {
        let expected = match chair.choice {
            ChairChoice::Approve => ChairEffect::EndorsementOnly,
            ChairChoice::Reject => ChairEffect::ScopedHumanOverrideHold,
            ChairChoice::Abstain | ChairChoice::Comment => ChairEffect::NoAuthorityEffect,
        };
        if chair.effect != expected {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: "/disposition_bundle/chair_interventions/effect".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("{expected:?}"),
                actual: format!("{:?}", chair.effect),
            });
        }
        signature_shape(
            "ChairInterventionV1",
            SignedPayloadTarget::ChairInterventionV1,
            chair.signature.signed_payload_target,
            chair.signature.signing_key_id,
            chair.signature.verification_key,
            chair.signature.signature,
            chair.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    validate_hash_references(
        "disposition_bundle.kernel_verdicts",
        &dispositions.kernel_verdicts,
    )
}

fn validate_learning(learning: &SystemicLearningManifest) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    for record in &learning.records {
        basis_points(
            "systemic_learning_record.causal_confidence_basis_points",
            record.causal_confidence_basis_points,
        )?;
    }
    validate_hash_references(
        "systemic_learning_manifest.candidate_roadmap_scenarios",
        &learning.candidate_roadmap_scenarios,
    )
}

fn validate_commercial(commercial: &CommercialBoundary) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    required(
        "commercial_boundary.metering_class",
        &commercial.metering_class,
    )?;
    nonzero_hash(
        "commercial_boundary.bailment_licensure_hash",
        commercial.bailment_licensure_hash,
    )?;
    nonzero_hash(
        "commercial_boundary.permitted_use_hash",
        commercial.permitted_use_hash,
    )
}

pub(super) fn validate_receipt_manifest(receipts: &ReceiptManifest) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if receipts.preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "receipt_manifest.preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts",
        });
    }
    let allowed = [
        BctsState::Draft,
        BctsState::Submitted,
        BctsState::IdentityResolved,
        BctsState::ConsentValidated,
        BctsState::Deliberated,
        BctsState::Verified,
        BctsState::Governed,
        BctsState::Approved,
    ];
    for (index, receipt) in receipts
        .preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
    {
        if allowed.get(index) != Some(&receipt.lifecycle_state) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::GraphMismatch {
                path: format!(
                    "/receipt_manifest/preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts/{index}/lifecycle_state",
                ),
                expected: format!("{:?}", allowed.get(index)),
                actual: format!("{:?}", receipt.lifecycle_state),
            });
        }
        if let Some(root) = receipt.authorized_package_root {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CurrentReceiptCommitmentCycle {
                path: format!(
                    "/receipt_manifest/preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts/{index}/authorized_package_root",
                ),
                expected: "null for every in-package preauthorization receipt".to_owned(),
                actual: root.to_string(),
            });
        }
        nonzero_hash(
            "preauthorization_lifecycle_receipt.receipt_hash",
            receipt.receipt_hash,
        )?;
    }
    let publication = receipts.publication_authorization_receipt.as_ref().ok_or(
        ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "receipt_manifest.publication_authorization_receipt",
        },
    )?;
    signature_shape(
        "PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1",
        SignedPayloadTarget::PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1,
        publication.signature.signed_payload_target,
        publication.signature.signing_key_id,
        publication.signature.verification_key,
        publication.signature.signature,
        publication.signature.signed_payload_hash,
    )?;
    nonzero_hash(
        "receipt_manifest.final_package_root",
        receipts.final_package_root,
    )?;
    if let Some(genesis) = &receipts.genesis_adoption_receipt {
        let chronology_entries = &genesis.evidence_bundle.chronology_entries;
        if chronology_entries.is_empty() {
            return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
                field: "genesis_evidence_bundle.chronology_entries",
            });
        }
        let latest_occurred_at = chronology_entries
            .iter()
            .map(|entry| entry.occurred_at)
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(genesis.effect_starts_at);
        if genesis.effect_starts_at <= latest_occurred_at {
            return Err(ProtocolError::GenesisProvenance {
                path: "/receipt_manifest/genesis_adoption_receipt/effect_starts_at".to_owned(),
                expected: format!("strictly after {latest_occurred_at:?}"),
                actual: format!("{:?}", genesis.effect_starts_at),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn signature_shape(
    target_name: &'static str,
    expected_target: SignedPayloadTarget,
    actual_target: SignedPayloadTarget,
    signing_key_id: ProtocolHash256,
    verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey,
    signature: Ed25519Signature,
    payload_hash: ProtocolHash256,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if actual_target != expected_target {
        return Err(ProtocolError::SignatureTargetMismatch {
            expected: target_name,
            actual: format!("{actual_target:?}"),
        });
    }
    nonzero_hash("signature.signing_key_id", signing_key_id)?;
    nonzero_key("signature.verification_key", verification_key)?;
    if signature == Ed25519Signature::ZERO {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed {
            field: "signature.signature",
        });
    }
    nonzero_hash("signature.signed_payload_hash", payload_hash)
}

fn validate_hash_references(
    collection: &'static str,
    references: &[HashReference],
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    for reference in references {
        required("hash_reference.kind", &reference.kind)?;
        required("hash_reference.media_type", &reference.media_type)?;
        nonzero_hash("hash_reference.content_hash", reference.content_hash)?;
    }
    sorted_by(collection, references, |value| {
        (
            value.kind.clone(),
            value.content_hash,
            value.media_type.clone(),
        )
    })
}

fn required(field: &'static str, value: &str) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if value.is_empty() {
        Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue { field })
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn basis_points(field: &'static str, value: u16) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if value > 10_000 {
        Err(ProtocolError::BasisPointsOutOfRange { field, value })
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub(super) fn nonzero_hash(field: &'static str, value: ProtocolHash256) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if value == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
        Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed { field })
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub(super) fn nonzero_key(field: &'static str, value: Ed25519VerificationKey) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if value == Ed25519VerificationKey::ZERO {
        Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed { field })
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn nonempty_strings(field: &'static str, values: &[String]) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if values.is_empty() || values.iter().any(String::is_empty) {
        Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue { field })
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn unique_strings(collection: &'static str, values: &[String]) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    for value in values {
        if !seen.insert(value) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::DuplicateIdentifier {
                collection,
                id: value.clone(),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn nonempty_set<T>(field: &'static str, values: &BTreeSet<T>) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if values.is_empty() {
        Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue { field })
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn exact_len(field: &'static str, actual: usize, expected: usize) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if actual == expected {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: format!("/{field}"),
            expected,
            actual,
        })
    }
}

fn unique_ids(
    collection: &'static str,
    values: impl IntoIterator<Item = ProtocolUuid>,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    for value in values {
        if !seen.insert(value) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::DuplicateIdentifier {
                collection,
                id: value.to_string(),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn sorted_by<T, K: Ord>(
    collection: &'static str,
    values: &[T],
    key: impl Fn(&T) -> K,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    for (index, pair) in values.windows(2).enumerate() {
        if key(&pair[0]) >= key(&pair[1]) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidOrder {
                collection,
                index: index + 1,
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
pub const PEER_REVIEWED_PROTOCOL_PACKAGE_V1_HASH_DOMAIN: &str =

pub fn domain_hash<T: Serialize + ?Sized>(
    domain: ProtocolHashDomain,
    value: &T,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    let bytes = canonical_protocol_cbor(&(domain.as_str(), value))?;
    Ok(ProtocolHash256::from_bytes(
        *blake3::hash(&bytes).as_bytes(),
    ))
}
```

```rust
pub fn authorization_target(package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1) -> AuthorizationTargetV1 {
    let mut reviews = package.review_bundle.clone();
    for review in &mut reviews.signed_reviews {
        review.authorization_target_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
        review.signature.signed_payload_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
        review.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::ZERO;
    }
    AuthorizationTargetV1 {
        schema_version: package.schema_version,
        protocol_identity: package.protocol_identity.clone(),
        protocol_document: package.protocol_document.clone(),
        protocol_envelope: package.protocol_envelope.clone(),
        evidence_manifest: package.evidence_manifest.clone(),
        review_bundle: reviews,
        monitoring_plan: package.monitoring_plan.clone(),
        systemic_learning_manifest: package.systemic_learning_manifest.clone(),
        commercial_boundary: package.commercial_boundary.clone(),
        receipt_manifest: AuthorizationTargetReceiptManifestV1 {
            preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts: package
                .receipt_manifest
                .preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts
                .clone(),
            prior_execution_receipt_chain: package
                .receipt_manifest
                .prior_execution_receipt_chain
                .clone(),
            genesis_adoption_receipt: package.receipt_manifest.genesis_adoption_receipt.clone(),
        },
    }
}

pub fn authorization_target_hash(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolAuthorizationTargetV1,
        &authorization_target(package),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn normalized_prepublication(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> PrepublicationPackageV1 {
    let mut normalized = package.clone();
    normalized
        .receipt_manifest
        .publication_authorization_receipt = None;
    normalized.receipt_manifest.final_package_root = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    PrepublicationPackageV1(normalized)
}

pub fn prepublication_root(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::PrepublicationPackageV1,
        &normalized_prepublication(package),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn normalized_final(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> NormalizedFinalPackageV1 {
    let mut normalized = package.clone();
    normalized.receipt_manifest.final_package_root = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    NormalizedFinalPackageV1(normalized)
}

pub fn recompute_final_package_root(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
        &normalized_final(package),
    )
}
```
