```rust
}

pub(crate) fn normalized_genesis_adoption_receipt(
    receipt: &GenesisAdoptionReceipt,
) -> GenesisAdoptionReceipt {
    let mut normalized = receipt.clone();
    normalized.receipt_root = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    normalized
}

pub fn verify_genesis_adoption_receipt(
    receipt: &GenesisAdoptionReceipt,
    current: CurrentPackageCommitments,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    let bundle = &receipt.evidence_bundle;
    let expected_bundle_hash = genesis_evidence_bundle_hash(bundle)?;
    if receipt.evidence_bundle_hash != expected_bundle_hash {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "genesis_evidence_bundle",
            expected: expected_bundle_hash,
            actual: receipt.evidence_bundle_hash,
        });
    }
    if bundle.chronology_entries.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "genesis_evidence_bundle.chronology_entries",
        });
    }

    let mut previous_entry_hash: Option<ProtocolHash256> = None;
    let mut previous_sort_key = None;
    let mut artifact_content_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut observed_hashes = vec![
        receipt.protocol_version_hash,
        receipt.evidence_bundle_hash,
        receipt.issuer_key_id,
        receipt.receipt_root,
        bundle.chronology_root,
    ];
    for (index, entry) in bundle.chronology_entries.iter().enumerate() {
        if entry.predecessor_entry_hash != previous_entry_hash {
            return Err(ProtocolError::GenesisProvenance {
                path: format!(
                    "/receipt_manifest/genesis_adoption_receipt/evidence_bundle/chronology_entries/{index}/predecessor_entry_hash"
                ),
                expected: format!("{previous_entry_hash:?}"),
                actual: format!("{:?}", entry.predecessor_entry_hash),
            });
        }
        let sort_key = (entry.occurred_at, entry.act_kind, entry.act_id);
        if previous_sort_key.is_some_and(|previous| sort_key <= previous) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidOrder {
                collection: "genesis_evidence_bundle.chronology_entries",
                index,
            });
        }
        previous_sort_key = Some(sort_key);
        artifact_content_hashes.insert(entry.artifact_content_hash);
        observed_hashes.push(entry.artifact_content_hash);
        observed_hashes.push(entry.artifact_path_hash);
        observed_hashes.push(entry.provenance_hash);
        if let Some(predecessor) = entry.predecessor_entry_hash {
            observed_hashes.push(predecessor);
        }
        previous_entry_hash = Some(domain_hash(
            ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalActChronologyEntryV1,
            entry,
        )?);
    }
    let expected_chronology_root = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalActChronologyV1,
        &bundle.chronology_entries,
    )?;
    if bundle.chronology_root != expected_chronology_root {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "genesis_chronology_root",
            expected: expected_chronology_root,
            actual: bundle.chronology_root,
        });
    }

    let mut normalized_artifact_set = bundle.historical_artifact_set.clone();
    normalized_artifact_set.artifact_set_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    let expected_artifact_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalArtifactSetCommitmentV1,
        &normalized_artifact_set,
    )?;
    if bundle.historical_artifact_set.artifact_set_hash != expected_artifact_set_hash
        || bundle.historical_artifact_set.artifact_entry_hashes != artifact_content_hashes
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "genesis_historical_artifact_set",
            expected: expected_artifact_set_hash,
            actual: bundle.historical_artifact_set.artifact_set_hash,
        });
    }
    let artifact_set_hash = bundle.historical_artifact_set.artifact_set_hash;
    observed_hashes.push(artifact_set_hash);
    observed_hashes.extend(bundle.historical_artifact_set.artifact_entry_hashes.iter());

    let proof = &bundle.unchanged_content_proof;
    if !proof.exact_set_equal
        || proof.submitted_artifact_set_hash != artifact_set_hash
        || proof.reviewed_artifact_set_hash != artifact_set_hash
        || proof.unchanged_content_set_hash != artifact_set_hash
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::GenesisProvenance {
            path: "/receipt_manifest/genesis_adoption_receipt/evidence_bundle/unchanged_content_proof"
                .to_owned(),
            expected: "exact_set_equal=true with submitted, reviewed, and unchanged hashes equal to the historical artifact set hash".to_owned(),
            actual: "unchanged-content equality proof is not self-consistent".to_owned(),
        });
    }
    observed_hashes.push(proof.submitted_artifact_set_hash);
    observed_hashes.push(proof.reviewed_artifact_set_hash);
    observed_hashes.push(proof.unchanged_content_set_hash);

    let mut normalized_coverage = bundle.ordinary_blinded_review.clone();
    normalized_coverage.coverage_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    let expected_coverage_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalBlindReviewCoverageV1,
        &normalized_coverage,
    )?;
    let coverage = &bundle.ordinary_blinded_review;
    if coverage.coverage_hash != expected_coverage_hash
        || coverage.reviewed_artifact_set_hash != artifact_set_hash
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "genesis_blind_review_coverage",
            expected: expected_coverage_hash,
            actual: coverage.coverage_hash,
        });
    }
    observed_hashes.push(coverage.coverage_hash);
    observed_hashes.push(coverage.verified_reveal_hash);
    observed_hashes.push(coverage.reviewed_artifact_set_hash);
    observed_hashes.extend(coverage.assignment_hashes.iter());
    observed_hashes.extend(coverage.assignment_commitment_hashes.iter());
    observed_hashes.extend(coverage.sealed_review_hashes.iter());
    observed_hashes.extend(coverage.reviewer_qualification_hashes.iter());
    observed_hashes.extend(coverage.disposition_hashes.iter());

    if receipt.signature.signed_payload_target != SignedPayloadTarget::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::SignatureTargetMismatch {
            expected: "GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1",
            actual: format!("{:?}", receipt.signature.signed_payload_target),
        });
    }
    verify_envelope(
        ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionSigningPayloadV1,
        "GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1",
        &GenesisAdoptionSigningPayloadV1::from(receipt),
        receipt.signature.signing_key_id,
        receipt.signature.verification_key,
        receipt.signature.signature,
        receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash,
    )?;
    observed_hashes.push(receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash);
    observed_hashes.push(receipt.signature.signing_key_id);

    let forbidden = [
        current.authorization_target_hash,
        current.prepublication_root,
        current.final_package_root,
    ];
    if observed_hashes.iter().any(|hash| forbidden.contains(hash)) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::GenesisCommitmentCycle {
            field: "genesis_adoption_receipt",
        });
    }

    let normalized = normalized_genesis_adoption_receipt(receipt);
    let expected = domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1, &normalized)?;
    if expected != receipt.receipt_root {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "genesis_adoption_receipt",
            expected,
            actual: receipt.receipt_root,
        });
    }
    Ok(expected)
}

pub fn verify_v1_package_root(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    trust: &VerifiedPackageTrustRegistryV1,
) -> Result<VerifiedPackageRoot, ProtocolError> {
    validate_protocol_structure(package)?;
    if package.protocol_identity.version != 1
        || package.protocol_identity.prior_version_hash.is_some()
        || package
            .receipt_manifest
            .prior_execution_receipt_chain
            .is_some()
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence {
            version: package.protocol_identity.version,
        });
    }
    verify_package_self_consistency(package)?;
    let computed_version = protocol_version_hash(&package.protocol_identity)?;
    let authorization = authorization_target_hash(package)?;
    let prepublication = prepublication_root(package)?;
    trust.verify_package_graph(package, computed_version, authorization)?;
    validate_context_graph(package, computed_version, authorization, prepublication)?;
    if let Some(genesis) = &package.receipt_manifest.genesis_adoption_receipt {
        verify_genesis_adoption_receipt(
            genesis,
            CurrentPackageCommitments {
                authorization_target_hash: authorization,
                prepublication_root: prepublication,
                final_package_root: package.receipt_manifest.final_package_root,
            },
        )?;
    }
    let expected = recompute_final_package_root(package)?;
    let actual = package.receipt_manifest.final_package_root;
    if expected != actual {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "final_package_root",
            expected,
            actual,
        });
    }
    Ok(VerifiedPackageRoot {
        tenant_id: package.protocol_identity.tenant_id.clone(),
        protocol_id: package.protocol_identity.protocol_id.clone(),
        protocol_version: package.protocol_identity.version,
        protocol_version_hash: computed_version,
        final_package_root: actual,
        verified_predecessor: None,
    })
}

pub(super) fn verify_package_self_consistency(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    verify_commitment_scheme(&package.receipt_manifest.commitment_scheme)?;
    let authorization = authorization_target_hash(package)?;
    for attestation in all_attestations(&package.review_bundle) {
        verify_envelope(
            ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationSigningPayloadV1,
            "SeatAttestationV1",
            &SeatAttestationSigningPayloadV1::from(attestation),
            attestation.signature.signing_key_id,
            attestation.signature.verification_key,
            attestation.signature.signature,
            attestation.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for review in &package.review_bundle.signed_reviews {
        if review.authorization_target_hash != authorization {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
                component: "peer_review.authorization_target_hash",
                expected: authorization,
                actual: review.authorization_target_hash,
            });
        }
        verify_envelope(
            ProtocolHashDomain::PeerReviewSigningPayloadV1,
            "PeerReviewV1",
            &PeerReviewSigningPayloadV1::from(review),
            review.signature.signing_key_id,
            review.signature.verification_key,
            review.signature.signature,
            review.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for vote in &package.disposition_bundle.council_votes {
        if vote.authorization_target_hash != authorization {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
                component: "council_vote.authorization_target_hash",
                expected: authorization,
                actual: vote.authorization_target_hash,
            });
        }
        verify_envelope(
            ProtocolHashDomain::CouncilDispositionSigningPayloadV1,
            "CouncilDispositionV1",
            &CouncilDispositionSigningPayloadV1::from(vote),
            vote.signature.signing_key_id,
            vote.signature.verification_key,
            vote.signature.signature,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for vote in &package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_votes {
        if vote.authorization_target_hash != authorization {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
                component: "ai_irb_vote.authorization_target_hash",
                expected: authorization,
                actual: vote.authorization_target_hash,
            });
        }
        verify_envelope(
            ProtocolHashDomain::AiIrbDispositionSigningPayloadV1,
            "AiIrbDispositionV1",
            &AiIrbDispositionSigningPayloadV1::from(vote),
            vote.signature.signing_key_id,
            vote.signature.verification_key,
            vote.signature.signature,
            vote.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    for intervention in &package.disposition_bundle.chair_interventions {
        if intervention.authorization_target_hash != authorization {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
                component: "chair_intervention.authorization_target_hash",
                expected: authorization,
                actual: intervention.authorization_target_hash,
            });
        }
        verify_envelope(
            ProtocolHashDomain::ChairInterventionSigningPayloadV1,
            "ChairInterventionV1",
            &ChairInterventionSigningPayloadV1::from(intervention),
            intervention.signature.signing_key_id,
            intervention.signature.verification_key,
            intervention.signature.signature,
            intervention.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        )?;
    }
    let publication = package
        .receipt_manifest
        .publication_authorization_receipt
        .as_ref()
        .ok_or(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "receipt_manifest.publication_authorization_receipt",
        })?;
    let expected_prepublication = prepublication_root(package)?;
    if publication.prepublication_root != expected_prepublication {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "publication_authorization.prepublication_root",
            expected: expected_prepublication,
            actual: publication.prepublication_root,
        });
    }
    if publication.publisher_did != publication.publisher_authority.publisher_did
        || publication.signature.signing_key_id != publication.publisher_authority.signing_key_id
        || publication.signature.verification_key
            != publication.publisher_authority.verification_key
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/receipt_manifest/publication_authorization_receipt/publisher_authority"
                .to_owned(),
            expected: "publisher DID, signing key id, and verification key equal signature context"
                .to_owned(),
            actual: "publication authority/signature context mismatch".to_owned(),
        });
    }
    verify_envelope(
        ProtocolHashDomain::PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1,
        "PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1",
        &PublicationAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1::from(publication),
        publication.signature.signing_key_id,
        publication.signature.verification_key,
        publication.signature.signature,
        publication.signature.signed_payload_hash,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn verify_envelope<T: Serialize + ?Sized>(
    domain: ProtocolHashDomain,
    target: &'static str,
    payload: &T,
    signing_key_id: ProtocolHash256,
    verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey,
    signature: Ed25519Signature,
    stored_payload_hash: ProtocolHash256,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let expected = domain_hash(domain, payload)?;
    if expected != stored_payload_hash {
        return Err(ProtocolError::SignaturePayloadMismatch { target });
    }
    if signing_key_id == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed {
            field: "signature.signing_key_id",
        });
    }
    let public = PublicKey::from_bytes(*verification_key.as_bytes());
    let signature = Signature::Ed25519(*signature.as_bytes());
    if !crypto::verify(expected.as_bytes(), &signature, &public) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidSignature { target });
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

`verify_envelope` proves only that a supplied key signs the supplied body. It
must not be renamed to `verify_authority`, and its private visibility prevents
downstream code from treating package keys as trust anchors.

```rust
) -> (

pub(crate) fn seat_attestation(
    body: SeatKind,
    provider: ProviderClass,
    index: u8,
    seat_key: &KeyPair,
    controller_key: &KeyPair,
) -> SeatAttestation {
    let scope = match body {
        SeatKind::Council => AuthorityScope::CouncilSeatV1,
        SeatKind::AiIrb => AuthorityScope::AiIrbSeatV1,
    };
    let seat_id = did(&format!("did:exo:{:?}-{index}", body).to_ascii_lowercase());
    let mut value = SeatAttestation {
        tenant_id: "tenant-a".to_owned(),
        protocol_id: "DF-PROTOCOL-001".to_owned(),
        seat_id,
        seat_kind: body,
        provider_class: provider,
        controller_did: did(&format!("did:exo:controller-{index}")),
        independent_control_proof_hash: (provider == ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider)
            .then(|| hash(index.wrapping_add(80))),
        reviewer_identifier: format!("reviewer-{index}"),
        observable_version: "1".to_owned(),
        system_configuration_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(1)),
        sampling_parameters_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(2)),
        tool_policy_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(3)),
        context_manifest_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(4)),
        behavioral_fingerprint_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(5)),
        signing_key_id: hash(index.wrapping_add(6)),
        verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(*seat_key.public_key().as_bytes()),
        valid_from: Timestamp::new(1, 0),
        valid_until: Timestamp::new(100, 0),
        evidence_classes: if provider == ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider {
            BTreeSet::from([EvidenceClass::IndependentNonProviderEvidence])
        } else {
            BTreeSet::from([EvidenceClass::ProviderModelJudgment])
        },
        conflict_declaration_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(7)),
        authority_scope: scope,
        authority_chain_hash: hash(index.wrapping_add(8)),
        signature: SeatAttestationSignatureV1 {
            algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
            signing_key_id: hash(index.wrapping_add(9)),
            verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(
                *controller_key.public_key().as_bytes(),
            ),
            signature: Ed25519Signature::from_bytes([1; 64]),
            signed_payload_hash: hash(1),
            signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::SeatAttestationV1,
        },
    };
    let digest = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationSigningPayloadV1,
        &SeatAttestationSigningPayloadV1::from(&value),
    )
    .expect("attestation digest");
    let (key, bytes, key_id, target) = signature(
        controller_key,
        value.signature.signing_key_id,
        SignedPayloadTarget::SeatAttestationV1,
        digest,
    );
    value.signature.verification_key = key;
    value.signature.signature = bytes;
    value.signature.signing_key_id = key_id;
    value.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
    value.signature.signed_payload_target = target;
    value
}

// `df_protocol_001_*` integration-test binaries). Not every consumer of this
// shared module calls every genesis helper below (`df_protocol_001_wire` and
// `df_protocol_001_commitment` use none of them; the `--lib` target uses only
// `genesis_chronology_entry`/`genesis_evidence_bundle`/`genesis_adoption_receipt`
// transitively through `fixture::genesis_adoption_receipt`, not
// `genesis_issuer_key`/`sign_digest` directly), so each helper is annotated to
// stay warning-clean under `-D warnings` in every one of those independent
// compilation units without deleting a helper a sibling binary genuinely needs.
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn genesis_issuer_key(seed: u8) -> KeyPair {
    KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([seed; 32]).expect("genesis issuer fixture key")
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn sign_digest(key: &KeyPair, digest: ProtocolHash256) -> Ed25519Signature {
    let (_key, bytes, _key_id, _target) = signature(
        key,
        ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
        SignedPayloadTarget::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1,
        digest,
    );
    bytes
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn genesis_chronology_entry(
    seed: u8,
    act_kind: HistoricalActKindV1,
    occurred_at: Timestamp,
    predecessor_entry_hash: Option<ProtocolHash256>,
) -> HistoricalActChronologyEntryV1 {
    HistoricalActChronologyEntryV1 {
        act_id: uuid(seed),
        act_kind,
        status: HistoricalActStatusV1::CompletedBeforeProtocolActivation,
        git_object_id: GitObjectId::from_sha1_hex(&format!("{:040x}", u128::from(seed) + 1))
            .expect("typed historical Git object id"),
        artifact_content_hash: hash(seed.wrapping_add(1)),
        artifact_path_hash: hash(seed.wrapping_add(2)),
        occurred_at,
        provenance_hash: hash(seed.wrapping_add(3)),
        predecessor_entry_hash,
    }
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn genesis_evidence_bundle(
    chronology_entries: Vec<HistoricalActChronologyEntryV1>,
) -> GenesisEvidenceBundleV1 {
    let chronology_root = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalActChronologyV1,
        &chronology_entries,
    )
    .expect("chronology root");
    let artifact_entry_hashes = chronology_entries
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry.artifact_content_hash)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let artifact_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalArtifactSetCommitmentV1,
        &HistoricalArtifactSetCommitmentV1 {
            artifact_entry_hashes: artifact_entry_hashes.clone(),
            artifact_set_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
        },
    )
    .expect("artifact set hash");
    let historical_artifact_set = HistoricalArtifactSetCommitmentV1 {
        artifact_entry_hashes,
        artifact_set_hash,
    };
    let unchanged_content_proof = HistoricalArtifactSetEqualityProofV1 {
        submitted_artifact_set_hash: artifact_set_hash,
        reviewed_artifact_set_hash: artifact_set_hash,
        unchanged_content_set_hash: artifact_set_hash,
        exact_set_equal: true,
    };
    let coverage_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalBlindReviewCoverageV1,
        &HistoricalBlindReviewCoverageV1 {
            assignment_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(241)]),
            assignment_commitment_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(242)]),
            sealed_review_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(243)]),
            verified_reveal_hash: hash(244),
            reviewer_qualification_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(245)]),
            disposition_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(246)]),
            reviewed_artifact_set_hash: artifact_set_hash,
            coverage_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
        },
    )
    .expect("blind review coverage hash");
    let ordinary_blinded_review = HistoricalBlindReviewCoverageV1 {
        assignment_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(241)]),
        assignment_commitment_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(242)]),
        sealed_review_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(243)]),
        verified_reveal_hash: hash(244),
        reviewer_qualification_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(245)]),
        disposition_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(246)]),
        reviewed_artifact_set_hash: artifact_set_hash,
        coverage_hash,
    };
    GenesisEvidenceBundleV1 {
        chronology_entries,
        chronology_root,
        historical_artifact_set,
        unchanged_content_proof,
        ordinary_blinded_review,
    }
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn genesis_adoption_receipt(
    protocol_version_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    issuer_key: &KeyPair,
) -> GenesisAdoptionReceipt {
    let first_entry = genesis_chronology_entry(
        201,
        HistoricalActKindV1::DesignRecord,
        Timestamp::new(10, 0),
        None,
    );
    let first_entry_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::HistoricalActChronologyEntryV1,
        &first_entry,
    )
    .expect("first chronology entry hash");
    let second_entry = genesis_chronology_entry(
        205,
        HistoricalActKindV1::IndependentReview,
        Timestamp::new(20, 0),
        Some(first_entry_hash),
    );
    let evidence_bundle = genesis_evidence_bundle(vec![first_entry, second_entry]);
    let evidence_bundle_hash =
        genesis_evidence_bundle_hash(&evidence_bundle).expect("evidence bundle hash");
    let mut receipt = GenesisAdoptionReceipt {
        receipt_id: uuid(209),
        tenant_id: "tenant-a".to_owned(),
        protocol_id: "DF-PROTOCOL-001".to_owned(),
        protocol_version_hash,
        evidence_bundle_hash,
        evidence_bundle,
        prospective_effect: GenesisProspectiveEffectV1::AuthorizeSubsequentExecutionOnly,
        prospective_scope: GenesisProspectiveScopeV1::ExactReviewedProtocolEnvelopeOnly,
        effect_starts_at: Timestamp::new(30, 0),
        issuer_did: did("did:exo:genesis-issuer"),
        issuer_key_id: hash(247),
        signature: GenesisAdoptionSignatureV1 {
            algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
            signing_key_id: hash(247),
            verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(
                *issuer_key.public_key().as_bytes(),
            ),
            signature: Ed25519Signature::from_bytes([1; 64]),
            signed_payload_hash: hash(1),
            signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1,
        },
        receipt_root: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
    };
    let payload_digest = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionSigningPayloadV1,
        &GenesisAdoptionSigningPayloadV1::from(&receipt),
    )
    .expect("genesis signing payload digest");
    let (key, bytes, key_id, target) = signature(
        issuer_key,
        receipt.signature.signing_key_id,
        SignedPayloadTarget::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1,
        payload_digest,
    );
    receipt.signature.verification_key = key;
    receipt.signature.signature = bytes;
    receipt.signature.signing_key_id = key_id;
    receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash = payload_digest;
    receipt.signature.signed_payload_target = target;
    // `receipt.receipt_root` is still `ProtocolHash256::ZERO` at this point, so
    // hashing `receipt` directly is exactly the normalized-for-hashing form.
    receipt.receipt_root = domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1, &receipt)
        .expect("genesis receipt root");
    receipt
}

pub fn valid_v1_package() -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    let seat_keys = (0u8..10)
        .map(|index| KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([index.wrapping_add(1); 32]).expect("seat key"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let controller_keys = (0u8..10)
        .map(|index| {
            KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([index.wrapping_add(21); 32]).expect("controller key")
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let chair_key = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([41; 32]).expect("Chair key");
    let publisher_key = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([42; 32]).expect("publisher key");
    let providers = [
        ProviderClass::OpenAI,
        ProviderClass::Anthropic,
        ProviderClass::XAi,
        ProviderClass::AlphabetGoogleGemini,
        ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider,
    ];
    let council = (0..5)
        .map(|index| {
            seat_attestation(
                SeatKind::Council,
                providers[index],
                fixture_u8(index) + 1,
                &seat_keys[index],
                &controller_keys[index],
            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let irb = (0..5)
        .map(|index| {
            seat_attestation(
                SeatKind::AiIrb,
                providers[index],
                fixture_u8(index) + 11,
                &seat_keys[index + 5],
                &controller_keys[index + 5],
            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let council_roster = CouncilRoster {
        openai: council[0].clone(),
        anthropic: council[1].clone(),
        xai: council[2].clone(),
        alphabet_google_gemini: council[3].clone(),
        independent_non_provider: council[4].clone(),
    };
    let irb_roster = AiIrbRoster {
        openai: irb[0].clone(),
        anthropic: irb[1].clone(),
        xai: irb[2].clone(),
        alphabet_google_gemini: irb[3].clone(),
        independent_non_provider: irb[4].clone(),
    };
    let roles = [
        ReviewRole::Governance,
        ReviewRole::Legal,
        ReviewRole::Architecture,
        ReviewRole::Security,
        ReviewRole::Operations,
        ReviewRole::RiskBenefit,
        ReviewRole::Monitoring,
        ReviewRole::AdverseEvent,
        ReviewRole::ProgressiveEvent,
        ReviewRole::CorrectiveAction,
    ];
    let all_seats = council.iter().chain(irb.iter()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let identity = ProtocolIdentity {
        protocol_id: "DF-PROTOCOL-001".to_owned(),
        tenant_id: "tenant-a".to_owned(),
        constitutional_hash: hash(2),
        version: 1,
        prior_version_hash: None,
        lifecycle_state: BctsState::Approved,
        co_pi_dids: BTreeSet::from([did("did:exo:bob"), did("did:exo:codex")]),
        chair_did: did("did:exo:bob"),
        chair_authority: ChairAuthorityV1 {
            chair_did: did("did:exo:bob"),
            signing_key_id: hash(3),
            verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(
                *chair_key.public_key().as_bytes(),
            ),
            authority_chain_hash: hash(4),
        },
        domain: "governance".to_owned(),
    };
    let version = protocol_version_hash(&identity).expect("v1 protocol version");
    let mut assignment_seat_ids = BTreeMap::<ProtocolUuid, Did>::new();
    let mut assignments = (0..10)
        .map(|index| {
            let assignment = ReviewAssignment {
                assignment_id: uuid(fixture_u8(index) + 1),
                tenant_id: "tenant-alpha".to_owned(),
                protocol_id: "DF-PROTOCOL-001".to_owned(),
                seat_kind: all_seats[index].seat_kind,
                protocol_version_hash: version,
                review_role: roles[index],
                blind_assignment_commitment: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 71),
                ephemeral_reviewer_key_commitment: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 81),
                context_commitment: all_seats[index].context_manifest_hash,
                conflict_commitment: all_seats[index].conflict_declaration_hash,
                assigned_at: Timestamp::new(10 + fixture_u64(index), 0),
            };
            assignment_seat_ids.insert(assignment.assignment_id, all_seats[index].seat_id.clone());
            assignment
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assignments.sort_by_key(|value| (value.seat_kind, value.review_role, value.assignment_id));
    let mut reviews = assignments
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, assignment)| {
            let seat_id = assignment_seat_ids
                .get(&assignment.assignment_id)
                .expect("fixture assignment seat")
                .clone();
            let seat = all_seats
                .iter()
                .find(|seat| seat.seat_id == seat_id)
                .expect("assigned seat");
            PeerReview {
                review_id: uuid(fixture_u8(index) + 31),
                assignment_id: assignment.assignment_id,
                protocol_version_hash: version,
                criteria_results_hash: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 90),
                review_body_hash: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 100),
                disposition: PeerReviewDisposition::Approve,
                sealed_at: Timestamp::new(30 + fixture_u64(index), 0),
                authorization_target_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
                signature: PeerReviewSignatureV1 {
                    algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
                    signing_key_id: seat.signing_key_id,
                    verification_key: seat.verification_key,
                    signature: Ed25519Signature::ZERO,
                    signed_payload_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
                    signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::PeerReviewV1,
                },
            }
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    reviews.sort_by_key(|value| (value.assignment_id, value.review_id));
    let mut resolutions = reviews
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, review)| ReviewResolution {
            resolution_id: uuid(fixture_u8(index) + 51),
            review_id: review.review_id,
            comment_hash: review.review_body_hash,
            author_response_hash: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 120),
            revision_diff_hash: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 130),
            resolution: ReviewResolutionKind::Accepted,
            resolved_at: Timestamp::new(50 + fixture_u64(index), 0),
            signature_hash: hash(fixture_u8(index) + 140),
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    resolutions.sort_by_key(|value| (value.review_id, value.resolution_id));
    let mut package = PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
        schema_version: 1,
        protocol_identity: identity,
        protocol_document: ProtocolDocument {
            abstract_text: "abstract".to_owned(),
            purpose: "purpose".to_owned(),
            hypotheses: vec!["hypothesis".to_owned()],
            scope: "scope".to_owned(),
            architecture: "architecture".to_owned(),
            methods: vec!["method-a".to_owned(), "method-b".to_owned()],
            implementation_controls: vec!["control".to_owned()],
            risks: vec!["risk".to_owned()],
            benefits: vec!["benefit".to_owned()],
            consent_bailment_basis: "consent".to_owned(),
            data_handling: "data".to_owned(),
            threat_model: vec!["threat".to_owned()],
            monitoring: "monitor".to_owned(),
            stopping_rules: vec!["stop".to_owned()],
            evaluation_method: "deterministic".to_owned(),
            implementation_test_plan: vec!["test".to_owned()],
            claims: vec![hash_reference("claim", 5)],
            closeout_criteria: vec!["close".to_owned()],
        },
        protocol_envelope: ProtocolEnvelope {
            permitted_actions: BTreeSet::from(["review".to_owned()]),
            systems: BTreeSet::from(["decision-forum".to_owned()]),
            tenants: BTreeSet::from(["tenant-a".to_owned()]),
            datasets: BTreeSet::from([hash(249)]),
            actor_classes: BTreeSet::from(["reviewer".to_owned()]),
            resource_ceilings: BTreeMap::from([
                (ResourceKind::ActionCount, 10),
                (ResourceKind::ComputeMilliseconds, 9_007_199_254_740_991),
                (ResourceKind::MemoryBytes, 9_007_199_254_740_992),
                (ResourceKind::StorageBytes, u64::MAX),
            ]),
            risk_ceiling_basis_points: 100,
            starts_at: Timestamp::new(1, 0),
            ends_at: Timestamp::new(100, 0),
            phase_ladder: vec!["phase-1".to_owned(), "phase-2".to_owned()],
        },
        evidence_manifest: EvidenceManifest {
            items: vec![hash_reference("evidence", 6)],
            independent_evidence_classes: BTreeSet::from([
                IndependentEvidenceClass::DeterministicTest,
                IndependentEvidenceClass::IndependentNonProviderEvidence,
            ]),
            negative_or_inconclusive_results: vec![hash_reference("negative", 7)],
        },
        review_bundle: ReviewBundle {
            council_seat_attestations: council_roster,
            ai_irb_seat_attestations: irb_roster,
            assignments,
            blind_commitments: BTreeSet::from([hash(8)]),
            conflict_declarations: vec![hash_reference("conflict", 9)],
            signed_reviews: reviews,
            author_responses: (0u8..10)
                .map(|i| hash_reference(&format!("response-{i:02}"), i.wrapping_add(120)))
                .collect(),
            revision_diffs: (0u8..10)
                .map(|i| hash_reference(&format!("revision-{i:02}"), i.wrapping_add(130)))
                .collect(),
            resolution_matrix: resolutions,
            reveal_package_hash: Some(hash(50)),
        },
        disposition_bundle: DispositionBundle {
            council_eligible_set: council.iter().map(|value| value.seat_id.clone()).collect(),
            ai_irb_eligible_set: irb.iter().map(|value| value.seat_id.clone()).collect(),
            council_votes: Vec::new(),
            ai_irb_votes: Vec::new(),
            ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions: Vec::new(),
            dissents: Vec::new(),
            quorum_proofs: vec![quorum(SeatKind::Council, 1), quorum(SeatKind::AiIrb, 2)],
            chair_interventions: Vec::new(),
            kernel_verdicts: vec![hash_reference("kernel", 51)],
            authority_chain: authority_chain(&council, &irb, &chair_key, &publisher_key),
            binding_mode: BindingMode::Advisory,
        },
        monitoring_plan: MonitoringPlan {
            max_iterations: 25,
            success_stop_condition: "success".to_owned(),
            repeat_failure_limit: 2,
            escalation_destination: did("did:exo:bob"),
            scheduled_interval_hlc_units: 1,
            claim_thresholds: vec![hash_reference("claim-threshold", 246)],
            adverse_event_definitions: vec!["adverse".to_owned()],
            progressive_event_definitions: vec!["progressive".to_owned()],
            reporting_destinations: BTreeSet::from(["chair".to_owned()]),
            event_payload_type_domains: BTreeSet::from([
                "exo.decision_forum.protocol_event.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.investigator_designation.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.aar_rca_attestation.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.estop_disposition.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.estop_authorization.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.notification_attempt.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.capa_record.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.reset_authorization.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion_disposition.v1".to_owned(),
                "exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion.v1".to_owned(),
            ]),
        },
        systemic_learning_manifest: SystemicLearningManifest {
            records: vec![SystemicLearningRecord {
                record_id: uuid(90),
                source_event_id: uuid(91),
                prior_assumption_hash: hash(54),
                observed_evidence_hash: hash(55),
                causal_confidence_basis_points: 5000,
                changed_control_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(56)]),
                recurrence_result_hash: hash(57),
                affected_claim_hash: hash(58),
                candidate_roadmap_scenario_hashes: BTreeSet::from([hash(59)]),
                authority_effect: LearningAuthorityEffect::ContextOnlyNoEnactmentAuthority,
            }],
            candidate_roadmap_scenarios: vec![hash_reference("roadmap", 60)],
            authority_effect: LearningAuthorityEffect::ContextOnlyNoEnactmentAuthority,
        },
        commercial_boundary: CommercialBoundary {
            core_license: CoreLicense::Apache2,
            product_license_model: ProductLicenseModel::Commercial,
            bailment_licensure_hash: hash(52),
            permitted_use_hash: hash(53),
            metering_class: "core".to_owned(),
            usage_accounting_policy: UsageAccountingPolicy::ExoEconomyUseEventV1,
        },
        receipt_manifest: ReceiptManifest {
            commitment_scheme: commitment_scheme(),
            preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts: [
                BctsState::Draft,
                BctsState::Submitted,
                BctsState::IdentityResolved,
                BctsState::ConsentValidated,
                BctsState::Deliberated,
                BctsState::Verified,
                BctsState::Governed,
                BctsState::Approved,
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, state)| PreauthorizationLifecycleReceiptV1 {
                receipt_hash: hash(fixture_u8(i) + 150),
                lifecycle_state: state,
                authorized_package_root: None,
            })
            .collect(),
            prior_execution_receipt_chain: None,
            publication_authorization_receipt: None,
            genesis_adoption_receipt: None,
            final_package_root: hash(200),
        },
    };
    let authorization = authorization_target_hash(&package).expect("authorization target");
    for review in &mut package.review_bundle.signed_reviews {
        review.authorization_target_hash = authorization;
        let assignment = package
            .review_bundle
            .assignments
            .iter()
            .find(|value| value.assignment_id == review.assignment_id)
            .expect("assignment");
        let seat_id = assignment_seat_ids
            .get(&assignment.assignment_id)
            .expect("fixture assignment seat");
        let seat_index = all_seats
            .iter()
            .position(|value| value.seat_id == *seat_id)
            .expect("seat index");
        let digest = domain_hash(
            ProtocolHashDomain::PeerReviewSigningPayloadV1,
            &PeerReviewSigningPayloadV1::from(&*review),
        )
        .expect("review digest");
        let (key, bytes, key_id, target) = signature(
            &seat_keys[seat_index],
            all_seats[seat_index].signing_key_id,
            SignedPayloadTarget::PeerReviewV1,
            digest,
        );
        review.signature.verification_key = key;
        review.signature.signature = bytes;
        review.signature.signing_key_id = key_id;
        review.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
        review.signature.signed_payload_target = target;
    }

    let review_bundle_hash =
        domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::ReviewBundleV1, &package.review_bundle)
            .expect("review bundle hash");
    let council_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::EligibleSetV1,
        &(
            SeatKind::Council,
            &package.disposition_bundle.council_eligible_set,
        ),
    )
    .expect("Council eligible set hash");
    let ai_irb_set_hash = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::EligibleSetV1,
        &(
            SeatKind::AiIrb,
            &package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_eligible_set,
        ),
    )
    .expect("AI-IRB eligible set hash");
    package.disposition_bundle.council_votes = council
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, seat)| {
            let mut vote = CouncilDisposition {
                disposition_id: uuid(110 + fixture_u8(index)),
                seat_id: seat.seat_id.clone(),
                seat_kind: SeatKind::Council,
                choice: DispositionChoice::Approve,
                authorization_target_hash: authorization,
                protocol_version_hash: version,
                review_bundle_hash,
                eligible_set_hash: council_set_hash,
                seat_attestation_hash: domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationV1, seat)
                    .expect("seat hash"),
                context_manifest_hash: seat.context_manifest_hash,
                signed_at: Timestamp::new(70 + fixture_u64(index), 0),
                signature: CouncilDispositionSignatureV1 {
                    algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
                    signing_key_id: seat.signing_key_id,
                    verification_key: seat.verification_key,
                    signature: Ed25519Signature::ZERO,
                    signed_payload_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
                    signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::CouncilDispositionV1,
                },
            };
            let digest = domain_hash(
                ProtocolHashDomain::CouncilDispositionSigningPayloadV1,
                &CouncilDispositionSigningPayloadV1::from(&vote),
            )
            .expect("Council vote digest");
            let Signature::Ed25519(bytes) = seat_keys[index].sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
                panic!("fixture uses Ed25519");
            };
            vote.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
            vote.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
            vote
        })
        .collect();
    package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_votes = irb
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, seat)| {
            let mut vote = AiIrbDisposition {
                disposition_id: uuid(120 + fixture_u8(index)),
                seat_id: seat.seat_id.clone(),
                seat_kind: SeatKind::AiIrb,
                choice: DispositionChoice::Approve,
                authorization_target_hash: authorization,
                protocol_version_hash: version,
                review_bundle_hash,
                eligible_set_hash: ai_irb_set_hash,
                seat_attestation_hash: domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationV1, seat)
                    .expect("seat hash"),
                context_manifest_hash: seat.context_manifest_hash,
                signed_at: Timestamp::new(75 + fixture_u64(index), 0),
                signature: AiIrbDispositionSignatureV1 {
```

```rust
fn fixture_seat_key_map(start: u8) -> BTreeMap<Did, (KeyPair, ProtocolHash256)> {
    let package = valid_v1_package();
    seat_rows(&package)
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, seat)| {
            let seed = start
                .checked_add(u8::try_from(index).expect("ten seats"))
                .expect("fixture key seed");
            (
                seat.seat_id.clone(),
                (
                    KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([seed; 32]).expect("fixture seat key"),
                    seat.signing_key_id,
                ),
            )
        })
        .collect()
}

pub(crate) fn valid_peer_review_disposition_package(
    disposition: PeerReviewDisposition,
) -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    let mut package = valid_v1_package();
    package.review_bundle.signed_reviews[0].disposition = disposition;
    package.review_bundle.resolution_matrix[0].resolution = match disposition {
        PeerReviewDisposition::Approve => ReviewResolutionKind::Accepted,
        PeerReviewDisposition::ChangesRequired => ReviewResolutionKind::Accepted,
        PeerReviewDisposition::Reject => ReviewResolutionKind::ReasonedRejection,
    };
    let keys = fixture_seat_key_map(1);
    resign_complete_package_graph(
        &mut package,
        &keys,
        false,
        &KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([41; 32]).expect("Chair key"),
        &KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([42; 32]).expect("publisher key"),
    );
    package
}

pub(crate) fn valid_non_authorizing_negative_package() -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    let mut package = valid_v1_package();

    package.disposition_bundle.council_votes[0].choice = DispositionChoice::Reject;

    let chair = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([41; 32]).expect("Chair key");
    let publisher = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([42; 32]).expect("publisher key");
    resign_complete_package_graph(&mut package, &keys, false, &chair, &publisher);
    let source = package.disposition_bundle.council_votes[0].clone();
    package.disposition_bundle.dissents.push(DissentRecord {
        dissent_id: uuid(246),
        tenant_id: package.protocol_identity.tenant_id.clone(),
        protocol_id: package.protocol_identity.protocol_id.clone(),
        protocol_version_hash: source.protocol_version_hash,
        authorization_target_hash: source.authorization_target_hash,
        body: SeatKind::Council,
        seat_id: source.seat_id.clone(),
        source_kind: DissentSourceKind::CouncilAuthorizationDisposition,
        source_disposition_id: source.disposition_id,
        source_signed_payload_hash: source.signature.signed_payload_hash,
        signed_choice: source.choice,
        context: DissentContext::Authorization,
        effect: DissentEffect::AuthorizationBlocked,
        recorded_at: Timestamp::new(900, 0),
        chair_alert_receipt_hash: Some(hash(247)),
        signature: DissentSignatureV1 {
            algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
            signing_key_id: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
            verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::ZERO,
            signature: Ed25519Signature::ZERO,
            signed_payload_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
            signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::DissentV1,
        },
    });
    resign_complete_package_graph(&mut package, &keys, false, &chair, &publisher);
    package
}

pub(crate) fn valid_missing_vote_package() -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    let mut package = valid_v1_package();
    package.disposition_bundle.binding_mode = BindingMode::Advisory;
    package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_votes.pop();
    let keys = fixture_seat_key_map(1);

    let source = package.disposition_bundle.ai_irb_monitoring_dispositions[0].clone();
    package.disposition_bundle.dissents.push(DissentRecord {
        dissent_id: uuid(249),

        body: SeatKind::AiIrb,

        source_signed_payload_hash: source.signature.signed_payload_hash,

    package
}

pub(crate) fn fully_resigned_attacker_package() -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    let mut package = valid_v1_package();
    let keys = fixture_seat_key_map(31);
    let controllers = (0u8..10)
        .map(|index| KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([51 + index; 32]).expect("attacker controller key"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let providers = [
        ProviderClass::OpenAI,
        ProviderClass::Anthropic,
        ProviderClass::XAi,
        ProviderClass::AlphabetGoogleGemini,
        ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider,
    ];
    let seat_keys = (0u8..10)
        .map(|index| KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([31 + index; 32]).expect("attacker seat key"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let council = (0..5)
        .map(|index| {
            seat_attestation(
                SeatKind::Council,
                providers[index],
                fixture_u8(index) + 1,
                &seat_keys[index],

            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let irb = (0..5)
        .map(|index| {

                providers[index],
                fixture_u8(index) + 11,
                &seat_keys[index + 5],
                &controllers[index + 5],

    package.review_bundle.council_seat_attestations = CouncilRoster {
        openai: council[0].clone(),

        xai: council[2].clone(),
        alphabet_google_gemini: council[3].clone(),

    package.review_bundle.ai_irb_seat_attestations = AiIrbRoster {
        openai: irb[0].clone(),
        anthropic: irb[1].clone(),
        xai: irb[2].clone(),
        alphabet_google_gemini: irb[3].clone(),
        independent_non_provider: irb[4].clone(),

    resign_complete_package_graph(

        &keys,
        false,

    package
```

```rust
        proof_id: uuid(byte),
        seat_kind: kind,

fn authority_chain(
    council: &[SeatAttestation],
    irb: &[SeatAttestation],
    chair_key: &KeyPair,
    publisher_key: &KeyPair,
) -> Vec<AuthorityChainReferenceV1> {
    let mut values = council
        .iter()
        .chain(irb.iter())
        .map(|seat| AuthorityChainReferenceV1 {
            binding_kind: AuthorityBindingKind::SeatAuthority,
            tenant_id: seat.tenant_id.clone(),
            protocol_id: seat.protocol_id.clone(),
            actor_did: seat.seat_id.clone(),
            controller_did: seat.controller_did.clone(),
            scope: seat.authority_scope,
            signing_key_id: seat.signing_key_id,
            verification_key: seat.verification_key,
            authority_chain_hash: seat.authority_chain_hash,
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    for (did_value, scope, signing_key_id, verification_key, authority_chain_hash) in [
        (
            "did:exo:bob",
            AuthorityScope::ChairInterventionV1,
            hash(3),
            Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(*chair_key.public_key().as_bytes()),
            hash(4),
        ),
        (
            "did:exo:publisher",
            AuthorityScope::PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1,
            hash(202),
            Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(*publisher_key.public_key().as_bytes()),
            hash(203),
        ),
    ] {
        values.push(AuthorityChainReferenceV1 {
            binding_kind: AuthorityBindingKind::NonSeatAuthority,
            tenant_id: "tenant-a".to_owned(),
            protocol_id: "DF-PROTOCOL-001".to_owned(),
            actor_did: did(did_value),
            controller_did: did(did_value),
            scope,
            signing_key_id,
            verification_key,
            authority_chain_hash,
        });
    }
    values.sort_by_key(|value| (value.binding_kind, value.scope, value.actor_did.clone()));
    values
}
```

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum CommitmentLayer {
    Authorization,
    Prepublication,
    Final,
}

fn mutate(
    mut package: decision_forum::protocol::PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    path: &str,
) -> decision_forum::protocol::PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    let mut value = serde_json::to_value(&package).expect("fixture JSON");
    let target = value
        .pointer_mut(path)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing pointer {path}"));
    match target {
        serde_json::Value::String(text) if text.len() == 64 => {
            *text = if text.starts_with('f') {
                "e".repeat(64)
            } else {
                "f".repeat(64)
            };
        }
        serde_json::Value::String(text) => text.push_str("-changed"),
        serde_json::Value::Number(number) => {
            let next = number.as_u64().expect("u64") + 1;
            *number = next.into();
        }
        serde_json::Value::Bool(value) => *value = !*value,
        _ => panic!("unsupported mutation pointer {path}"),
    }
    package = serde_json::from_value(value).expect("mutated typed package");
    package
}

            "/disposition_bundle/authority_chain/0/authority_chain_hash",
            CommitmentLayer::Prepublication,
        ),
        (
            "/receipt_manifest/publication_authorization_receipt/renderer_manifest_hash",
            CommitmentLayer::Final,
        ),
    ];
    for (path, layer) in matrix {
        let changed = mutate(package.clone(), path);
        match layer {
            CommitmentLayer::Authorization => assert_ne!(
                authorization_target_hash(&changed).expect("changed authorization"),
                authorization,
                "{path}"
            ),
            CommitmentLayer::Prepublication | CommitmentLayer::Final => assert_eq!(
                authorization_target_hash(&changed).expect("unchanged authorization"),
                authorization,
                "{path}"
            ),
        }
        match layer {
            CommitmentLayer::Final => assert_eq!(
                prepublication_root(&changed).expect("unchanged prepublication"),
                prepublication,
                "{path}"
            ),
            _ => assert_ne!(
                prepublication_root(&changed).expect("changed prepublication"),
                prepublication,
                "{path}"
            ),
        }
        assert_ne!(
            decision_forum::protocol::recompute_final_package_root(&changed)
                .expect("changed final"),
            final_root,
            "{path}",
        );
    }
}
```

Gate 13 treats the original rows plus this delta as one inventory: for both v1
and v2 it requires all nine scalar suffixes, the monitoring-disposition array,
and all ten exact monitoring domains; for each governed record it compares the
literal top-level field set, signature field set, set-field list, and recursive
concrete-pointer count with the canonical full vector. It then removes every
required leaf, duplicates every declared set member, changes every signed leaf,
and executes all 16 wrong-domain/wrong-target and six cross-link cases. Missing,
extra, or unexecuted delta rows fail the test. Signed-leaf changes must fail the
exact signature; record-only receipt fields must change the record-domain hash.
