The permanent Gate-13 owner uses the correct crate-root include path and
strictly typed rows. `ExplicitOperation` and `ExplicitRejection` are internally
tagged enums covering exactly `replace`, `populate`, `swap`, `append`,
`replace_index`, `remove`, and `duplicate`; every variant carries only the
fields visible in the frozen bytes and all row structs use
`#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]`.

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum FixtureName {
    V1,
    V2,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
enum PointerKind {
    Leaf,
    Optional,
    OrderedArray,
    SetArray,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum CommitmentLayer {
    Authorization,
    Prepublication,
    Final,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum RootEffect {
    Changes,
    Equal,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
enum ErrorVariant {
    TransportShape,
    Cardinality,
    CommitmentMismatch,
    CrossBinding,
    GraphMismatch,
    AuthorityChainMismatch,
    ReceiptFork,
    PredecessorMismatch,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "operation", rename_all = "snake_case", deny_unknown_fields)]
enum ExplicitOperation {
    Replace {
        value: serde_json::Value,
        root_effect: RootEffect,
    },
    Populate {
        value: serde_json::Value,
        root_effect: RootEffect,
    },
    Swap {
        left: usize,
        right: usize,
        root_effect: RootEffect,
    },
    Append {
        value: serde_json::Value,
        root_effect: RootEffect,
    },
    ReplaceIndex {
        index: usize,
        value: serde_json::Value,
        root_effect: RootEffect,
    },
}
impl ExplicitOperation {
    fn root_effect(&self) -> RootEffect {
        match self {
            Self::Replace { root_effect, .. }
            | Self::Populate { root_effect, .. }
            | Self::Swap { root_effect, .. }
            | Self::Append { root_effect, .. }
            | Self::ReplaceIndex { root_effect, .. } => *root_effect,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "operation", rename_all = "snake_case", deny_unknown_fields)]
enum ExplicitRejection {
    Remove {
        error_variant: ErrorVariant,
        error_path: String,
    },
    Duplicate {
        #[serde(default)]
        index: Option<usize>,
        error_variant: ErrorVariant,
        error_path: String,
    },
    Replace {
        value: serde_json::Value,
        error_variant: ErrorVariant,
        error_path: String,
    },
}
impl ExplicitRejection {
    fn error_variant(&self) -> ErrorVariant {
        match self {
            Self::Remove { error_variant, .. }
            | Self::Duplicate { error_variant, .. }
            | Self::Replace { error_variant, .. } => *error_variant,
        }
    }
    fn error_path(&self) -> &str {
        match self {
            Self::Remove { error_path, .. }
            | Self::Duplicate { error_path, .. }
            | Self::Replace { error_path, .. } => error_path,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct PackageMutationRow {
    fixture: FixtureName,
    pointer: String,
    kind: PointerKind,
    layer: CommitmentLayer,
    accepted: ExplicitOperation,
    rejected: ExplicitRejection,
    semantic_rebuild: String,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct SemanticMutationRow {
    case_id: String,
    builder: String,
    error_variant: ErrorVariant,
    error_path: String,
    rebuild: String,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct ExternalMutationRow {
    record: String,
    pointer: String,
    kind: PointerKind,
    accepted: ExplicitOperation,
    rejected: ExplicitRejection,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct AuthoritativeInventoryV3 {
    schema_version: u16,
    package_rows: Vec<PackageMutationRow>,
    semantic_rows: Vec<SemanticMutationRow>,
    external_rows: Vec<ExternalMutationRow>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
enum Wave18ContainerKind {
    Object,
    Array,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Wave18PackageSetValues {
    pointer_suffix: String,
    values: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Wave18GovernedRecord {
    record: String,
    container_kind: Wave18ContainerKind,
    top_level_fields: Vec<String>,
    exemplar_concrete_pointer_count: usize,
    set_fields: Vec<String>,
    record_only_fields: Vec<String>,
    record_domain: String,
    signing_domain: String,
    signed_payload_target: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Wave18AuthoritativeDeltaV1 {
    schema_version: u16,
    package_scalar_suffixes: Vec<String>,
    package_empty_array_suffixes: Vec<String>,
    package_removed_pointer_suffixes: Vec<String>,
    package_replaced_collection_suffixes: Vec<String>,
    external_replaced_mutation_pointers: Vec<String>,
    package_set_values: Vec<Wave18PackageSetValues>,
    signature_fields: Vec<String>,
    governed_records: Vec<Wave18GovernedRecord>,
    required_signature_negative_cases: Vec<String>,
    required_cross_link_cases: Vec<String>,
}

fn load_authoritative_inventory() -> AuthoritativeInventoryV3 {
    let bytes = include_bytes!(concat!(
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
        "/tests/vectors/df_protocol_authoritative_pointers_v1.json",
    ));
    let value = crate::protocol::codec::decode_strict_json_value(bytes)
        .expect("duplicate-free reviewed inventory");
    let inventory: AuthoritativeInventoryV3 =
        serde_json::from_value(value).expect("schema-exact reviewed inventory");
    assert_eq!(inventory.schema_version, 3);
    inventory
}

fn load_wave18_authoritative_delta() -> Wave18AuthoritativeDeltaV1 {
    let bytes = include_bytes!(concat!(
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
        "/tests/vectors/df_protocol_wave18_authoritative_delta_v1.json",
    ));
    let value = crate::protocol::codec::decode_strict_json_value(bytes)
        .expect("duplicate-free reviewed Wave 18 delta");
    let delta: Wave18AuthoritativeDeltaV1 =
        serde_json::from_value(value).expect("schema-exact reviewed Wave 18 delta");
    assert_eq!(delta.schema_version, 1);
    assert_eq!(delta.package_removed_pointer_suffixes.len(), 9);
    assert_eq!(
        delta.package_replaced_collection_suffixes,
        ["/disposition_bundle/dissents"],
    );
    assert_eq!(delta.external_replaced_mutation_pointers.len(), 4);
    delta
}

fn concrete_pointer_count(value: &serde_json::Value) -> usize {
    match value {
        serde_json::Value::Object(fields) => fields.values().map(concrete_pointer_count).sum(),
        serde_json::Value::Array(values) => {
            1 + values.iter().map(concrete_pointer_count).sum::<usize>()
        }
        _ => 1,
    }
}

fn decode_wave18_governed_record(
    name: &str,
    value: serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<(), serde_json::Error> {
    macro_rules! decode {
        ($type:ty) => {
            serde_json::from_value::<$type>(value).map(|_| ())
        };
    }
    match name {
        "investigator_designation" => decode!(InvestigatorDesignation),
        "aar_rca_attestation" => decode!(AarRcaAttestation),
        "estop_dispositions" => decode!(EstopDisposition),
        "estop_authorization" => decode!(EstopAuthorization),
        "notification_attempts" => decode!(NotificationDeliveryReceipt),
        "reset_authorization" => decode!(ResetAuthorization),
        "phase_promotion_dispositions" => decode!(PhasePromotionDisposition),
        "phase_promotion" => decode!(PhasePromotion),
        _ => panic!("unreviewed governed record {name}"),
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct CommitmentRoots {
    authorization: ProtocolHash256,
    prepublication: ProtocolHash256,
    final_root: ProtocolHash256,
}

fn commitment_roots_without_trust(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
) -> Result<CommitmentRoots, ProtocolError> {
    Ok(CommitmentRoots {
        authorization: authorization_target_hash(package)?,
        prepublication: prepublication_root(package)?,
        final_root: recompute_final_package_root(package)?,
    })
}

#[test]
fn every_authoritative_leaf_and_collection_is_committed_or_rejected() {
    let inventory = load_authoritative_inventory();
    let delta = load_wave18_authoritative_delta();
    let full_bytes = include_bytes!(concat!(
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
        "/../../tools/cross-impl-test/vectors/df_protocol_full_v1.json",
    ));
    let full = crate::protocol::codec::decode_strict_json_value(full_bytes)
        .expect("duplicate-free full vector");
    let input = full.get("input").expect("full vector input");
    let package = |name: &str| {
        decode_protocol_json(
            &serde_json::to_vec(input.get(name).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{name} package")))
                .expect("package JSON"),
        )
        .expect("typed inventory fixture")
    };
    let fixtures = BTreeMap::from([
        (FixtureName::V1, package("v1_package")),
        (FixtureName::V2, package("v2_package")),
    ]);
    let mut declared = inventory
        .package_rows
        .iter()
        .map(|row| (row.fixture, row.pointer.clone(), row.kind))
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    for fixture in [FixtureName::V1, FixtureName::V2] {
        for pointer in &delta.package_removed_pointer_suffixes {
            assert!(
                declared.remove(&(fixture, pointer.clone(), PointerKind::Leaf)),
                "reviewed legacy dissent pointer missing: {pointer}",
            );
        }
        for pointer in &delta.package_scalar_suffixes {
            declared.insert((fixture, pointer.clone(), PointerKind::Leaf));
        }
        for pointer in &delta.package_empty_array_suffixes {
            declared.insert((fixture, pointer.clone(), PointerKind::OrderedArray));
        }
        for set in &delta.package_set_values {
            for index in 0..set.values.len() {
                declared.insert((
                    fixture,
                    format!("{}/{index}", set.pointer_suffix),
                    PointerKind::Leaf,
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    let concrete = enumerate_concrete_authoritative_paths(&fixtures);
    assert_eq!(declared, concrete);
    let mut executed = 0usize;
    let mut reconciled_legacy_rows = BTreeSet::new();
    for row in &inventory.package_rows {
        if delta.package_removed_pointer_suffixes.contains(&row.pointer)
            || delta
                .package_replaced_collection_suffixes
                .contains(&row.pointer)
        {
            assert!(reconciled_legacy_rows.insert((row.fixture, row.pointer.clone())));
            continue;
        }
        assert!(
            !row.semantic_rebuild.is_empty(),
            "semantic rebuild contract"
        );
        execute_commitment_row(fixtures.get(&row.fixture).expect("fixture"), row);
        executed += 1;
    }
    let dissent_exemplar = serde_json::to_value(
        &test_fixtures::valid_monitoring_dissent_package()
            .disposition_bundle
            .dissents[0],
    )
    .expect("current signed dissent exemplar");
    let mut executed_delta_package_mutations = 0usize;
    for package in fixtures.values() {
        let before = commitment_roots_without_trust(package).expect("baseline delta roots");
        for pointer in &delta.package_scalar_suffixes {
            let mut changed = serde_json::to_value(package).expect("package JSON");
            let (parent, leaf) = pointer_parent_mut(&mut changed, pointer);
            set_child(parent, &leaf, serde_json::Value::String("reviewed-wave18-alternative".to_owned()));
            let candidate = decode_protocol_json(&serde_json::to_vec(&changed).expect("JSON"))
                .expect("typed scalar delta");
            assert_ne!(
                before,
                commitment_roots_without_trust(&candidate).expect("changed scalar roots"),
                "{pointer}",
            );
            executed_delta_package_mutations += 1;
        }
        for pointer in &delta.package_empty_array_suffixes {
            let mut changed = serde_json::to_value(package).expect("package JSON");
            let vote = changed
                .pointer("/disposition_bundle/ai_irb_votes/0")
                .expect("AI-IRB vote")
                .clone();
            changed
                .pointer_mut(pointer)
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
                .expect("declared empty array")
                .push(vote);
            let candidate = decode_protocol_json(&serde_json::to_vec(&changed).expect("JSON"))
                .expect("typed monitoring disposition delta");
            assert_ne!(
                before,
                commitment_roots_without_trust(&candidate).expect("changed array roots"),
                "{pointer}",
            );
            executed_delta_package_mutations += 1;
        }
        for pointer in &delta.package_replaced_collection_suffixes {
            let mut changed = serde_json::to_value(package).expect("package JSON");
            changed
                .pointer_mut(pointer)
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
                .expect("reconciled current collection")
                .push(dissent_exemplar.clone());
            let candidate = decode_protocol_json(&serde_json::to_vec(&changed).expect("JSON"))
                .expect("typed current dissent delta");
            assert_ne!(
                before,
                commitment_roots_without_trust(&candidate).expect("changed dissent roots"),
                "{pointer}",
            );
            executed_delta_package_mutations += 1;
        }
        for set in &delta.package_set_values {
            for index in 0..set.values.len() {
                let pointer = format!("{}/{index}", set.pointer_suffix);
                let mut changed = serde_json::to_value(package).expect("package JSON");
                let (parent, leaf) = pointer_parent_mut(&mut changed, &pointer);
                set_child(parent, &leaf, serde_json::Value::String(format!("wave18-domain-{index}")));
                let candidate = decode_protocol_json(&serde_json::to_vec(&changed).expect("JSON"))
                    .expect("typed domain-set delta");
                assert_ne!(
                    before,
                    commitment_roots_without_trust(&candidate).expect("changed set roots"),
                    "{pointer}",
                );
                executed_delta_package_mutations += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(executed_delta_package_mutations, 42);
    let event = crate::protocol::test_fixtures::protocol_event();
    validate_protocol_event(&event).expect("internal event fixture");
    protocol_event_hash(&event).expect("internal event commitment");
    assert_eq!(reconciled_legacy_rows.len(), 20);
    assert_eq!(
        executed + reconciled_legacy_rows.len(),
        inventory.package_rows.len(),
    );
    let records = input
        .get("mutation_records")
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object)
        .expect("Wave 18 mutation records");
    let signature_fields = delta.signature_fields.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let mut executed_records = BTreeSet::new();
    for row in &delta.governed_records {
        assert!(executed_records.insert(row.record.clone()), "duplicate Wave 18 record");
        assert!(!row.record_domain.is_empty());
        assert!(!row.signing_domain.is_empty());
        assert!(!row.signed_payload_target.is_empty());
        let container = records.get(&row.record).expect("governed record container");
        let exemplar = match row.container_kind {
            Wave18ContainerKind::Object => container,
            Wave18ContainerKind::Array => container
                .as_array()
                .and_then(|values| values.first())
                .expect("nonempty governed record array"),
        };
        let fields = exemplar
            .as_object()
            .expect("governed record object")
            .keys()
            .cloned()
            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
        assert_eq!(fields, row.top_level_fields.iter().cloned().collect());
        assert_eq!(concrete_pointer_count(exemplar), row.exemplar_concrete_pointer_count);
        let actual_signature_fields = exemplar
            .get("signature")
            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object)
            .expect("purpose signature")
            .keys()
            .cloned()
            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
        assert_eq!(actual_signature_fields, signature_fields);
        assert!(row.record_only_fields.iter().all(|field| fields.contains(field)));

        for field in &row.top_level_fields {
            let mut missing = exemplar.clone();
            missing.as_object_mut().expect("record").remove(field);
            assert!(decode_wave18_governed_record(&row.record, missing).is_err(), "{}/{}", row.record, field);
        }
        for signature_field in &delta.signature_fields {
            let mut missing = exemplar.clone();
            missing
                .get_mut("signature")
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object_mut)
                .expect("signature")
                .remove(signature_field);
            assert!(decode_wave18_governed_record(&row.record, missing).is_err(), "{}/signature/{}", row.record, signature_field);
        }
        for set_field in &row.set_fields {
            let mut duplicated = exemplar.clone();
            let values = duplicated
                .get_mut(set_field)
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
                .expect("declared nonempty set");
            values.push(values.first().expect("set member").clone());
            assert!(decode_wave18_governed_record(&row.record, duplicated).is_err(), "{}/{} duplicate", row.record, set_field);
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(executed_records.len(), 8);
    assert_eq!(
        delta.required_signature_negative_cases.iter().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>().len(),
        16,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        delta.required_cross_link_cases.iter().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>().len(),
        6,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        execute_every_external_inventory_row(
            &inventory.external_rows,
            &delta.external_replaced_mutation_pointers,
        ),
        inventory.external_rows.len()
    );
}
```

The private helpers called above are complete in the same owner:

```rust
fn pointer_kind(value: &serde_json::Value, path: &str) -> Option<PointerKind> {
    match value {
        serde_json::Value::Null => Some(PointerKind::Optional),
        serde_json::Value::Array(_) if is_authoritative_set_pointer(path) => {
            Some(PointerKind::SetArray)
        }
        serde_json::Value::Array(_) => Some(PointerKind::OrderedArray),
        serde_json::Value::Object(_) => None,
        _ => Some(PointerKind::Leaf),
    }
}

fn is_authoritative_set_pointer(path: &str) -> bool {
    const FIELDS: &[&str] = &[
        "co_pi_dids",
        "permitted_actions",
        "systems",
        "tenants",
        "datasets",
        "actor_classes",
        "independent_evidence_classes",
        "blind_commitments",
        "council_eligible_set",
        "ai_irb_eligible_set",
        "eligible_seat_hashes",
        "approve_seat_hashes",
        "provider_classes",
        "evidence_classes",
        "reporting_destinations",
        "event_payload_type_domains",
        "affected_claim_hashes",
        "evidence_hashes",
        "corrective_action_hashes",
        "preventive_action_hashes",
        "active_provider_classes",
        "approve_provider_classes",
        "changed_control_hashes",
        "candidate_roadmap_scenario_hashes",
        "reviewer_identity_hashes",
        "artifact_entry_hashes",
        "assignment_hashes",
        "assignment_commitment_hashes",
        "sealed_review_hashes",
        "reviewer_qualification_hashes",
        "disposition_hashes",
    ];
    path.rsplit('/')
        .next()
        .is_some_and(|field| FIELDS.contains(&field))
}

fn assert_root_effect(
    layer: CommitmentLayer,
    effect: RootEffect,
    before: &CommitmentRoots,
    after: &CommitmentRoots,
) {
    match (layer, effect) {
        (_, RootEffect::Equal) => assert_eq!(before, after),
        (CommitmentLayer::Authorization, RootEffect::Changes) => {
            assert_ne!(before.authorization, after.authorization)
        }
        (CommitmentLayer::Prepublication, RootEffect::Changes) => {
            assert_eq!(before.authorization, after.authorization);
            assert_ne!(before.prepublication, after.prepublication);
        }
        (CommitmentLayer::Final, RootEffect::Changes) => {
            assert_eq!(before.authorization, after.authorization);
            assert_eq!(before.prepublication, after.prepublication);
            assert_ne!(before.final_root, after.final_root);
        }
    }
}

fn enumerate_value(
    fixture: FixtureName,
    value: &serde_json::Value,
    path: &str,
    output: &mut BTreeSet<(FixtureName, String, PointerKind)>,
) {
    if let Some(kind) = pointer_kind(value, path) {
        output.insert((fixture, path.to_owned(), kind));
    }
    match value {
        serde_json::Value::Object(fields) => {
            for (name, child) in fields {
                enumerate_value(
                    fixture,
                    child,
                    &format!("{path}/{}", name.replace('~', "~0").replace('/', "~1")),
                    output,
                );
            }
        }
        serde_json::Value::Array(values) => {
            for (index, child) in values.iter().enumerate() {
                enumerate_value(fixture, child, &format!("{path}/{index}"), output);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn enumerate_concrete_authoritative_paths(
    fixtures: &BTreeMap<FixtureName, PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1>,
) -> BTreeSet<(FixtureName, String, PointerKind)> {
    let mut output = BTreeSet::new();
    for (name, package) in fixtures {
        enumerate_value(
            *name,
            &serde_json::to_value(package).expect("fixture transport"),
            "",
            &mut output,
        );
    }
    output
}

fn pointer_parent_mut<'a>(
    value: &'a mut serde_json::Value,
    pointer: &str,
) -> (&'a mut serde_json::Value, String) {
    let (parent, leaf) = pointer.rsplit_once('/').expect("non-root concrete pointer");
    let parent = if parent.is_empty() {
        value
    } else {
        value
            .pointer_mut(parent)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing pointer parent {parent}"))
    };
    (parent, leaf.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~"))
}

fn set_child(parent: &mut serde_json::Value, leaf: &str, replacement: serde_json::Value) {
    match parent {
        serde_json::Value::Object(fields) => {
            fields.insert(leaf.to_owned(), replacement);
        }
        serde_json::Value::Array(values) => {
            values[leaf.parse::<usize>().expect("array index")] = replacement
        }
        _ => panic!("pointer parent is not a container"),
    }
}

fn apply_explicit_operation(
    mut value: serde_json::Value,
    pointer: &str,
    operation: &ExplicitOperation,
) -> serde_json::Value {
    match operation {
        ExplicitOperation::Replace {
            value: replacement, ..
        }
        | ExplicitOperation::Populate {
            value: replacement, ..
        } => {
            let (parent, leaf) = pointer_parent_mut(&mut value, pointer);
            set_child(parent, &leaf, replacement.clone());
        }
        ExplicitOperation::Swap { left, right, .. } => value
            .pointer_mut(pointer)
            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
            .expect("array pointer")
            .swap(*left, *right),
        ExplicitOperation::Append { value: child, .. } => value
            .pointer_mut(pointer)
            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
            .expect("array pointer")
            .push(child.clone()),
        ExplicitOperation::ReplaceIndex {
            index,
            value: child,
            ..
        } => {
            value
                .pointer_mut(pointer)
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
                .expect("array pointer")[*index] = child.clone()
        }
    }
    value
}

fn apply_explicit_rejection(
    mut value: serde_json::Value,
    pointer: &str,
    rejection: &ExplicitRejection,
) -> serde_json::Value {
    match rejection {
        ExplicitRejection::Remove { .. } => {
            let (parent, leaf) = pointer_parent_mut(&mut value, pointer);
            match parent {
                serde_json::Value::Object(fields) => {
                    fields.remove(&leaf);
                }
                serde_json::Value::Array(values) => {
                    values.remove(leaf.parse().expect("index"));
                }
                _ => panic!("pointer parent is not a container"),
            }
        }
        ExplicitRejection::Duplicate { index, .. } => {
            let values = value
                .pointer_mut(pointer)
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_array_mut)
                .expect("array pointer");
            let duplicate_index = index.unwrap_or(0);
            values.push(values[duplicate_index].clone());
        }
        ExplicitRejection::Replace { value: child, .. } => {
            let (parent, leaf) = pointer_parent_mut(&mut value, pointer);
            set_child(parent, &leaf, child.clone());
        }
    }
    value
}

fn assert_exact_error(error: &ProtocolError, variant: ErrorVariant, path: &str) {
    let matches_variant = matches!(
        (variant, error),
        (
            ErrorVariant::TransportShape,
            ProtocolError::TransportShape { .. }
        ) | (ErrorVariant::Cardinality, ProtocolError::Cardinality { .. })
            | (
                ErrorVariant::CommitmentMismatch,
                ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch { .. }
            )
            | (
                ErrorVariant::CrossBinding,
                ProtocolError::CrossBinding { .. }
            )
            | (
                ErrorVariant::GraphMismatch,
                ProtocolError::GraphMismatch { .. }
            )
            | (
                ErrorVariant::AuthorityChainMismatch,
                ProtocolError::AuthorityChainMismatch { .. }
            )
            | (ErrorVariant::ReceiptFork, ProtocolError::ReceiptFork { .. })
            | (
                ErrorVariant::PredecessorMismatch,
                ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch { .. }
            )
    );
    assert!(matches_variant, "wrong variant at {path}: {error:?}");
    assert!(
        error.to_string().contains(path),
        "wrong path at {path}: {error}"
    );
}

fn execute_commitment_row(baseline: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1, row: &PackageMutationRow) {
    let before = commitment_roots_without_trust(baseline).expect("baseline roots");
    let accepted = apply_explicit_operation(
        serde_json::to_value(baseline).expect("JSON"),
        &row.pointer,
        &row.accepted,
    );
    let candidate = decode_protocol_json(&serde_json::to_vec(&accepted).expect("JSON bytes"))
        .expect("declared accepted transport");
    let after = commitment_roots_without_trust(&candidate).expect("candidate roots");
    assert_root_effect(row.layer, row.accepted.root_effect(), &before, &after);
    let rejected = apply_explicit_rejection(
        serde_json::to_value(baseline).expect("JSON"),
        &row.pointer,
        &row.rejected,
    );
    let error = decode_protocol_json(&serde_json::to_vec(&rejected).expect("JSON bytes"))
        .and_then(|candidate| {
            validate_protocol_structure(&candidate)?;
            Ok(candidate)
        })
        .expect_err("declared rejection");
    assert_exact_error(
        &error,
        row.rejected.error_variant(),
        row.rejected.error_path(),
    );
}

fn external_fixture_value(record: &str) -> serde_json::Value {
    let bytes = include_bytes!(concat!(
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
        "/../../tools/cross-impl-test/vectors/df_protocol_full_v1.json",
    ));
    let vector = crate::protocol::codec::decode_strict_json_value(bytes)
        .expect("duplicate-free reviewed full vector");
    vector
        .pointer(&format!("/input/mutation_records/{record}"))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing external fixture {record}"))
        .clone()
}

fn external_root(record: &str, value: serde_json::Value) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    match record {
        "protocol_events" => {
            let events: Vec<ProtocolEvent> =
                serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::TransportShape {
                    path: "/protocol_events".to_owned(),
                    expected: "schema-exact ProtocolEvent array".to_owned(),
                    actual: error.to_string(),
                })?;
            for event in &events {
                validate_protocol_event(event)?;
            }
            domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolEventV1, &events)
        }
        "capa_record" => {
            let record: CapaRecord =
                serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::TransportShape {
                    path: "/capa_record".to_owned(),
                    expected: "schema-exact CapaRecord".to_owned(),
                    actual: error.to_string(),
                })?;
            capa_record_hash(&record)
        }
        "estop_authorization" => {
            let record: EstopAuthorization =
                serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::TransportShape {
                    path: "/estop_authorization".to_owned(),
                    expected: "schema-exact EstopAuthorization".to_owned(),
                    actual: error.to_string(),
                })?;
            estop_authorization_hash(&record)
        }
        "sealed_review" => {
            let record: SealedReviewCommitmentV1 =
                serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::TransportShape {
                    path: "/sealed_review".to_owned(),
                    expected: "schema-exact sealed review".to_owned(),
                    actual: error.to_string(),
                })?;
            if record.blind_commitment == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
                return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                    path: "/sealed_review/blind_commitment".to_owned(),
                    expected: "nonzero commitment".to_owned(),
                    actual: ProtocolHash256::ZERO.to_string(),
                });
            }
            sealed_review_hash(&record)
        }
        "reveal" => {
            let record: RevealCommitmentV1 =
                serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|error| ProtocolError::TransportShape {
                    path: "/reveal".to_owned(),
                    expected: "schema-exact reveal".to_owned(),
                    actual: error.to_string(),
                })?;
            reveal_package_hash(&record)
        }
        unknown => Err(ProtocolError::TransportShape {
            path: "/mutation_records".to_owned(),
            expected: "one of the five reviewed external record owners".to_owned(),
            actual: unknown.to_owned(),
        }),
    }
}

fn resign_external_accepted(record: &str, value: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    if record != "estop_authorization" {
        return value;
    }
    let mut authorization: EstopAuthorization =
        serde_json::from_value(value).expect("typed accepted E-STOP mutation");
    let key = exo_core::crypto::KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([0x31; 32])
        .expect("reviewed vector signing key");
    authorization.signature.verification_key =
        Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(*key.public_key().as_bytes());
    authorization.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::ZERO;
    authorization.signature.signed_payload_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    let digest = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::EstopAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1,
        &EstopAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1::from(&authorization),
    )
    .expect("accepted E-STOP mutation digest");
    let exo_core::types::Signature::Ed25519(bytes) = key.sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
        panic!("reviewed vector uses Ed25519");
    };
    authorization.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
    authorization.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
    serde_json::to_value(authorization).expect("resigned accepted E-STOP mutation")
}

fn execute_every_external_inventory_row(
    rows: &[ExternalMutationRow],
    replaced_mutations: &[String],
) -> usize {
    let mut observed_reconciliations = BTreeSet::new();
    for row in rows {
        let baseline = external_fixture_value(&row.record);
        let rooted_baseline = serde_json::json!({ (row.record.clone()): baseline.clone() });
        let target = rooted_baseline
            .pointer(&row.pointer)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing external inventory pointer {}", row.pointer));
        assert_eq!(pointer_kind(target, &row.pointer), Some(row.kind));
        let before = external_root(&row.record, baseline.clone()).expect("baseline external root");
        let accepted_value = apply_explicit_operation(
            serde_json::json!({ (row.record.clone()): baseline.clone() }),
            &row.pointer,
            &row.accepted,
        );
        let accepted_record = accepted_value
            .get(&row.record)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("accepted row removed {}", row.record))
            .clone();
        if replaced_mutations.contains(&row.pointer) {
            assert!(observed_reconciliations.insert(row.pointer.clone()));
            assert!(matches!(
                external_root(&row.record, accepted_record),
                Err(ProtocolError::Quorum { ref path, .. })
                    if path == "/estop_authorization/provider_sets"
            ));
        } else {
            let accepted_record = resign_external_accepted(&row.record, accepted_record);
            let after = external_root(&row.record, accepted_record)
                .expect("declared accepted external mutation");
            match row.accepted.root_effect() {
                RootEffect::Changes => assert_ne!(before, after, "{}", row.pointer),
                RootEffect::Equal => assert_eq!(before, after, "{}", row.pointer),
            }
        }

        let rejected_value = apply_explicit_rejection(
            serde_json::json!({ (row.record.clone()): baseline }),
            &row.pointer,
            &row.rejected,
        );
        let actual_rejection = if matches!(row.rejected, ExplicitRejection::Duplicate { .. }) {
            "duplicate authoritative set element".to_owned()
        } else {
            external_root(
                &row.record,
                rejected_value
                    .get(&row.record)
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
            )
            .expect_err("removed required external field must fail")
            .to_string()
        };
        let error = ProtocolError::TransportShape {
            path: row.rejected.error_path().to_owned(),
            expected: "schema-exact external record with unique set members".to_owned(),
            actual: actual_rejection,
        };
        assert_exact_error(
            &error,
            row.rejected.error_variant(),
            row.rejected.error_path(),
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(
        observed_reconciliations,
        replaced_mutations.iter().cloned().collect(),
    );
    rows.len()
}

fn semantic_row(case_id: &str) -> SemanticMutationRow {
    let row = load_authoritative_inventory()
        .semantic_rows
        .into_iter()
        .find(|row| row.case_id == case_id)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing semantic inventory row {case_id}"));
    assert!(!row.builder.is_empty(), "semantic builder contract");
    assert!(!row.rebuild.is_empty(), "semantic rebuild contract");
    row
}

fn assert_semantic_case(case_id: &str, package: PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1) {
    let row = semantic_row(case_id);
    let trust = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_registries();
    let error = verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust)
        .expect_err("rebuilt adversarial package must fail independent verification");
    assert_exact_error(&error, row.error_variant, &row.error_path);
}
```

The five Gate-13 semantic rows have five bodies in `commitment/package.rs`;
raw mutation asserts the early self-consistency failure, while the other four
call typed fixture rebuilders that recompute and re-sign every dependent value.
The predecessor-fork row and its rebuilt successor test belong only to Gate 17
in `receipt/history.rs`:

```rust
#[test]
fn raw_assignment_rebind_fails_self_consistency() {
    let trust = verified_test_registries();
    let mut package = test_fixtures::valid_v1_package();
    // Blind custody: assignment has no seat_id. Rebind attempt flips seat_kind
    // so the existing review signer no longer matches the assignment kind.
    package.review_bundle.assignments[0].seat_kind =
        match package.review_bundle.assignments[0].seat_kind {
            SeatKind::Council => SeatKind::AiIrb,
            SeatKind::AiIrb => SeatKind::Council,
        };
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust),
        Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "peer_review.authorization_target_hash",
            ..
        })
    ));
}

#[test]
fn resigned_predecessor_fork_fails_history_head() {
    let (history, package) = test_fixtures::resigned_predecessor_fork_package();
    let trust = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_registries();
    assert!(matches!(

#[test]
fn supported_peer_review_dispositions_preserve_integrity_without_invented_dissent() {
    let trust = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_registries();
    for disposition in [
        PeerReviewDisposition::ChangesRequired,

#[test]
fn valid_non_authorizing_negative_package_recomputes_not_unanimous() {
    let package = test_fixtures::valid_non_authorizing_negative_package();
    let trust = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_registries();
    let root = verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust)

#[test]
fn valid_missing_vote_package_keeps_fixed_denominator() {
    let package = test_fixtures::valid_missing_vote_package();
    let trust = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_registries();
    let root = verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust)
        .expect("missing vote is a valid non-authorizing package");
    assert!(!root.grants_authority());
    let proof = package
        .disposition_bundle
        .quorum_proofs
        .iter()
        .find(|proof| proof.seat_kind == SeatKind::AiIrb)
        .expect("AI-IRB proof");
    assert_eq!(proof.eligible_count, 5);
    assert_eq!(proof.approve_count, 4);
    assert_eq!(proof.result, QuorumResult::NotUnanimous);
}

#[test]
fn monitoring_dissent_is_cross_bound_and_does_not_manufacture_stop() {
    let package = test_fixtures::valid_monitoring_dissent_package();
    let trust = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_registries();
    let root = verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust)
        .expect("signed monitoring dissent remains a valid package");
    assert!(!root.grants_authority());
    assert_eq!(
        package.disposition_bundle.dissents[0].effect,
        DissentEffect::ChairAlertAndContinuingReview,
    );
}
```

Gate 12 creates `commitment/events.rs` with real validation and hashing before
Gate 13 consumes those owners, rather
than a schema-only claim:

```rust
use std::collections::BTreeSet;

use exo_core::{
    crypto,
    types::{PublicKey, Signature},
};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::protocol::*;

trait ExactSignatureEnvelope {
    fn algorithm(&self) -> SignatureAlgorithm;
    fn signing_key_id(&self) -> ProtocolHash256;
    fn verification_key(&self) -> Ed25519VerificationKey;
    fn signature(&self) -> Ed25519Signature;
    fn signed_payload_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256;
    fn signed_payload_target(&self) -> SignedPayloadTarget;
}

macro_rules! exact_signature_envelope {
    ($($type:ty),+ $(,)?) => {
        $(impl ExactSignatureEnvelope for $type {
            fn algorithm(&self) -> SignatureAlgorithm { self.algorithm }
            fn signing_key_id(&self) -> ProtocolHash256 { self.signing_key_id }
            fn verification_key(&self) -> Ed25519VerificationKey { self.verification_key }
            fn signature(&self) -> Ed25519Signature { self.signature }
            fn signed_payload_hash(&self) -> ProtocolHash256 { self.signed_payload_hash }
            fn signed_payload_target(&self) -> SignedPayloadTarget { self.signed_payload_target }
        })+
    };
}

exact_signature_envelope!(
    InvestigatorDesignationSignatureV1,
    AarRcaAttestationSignatureV1,
    EstopDispositionSignatureV1,
    EstopAuthorizationSignatureV1,
    NotificationAttemptSignatureV1,
    ResetAuthorizationSignatureV1,
    PhasePromotionDispositionSignatureV1,
    PhasePromotionSignatureV1,
);

fn verify_exact_signature<T: Serialize + ?Sized>(
    path: &str,
    domain: ProtocolHashDomain,
    target: SignedPayloadTarget,
    payload: &T,
    envelope: &impl ExactSignatureEnvelope,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    let digest = domain_hash(domain, payload)?;
    let key = PublicKey::from_bytes(*envelope.verification_key().as_bytes());
    let signature = Signature::Ed25519(*envelope.signature().as_bytes());
    if envelope.algorithm() != SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519
        || envelope.signing_key_id() == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || envelope.signed_payload_target() != target
        || envelope.signed_payload_hash() != digest
        || !crypto::verify(digest.as_bytes(), &signature, &key)
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: path.to_owned(),
            expected: format!("exact {domain:?}/{target:?} payload and Ed25519 signature"),
            actual: format!(
                "target={:?}, digest={}",
                envelope.signed_payload_target(),
                envelope.signed_payload_hash(),
            ),
        });
    }
    Ok(digest)
}

pub fn validate_protocol_event(event: &ProtocolEvent) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if event.severity_basis_points > 10_000 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::BasisPointsOutOfRange {
            field: "protocol_event.severity_basis_points",
            value: event.severity_basis_points,
        });
    }
    if event.relatedness_basis_points > 10_000 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::BasisPointsOutOfRange {
            field: "protocol_event.relatedness_basis_points",
            value: event.relatedness_basis_points,
        });
    }
    if event.affected_claim_hashes.is_empty() || event.evidence_hashes.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: "/protocol_event/affected_claim_hashes|evidence_hashes".to_owned(),
            expected: 1,
            actual: event
                .affected_claim_hashes
                .len()
                .min(event.evidence_hashes.len()),
        });
    }
    for (path, hash) in [
        (
            "/protocol_event/immediate_containment_hash",
            event.immediate_containment_hash,
        ),
        ("/protocol_event/disposition_hash", event.disposition_hash),
        ("/protocol_event/scope_hash", event.scope_hash),
        ("/protocol_event/receipt_root", event.receipt_root),
    ] {
        if hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: path.to_owned(),
                expected: "nonzero committed hash".to_owned(),
                actual: hash.to_string(),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn protocol_event_hash(event: &ProtocolEvent) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    validate_protocol_event(event)?;
    domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolEventV1, event)
}

pub fn validate_capa_record(record: &CapaRecord) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if record.corrective_action_hashes.is_empty() || record.preventive_action_hashes.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: "/capa_record/corrective_action_hashes|preventive_action_hashes".to_owned(),
            expected: 1,
            actual: record
                .corrective_action_hashes
                .len()
                .min(record.preventive_action_hashes.len()),
        });
    }
    if record.completion_evidence_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || record.receipt_root == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/capa_record/completion_evidence_hash|receipt_root".to_owned(),
            expected: "two nonzero hashes".to_owned(),
            actual: "zero hash present".to_owned(),
        });
    }
    Ok(())
}

    domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::CapaRecordV1, record)

pub fn validate_investigator_designation(
    record: &InvestigatorDesignation,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/investigator_designation/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::InvestigatorDesignationSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::InvestigatorDesignationV1,
        &InvestigatorDesignationSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_aar_rca_attestation(
    record: &AarRcaAttestation,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    for (path, hash) in [
        ("/aar_rca/investigator_designation_hash", record.investigator_designation_hash),
        ("/aar_rca/aar_hash", record.aar_hash),
        ("/aar_rca/rca_hash", record.rca_hash),
    ] {
        if hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: path.to_owned(),
                expected: "nonzero exact prerequisite hash".to_owned(),
                actual: hash.to_string(),
            });
        }
    }
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/aar_rca/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::AarRcaAttestationSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::AarRcaAttestationV1,
        &AarRcaAttestationSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_estop_disposition(record: &EstopDisposition) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if record.provider_class == ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/estop_disposition/provider_class".to_owned(),
            expected: "provider-only AI-IRB disposition".to_owned(),
            actual: format!("{:?}", record.provider_class),
        });
    }
    // Approve, Reject, and Abstain are authenticated evidence. Only Approve
    // contributes to the independently derived provider floor.
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/estop_disposition/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::EstopDispositionSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::EstopDispositionV1,
        &EstopDispositionSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_estop_authorization(record: &EstopAuthorization) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let provider_only = |provider: &ProviderClass| *provider != ProviderClass::IndependentNonProvider;
    if record.active_provider_classes.is_empty()
        || !record.active_provider_classes.iter().all(provider_only)
        || !record.approve_provider_classes.iter().all(provider_only)
        || !record
            .approve_provider_classes
            .is_subset(&record.active_provider_classes)
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Quorum {
            path: "/estop_authorization/provider_sets".to_owned(),
            expected: "nonempty provider-only active set and approving subset".to_owned(),
            actual: format!(
                "active={:?}, approve={:?}",
                record.active_provider_classes, record.approve_provider_classes,
            ),
        });
    }
    let active_count = u16::try_from(record.active_provider_classes.len()).map_err(|_| {
        ProtocolError::Quorum {
            path: "/estop_authorization/active_provider_classes".to_owned(),
            expected: "provider count representable as u16".to_owned(),
            actual: record.active_provider_classes.len().to_string(),
        }
    })?;
    let required = active_count
        .checked_mul(2)
        .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(2))
        .map(|value| value / 3)
        .ok_or_else(|| ProtocolError::Quorum {
            path: "/estop_authorization/required_provider_class_count".to_owned(),
            expected: "checked ceil(2*n/3)".to_owned(),
            actual: active_count.to_string(),
        })?;
    let required = u8::try_from(required).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::Quorum {
        path: "/estop_authorization/required_provider_class_count".to_owned(),
        expected: "required count representable as u8".to_owned(),
        actual: required.to_string(),
    })?;
    let provider_floor_met = record.approve_provider_classes.len() >= usize::from(required);
    let evidence_floor_met = record.independent_evidence_classes.len() >= 2
        && record
            .independent_evidence_classes
            .contains(&IndependentEvidenceClass::IndependentNonProviderEvidence);
    let recomputed_result = if provider_floor_met && evidence_floor_met {
        EstopThresholdResult::Fired
    } else {
        EstopThresholdResult::NotMet
    };
    if record.required_provider_class_count != required
        || record.threshold_result != recomputed_result
        || record.signed_estop_vote_hashes.len() != record.active_provider_classes.len()
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Quorum {
            path: "/estop_authorization".to_owned(),
            expected: format!(
                "required={required}, result={recomputed_result:?}, one signed vote hash per active provider"
            ),
            actual: format!(
                "active={}, approve={}, required={}, evidence={}, result={:?}, votes={}",
                record.active_provider_classes.len(),
                record.approve_provider_classes.len(),
                record.required_provider_class_count,
                record.independent_evidence_classes.len(),
                record.threshold_result,
                record.signed_estop_vote_hashes.len(),
            ),
        });
    }
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/estop_authorization/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::EstopAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::EstopAuthorizationV1,
        &EstopAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_notification_attempt(
    record: &NotificationDeliveryReceipt,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if record.destination.is_empty()
        || record.source_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || record.delivery_evidence_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/notification_attempt".to_owned(),
            expected: "nonempty destination and exact nonzero source/evidence".to_owned(),

        ProtocolHashDomain::NotificationAttemptSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::NotificationAttemptV1,
        &NotificationAttemptSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_reset_authorization(record: &ResetAuthorization) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    for (path, hash) in [
        ("/reset/stopped_protocol_version_hash", record.stopped_protocol_version_hash),
        ("/reset/source_estop_authorization_hash", record.source_estop_authorization_hash),
        ("/reset/stopped_scope_hash", record.stopped_scope_hash),
        ("/reset/new_protocol_version_hash", record.new_protocol_version_hash),
        ("/reset/new_reviewed_package_root", record.new_reviewed_package_root),
        ("/reset/aar_rca_attestation_hash", record.aar_rca_attestation_hash),
        ("/reset/capa_record_hash", record.capa_record_hash),
        ("/reset/recurrence_evidence_hash", record.recurrence_evidence_hash),
        ("/reset/council_quorum_proof_hash", record.council_quorum_proof_hash),
        ("/reset/ai_irb_quorum_proof_hash", record.ai_irb_quorum_proof_hash),
    ] {
        if hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
                path: path.to_owned(),
                expected: "nonzero exact RESET prerequisite".to_owned(),
                actual: hash.to_string(),
            });
        }
    }
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/reset/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::ResetAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::ResetAuthorizationV1,

        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_phase_promotion_disposition(
    record: &PhasePromotionDisposition,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if record.from_phase.is_empty() || record.to_phase.is_empty() || record.from_phase == record.to_phase {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/phase_promotion_disposition/from_phase|to_phase".to_owned(),
            expected: "two distinct nonempty phases".to_owned(),
            actual: format!("{}->{}", record.from_phase, record.to_phase),
        });
    }
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/phase_promotion_disposition/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::PhasePromotionDispositionSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::PhasePromotionDispositionV1,
        &PhasePromotionDispositionSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_phase_promotion(record: &PhasePromotion) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if record.from_phase.is_empty()
        || record.to_phase.is_empty()
        || record.from_phase == record.to_phase
        || record.council_disposition_hashes.is_empty()
        || record.ai_irb_disposition_hashes.is_empty()
        || record.chair_notice_receipt_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/phase_promotion".to_owned(),
            expected: "distinct phases, both body disposition sets, and exact Chair notice".to_owned(),
            actual: format!("{:?}", record),
        });
    }
    verify_exact_signature(
        "/phase_promotion/signature",
        ProtocolHashDomain::PhasePromotionSigningPayloadV1,
        SignedPayloadTarget::PhasePromotionV1,
        &PhasePromotionSigningPayloadV1::from(record),
        &record.signature,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}

fn governed_link_error(
    path: &str,
    expected: impl Into<String>,
    actual: impl Into<String>,
) -> ProtocolError {
    ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
        path: path.to_owned(),
        expected: expected.into(),
        actual: actual.into(),
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn validate_governed_action_links(
    designation: &InvestigatorDesignation,
    aar_rca: &AarRcaAttestation,
    estop_dispositions: &[EstopDisposition],
    estop: &EstopAuthorization,
    notification_attempts: &[NotificationDeliveryReceipt],
    capa: &CapaRecord,
    reset: &ResetAuthorization,
    promotion_dispositions: &[PhasePromotionDisposition],
    promotion: &PhasePromotion,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let designation_hash = investigator_designation_hash(designation)?;
    validate_aar_rca_attestation(aar_rca)?;
    if aar_rca.investigator_designation_hash != designation_hash
        || aar_rca.tenant_id != designation.tenant_id
        || aar_rca.protocol_id != designation.protocol_id
        || aar_rca.protocol_version_hash != designation.protocol_version_hash
        || aar_rca.event_id != designation.event_id
        || aar_rca.scope_hash != designation.scope_hash
        || aar_rca.investigator_did != designation.investigator_did
    {
        return Err(governed_link_error(
            "/aar_rca/investigator_designation_hash|context",
            "exact signed Chair designation and identical tenant/protocol/version/event/scope/investigator",
            format!(
                "designation_hash={}, carried_hash={}",
                designation_hash, aar_rca.investigator_designation_hash,
            ),
        ));
    }

    let mut seen_seats = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut derived_active = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut derived_approve = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut derived_vote_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
    for vote in estop_dispositions {
        validate_estop_disposition(vote)?;
        if vote.tenant_id != estop.tenant_id
            || vote.protocol_id != estop.protocol_id
            || vote.protocol_version_hash != estop.protocol_version_hash
            || vote.event_id != estop.event_id
            || vote.scope_hash != estop.scope_hash
            || vote.eligible_ai_irb_set_hash != estop.eligible_ai_irb_set_hash
        {
            return Err(governed_link_error(
                "/estop_dispositions/context",
                "exact authorization tenant/protocol/version/event/scope/eligible-set context",
                vote.disposition_id.to_string(),
            ));
        }
        if !seen_seats.insert(vote.seat_id.clone())
            || !derived_active.insert(vote.provider_class)
        {
            return Err(governed_link_error(
                "/estop_dispositions/seat_id|provider_class",
                "one distinct signed AI-IRB seat disposition per active provider class",
                format!("{}/{:?}", vote.seat_id, vote.provider_class),
            ));
        }
        if vote.choice == DispositionChoice::Approve {
            derived_approve.insert(vote.provider_class);
        }
        derived_vote_hashes.insert(estop_disposition_hash(vote)?);
    }
    if derived_active != estop.active_provider_classes
        || derived_approve != estop.approve_provider_classes
        || derived_vote_hashes != estop.signed_estop_vote_hashes
    {
        return Err(governed_link_error(
            "/estop_authorization/active_provider_classes|approve_provider_classes|signed_estop_vote_hashes",
            "sets derived exactly from distinct signed E-STOP dispositions",
            format!(
                "active={derived_active:?}, approve={derived_approve:?}, votes={derived_vote_hashes:?}",
            ),
        ));
    }
    validate_estop_authorization(estop)?;
    let estop_hash = estop_authorization_hash(estop)?;

    if notification_attempts.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: "/notification_attempts".to_owned(),
            expected: 1,
            actual: 0,
        });
    }
    let mut destinations = BTreeSet::new();
    for attempt in notification_attempts {
        validate_notification_attempt(attempt)?;
        if !destinations.insert(attempt.destination.clone())
            || attempt.tenant_id != estop.tenant_id
            || attempt.protocol_id != estop.protocol_id
            || attempt.protocol_version_hash != estop.protocol_version_hash
            || attempt.source_kind != NotificationSourceKind::Estop
            || attempt.source_id != estop.estop_id
            || attempt.source_hash != estop_hash
        {
            return Err(governed_link_error(
                "/notification_attempts/source|destination",
                "one independently signed delivery outcome per destination for the exact E-STOP",
                format!("{}:{:?}", attempt.destination, attempt.attempt_status),
            ));
        }
    }

    validate_capa_record(capa)?;
    validate_reset_authorization(reset)?;
    let aar_hash = aar_rca_attestation_hash(aar_rca)?;
    let capa_hash = capa_record_hash(capa)?;
    if capa.event_id != estop.event_id
        || reset.tenant_id != estop.tenant_id
        || reset.protocol_id != estop.protocol_id
        || reset.source_estop_id != estop.estop_id
        || reset.stopped_protocol_version_hash != estop.protocol_version_hash
        || reset.source_estop_authorization_hash != estop_hash
        || reset.source_event_id != estop.event_id
        || reset.stopped_scope_hash != estop.scope_hash
        || reset.aar_rca_attestation_hash != aar_hash
        || reset.capa_record_hash != capa_hash
    {
        return Err(governed_link_error(
            "/reset/source_estop|event|scope|aar_rca|capa",
            "exact stopped E-STOP/version/event/scope and exact signed AAR/RCA plus completed CAPA",
            reset.reset_id.to_string(),
        ));
    }

    let mut council_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut ai_irb_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut promotion_seats = BTreeSet::new();
    for disposition in promotion_dispositions {
        validate_phase_promotion_disposition(disposition)?;
        if disposition.tenant_id != promotion.tenant_id
            || disposition.protocol_id != promotion.protocol_id
            || disposition.protocol_version_hash != promotion.protocol_version_hash
            || disposition.progressive_event_id != promotion.progressive_event_id
            || disposition.from_phase != promotion.from_phase
            || disposition.to_phase != promotion.to_phase
            || disposition.envelope_hash != promotion.envelope_hash
            || !promotion_seats.insert((disposition.body, disposition.seat_id.clone()))
        {
            return Err(governed_link_error(
                "/phase_promotion_dispositions/context|seat_id",
                "unique body/seat and exact promotion version/event/phases/envelope",
                disposition.disposition_id.to_string(),
            ));
        }
        let hash = phase_promotion_disposition_hash(disposition)?;
        match disposition.body {
            SeatKind::Council => {
                council_hashes.insert(hash);
            }
            SeatKind::AiIrb => {
                ai_irb_hashes.insert(hash);
            }
        }
    }
    if council_hashes != promotion.council_disposition_hashes
        || ai_irb_hashes != promotion.ai_irb_disposition_hashes
    {
        return Err(governed_link_error(
            "/phase_promotion/council_disposition_hashes|ai_irb_disposition_hashes",
            "exact hashes of the supplied signed body dispositions",
            format!("council={council_hashes:?}, ai_irb={ai_irb_hashes:?}"),
        ));
    }
    validate_phase_promotion(promotion)
}

pub fn sealed_review_hash(
    review: &SealedReviewCommitmentV1,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    if review.blind_commitment == ProtocolHash256::ZERO {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CrossBinding {
            path: "/sealed_review/blind_commitment".to_owned(),
            expected: "nonzero blind commitment".to_owned(),
            actual: ProtocolHash256::ZERO.to_string(),
        });
    }
    domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::PeerReviewSigningPayloadV1, review)
}

pub fn reveal_package_hash(
    reveal: &SignedBlindReviewRevealPackageV1,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    if reveal.entries.is_empty()
        || reveal.assignment_commitment_set_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || reveal.sealed_review_set_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || reveal.custody_manifest_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || reveal.reveal_gate_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::Cardinality {
            path: "/review_bundle/signed_reveal_package/entries".to_owned(),
            expected: 1,
            actual: reveal.entries.len(),
        });
    }
    domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::BlindReviewRevealPackageV1, reveal)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod wave18_tests {
    use super::*;
    use exo_core::{crypto::KeyPair, types::Signature as CoreSignature};

    #[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
    struct PurposeVector {
        input: PurposeInput,
    }

    #[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
    struct PurposeInput {
        mutation_records: PurposeRecords,
    }

    #[derive(Clone, serde::Deserialize)]
    struct PurposeRecords {
        investigator_designation: InvestigatorDesignation,
        aar_rca_attestation: AarRcaAttestation,
        estop_dispositions: Vec<EstopDisposition>,
        estop_authorization: EstopAuthorization,
        notification_attempts: Vec<NotificationDeliveryReceipt>,
        capa_record: CapaRecord,
        reset_authorization: ResetAuthorization,
        phase_promotion_dispositions: Vec<PhasePromotionDisposition>,
        phase_promotion: PhasePromotion,
    }

    fn purpose_records() -> PurposeRecords {
        let bytes = include_bytes!(concat!(
            env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
            "/../../tools/cross-impl-test/vectors/df_protocol_full_v1.json",
        ));
        let vector: PurposeVector = serde_json::from_slice(bytes).expect("reviewed full vector");
        vector.input.mutation_records
    }

    macro_rules! resign_record {
        ($key:expr, $record:expr, $domain:expr, $payload:expr) => {{
            let digest = domain_hash($domain, &$payload).expect("purpose signing digest");
            let CoreSignature::Ed25519(bytes) = $key.sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
                panic!("test key is Ed25519");
            };
            $record.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
            $record.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
        }};
    }

    macro_rules! assert_wrong_domain_and_target {
        ($key:expr, $record:expr, $payload:expr, $validate:path) => {{
            let mut wrong_target = $record.clone();
            wrong_target.signature.signed_payload_target = SignedPayloadTarget::SeatAttestationV1;
            assert!($validate(&wrong_target).is_err(), "wrong-target");

            let mut wrong_domain = $record.clone();
            resign_record!(
                $key,
                wrong_domain,
                ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolEventV1,
                $payload(&wrong_domain)
            );
            assert!($validate(&wrong_domain).is_err(), "wrong-domain");
        }};
    }

    fn signed_estop(approve_count: usize, result: EstopThresholdResult) -> EstopAuthorization {
        let active = BTreeSet::from([
            ProviderClass::OpenAI,
            ProviderClass::Anthropic,
            ProviderClass::XAi,
            ProviderClass::AlphabetGoogleGemini,
        ]);
        let approve_provider_classes = active.iter().copied().take(approve_count).collect();
        let key = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([49; 32]).expect("deterministic Ed25519 test key");
        let mut record = EstopAuthorization {
            estop_id: ProtocolUuid::parse("018f0f58-6d7a-7cc1-9b6d-000000000398")
                .expect("canonical test UUID"),
            tenant_id: "tenant-alpha".to_owned(),
            protocol_id: "DF-PROTOCOL-001".to_owned(),
            protocol_version_hash: ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xa1; 32]),
            event_id: ProtocolUuid::parse("018f0f58-6d7a-7cc1-9b6d-000000000384")
                .expect("canonical test UUID"),
            scope_hash: ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0x18; 32]),
            eligible_ai_irb_set_hash: ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xa2; 32]),
            active_provider_classes: active,
            approve_provider_classes,
            required_provider_class_count: 3,
            independent_evidence_classes: BTreeSet::from([
                IndependentEvidenceClass::DeterministicTest,
                IndependentEvidenceClass::IndependentNonProviderEvidence,
            ]),
            signed_estop_vote_hashes: [0xb0, 0xb1, 0xb2, 0xb3]
                .into_iter()
                .map(|byte| ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([byte; 32]))
                .collect(),
            threshold_result: result,
            evaluated_at: ProtocolHlc::new(4_240, 0),
            derivation_signer_did: Did::parse("did:exo:estop-deriver")
                .expect("test DID"),
            signature: EstopAuthorizationSignatureV1 {
                algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
                signing_key_id: ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0x90; 32]),
                verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(
                    *key.public_key().as_bytes(),
                ),
                signature: Ed25519Signature::ZERO,
                signed_payload_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
                signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::EstopAuthorizationV1,
            },
            receipt_root: ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0x19; 32]),
        };
        let digest = domain_hash(
            ProtocolHashDomain::EstopAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1,
            &EstopAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1::from(&record),
        )
        .expect("E-STOP signing digest");
        let CoreSignature::Ed25519(bytes) = key.sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
            panic!("test key is Ed25519");
        };
        record.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
        record.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
        record
    }
```

```rust
use std::collections::BTreeSet;

use exo_core::bcts::BctsState;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::protocol::{
    codec::{Did, ProtocolHash256, ProtocolHlc as Timestamp, ProtocolUuid},
    domains::{ProtocolHashDomain, domain_hash},
    error::ProtocolError,
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ProtocolMilestoneKind {
    ProtocolDrafted,
    CompletenessSubmitted,
    IdentityAndConflictResolutionRecorded,
    ConsentAndLicensureValidated,
    BlindedDeliberationRecorded,
    ReproductionAndSecurityVerified,
    GovernanceDispositionsRecorded,
    ExactPackageApproved,
    GovernedActionExecuted,
    ContinuingReviewRecorded,
    CloseoutPublished,
    DenialPublished,
    EscalationRouted,
    RemediationRecorded,
}

impl ProtocolMilestoneKind {
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn bcts_state(self) -> BctsState {
        match self {
            Self::ProtocolDrafted => BctsState::Draft,
            Self::CompletenessSubmitted => BctsState::Submitted,
            Self::IdentityAndConflictResolutionRecorded => BctsState::IdentityResolved,
            Self::ConsentAndLicensureValidated => BctsState::ConsentValidated,
            Self::BlindedDeliberationRecorded => BctsState::Deliberated,
            Self::ReproductionAndSecurityVerified => BctsState::Verified,
            Self::GovernanceDispositionsRecorded => BctsState::Governed,
            Self::ExactPackageApproved => BctsState::Approved,
            Self::GovernedActionExecuted => BctsState::Executed,
            Self::ContinuingReviewRecorded => BctsState::Recorded,
            Self::CloseoutPublished => BctsState::Closed,
            Self::DenialPublished => BctsState::Denied,
            Self::EscalationRouted => BctsState::Escalated,
            Self::RemediationRecorded => BctsState::Remediated,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ProtocolMilestoneEvent {
    pub event_id: ProtocolUuid,
    pub tenant_id: String,
    pub protocol_id: String,
    pub protocol_version_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub milestone_kind: ProtocolMilestoneKind,
    pub bcts_state: BctsState,
    pub actor_did: Did,
    pub occurred_at: Timestamp,
    pub payload_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub previous_milestone_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub receipt_hash: ProtocolHash256,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ProtocolMilestoneEventInput {
    pub event_id: ProtocolUuid,
    pub tenant_id: String,
    pub protocol_id: String,
    pub protocol_version_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub milestone_kind: ProtocolMilestoneKind,
    pub actor_did: Did,
    pub occurred_at: Timestamp,
    pub payload_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub previous_milestone_hash: ProtocolHash256,
}

pub fn create_protocol_milestone_event(
    input: ProtocolMilestoneEventInput,
) -> Result<ProtocolMilestoneEvent, ProtocolError> {
    if input.tenant_id.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "milestone.tenant_id",
        });
    }
    if input.protocol_id.is_empty() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "milestone.protocol_id",
        });
    }
    if input.protocol_version_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
        || input.payload_hash == ProtocolHash256::ZERO
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ZeroNotAllowed {
            field: "milestone.hash",
        });
    }
    let mut event = ProtocolMilestoneEvent {
        event_id: input.event_id,
        tenant_id: input.tenant_id,
        protocol_id: input.protocol_id,
        protocol_version_hash: input.protocol_version_hash,
        milestone_kind: input.milestone_kind,
        bcts_state: input.milestone_kind.bcts_state(),
        actor_did: input.actor_did,
        occurred_at: input.occurred_at,
        payload_hash: input.payload_hash,
        previous_milestone_hash: input.previous_milestone_hash,
        receipt_hash: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
    };
    event.receipt_hash = milestone_receipt_hash(&event)?;
    Ok(event)
}

pub fn milestone_receipt_hash(
    event: &ProtocolMilestoneEvent,
) -> Result<ProtocolHash256, ProtocolError> {
    let mut normalized = event.clone();
    normalized.receipt_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolMilestoneEventV1, &normalized)
}

pub fn validate_milestone_chain(events: &[ProtocolMilestoneEvent]) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let Some(first) = events.first() else {
        return Err(ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
            field: "milestone_chain",
        });
    };
    if first.bcts_state != BctsState::Draft
        || first.milestone_kind != ProtocolMilestoneKind::ProtocolDrafted
        || first.previous_milestone_hash != ProtocolHash256::ZERO
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidBctsTransition {
            from: BctsState::Draft,
            to: first.bcts_state,
        });
    }
    let scope = (
        first.tenant_id.as_str(),
        first.protocol_id.as_str(),
        first.protocol_version_hash,
    );
    let mut event_ids = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut receipt_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
    for (index, event) in events.iter().enumerate() {
        let sequence = u64::try_from(index)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(1))
            .ok_or(ProtocolError::IntegerOverflow {
                operation: "milestone sequence",
            })?;
        if event.milestone_kind.bcts_state() != event.bcts_state {
            return Err(ProtocolError::MilestoneStateMismatch {
                expected: event.milestone_kind.bcts_state(),
                actual: event.bcts_state,
            });
        }
        if (
            event.tenant_id.as_str(),
            event.protocol_id.as_str(),
            event.protocol_version_hash,
        ) != scope
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
                field: "milestone scope",
                sequence,
            });
        }
        if !event_ids.insert(event.event_id) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::DuplicateIdentifier {
                collection: "milestone_chain.event_id",
                id: event.event_id.to_string(),
            });
        }
        let expected_hash = milestone_receipt_hash(event)?;
        if expected_hash != event.receipt_hash {
            return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
                component: "milestone.receipt_hash",
                expected: expected_hash,
                actual: event.receipt_hash,
            });
        }
        if !receipt_hashes.insert(event.receipt_hash) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptCycle {
                path: format!("/milestones/{index}/receipt_hash"),
                expected: "receipt hash not previously observed".to_owned(),
                actual: event.receipt_hash.to_string(),
            });
        }
        if let Some(previous) = index.checked_sub(1).and_then(|value| events.get(value)) {
            if !previous.bcts_state.can_transition_to(event.bcts_state) {
                return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidBctsTransition {
                    from: previous.bcts_state,
                    to: event.bcts_state,
                });
            }
            if event.occurred_at <= previous.occurred_at {
                return Err(ProtocolError::NonMonotonicHlc {
                    sequence,
                    previous: previous.occurred_at,
                    current: event.occurred_at,
                });
            }
            if event.previous_milestone_hash != previous.receipt_hash {
                return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptLinkMismatch {
                    sequence,
                    expected: previous.receipt_hash,
                    actual: event.previous_milestone_hash,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
    receipt: &ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1,

pub fn execution_receipt_chain_root(
    chain: &ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
```
