pub(super) fn next_receipt_sequence(
    current: u64,
    operation: &'static str,
) -> Result<u64, ProtocolError> {
    current
        .checked_add(1)
        .ok_or(ProtocolError::IntegerOverflow { operation })
}

pub(super) fn build_execution_receipt_segment(
    verified_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    verified_predecessor: Option<&VerifiedExecutionSegment>,
    signer_authorities: &VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1,
    receipts: Vec<ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1>,
) -> Result<ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1, ProtocolError> {
    let first = receipts.first().ok_or(ProtocolError::EmptyReceiptChain)?;
    let last = receipts.last().ok_or(ProtocolError::EmptyReceiptChain)?;
    let tenant_id = first.tenant_id.clone();
    let protocol_id = first.protocol_id.clone();
    let protocol_version_hash = first.protocol_version_hash;
    let authorized_package_root = first.authorized_package_root;
    let first_sequence = first.sequence;
    let terminal_sequence = last.sequence;
    let (previous_chain_root, predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash, predecessor_terminal_sequence) =
        verified_predecessor.map_or((ProtocolHash256::ZERO, ProtocolHash256::ZERO, 0), |value| {
            (
                value.chain_root,
                value.terminal_receipt_hash,
                value.terminal_sequence,
            )
        });
    let receipt_count =
        u64::try_from(receipts.len()).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::IntegerOverflow {
            operation: "receipt_count",
        })?;
    let terminal_receipt_hash = protocol_execution_receipt_hash(last)?;
    let signer_authority_references = receipts
        .iter()
        .map(|receipt| receipt.signer_did.clone())
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|did| {
            signer_authorities
                .exact_reference(&did, AuthorityScope::ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1)
                .map(|reference| (did, reference))
        })
        .collect::<Result<BTreeMap<_, _>, _>>()?;
    let mut chain = ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1 {
        schema_version: 1,
        tenant_id,
        protocol_id,
        protocol_version_hash,
        authorized_package_root,
        previous_chain_root,
        predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash,
        predecessor_terminal_sequence,
        first_sequence,
        signer_authorities: signer_authority_references,
        receipts,
        terminal_receipt_hash,
        terminal_sequence,
        receipt_count,
        chain_root: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
    };
    chain.chain_root = execution_receipt_chain_root(&chain)?;
    verify_execution_receipt_segment(
        &chain,
        verified_root,
        verified_predecessor,
        signer_authorities,
    )?;
    Ok(chain)
}

pub(super) fn verify_execution_receipt_segment(
    chain: &ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
    verified_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    verified_predecessor: Option<&VerifiedExecutionSegment>,
    signer_authorities: &VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1,
) -> Result<VerifiedExecutionSegment, ProtocolError> {
    if chain.schema_version != 1 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::UnsupportedSchemaVersion {
            found: chain.schema_version,
        });
    }
    let first = chain
        .receipts
        .first()
        .ok_or(ProtocolError::EmptyReceiptChain)?;
    let last = chain
        .receipts
        .last()
        .ok_or(ProtocolError::EmptyReceiptChain)?;
    let (root_tenant, root_protocol, root_version, root_hash) = package_scope(verified_root);
    if chain.tenant_id != root_tenant
        || chain.protocol_id != root_protocol
        || chain.protocol_version_hash != root_version
        || chain.authorized_package_root != root_hash
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
            field: "chain",
            sequence: first.sequence,
        });
    }
    let expected_first = match verified_predecessor {
        None => {
            if chain.previous_chain_root != ProtocolHash256::ZERO
                || chain.predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash != ProtocolHash256::ZERO
                || chain.predecessor_terminal_sequence != 0
                || first.previous_receipt_hash != ProtocolHash256::ZERO
            {
                return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptLinkMismatch {
                    sequence: first.sequence,
                    expected: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
                    actual: first.previous_receipt_hash,
                });
            }
            1
        }
        Some(predecessor) => {
            if predecessor.tenant_id != chain.tenant_id
                || predecessor.protocol_id != chain.protocol_id
                || chain.previous_chain_root != predecessor.chain_root
                || chain.predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash != predecessor.terminal_receipt_hash
                || chain.predecessor_terminal_sequence != predecessor.terminal_sequence
                || first.previous_receipt_hash != predecessor.terminal_receipt_hash
            {
                return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
                    field: "predecessor",
                    sequence: first.sequence,
                });
            }
            if first.occurred_at <= predecessor.terminal_timestamp {
                return Err(ProtocolError::NonMonotonicHlc {
                    sequence: first.sequence,
                    previous: predecessor.terminal_timestamp,
                    current: first.occurred_at,
                });
            }
            next_receipt_sequence(predecessor.terminal_sequence, "first_sequence")?
        }
    };
    if chain.first_sequence != expected_first || first.sequence != expected_first {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptSequenceMismatch {
            expected: expected_first,
            actual: first.sequence,
        });
    }
    let mut expected_sequence = expected_first;
    let mut expected_previous = first.previous_receipt_hash;
    let mut previous_timestamp =
        verified_predecessor.map(VerifiedExecutionSegment::terminal_timestamp);
    // Segment-local replay/cycle sets. History-wide replay and stale-head fork
    // checks are owned only by Gate 17 in history.rs.
    let mut receipt_ids = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut idempotency_keys = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut receipt_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut segment_roots = BTreeSet::new();
    for receipt in &chain.receipts {
        if receipt.sequence != expected_sequence {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptSequenceMismatch {
                expected: expected_sequence,
                actual: receipt.sequence,
            });
        }
        if receipt.tenant_id != chain.tenant_id
            || receipt.protocol_id != chain.protocol_id
            || receipt.protocol_version_hash != chain.protocol_version_hash
            || receipt.authorized_package_root != chain.authorized_package_root
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
                field: "receipt",
                sequence: receipt.sequence,
            });
        }
        if receipt.previous_receipt_hash != expected_previous {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptLinkMismatch {
                sequence: receipt.sequence,
                expected: expected_previous,
                actual: receipt.previous_receipt_hash,
            });
        }
        if let Some(previous) = previous_timestamp
            && receipt.occurred_at <= previous
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::NonMonotonicHlc {
                sequence: receipt.sequence,
                previous,
                current: receipt.occurred_at,
            });
        }
        if !receipt_ids.insert(receipt.receipt_id) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
                path: format!("/receipts/{}/receipt_id", receipt.sequence),
                kind: "receipt_id",
                value: receipt.receipt_id.to_string(),
            });
        }
        if !idempotency_keys.insert(receipt.idempotency_key_hash) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
                path: format!("/receipts/{}/idempotency_key_hash", receipt.sequence),
                kind: "idempotency_key_hash",
                value: receipt.idempotency_key_hash.to_string(),
            });
        }
        let authority = chain.signer_authorities.get(&receipt.signer_did).ok_or(
            ProtocolError::EmptyRequiredValue {
                field: "chain.signer_authorities",
            },
        )?;
        let independently_verified = signer_authorities.exact_reference(
            &receipt.signer_did,
            AuthorityScope::ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1,
        )?;
        if authority != &independently_verified
            || authority.actor_did != receipt.signer_did
            || authority.scope != AuthorityScope::ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1
            || authority.tenant_id != chain.tenant_id
            || authority.protocol_id != chain.protocol_id
            || authority.signing_key_id != receipt.signature.signing_key_id
            || authority.verification_key != receipt.signature.verification_key
            || receipt.signature.signed_payload_target
                != SignedPayloadTarget::ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
                field: "signer_authority_shape",
                sequence: receipt.sequence,
            });
        }
        let expected_payload = protocol_execution_receipt_payload_hash(receipt)?;
        if expected_payload != receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash {
            return Err(ProtocolError::SignaturePayloadMismatch {
                target: "ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1",
            });
        }
        let public = PublicKey::from_bytes(*receipt.signature.verification_key.as_bytes());
        let signature = Signature::Ed25519(*receipt.signature.signature.as_bytes());
        if !crypto::verify(expected_payload.as_bytes(), &signature, &public) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidSignature {
                target: "ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1",
            });
        }
        let receipt_hash = protocol_execution_receipt_hash(receipt)?;
        if !receipt_hashes.insert(receipt_hash) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptCycle {
                path: format!("/receipts/{}/signed_receipt_hash", receipt.sequence),
                expected: "signed receipt hash not previously observed".to_owned(),
                actual: receipt_hash.to_string(),
            });
        }
        expected_previous = receipt_hash;
        previous_timestamp = Some(receipt.occurred_at);
        expected_sequence = next_receipt_sequence(expected_sequence, "receipt sequence")?;
    }
    let count =
        u64::try_from(chain.receipts.len()).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::IntegerOverflow {
            operation: "receipt_count",
        })?;
    let last_hash = protocol_execution_receipt_hash(last)?;
    if chain.receipt_count != count
        || chain.terminal_sequence != last.sequence
        || chain.terminal_receipt_hash != last_hash
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
            field: "chain terminal metadata",
            sequence: last.sequence,
        });
    }
    let expected_root = execution_receipt_chain_root(chain)?;
    if expected_root != chain.chain_root {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "execution_receipt_chain",
            expected: expected_root,
            actual: chain.chain_root,
        });
    }
    if !segment_roots.insert(chain.chain_root) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
            path: "/chain_root".to_owned(),
            kind: "segment_root",
            value: chain.chain_root.to_string(),
        });
    }
    Ok(VerifiedExecutionSegment {
        tenant_id: chain.tenant_id.clone(),
        protocol_id: chain.protocol_id.clone(),
        protocol_version: verified_root.protocol_version(),
        protocol_version_hash: chain.protocol_version_hash,
        authorized_package_root: chain.authorized_package_root,
        previous_chain_root: chain.previous_chain_root,
        predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash: chain.predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash,
        predecessor_terminal_sequence: chain.predecessor_terminal_sequence,

fn verify_root_history_lineage(
    verified_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    history: &VerifiedExecutionHistory,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    let head = &history.head;
    let same_package = verified_root.protocol_version() == head.protocol_version
        && verified_root.protocol_version_hash() == head.protocol_version_hash
        && verified_root.final_package_root() == head.authorized_package_root;
    if verified_root.tenant_id() != head.tenant_id
        || verified_root.protocol_id() != head.protocol_id
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.scope",
            expected: head.chain_root,
            actual: verified_root
                .verified_predecessor()
                .map_or(ProtocolHash256::ZERO, |value| value.chain_root),
        });
    }
    if same_package {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let expected = successor_chain_reference(history);
    let actual = verified_root.verified_predecessor().ok_or(
        ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            expected: expected.chain_root,
            actual: ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
        },
    )?;
    if verified_root.protocol_version() <= head.protocol_version || actual != &expected {
        return Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            expected: expected.chain_root,
            actual: actual.chain_root,
        });
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn build_execution_receipt_chain(
    verified_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    verified_history: Option<&VerifiedExecutionHistory>,
    signer_authorities: &VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1,
    receipts: Vec<ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1>,
) -> Result<ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1, ProtocolError> {
    match verified_history {
        Some(history) => verify_root_history_lineage(verified_root, history)?,
        None
            if verified_root.protocol_version() != 1
                || verified_root.verified_predecessor().is_some() =>
        {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence {
                version: verified_root.protocol_version(),
            });
        }
        None => {}
    }
    build_execution_receipt_segment(
        verified_root,
        verified_history.map(|value| &value.head),
        signer_authorities,
        receipts,
    )
}

pub fn begin_execution_history(
    genesis_package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    chain: &ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
    verified_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    signer_authorities: &VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1,
) -> Result<VerifiedExecutionHistory, ProtocolError> {
    if genesis_package.protocol_identity.version != 1
        || genesis_package
            .protocol_identity
            .prior_version_hash
            .is_some()
        || genesis_package
            .receipt_manifest
            .prior_execution_receipt_chain
            .is_some()
        || protocol_version_hash(&genesis_package.protocol_identity)?
            != verified_root.protocol_version_hash()
        || genesis_package.receipt_manifest.final_package_root != verified_root.final_package_root()
        || verified_root.protocol_version() != 1
        || verified_root.verified_predecessor().is_some()
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence {
            version: genesis_package.protocol_identity.version,
        });
    }
    let head = verify_execution_receipt_segment(chain, verified_root, None, signer_authorities)?;
    Ok(VerifiedExecutionHistory {
        receipt_ids: head.receipt_ids.clone(),
        idempotency_keys: head.idempotency_keys.clone(),
        receipt_hashes: head.receipt_hashes.clone(),
        segment_roots: head.segment_roots.clone(),
        head,
    })
}
// END OWNER

// BEGIN OWNER: crates/decision-forum/src/protocol/receipt/history.rs GATE 16 INITIAL
pub fn verify_and_advance_execution_history(
    history: &mut VerifiedExecutionHistory,
    verified_current_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    chain: &ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
    signer_authorities: &VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    verify_root_history_lineage(verified_current_root, history)?;
    let next = verify_execution_receipt_segment(
        chain,
        verified_current_root,
        Some(&history.head),
        signer_authorities,
    )?;
    history.receipt_ids.extend(next.receipt_ids.iter().copied());
    history
        .idempotency_keys
        .extend(next.idempotency_keys.iter().copied());
    history
        .receipt_hashes
        .extend(next.receipt_hashes.iter().copied());
    history
        .segment_roots
        .extend(next.segment_roots.iter().copied());
    history.head = next;
    Ok(())
}

// BEGIN OWNER: crates/decision-forum/src/protocol/receipt/history.rs GATE 17 REPLACEMENT
pub fn verify_and_advance_execution_history(
    history: &mut VerifiedExecutionHistory,
    verified_current_root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    chain: &ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
    signer_authorities: &VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1,
) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    verify_root_history_lineage(verified_current_root, history)?;
    if chain.previous_chain_root != history.head.chain_root {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptFork {
            path: "/previous_chain_root".to_owned(),
            expected_head: history.head.chain_root,
            actual_head: chain.previous_chain_root,
        });
    }
    let next = verify_execution_receipt_segment(
        chain,
        verified_current_root,
        Some(&history.head),
        signer_authorities,
    )?;
    if let Some(value) = next.receipt_ids.intersection(&history.receipt_ids).next() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
            path: "/history/receipt_id".to_owned(),
            kind: "receipt_id",
            value: value.to_string(),
        });
    }
    if let Some(value) = next
        .idempotency_keys
        .intersection(&history.idempotency_keys)
        .next()
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
            path: "/history/idempotency_key_hash".to_owned(),
            kind: "idempotency_key_hash",
            value: value.to_string(),
        });
    }
    if let Some(value) = next.receipt_hashes.intersection(&history.receipt_hashes).next() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptCycle {
            path: "/history/signed_receipt_hash".to_owned(),
            expected: "signed receipt hash not previously observed".to_owned(),
            actual: value.to_string(),
        });
    }
    if let Some(value) = next.segment_roots.intersection(&history.segment_roots).next() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
            path: "/history/chain_root".to_owned(),
            kind: "segment_root",
            value: value.to_string(),
        });
    }
    history.receipt_ids.extend(next.receipt_ids.iter().copied());
    history
        .idempotency_keys
        .extend(next.idempotency_keys.iter().copied());
    history
        .receipt_hashes
        .extend(next.receipt_hashes.iter().copied());
    history
        .segment_roots
        .extend(next.segment_roots.iter().copied());
    history.head = next;
    Ok(())
}

```rust
use crate::protocol::receipt::{VerifiedExecutionHistory, successor_chain_reference};

pub fn verify_package_root(
    package: &PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    trust: &VerifiedPackageTrustRegistryV1,
    verified_predecessor: Option<&VerifiedExecutionHistory>,
) -> Result<VerifiedPackageRoot, ProtocolError> {
    if package.protocol_identity.version == 1 {
        if verified_predecessor.is_some() {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence { version: 1 });
        }
        return verify_v1_package_root(package, trust);
    }
    validate_protocol_structure(package)?;
    let predecessor = verified_predecessor.ok_or(ProtocolError::InvalidPredecessorPresence {
        version: package.protocol_identity.version,
    })?;
    let expected_reference = successor_chain_reference(predecessor);
    let actual_reference = package
        .receipt_manifest
        .prior_execution_receipt_chain
        .as_ref()
        .ok_or(ProtocolError::HalfNullPredecessor {
            version: package.protocol_identity.version,
        })?;
    if actual_reference.previous_chain_root != expected_reference.previous_chain_root {
        return Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptFork {
            path: "/receipt_manifest/prior_execution_receipt_chain/previous_chain_root".to_owned(),
            expected_head: expected_reference.previous_chain_root,
            actual_head: actual_reference.previous_chain_root,
        });
    }
    if actual_reference != &expected_reference
        || package.protocol_identity.prior_version_hash
            != Some(expected_reference.prior_protocol_version_hash)
        || actual_reference.tenant_id != package.protocol_identity.tenant_id
        || actual_reference.protocol_id != package.protocol_identity.protocol_id
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "prior_execution_receipt_chain",
            expected: expected_reference.chain_root,
            actual: actual_reference.chain_root,
        });
    }
    verify_package_self_consistency(package)?;
    let computed_version = protocol_version_hash(&package.protocol_identity)?;
    let authorization = authorization_target_hash(package)?;
    let prepublication = prepublication_root(package)?;
    trust.verify_package_graph(package, computed_version, authorization)?;
    validate_context_graph(package, computed_version, authorization, prepublication)?;
    if let Some(genesis) = &package.receipt_manifest.genesis_adoption_receipt {
        verify_genesis_adoption_receipt(
            genesis,
            CurrentPackageCommitments {
                authorization_target_hash: authorization,
                prepublication_root: prepublication,
                final_package_root: package.receipt_manifest.final_package_root,
            },
        )?;
    }
    let expected = recompute_final_package_root(package)?;
    let actual = package.receipt_manifest.final_package_root;
    if expected != actual {
        return Err(ProtocolError::CommitmentMismatch {
            component: "final_package_root",
            expected,
            actual,
        });
    }
    Ok(VerifiedPackageRoot {
        tenant_id: package.protocol_identity.tenant_id.clone(),
        protocol_id: package.protocol_identity.protocol_id.clone(),
        protocol_version: package.protocol_identity.version,
        protocol_version_hash: computed_version,
        final_package_root: actual,
        verified_predecessor: Some(expected_reference),
    })
}

No package-supplied raw predecessor reference can satisfy this function; the

pub fn signed_receipts(
    root: &VerifiedPackageRoot,
    predecessor: Option<&VerifiedExecutionHistory>,
    count: u8,
) -> (VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1, Vec<ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1>) {
    let (authorities, signer) = crate::protocol::trust::verified_test_execution_authority();
    let mut previous = predecessor.map_or(
        ProtocolHash256::ZERO,
        VerifiedExecutionHistory::terminal_receipt_hash,
    );
    let first = predecessor.map_or(1, |value| value.terminal_sequence() + 1);
    let mut receipts = Vec::new();
    for offset in 0..count {
        let sequence = first + u64::from(offset);
        let sequence_byte = u8::try_from(sequence).expect("fixture sequence fits u8");
        let mut receipt = ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1 {
            receipt_id: uuid(100 + sequence_byte),
            tenant_id: root.tenant_id().to_owned(),
            protocol_id: root.protocol_id().to_owned(),
            protocol_version_hash: root.protocol_version_hash(),
            authorized_package_root: root.final_package_root(),
            sequence,
            receipt_kind: ProtocolExecutionReceiptKind::ActionExecuted,
            previous_receipt_hash: previous,
            payload_hash: hash(100 + sequence_byte),
            idempotency_key_hash: hash(120 + sequence_byte),
            occurred_at: Timestamp::new(200 + sequence, 0),
            signer_did: signer.actor_did().clone(),
            signature: ProtocolExecutionReceiptSignatureV1 {
                algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
                signing_key_id: signer.signing_key_id(),
                verification_key: signer.verification_key(),
                signature: Ed25519Signature::from_bytes([1; 64]),
                signed_payload_hash: hash(1),
                signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1,
            },
        };
        let digest = protocol_execution_receipt_payload_hash(&receipt).expect("receipt digest");
        receipt.signature.signature = signer.sign(digest);
        receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
        previous = protocol_execution_receipt_hash(&receipt).expect("receipt hash");
        receipts.push(receipt);
    }
    (authorities, receipts)
}

pub(crate) fn verified_v1_history() -> VerifiedExecutionHistory {
    let package = valid_v1_package();
    let trust = independent_trust_context();
    let root = verify_package_root(&package, &trust, None).expect("v1 root");
    let (authorities, receipts) = signed_receipts(&root, None, 2);
    let segment =
        build_execution_receipt_chain(&root, None, &authorities, receipts).expect("v1 segment");
    begin_execution_history(&package, &segment, &root, &authorities).expect("verified v1 history")
}

        &package.review_bundle.council_seat_attestations.xai,
        &package
            .review_bundle
            .council_seat_attestations
            .alphabet_google_gemini,
        &package
            .review_bundle
            .council_seat_attestations
            .independent_non_provider,
    ];
    let ai_irb_attestations = [
        &package.review_bundle.ai_irb_seat_attestations.openai,
        &package.review_bundle.ai_irb_seat_attestations.anthropic,
        &package.review_bundle.ai_irb_seat_attestations.xai,
        &package
            .review_bundle
            .ai_irb_seat_attestations
            .alphabet_google_gemini,
        &package
            .review_bundle
            .ai_irb_seat_attestations
            .independent_non_provider,
    ];
    let council_seats = council_attestations
        .iter()
        .map(|seat| {
            domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationV1, *seat).expect("Council seat hash")
        })
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let ai_irb_seats = ai_irb_attestations
        .iter()
        .map(|seat| {
            domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::SeatAttestationV1, *seat).expect("AI-IRB seat hash")
        })
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    for (index, proof) in package
        .disposition_bundle
        .quorum_proofs
        .iter_mut()
        .enumerate()
    {
        proof.proof_id = uuid(225 + u8::try_from(index).expect("quorum index"));
        proof.eligible_seat_hashes = match proof.seat_kind {
            SeatKind::Council => council_seats.clone(),
            SeatKind::AiIrb => ai_irb_seats.clone(),
        };
        proof.approve_seat_hashes = proof.eligible_seat_hashes.clone();
        proof.eligible_count = 5;
        proof.approve_count = 5;
        proof.required_count = 5;
        proof.result = QuorumResult::EligibleUnanimity;
        proof.computed_at = Timestamp::new(220 + u64::try_from(index).expect("quorum index"), 0);
        proof.proof_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
        proof.proof_hash =
            domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::QuorumProofV1, proof).expect("v2 quorum proof hash");
    }

    let chair = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([41; 32]).expect("Chair key");
    for (index, intervention) in package
        .disposition_bundle
        .chair_interventions
        .iter_mut()
        .enumerate()
    {
        intervention.intervention_id = uuid(230 + u8::try_from(index).expect("Chair index"));
        intervention.comment_hash = hash(160 + u8::try_from(index).expect("Chair index"));
        intervention.authorization_target_hash = authorization;
        intervention.protocol_version_hash = version;
        intervention.signed_at =
            Timestamp::new(230 + u64::try_from(index).expect("Chair index"), 0);
        intervention.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::ZERO;
        intervention.signature.signed_payload_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
        let digest = domain_hash(
            ProtocolHashDomain::ChairInterventionSigningPayloadV1,
            &ChairInterventionSigningPayloadV1::from(&*intervention),
        )
        .expect("v2 Chair digest");
        let Signature::Ed25519(bytes) = chair.sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
            panic!("fixture uses Ed25519");
        };
        intervention.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
        intervention.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
    }

    let publisher = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([42; 32]).expect("publisher key");
    let mut receipt = PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1 {
        prepublication_root: prepublication_root(&package).expect("v2 prepublication"),
        renderer_manifest_hash: hash(250),
        publisher_did: did("did:exo:publisher"),
        authorized_at: Timestamp::new(250, 0),
        publisher_authority: PublisherAuthorityV1 {
            publisher_did: did("did:exo:publisher"),
            signing_key_id: hash(202),
            verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(
                *publisher.public_key().as_bytes(),
            ),
            authority_chain_hash: hash(203),
        },
        signature: PublicationAuthorizationSignatureV1 {
            algorithm: SignatureAlgorithm::Ed25519,
            signing_key_id: hash(202),
            verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(
                *publisher.public_key().as_bytes(),
            ),
            signature: Ed25519Signature::from_bytes([1; 64]),
            signed_payload_hash: hash(1),
            signed_payload_target: SignedPayloadTarget::PublicationAuthorizationReceiptV1,
        },
    };
    let digest = publication_authorization_payload_hash(&receipt).expect("publication digest");
    let Signature::Ed25519(bytes) = publisher.sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
        panic!("Ed25519");
    };
    receipt.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
    receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
    package.receipt_manifest.publication_authorization_receipt = Some(receipt);
    package.receipt_manifest.final_package_root =
        recompute_final_package_root(&package).expect("v2 root");
    package
}

fn rebuild_distinct_package_root(
    mut package: PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    suffix: &str,
) -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    package.protocol_document.abstract_text.push_str(suffix);
    let keys = fixture_seat_key_map(1);
    resign_complete_package_graph(
        &mut package,
        &keys,
        false,
        &KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([41; 32]).expect("Chair key"),
        &KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([42; 32]).expect("publisher key"),
    );
    package
}

pub(crate) fn valid_distinct_v1_package() -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    rebuild_distinct_package_root(valid_v1_package(), " distinct-v1-lineage")
}

pub(crate) fn valid_distinct_v2_package(
    predecessor: &VerifiedExecutionHistory,
) -> PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1 {
    rebuild_distinct_package_root(valid_v2_package(predecessor), " distinct-v2-lineage")
}

fn root_history_lineage_rejects_disconnected_rebound_and_other_history_without_mutation() {
    assert_lineage_inventory_cases(&[
        "disconnected_same_scope_v1_root",
        "same_version_different_root_rebind",
        "successor_verified_against_other_history",
    ]);
    let trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let package_a = fixture::valid_v1_package();
    let root_a = verify_package_root(&package_a, &trust, None).expect("root A");
    let (authorities_a, receipts_a) = fixture::signed_receipts(&root_a, None, 2);
    let segment_a = build_execution_receipt_chain(
        &root_a,
        None,
        &authorities_a,
        receipts_a,
    )
    .expect("segment A");
    let mut history_a = begin_execution_history(
        &package_a,
        &segment_a,
        &root_a,
        &authorities_a,
    )
    .expect("history A");

    let package_b = fixture::valid_distinct_v1_package();
    let root_b = verify_package_root(&package_b, &trust, None).expect("root B");
    assert_eq!(root_a.tenant_id(), root_b.tenant_id());
    assert_eq!(root_a.protocol_id(), root_b.protocol_id());
    assert_ne!(root_a.final_package_root(), root_b.final_package_root());

    let before_disconnected_builder = history_snapshot(&history_a);
    let (authorities_b, receipts_b) =
        fixture::signed_receipts(&root_b, Some(&history_a), 1);
    assert!(matches!(
        build_execution_receipt_chain(
            &root_b,
            Some(&history_a),
            &authorities_b,
            receipts_b.clone(),
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history_a), before_disconnected_builder);

    let rebound_segment = build_execution_receipt_segment(
        &root_b,
        Some(&history_a.head),
        &authorities_b,
        receipts_b,
    )
    .expect("private segment isolates root/history compatibility from receipt validity");
    let before_same_version_rebind = history_snapshot(&history_a);
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_and_advance_execution_history(
            &mut history_a,
            &root_b,
            &rebound_segment,
            &authorities_b,
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history_a), before_same_version_rebind);

    let (authorities_b0, receipts_b0) = fixture::signed_receipts(&root_b, None, 2);
    let segment_b = build_execution_receipt_chain(&root_b, None, &authorities_b0, receipts_b0)
        .expect("segment B");
    let history_b = begin_execution_history(
        &package_b,
        &segment_b,
        &root_b,
        &authorities_b0,
    )
    .expect("history B");
    let successor_b = fixture::valid_v2_package(&history_b);
    let successor_root_b = verify_package_root(&successor_b, &trust, Some(&history_b))
        .expect("successor verified only against history B");
    let (successor_authorities, successor_receipts) =
        fixture::signed_receipts(&successor_root_b, Some(&history_a), 1);
    let before_other_history_builder = history_snapshot(&history_a);
    assert!(matches!(
        build_execution_receipt_chain(
            &successor_root_b,
            Some(&history_a),
            &successor_authorities,
            successor_receipts.clone(),
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history_a), before_other_history_builder);

    let other_history_segment = build_execution_receipt_segment(
        &successor_root_b,
        Some(&history_a.head),
        &successor_authorities,
        successor_receipts,
    )
    .expect("private segment is otherwise valid for history A's receipt head");
    let before_other_history_advance = history_snapshot(&history_a);
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_and_advance_execution_history(
            &mut history_a,
            &successor_root_b,
            &other_history_segment,
            &successor_authorities,
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history_a), before_other_history_advance);
}

#[test]
fn v2_continues_v1_sequence_and_hash_with_new_version_and_root() {
    let v1 = fixture::valid_v1_package();
    let v1_trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let root = verify_v1_package_root(&v1, &v1_trust).expect("v1 root");
    let (authorities, receipts) = fixture::signed_receipts(&root, None, 2);
    let first = build_execution_receipt_chain(&root, None, &authorities, receipts).expect("first");
    let mut history =
        begin_execution_history(&v1, &first, &root, &authorities).expect("v1 history");
    let v2 = fixture::valid_v2_package(&history);
    let v2_trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let verified_v2 = verify_package_root(&v2, &v2_trust, Some(&history)).expect("successor root");
    assert_ne!(
        root.protocol_version_hash(),
        verified_v2.protocol_version_hash()
    );
    assert_ne!(root.final_package_root(), verified_v2.final_package_root());

    let mut forged = v2.clone();
    forged
        .receipt_manifest
        .prior_execution_receipt_chain
        .as_mut()
        .expect("reference")
        .terminal_sequence += 1;
    forged.receipt_manifest.final_package_root =
        decision_forum::protocol::recompute_final_package_root(&forged).expect("forged root");
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_package_root(&forged, &v2_trust, Some(&history)),
        Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "prior_execution_receipt_chain",
            ..
        })
    ));

    let (authorities, receipts) = fixture::signed_receipts(&verified_v2, Some(&history), 2);
    let continuation =
        build_execution_receipt_chain(&verified_v2, Some(&history), &authorities, receipts)
            .expect("continuation");
    verify_and_advance_execution_history(&mut history, &verified_v2, &continuation, &authorities)
        .expect("v2 continues v1 history");
    let v1_ids = first
        .receipts
        .iter()
        .map(|receipt| receipt.receipt_id)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let v2_ids = continuation
        .receipts
        .iter()
        .map(|receipt| receipt.receipt_id)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let v1_keys = first
        .receipts
        .iter()
        .map(|receipt| receipt.idempotency_key_hash)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let v2_keys = continuation
        .receipts
        .iter()
        .map(|receipt| receipt.idempotency_key_hash)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    assert!(v1_ids.is_disjoint(&v2_ids));
    assert!(v1_keys.is_disjoint(&v2_keys));
    assert!(!verified_v2.grants_authority());
    assert_eq!(
        v2.receipt_manifest.prior_execution_receipt_chain.as_ref(),
        Some(&successor_chain_reference(
            &begin_execution_history(&v1, &first, &root, &authorities).expect("v1 history"),
        )),
    );
}

Expected RED for the second test: the old public builder accepts a v2 root with
sequence 1 and zero links. GREEN: the builder returns exact

```rust
fn resign_segment(chain: &mut ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1) {
    use exo_core::{crypto::KeyPair, types::Signature};
    let key = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([77; 32]).expect("fixture executor key");
    let mut previous = chain.predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash;
    for receipt in &mut chain.receipts {
        receipt.previous_receipt_hash = previous;
        let digest = protocol_execution_receipt_payload_hash(receipt).expect("payload");
        let Signature::Ed25519(bytes) = key.sign(digest.as_bytes()) else {
            panic!("fixture uses Ed25519");
        };
        receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash = digest;
        receipt.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
        previous = protocol_execution_receipt_hash(receipt).expect("receipt hash");
    }
    chain.terminal_receipt_hash = previous;
    chain.chain_root = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    chain.chain_root = execution_receipt_chain_root(chain).expect("chain root");
}

#[test]
fn history_rejects_replay_stale_successor_and_second_segment_without_mutation() {
    assert_lineage_inventory_cases(&["stale_successor_after_head_advance"]);
    let v1 = fixture::valid_v1_package();
    let v1_trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let v1_root = verify_v1_package_root(&v1, &v1_trust).expect("v1 root");
    let (authorities, receipts) = fixture::signed_receipts(&v1_root, None, 2);
    let first =
        build_execution_receipt_chain(&v1_root, None, &authorities, receipts).expect("v1 segment");
    let mut history =
        begin_execution_history(&v1, &first, &v1_root, &authorities).expect("history");
    let v2 = fixture::valid_v2_package(&history);
    let v2_trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let v2_root = verify_package_root(&v2, &v2_trust, Some(&history)).expect("v2 root");
    let stale_v2 = fixture::valid_distinct_v2_package(&history);
    let stale_v2_root = verify_package_root(&stale_v2, &v2_trust, Some(&history))
        .expect("second successor verified against the same old head");

    let (authorities, receipts) = fixture::signed_receipts(&v2_root, Some(&history), 1);
    let accepted = build_execution_receipt_chain(&v2_root, Some(&history), &authorities, receipts)
        .expect("accepted successor");
    let (stale_authorities, stale_receipts) =
        fixture::signed_receipts(&stale_v2_root, Some(&history), 1);
    let stale_segment = build_execution_receipt_chain(
        &stale_v2_root,
        Some(&history),
        &stale_authorities,
        stale_receipts,
    )
    .expect("stale successor is valid only while the old head is current");

    let mut reused_id = accepted.clone();
    reused_id.receipts[0].receipt_id = first.receipts[0].receipt_id;
    resign_segment(&mut reused_id);
    let reused_id_segment = build_execution_receipt_chain(
        &v2_root,
        Some(&history),
        &authorities,
        reused_id.receipts,
    )
    .expect("segment-local receipt id is structurally valid");
    let before_reused_id = history_snapshot(&history);
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_and_advance_execution_history(
            &mut history,
            &v2_root,
            &reused_id_segment,
            &authorities,
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
            kind: "receipt_id",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history), before_reused_id);

    let mut reused_key = accepted.clone();
    reused_key.receipts[0].idempotency_key_hash = first.receipts[0].idempotency_key_hash;
    resign_segment(&mut reused_key);
    let reused_key_segment = build_execution_receipt_chain(
        &v2_root,
        Some(&history),
        &authorities,
        reused_key.receipts,
    )
    .expect("segment-local idempotency key is structurally valid");
    let before_reused_key = history_snapshot(&history);
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_and_advance_execution_history(
            &mut history,
            &v2_root,
            &reused_key_segment,
            &authorities,
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptReplay {
            kind: "idempotency_key_hash",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history), before_reused_key);

    let mut sibling = accepted.clone();
    sibling.receipts[0].payload_hash = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xee; 32]);
    resign_segment(&mut sibling);
    verify_and_advance_execution_history(&mut history, &v2_root, &accepted, &authorities)
        .expect("first successor advances the accepted head");
    let before_stale_root = history_snapshot(&history);
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_and_advance_execution_history(
            &mut history,
            &stale_v2_root,
            &stale_segment,
            &stale_authorities,
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::PredecessorMismatch {
            field: "verified_package_root.predecessor_lineage",
            ..
        })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history), before_stale_root);

    let before_sibling = history_snapshot(&history);
    assert!(matches!(
        verify_and_advance_execution_history(&mut history, &v2_root, &sibling, &authorities),
        Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptFork { .. })
    ));
    assert_eq!(history_snapshot(&history), before_sibling);
}

#[test]
fn fully_resigned_attacker_execution_authority_is_rejected() {
    use exo_core::{crypto::KeyPair, types::Signature};

    let trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let package = fixture::valid_v1_package();
    let root = verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust).expect("root");
    let (trusted_authorities, receipts) = fixture::signed_receipts(&root, None, 1);
    let valid = build_execution_receipt_chain(&root, None, &trusted_authorities, receipts)
        .expect("trusted segment");

    let attacker_did = Did::parse("did:exo:attacker").expect("attacker DID");
    let attacker_key = KeyPair::from_secret_bytes([99; 32]).expect("attacker key");
    let attacker_key_id = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([99; 32]);
    let mut forged = valid;
    let (attacker_verification_key, attacker_receipt_hash) = {
        let receipt = &mut forged.receipts[0];
        receipt.signer_did = attacker_did.clone();
        receipt.signature.signing_key_id = attacker_key_id;
        receipt.signature.verification_key =
            Ed25519VerificationKey::from_bytes(*attacker_key.public_key().as_bytes());
        receipt.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::ZERO;
        receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
        let payload = protocol_execution_receipt_payload_hash(receipt).expect("attacker payload");
        let Signature::Ed25519(bytes) = attacker_key.sign(payload.as_bytes()) else {
            panic!("attacker key is Ed25519");
        };
        receipt.signature.signed_payload_hash = payload;
        receipt.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes(bytes);
        (
            receipt.signature.verification_key,
            protocol_execution_receipt_hash(receipt).expect("attacker receipt hash"),
        )
    };
    forged.signer_authorities = BTreeMap::from([(
        attacker_did.clone(),
        AuthorityChainReferenceV1 {
            binding_kind: AuthorityBindingKind::NonSeatAuthority,
            tenant_id: root.tenant_id().to_owned(),
            protocol_id: root.protocol_id().to_owned(),
            actor_did: attacker_did.clone(),
            controller_did: attacker_did,
            scope: AuthorityScope::ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1,
            signing_key_id: attacker_key_id,
            verification_key: attacker_verification_key,
            authority_chain_hash: ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([98; 32]),
        },
    )]);
    forged.terminal_receipt_hash = attacker_receipt_hash;
    forged.chain_root = ProtocolHash256::ZERO;
    forged.chain_root = execution_receipt_chain_root(&forged).expect("attacker segment root");

    assert!(matches!(
        begin_execution_history(
            &package,
            &forged,
            &root,
            &trusted_authorities,
        ),
        Err(ProtocolError::GraphMismatch { ref path, .. })
            if path == "/independent_trust/authorities"
    ));
}

fn signature_terminal_time_and_zero_sequence_errors_are_exact() {
    let package = fixture::valid_v1_package();
    let trust = fixture::independent_trust_context();
    let root = verify_v1_package_root(&package, &trust).expect("root");
    let (authorities, receipts) = fixture::signed_receipts(&root, None, 2);

    let mut bad_signature = chain.clone();
    bad_signature.receipts[0].signature.signature =

    assert!(matches!(

        Err(ProtocolError::InvalidSignature {
            target: "ProtocolExecutionReceiptV1"
        })

    stale_terminal.terminal_sequence = 0;
    assert!(matches!(

        Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptScopeMismatch {
            field: "chain terminal metadata",
            ..
        })
    ));

        Err(ProtocolError::ReceiptSequenceMismatch {

        })

use std::{collections::BTreeMap, env, fs, path::PathBuf};

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::protocol::{
    commitment::{eligible_set_commitment, normalized_genesis_adoption_receipt},
    receipt::normalized_execution_receipt_chain,
    test_fixtures as fixture, *,
};

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Vector {
    vector_id: String,
    name: String,
    category: String,
    input: Input,
    expected: Expected,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Input {
    domain: String,
    body: JsonProbe,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct JsonProbe {
    hash: ProtocolHash256,
    verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey,
    signature: Ed25519Signature,
    uuid: ProtocolUuid,
    timestamp: JsonHlc,
    labels: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct JsonHlc {
    physical_ms: String,
    logical: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct CanonicalProbe {
    hash: ProtocolHash256,
    verification_key: Ed25519VerificationKey,
    signature: Ed25519Signature,
    uuid: ProtocolUuid,
    timestamp: ProtocolHlc,
    labels: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Expected {
    canonical_cbor_hex: String,
    domain_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct ResultRecord {
    vector_id: String,
    name: String,
    category: String,
    actual: Actual,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct Actual {
    canonical_cbor_hex: String,
    domain_hash: String,
}

#[test]
fn df_protocol_codec_smoke_matches_golden() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let vectors_dir = env::var_os("EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_HASH_VECTORS")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
            PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../tools/cross-impl-test/vectors")
        });
    let mut paths = fs::read_dir(&vectors_dir)?
        .map(|entry| entry.map(|value| value.path()))
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    paths.retain(|path| path.extension().is_some_and(|value| value == "json"));
    paths.sort();
    let mut results = Vec::new();
    for path in paths {
        let source = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
        let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&source)?;
        if value.get("category").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
            != Some("df_protocol_commitment")
        {
            continue;
        }
        let vector: Vector = serde_json::from_value(value)?;
        if vector.vector_id
            != path
                .file_stem()
                .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
                .unwrap_or_default()
            || vector.input.domain != ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolAuthorizationTargetV1.as_str()
        {
            return Err(format!("{}: vector id/domain mismatch", path.display()).into());
        }
        let body = CanonicalProbe {
            hash: vector.input.body.hash,
            verification_key: vector.input.body.verification_key,
            signature: vector.input.body.signature,
            uuid: vector.input.body.uuid,
            timestamp: ProtocolHlc::new(
                vector.input.body.timestamp.physical_ms.parse::<u64>()?,
                vector.input.body.timestamp.logical,
            ),
            labels: vector.input.body.labels,
        };
        let cbor = canonical_protocol_cbor(&body)?;
        let actual = Actual {
            canonical_cbor_hex: hex(&cbor),
            domain_hash: domain_hash(ProtocolHashDomain::ProtocolAuthorizationTargetV1, &body)?
                .to_string(),
        };
        if actual.canonical_cbor_hex != vector.expected.canonical_cbor_hex
            || actual.domain_hash != vector.expected.domain_hash
        {
            return Err(format!("{}: golden mismatch", path.display()).into());
        }
        results.push(ResultRecord {
            vector_id: vector.vector_id,
            name: vector.name,
            category: vector.category,
            actual,
        });
    }
    if results.is_empty() {
        return Err("no committed df_protocol_commitment vector".into());
    }
    if let Some(output) = env::var_os("EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_DF_OUTPUT") {
        let body = results
            .iter()
            .map(serde_json::to_string)
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?
            .join("\n")
            + "\n";
        fs::write(PathBuf::from(output), body)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect()
}

Replace `tools/cross-impl-test/index.ts` after the existing Apache header:

```typescript
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { hash } from 'blake3';

type HashVector = {
  vector_id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'crypto_hash';
  input: { canonical_cbor_hex: string };
  expected: { blake3_hex: string };
};

type DfVector = {
  vector_id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'df_protocol_commitment';
  input: {
    domain: string;
    body: {
      hash: string;
      verification_key: string;
      signature: string;
      uuid: string;
      timestamp: { physical_ms: string; logical: number };
      labels: string[];
    };
  };
  expected: { canonical_cbor_hex: string; domain_hash: string };
};

type ResultRecord = {
  vector_id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  actual: Record<string, unknown>;
};

function optionFrom(argv: readonly string[], name: string): string {
  const index = argv.indexOf(name);
  if (index < 0 || index + 1 >= argv.length) throw new Error(`missing ${name}`);
  return argv[index + 1];
}

export function parseStrictJson(source: string): Json {
  let offset = 0;
  const whitespace = (): void => { while (/\s/.test(source[offset] ?? '')) offset += 1; };
  const string = (): string => {
    const start = offset;
    if (source[offset++] !== '"') throw new Error(`JSON string expected at ${start}`);
    while (offset < source.length) {
      const char = source[offset++];
      if (char === '\\') { offset += 1; continue; }
      if (char === '"') return JSON.parse(source.slice(start, offset)) as string;
    }
    throw new Error(`unterminated JSON string at ${start}`);
  };
  const value = (path: string): Json => {
    whitespace();
    if (source[offset] === '{') {
      offset += 1; whitespace();
      const output: Record<string, Json> = {};
      if (source[offset] === '}') { offset += 1; return output; }
      for (;;) {
        whitespace(); const key = string(); whitespace();
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(output, key)) {
          throw new Error(`duplicate JSON member ${path}/${key}`);
        }
        if (source[offset++] !== ':') throw new Error(`JSON colon expected at ${offset - 1}`);
        output[key] = value(`${path}/${key.replaceAll('~', '~0').replaceAll('/', '~1')}`);
        whitespace();
        const delimiter = source[offset++];
        if (delimiter === '}') return output;
        if (delimiter !== ',') throw new Error(`JSON object delimiter expected at ${offset - 1}`);
      }
    }
    if (source[offset] === '[') {
      offset += 1; whitespace();
      const output: Json[] = [];
      if (source[offset] === ']') { offset += 1; return output; }
      for (;;) {
        output.push(value(`${path}/${output.length}`)); whitespace();
        const delimiter = source[offset++];
        if (delimiter === ']') return output;
        if (delimiter !== ',') throw new Error(`JSON array delimiter expected at ${offset - 1}`);
      }
    }
    if (source[offset] === '"') return string();
    if (source.startsWith('true', offset)) { offset += 4; return true; }
    if (source.startsWith('false', offset)) { offset += 5; return false; }
    if (source.startsWith('null', offset)) { offset += 4; return null; }
    const match = /^-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?/
      .exec(source.slice(offset));
    if (match === null) throw new Error(`JSON value expected at ${offset}`);
    const token = match[0]; offset += token.length;
    if (U64_FIELD.test(path)) {
      if (!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(token)) throw new Error(`${path}: decimal u64 required`);
      u64(token, path);
      return token;
    }
    const parsed = Number(token);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < 0) {
      throw new Error(`${path}: nonnegative safe structural integer required`);
    }
    return parsed;
  };
  const parsed = value(''); whitespace();
  if (offset !== source.length) throw new Error(`trailing JSON at ${offset}`);
  return parsed;
}

function parseVectorStrict(source: string, file: string):
    HashVector | DfVector | FullVector | RendererVector {
  const parsed = parseStrictJson(source) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const allowed = new Set(['vector_id', 'name', 'category', 'input', 'expected']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(parsed)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) throw new Error(`${file}: unknown vector field ${key}`);
  }
  if (typeof parsed.vector_id !== 'string' || typeof parsed.name !== 'string'
      || typeof parsed.category !== 'string' || typeof parsed.input !== 'object'
      || parsed.input === null) {
    throw new Error(`${file}: invalid vector envelope`);
  }
  if ((parsed.category === 'df_protocol_full' || parsed.category === 'df_protocol_renderer')
      && 'expected' in parsed) {
    throw new Error(`${file}: full/renderer vectors are input-only`);
  }
  return parsed as HashVector | DfVector | FullVector | RendererVector;
}

function assertNever(value: never): never {
  throw new Error(`unsupported category ${(value as { category?: unknown }).category}`);
}

function decodeHex(value: string, bytes: number, label: string): Buffer {
  if (value.length !== bytes * 2 || !/^[0-9a-f]+$/.test(value)) {
    throw new Error(`${label}: expected ${bytes} lowercase bytes`);
  }
  return Buffer.from(value, 'hex');
}

function decodeUuid(value: string): Buffer {
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new Error('uuid must be canonical lowercase RFC form');
  }
  return decodeHex(value.replaceAll('-', ''), 16, 'uuid');
}

function u64(text: string, path: string): bigint {
  if (!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(text)) throw new Error(`${path}: noncanonical u64`);
  const value = BigInt(text);
  if (value > 0xffffffffffffffffn) throw new Error(`${path}: u64 overflow`);
  return value;
}

function header(major: number, value: bigint): Buffer {
  if (value < 0n) throw new Error('negative value in unsigned header');
  if (value <= 23n) return Buffer.from([(major << 5) | Number(value)]);
  if (value <= 0xffn) return Buffer.from([(major << 5) | 24, Number(value)]);
  if (value <= 0xffffn) {
    const output = Buffer.alloc(3); output[0] = (major << 5) | 25;
    output.writeUInt16BE(Number(value), 1); return output;
  }
  if (value <= 0xffffffffn) {
    const output = Buffer.alloc(5); output[0] = (major << 5) | 26;
    output.writeUInt32BE(Number(value), 1); return output;
  }
  if (value <= 0xffffffffffffffffn) {
    const output = Buffer.alloc(9); output[0] = (major << 5) | 27;
    output.writeBigUInt64BE(value, 1); return output;
  }
  throw new Error('integer exceeds u64');
}

function encode(value: unknown): Buffer {
  if (value === null) return Buffer.from([0xf6]);
  if (value === false) return Buffer.from([0xf4]);
  if (value === true) return Buffer.from([0xf5]);
  if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) return Buffer.concat([header(2, BigInt(value.length)), value]);
  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return header(0, value);
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new Error('only nonnegative safe integers are allowed');
    return header(0, BigInt(value));
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const bytes = Buffer.from(value, 'utf8'); return Buffer.concat([header(3, BigInt(bytes.length)), bytes]);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return Buffer.concat([header(4, BigInt(value.length)), ...value.map(encode)]);
  }
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).map(([key, child]) => ({
      key: encode(key), child: encode(child),
    }));
    entries.sort((left, right) => left.key.length - right.key.length || Buffer.compare(left.key, right.key));
    return Buffer.concat([
      header(5, BigInt(entries.length)),
      ...entries.flatMap((entry) => [entry.key, entry.child]),
    ]);
  }
  throw new Error(`unsupported canonical CBOR type ${typeof value}`);
}

function executeHash(vector: HashVector): ResultRecord {
  const actual = hash(decodeHex(vector.input.canonical_cbor_hex,
    vector.input.canonical_cbor_hex.length / 2, vector.vector_id)).toString('hex');
  if (actual !== vector.expected.blake3_hex) throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: expected hash mismatch`);
  return { vector_id: vector.vector_id, name: vector.name, category: vector.category,
    actual: { blake3_hex: actual } };
}

function executeDf(vector: DfVector): ResultRecord {
  if (vector.input.domain !== 'exo.decision_forum.protocol_authorization_target.v1') {
    throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: wrong domain`);
  }
  const body = {
    hash: decodeHex(vector.input.body.hash, 32, 'hash'),
    verification_key: decodeHex(vector.input.body.verification_key, 32, 'verification_key'),
    signature: decodeHex(vector.input.body.signature, 64, 'signature'),
    uuid: decodeUuid(vector.input.body.uuid),
    timestamp: {
      physical_ms: u64(vector.input.body.timestamp.physical_ms, 'timestamp.physical_ms'),
      logical: vector.input.body.timestamp.logical,
    },
    labels: vector.input.body.labels,
  };
  const canonical = encode(body).toString('hex');
  const committed = encode([vector.input.domain, body]);
  const domainHash = hash(committed).toString('hex');
  if (canonical !== vector.expected.canonical_cbor_hex || domainHash !== vector.expected.domain_hash) {
    throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: DF golden mismatch`);
  }
  return { vector_id: vector.vector_id, name: vector.name, category: vector.category,
    actual: { canonical_cbor_hex: canonical, domain_hash: domainHash } };
}

export function main(argv: readonly string[] = process.argv): void {
  const vectorsDir = optionFrom(argv, '--vectors');
  const output = optionFrom(argv, '--output');
  const files = readdirSync(vectorsDir).filter((file) => file.endsWith('.json')).sort();
  if (files.length === 0) throw new Error('no committed vectors');
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const results = files.map((file): ResultRecord => {
    const vector = parseVectorStrict(readFileSync(join(vectorsDir, file), 'utf8'), file);
    if (vector.vector_id !== basename(file, '.json') || seen.has(vector.vector_id)) {
      throw new Error(`${file}: duplicate or vector_id/file mismatch`);
    }
    seen.add(vector.vector_id);
    if (vector.category === 'crypto_hash') return executeHash(vector);
    if (vector.category === 'df_protocol_commitment') return executeDf(vector);
    if (vector.category === 'df_protocol_full') return executeFull(vector);
    if (vector.category === 'df_protocol_renderer') return executeRenderer(vector);
    return assertNever(vector);
  });
  writeFileSync(output, `${results.sort((a, b) => a.vector_id.localeCompare(b.vector_id))
    .map((result) => JSON.stringify(result)).join('\n')}\n`, { flag: 'wx' });
}

The Step 5 block is the complete encoder but only the codec-smoke dispatch.
Extend its category union with `df_protocol_full` and `df_protocol_renderer`;
do not replace actual execution with `expected` output. The two new vectors
have `deny_unknown_fields`-equivalent schemas and contain inputs only:

- `df_protocol_full_v1.json` contains the complete strict-JSON v1 package, the
  complete strict-JSON v2 successor package, both signed external receipt
  segments, and exact decimal-string HLC boundary probes at
  `9007199254740991`, `9007199254740992`, and `18446744073709551615`;
- `df_protocol_renderer_manifest_v1.json` contains the renderer-configuration
  manifest and the distinct post-root `DeterministicArtifactManifestV1`. Their
  `domain` members must respectively equal
  `exo.decision_forum.renderer_manifest.v1` and
  `exo.decision_forum.publication_artifact_manifest.v1`.

Gate 06 adds the typed Rust renderer input alongside
`DeterministicArtifactManifestV1`; both Rust and TypeScript encode these fields
as typed values, never `Debug` text or suffix-guessed maps:

```rust
/// Leaf types for plan-only materialization of the transitive renderer lock.
/// No external diagnostic shim.

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Sha256Digest(pub [u8; 32]);

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ToolLockV1 {
    pub tool_name: String,
    pub tool_version: String,
    pub tool_digest: ProtocolHash256,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RendererAssetLockV1 {
    pub asset_path_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub asset_content_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub media_type: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RendererResourcePolicyV1 {
    pub max_memory_bytes: u64,
    pub max_cpu_milliseconds: u64,
    pub network_allowed: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ProtocolRendererManifestV1 {
    pub renderer_id: String,
    pub renderer_version: String,
    pub publisher_source_git_object: GitObjectId,
    pub publisher_source_tree_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub publisher_binary_blake3: ProtocolHash256,
    pub compiler_digest: ProtocolHash256,
    pub target_triple: String,
    pub renderer_image_sha256: Sha256Digest,
    pub weasyprint_lock: ToolLockV1,
    pub pango_lock: ToolLockV1,
    pub cairo_lock: ToolLockV1,
    pub harfbuzz_lock: ToolLockV1,
    pub verapdf_lock: ToolLockV1,
    pub font_assets: Vec<RendererAssetLockV1>,
    pub icc_profile: RendererAssetLockV1,
    pub template: RendererAssetLockV1,
    pub stylesheet: RendererAssetLockV1,
    pub entrypoint_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub environment: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub resource_policy: RendererResourcePolicyV1,
    pub third_party_notices_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub license_set_hash: ProtocolHash256,
    pub sbom_hash: ProtocolHash256,
}
```

Author the checked-in file by extracting the exact reviewed bytes above; do
not synthesize the file from a shape-only fixture:

```bash
set -euo pipefail
plan=docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-16-df-protocol-001-02-core-protocol-receipt-model.md
target=tools/cross-impl-test/vectors/df_protocol_full_v1.json
tmp="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/df-full-vector.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT INT TERM
awk '
  /<!-- DF_WAVE5_LITERAL_FULL_VECTOR -->/ { marker = 1; next }
  marker && /^```json$/ { capture = 1; next }
  capture && /^```$/ { exit }
  capture { print }
' "$plan" > "$tmp"
python3 - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
def reject(pairs):
    value = {}
    for key, child in pairs:
        if key in value:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate JSON member: {key}")
        value[key] = child
    return value
raw = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
assert len(raw) == 261579
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == "7764ba51a974be7d8db414b5a63318a0fca666219f0391acd94c553fb197a37a"
value = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=reject)
assert value["vector_id"] == "df_protocol_full_v1"
assert value["category"] == "df_protocol_full"
assert "expected" not in value and "actual" not in value
assert len(value["input"]["v1_package"]["review_bundle"]["assignments"]) == 10
assert len(value["input"]["v2_package"]["review_bundle"]["assignments"]) == 10
assert len(value["input"]["mutation_records"]["protocol_events"]) == 5
assert len(value["input"]["mutation_records"]["estop_dispositions"]) == 4
assert len(value["input"]["mutation_records"]["notification_attempts"]) == 2
assert len(value["input"]["mutation_records"]["phase_promotion_dispositions"]) == 10
assert len(value["input"]["mutation_records"]["reset_authorization"]) == 18
PY
install -m 0644 "$tmp" "$target"
cmp -s "$tmp" "$target"
```

The extraction command's exact SHA-256 assertion followed by `cmp -s` is the
sole reviewed-byte equality proof. There is no separate
`committed_full_vector_equals_reviewed_plan_bytes` test and no
`DF_PROTOCOL_PLAN_VECTOR` environment contract; Gate 18 must not claim either.
The proof never rewrites the reviewed plan artifact and has no ignored
authoring mode.
Neither new vector has an `expected`, `actual`, `canonical_cbor_hex`, or hash
field. Rust must deserialize with the real strict transport types, verify both
package roots and the v1-to-v2 history, build the exact projections with the
production functions, and serialize actual records. TypeScript must build the
same projections from input fields and encode them with the complete encoder.
Its projection functions perform these exact transformations: authorization
target omits the disposition bundle and retains only the three predecessor-only
receipt families while zeroing review self-signature fields; prepublication
sets publication authorization to `null` and final root to 32 zero bytes;
normalized final sets only final root to 32 zero bytes. It never reads or copies
a Rust-produced CBOR/hash field.

The strict Rust deserializer then proves every package/receipt field is
present and typed; these count/link guards cannot substitute for that decode.

Both runners use this result shape and exact key contract:

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct ObjectActual {
    canonical_cbor_hex: String,
    domain_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct ScalarActual {
    value: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
enum FullActual {
    Object(ObjectActual),
    Scalar(ScalarActual),
}

const FULL_KEYS: [&str; 23] = [
    "authorization_target",
    "protocol_version",
    "protocol_envelope",
    "review_bundle",
    "council_eligible_set",
    "ai_irb_eligible_set",
    "prepublication",
    "publication_authorization",
    "normalized_final",
    "final_package_root",
    "genesis_evidence",
    "genesis_adoption",
    "v1_receipt_segment",
    "v2_receipt_segment",
    "accepted_receipt_chain_root",
    "investigator_designation_signing_payload",
    "aar_rca_attestation_signing_payload",
    "estop_disposition_signing_payload",
    "estop_authorization_signing_payload",
    "notification_attempt_signing_payload",
    "reset_authorization_signing_payload",
    "phase_promotion_disposition_signing_payload",
    "phase_promotion_signing_payload",
];

const RENDERER_KEYS: [&str; 2] = ["renderer_manifest", "publication_artifact_manifest"];

fn object_actual<T: Serialize>(
    domain: ProtocolHashDomain,
    value: &T,
) -> Result<FullActual, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    Ok(FullActual::Object(ObjectActual {
        canonical_cbor_hex: hex(&canonical_protocol_cbor(value)?),
        domain_hash: domain_hash(domain, value)?.to_string(),
    }))
}

fn assert_exact_keys(
    actual: &BTreeMap<String, FullActual>,
    expected: &[&str],
) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let actual_keys = actual.keys().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let mut expected_keys = expected.to_vec();
    expected_keys.sort_unstable();
    if actual_keys != expected_keys {
        return Err(
            format!("actual output keys: {actual_keys:?}; expected {expected_keys:?}").into(),
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

`rust_emits_exact_production_commitment_outputs` is the following actual executor. The vector
contains complete packages and receipt segments. Before reading either package,
Rust builds the deterministic opaque registry through the test-only verifier
inside `trust.rs`; no package field or vector field can mint trust.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct InputOnlyVector<T> {
    vector_id: String,
    name: String,
    category: String,
    input: T,
}

fn load_input_only<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
    vector_id: &str,
    category: &str,
) -> Result<InputOnlyVector<T>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let directory = std::env::var_os("EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_HASH_VECTORS")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
            PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../tools/cross-impl-test/vectors")
        });
    let path = directory.join(format!("{vector_id}.json"));
    let bytes = std::fs::read(&path)?;
    let value = crate::protocol::codec::decode_strict_json_value(&bytes)?;
    let vector: InputOnlyVector<T> = serde_json::from_value(value)?;
    if vector.vector_id != vector_id || vector.category != category {
        return Err(format!("{}: vector identity/category mismatch", path.display()).into());
    }
    Ok(vector)
}

fn load_input_only_full_vector()
-> Result<InputOnlyVector<FullVectorInput>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    load_input_only("df_protocol_full_v1", "df_protocol_full")
}

fn load_input_only_renderer_vector()
-> Result<InputOnlyVector<RendererVectorInput>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    load_input_only("df_protocol_renderer_manifest_v1", "df_protocol_renderer")
}

fn write_result_record<T: Serialize>(
    vector_id: String,
    name: String,
    category: &str,
    actual: T,
) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let record = serde_json::json!({
        "vector_id": vector_id,
        "name": name,
        "category": category,
        "actual": actual,
    });
    let mut body = serde_json::to_vec(&record)?;
    body.push(b'\n');
    let Some(output) = std::env::var_os("EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_DF_OUTPUT") else {
        // Ordinary `cargo test` still executes and validates the entire owner;
        // only the parity runner requests a filesystem result record.
        let _: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&body)?;
        return Ok(());
    };
    use std::io::Write as _;
    let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .create_new(true)
        .open(PathBuf::from(output))?;
    file.write_all(&body)?;
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct FullVectorInput {
    v1_package: PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    v2_package: PeerReviewedProtocolPackageV1,
    v1_receipt_segment: ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
    v2_receipt_segment: ProtocolExecutionReceiptChainV1,
    mutation_records: MutationRecordsInput,
    u64_boundaries: [U64BoundaryInput; 3],
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct MutationRecordsInput {
    protocol_events: [ProtocolEvent; 5],
    capa_record: CapaRecord,
    investigator_designation: InvestigatorDesignation,
    aar_rca_attestation: AarRcaAttestation,
    estop_dispositions: [EstopDisposition; 4],
    estop_authorization: EstopAuthorization,
    notification_attempts: [NotificationDeliveryReceipt; 2],
    reset_authorization: ResetAuthorization,
    phase_promotion_dispositions: [PhasePromotionDisposition; 10],
    phase_promotion: PhasePromotion,
    sealed_review: SealedReviewCommitmentV1,
    reveal: RevealCommitmentV1,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct U64BoundaryInput {
    pointer: String,
    value: String,
}

fn emit_full_actual(
    input: FullVectorInput,
) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, FullActual>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    for event in &input.mutation_records.protocol_events {
        validate_protocol_event(event)?;
        let _ = protocol_event_hash(event)?;
    }
    validate_capa_record(&input.mutation_records.capa_record)?;
    let _ = capa_record_hash(&input.mutation_records.capa_record)?;
    validate_investigator_designation(&input.mutation_records.investigator_designation)?;
    let _ = investigator_designation_hash(&input.mutation_records.investigator_designation)?;
    validate_aar_rca_attestation(&input.mutation_records.aar_rca_attestation)?;
    let _ = aar_rca_attestation_hash(&input.mutation_records.aar_rca_attestation)?;
    for vote in &input.mutation_records.estop_dispositions {
        validate_estop_disposition(vote)?;
        let _ = estop_disposition_hash(vote)?;
    }
    validate_estop_authorization(&input.mutation_records.estop_authorization)?;
    let _ = estop_authorization_hash(&input.mutation_records.estop_authorization)?;
    for attempt in &input.mutation_records.notification_attempts {
        validate_notification_attempt(attempt)?;
        let _ = notification_attempt_hash(attempt)?;
    }
    validate_reset_authorization(&input.mutation_records.reset_authorization)?;
    let _ = reset_authorization_hash(&input.mutation_records.reset_authorization)?;
    for disposition in &input.mutation_records.phase_promotion_dispositions {
        validate_phase_promotion_disposition(disposition)?;
        let _ = phase_promotion_disposition_hash(disposition)?;
    }
    validate_phase_promotion(&input.mutation_records.phase_promotion)?;
    let _ = phase_promotion_hash(&input.mutation_records.phase_promotion)?;
    validate_governed_action_links(
        &input.mutation_records.investigator_designation,
        &input.mutation_records.aar_rca_attestation,
        &input.mutation_records.estop_dispositions,
        &input.mutation_records.estop_authorization,
        &input.mutation_records.notification_attempts,
        &input.mutation_records.capa_record,
        &input.mutation_records.reset_authorization,
        &input.mutation_records.phase_promotion_dispositions,
        &input.mutation_records.phase_promotion,
    )?;
    let _ = sealed_review_hash(&input.mutation_records.sealed_review)?;
    let _ = reveal_package_hash(&input.mutation_records.reveal)?;
    let expected_boundaries = [
        (
            ResourceKind::ComputeMilliseconds,
            "/protocol_envelope/resource_ceilings/compute_milliseconds",
            "9007199254740991",
        ),
        (
            ResourceKind::MemoryBytes,
            "/protocol_envelope/resource_ceilings/memory_bytes",
            "9007199254740992",
        ),
        (
            ResourceKind::StorageBytes,
            "/protocol_envelope/resource_ceilings/storage_bytes",
            "18446744073709551615",
        ),

    for (boundary, (kind, pointer, value)) in input.u64_boundaries.iter().zip(expected_boundaries) {

    let v2_root = verify_package_root(&input.v2_package, &package_trust, Some(&history))?;

    let authorization = authorization_target(&input.v1_package);

    let review_bundle = &input.v1_package.review_bundle;

        "reset_authorization_signing_payload".to_owned(),
        object_actual(
            ProtocolHashDomain::ResetAuthorizationSigningPayloadV1,
            &reset_payload,
        )?,
    );
    actual.insert(
        "phase_promotion_disposition_signing_payload".to_owned(),
        object_actual(
            ProtocolHashDomain::PhasePromotionDispositionSigningPayloadV1,
            &promotion_disposition_payload,
        )?,
    );
    actual.insert(
        "phase_promotion_signing_payload".to_owned(),
        object_actual(
            ProtocolHashDomain::PhasePromotionSigningPayloadV1,
            &promotion_payload,
        )?,
    );
    assert_exact_keys(&actual, &FULL_KEYS)?;
    Ok(actual)
}
