```rust
#[test]
fn rust_normalized_roots_ignore_only_self_fields() {
    let vector = load_input_only_full_vector().expect("strict input-only full vector");
    let genesis = vector
        .input
        .v1_package
        .receipt_manifest
        .genesis_adoption_receipt
        .as_ref()
        .expect("genesis");
    let baseline_genesis = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1,
        &normalized_genesis_adoption_receipt(genesis),
    )
    .expect("normalized genesis root");
    let mut self_root_genesis = genesis.clone();
    self_root_genesis.receipt_root = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xee; 32]);
    assert_eq!(
        domain_hash(
            ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1,
            &normalized_genesis_adoption_receipt(&self_root_genesis),
        )
        .expect("normalized mutated genesis root"),
        baseline_genesis,
    );
    let mut committed_genesis = genesis.clone();
    committed_genesis.evidence_bundle.chronology_root = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xed; 32]);
    assert_ne!(
        domain_hash(
            ProtocolHashDomain::GenesisAdoptionReceiptV1,
            &normalized_genesis_adoption_receipt(&committed_genesis),
        )
        .expect("committed-field genesis root"),
        baseline_genesis,
    );

    for chain in [
        &vector.input.v1_receipt_segment,
        &vector.input.v2_receipt_segment,
    ] {
        let baseline = execution_receipt_chain_root(chain).expect("chain root");
        let mut self_root = chain.clone();
        self_root.chain_root = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xec; 32]);
        assert_eq!(
            execution_receipt_chain_root(&self_root).expect("normalized chain root"),
            baseline,
        );
        let mut committed = chain.clone();
        committed.receipts[0].payload_hash = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xeb; 32]);
        assert_ne!(
            execution_receipt_chain_root(&committed).expect("committed-field chain root"),
            baseline,
        );
    }
}

fn rust_body_tags_and_publication_payload_are_production_exact() {
    let vector = load_input_only_full_vector().expect("strict input-only full vector");
    let package = vector.input.v1_package;
    let eligible = &package.disposition_bundle.council_eligible_set;
    let council = domain_hash(

        &eligible_set_commitment(SeatKind::Council, eligible),

    .expect("Council eligible-set commitment");
    let body_swap = domain_hash(
        ProtocolHashDomain::EligibleSetV1,
        &eligible_set_commitment(SeatKind::AiIrb, eligible),
    )
    .expect("AI-IRB body-tagged commitment over the same seats");
    assert_ne!(council, body_swap);

    let publication = package
        .receipt_manifest
        .publication_authorization_receipt
        .as_ref()
        .expect("publication");
    let baseline = publication_authorization_payload_hash(publication)
        .expect("publication signing payload");

    normalized_away.signature.signature = Ed25519Signature::from_bytes([0xea; 64]);
    assert_eq!(
        publication_authorization_payload_hash(&normalized_away)
            .expect("signature-excluded publication payload"),
        baseline,
    );
    let mut committed = publication.clone();
    committed.renderer_manifest_hash = ProtocolHash256::from_bytes([0xe9; 32]);
    assert_ne!(
        publication_authorization_payload_hash(&committed)
            .expect("committed publication payload"),
        baseline,
    );
}
```

The projections named above are package-private production projection types in
`commitment/projections.rs`; they are not test reimplementations. Direct
package JSON hashing is forbidden. The scalar final-root row is recomputed,
never copied from input.

The TypeScript `executeFull` and `executeRenderer` return the same nested
`actual` maps and call this equivalent before output:

```typescript

function assertExactKeys(
  actual: Record<string, unknown>,
  expected: readonly string[],
  label: string,
): void {
  const observed = Object.keys(actual).sort();
  const wanted = [...expected].sort();
  if (observed.length !== wanted.length
      || observed.some((key, index) => key !== wanted[index])) {
    throw new Error(`${label}: actual keys ${observed.join(',')} != ${wanted.join(',')}`);
  }
}
```

Append the actual TypeScript executors immediately after that helper:

```typescript
export type Json = null | boolean | number | string | Json[] | { [key: string]: Json };
export type ObjectActual = { canonical_cbor_hex: string; domain_hash: string };
type FullActual = ObjectActual | { value: string };
export type FullVector = {
  vector_id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'df_protocol_full';
  input: {

      phase_promotion: Record<string, Json>;

    };
    u64_boundaries: [
      { pointer: string; value: '9007199254740991' },
      { pointer: string; value: '9007199254740992' },
      { pointer: string; value: '18446744073709551615' },
    ];

};
type RendererManifestV1 = {

};

  name: string;
  category: 'df_protocol_renderer';
  input: {

    renderer_manifest: RendererManifestV1;
    artifact_domain: string;
    publication_artifact_manifest: PublicationArtifactManifestV1;

};

const ZERO_HASH = '00'.repeat(32);
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const BYTE32_FIELD_NAMES = new Set([
  'constitutional_hash', 'prior_version_hash', 'signing_key_id', 'verification_key',
  'authority_chain_hash', 'independent_control_proof_hash', 'system_configuration_hash',
  'sampling_parameters_hash', 'tool_policy_hash', 'context_manifest_hash',
  'behavioral_fingerprint_hash', 'conflict_declaration_hash', 'seat_attestation_hash',
  'blind_commitment', 'criteria_results_hash', 'review_body_hash',
  'authorization_target_hash', 'signed_payload_hash', 'comment_hash',
  'author_response_hash', 'revision_diff_hash', 'signature_hash', 'body_hash',
  'eligible_set_hash', 'review_bundle_hash',
  'chair_alert_receipt_hash', 'proof_hash', 'scope_hash', 'renderer_manifest_hash',
  'prepublication_root', 'receipt_hash', 'authorized_package_root', 'previous_chain_root',
  'predecessor_terminal_receipt_hash', 'chain_root', 'terminal_receipt_hash',
  'previous_receipt_hash', 'protocol_version_hash', 'payload_hash', 'idempotency_key_hash',
  'final_package_root', 'content_hash', 'template_hash', 'stylesheet_hash',
  'evidence_bundle_hash', 'issuer_key_id',
  'receipt_root', 'bailment_licensure_hash', 'permitted_use_hash',
  'prior_assumption_hash', 'observed_evidence_hash', 'recurrence_result_hash',
  'affected_claim_hash', 'completion_evidence_hash', 'reveal_package_hash',
  'canonical_cbor_digest', 'markdown_digest', 'html_digest', 'pdf_a_digest',
  'datasets', 'blind_commitments', 'eligible_seat_hashes', 'approve_seat_hashes',
  'affected_claim_hashes', 'evidence_hashes', 'corrective_action_hashes',
  'preventive_action_hashes', 'changed_control_hashes',
  'candidate_roadmap_scenario_hashes', 'reviewer_identity_hashes',
  'eligible_ai_irb_set_hash', 'investigator_designation_hash', 'aar_hash', 'rca_hash',
  'source_hash', 'delivery_evidence_hash', 'new_protocol_version_hash',
  'stopped_protocol_version_hash', 'source_estop_authorization_hash',
  'new_reviewed_package_root', 'aar_rca_attestation_hash', 'capa_record_hash',
  'recurrence_evidence_hash', 'council_quorum_proof_hash', 'ai_irb_quorum_proof_hash',
  'chair_notice_receipt_hash', 'envelope_hash', 'signed_estop_vote_hashes',
  'council_disposition_hashes', 'ai_irb_disposition_hashes',
  'chronology_root', 'artifact_content_hash', 'artifact_path_hash', 'provenance_hash',
  'predecessor_entry_hash', 'artifact_set_hash', 'artifact_entry_hashes',
  'verified_reveal_hash', 'coverage_hash', 'submitted_artifact_set_hash',
  'reviewed_artifact_set_hash', 'unchanged_content_set_hash',
  'assignment_hashes', 'assignment_commitment_hashes', 'sealed_review_hashes',
  'reviewer_qualification_hashes', 'disposition_hashes',
]);
const BYTE64_FIELD_NAMES = new Set(['signature']);
const GIT_OBJECT_FIELD = /\/chronology_entries\/\d+\/git_object_id$/;
const U64_FIELD = /\/(?:version|scheduled_interval_hlc_units|sequence|receipt_count|terminal_sequence|predecessor_terminal_sequence|first_sequence|physical_ms|resource_ceilings\/[^/]+)$/;

const SET_POINTERS = new Set([
  '/protocol_identity/co_pi_dids',
  '/protocol_envelope/permitted_actions', '/protocol_envelope/systems',
  '/protocol_envelope/tenants', '/protocol_envelope/datasets',
  '/protocol_envelope/actor_classes',
  '/evidence_manifest/independent_evidence_classes',
  '/review_bundle/blind_commitments',
  '/disposition_bundle/council_eligible_set',
  '/disposition_bundle/ai_irb_eligible_set',
  '/monitoring_plan/reporting_destinations',
  '/monitoring_plan/event_payload_type_domains',
]);
const SET_POINTER_PATTERNS = [
  /^\/review_bundle\/(?:council|ai_irb)_seat_attestations\/[^/]+\/evidence_classes$/,
  /^\/disposition_bundle\/quorum_proofs\/\d+\/(?:eligible_seat_hashes|approve_seat_hashes|provider_classes|evidence_classes)$/,
  /^\/systemic_learning_manifest\/records\/\d+\/(?:changed_control_hashes|candidate_roadmap_scenario_hashes)$/,
  /^\/receipt_manifest\/genesis_adoption_receipt\/evidence_bundle\/historical_artifact_set\/artifact_entry_hashes$/,
  /^\/receipt_manifest\/genesis_adoption_receipt\/evidence_bundle\/ordinary_blinded_review\/(?:assignment_hashes|assignment_commitment_hashes|sealed_review_hashes|reviewer_qualification_hashes|disposition_hashes)$/,
  /^\/mutation_records\/estop_authorization\/(?:active_provider_classes|approve_provider_classes|independent_evidence_classes|signed_estop_vote_hashes)$/,
  /^\/mutation_records\/phase_promotion\/(?:council_disposition_hashes|ai_irb_disposition_hashes)$/,
];

function isSetPointer(path: string): boolean {
  return SET_POINTERS.has(path) || SET_POINTER_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(path));
}

function typedFieldName(path: string): string {
  const components = path.split('/').filter((part) => part.length > 0);
  while (components.length > 0 && /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(components.at(-1)!)) {
    components.pop();
  }
  const field = components.at(-1);
  if (field === undefined) throw new Error(`${path}: typed field path required`);
  return field;
}

const PROVIDER_RANK = new Map([
  ['OpenAI', 0], ['Anthropic', 1], ['xAI', 2],
  ['AlphabetGoogleGemini', 3], ['IndependentNonProvider', 4],
]);
const EVIDENCE_RANK = new Map([
  ['ProviderModelJudgment', 0], ['DeterministicTest', 1],
  ['ReproducibleBenchmark', 2], ['AttestedExecution', 3],
  ['IndependentHumanReview', 4], ['FormalVerification', 5],
  ['ExternalAudit', 6], ['IndependentNonProviderEvidence', 7],
]);
const INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_RANK = new Map([
  ['DeterministicTest', 0], ['ReproducibleBenchmark', 1],
  ['AttestedExecution', 2], ['IndependentHumanReview', 3],
  ['FormalVerification', 4], ['ExternalAudit', 5],
  ['IndependentNonProviderEvidence', 6],
]);

function scalarOrder(left: unknown, right: unknown): number {
  if (Buffer.isBuffer(left) && Buffer.isBuffer(right)) return Buffer.compare(left, right);
  if (typeof left === 'string' && typeof right === 'string') return left.localeCompare(right);
  throw new Error('set element lacks a reviewed Rust Ord comparator');
}

function normalizeGitObjectId(value: Json, path: string): Buffer {
  if (value === null || Array.isArray(value) || typeof value !== 'object') {
    throw new Error(`${path}: GitObjectId object required`);
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
  if (keys.length !== 2 || keys[0] !== 'algorithm' || keys[1] !== 'digest'
      || value.algorithm !== 'sha1' || typeof value.digest !== 'string') {
    throw new Error(`${path}: exact sha1 GitObjectId required`);
  }
  return decodeHex(value.digest, 20, `${path}/digest`);
}

function compareSetElement(path: string, left: unknown, right: unknown): number {
  const rank = /\/(?:active_|approve_)?provider_classes$/.test(path)
    ? PROVIDER_RANK
    : /\/(?:independent_)?evidence_classes$/.test(path)
      && !path.includes('seat_attestations')
      ? INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_RANK
      : /\/evidence_classes$/.test(path)
        ? EVIDENCE_RANK
        : undefined;
  if (rank !== undefined) {
    const leftRank = rank.get(String(left));
    const rightRank = rank.get(String(right));
    if (leftRank === undefined || rightRank === undefined) {
      throw new Error(`${path}: unknown ranked enum value`);
    }
    return leftRank - rightRank;
  }
  return scalarOrder(left, right);
}

function normalizeProtocolObject(value: Json, path = ''): unknown {
  if (GIT_OBJECT_FIELD.test(path)) return normalizeGitObjectId(value, path);
  if (value === null || typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) {
      throw new Error(`${path}: nonnegative safe structural integer required`);
    }
    return value;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    if (U64_FIELD.test(path)) return u64(value, path);
    if (UUID.test(value)) return decodeUuid(value);
    const field = typedFieldName(path);
    if (BYTE64_FIELD_NAMES.has(field)) return decodeHex(value, 64, path);
    if (BYTE32_FIELD_NAMES.has(field)) return decodeHex(value, 32, path);
    return value;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    const normalized = value.map((child, index) =>
      normalizeProtocolObject(child, `${path}/${index}`));
    if (isSetPointer(path)) {
      normalized.sort((left, right) => compareSetElement(path, left, right));
    }
    return normalized;
  }
  const output: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort()) {
    output[key] = normalizeProtocolObject(value[key], `${path}/${key}`);
  }
  return output;
}

function cloneJson<T extends Json>(value: T): T {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T;
}

function exactSigningPayload(
  record: Record<string, Json>,
  excludedRecordFields: readonly string[] = [],
): Record<string, Json> {
  const payload = cloneJson(record);
  delete payload.signature;
  for (const field of excludedRecordFields) delete payload[field];
  return payload;
}

function pointerValue(root: Json, pointer: string): Json {
  if (!pointer.startsWith('/')) throw new Error(`${pointer}: absolute JSON pointer required`);
  let current: Json = root;
  for (const encoded of pointer.slice(1).split('/')) {
    const part = encoded.replaceAll('~1', '/').replaceAll('~0', '~');
    if (Array.isArray(current)) {
      if (!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(part)) throw new Error(`${pointer}: bad array index`);
      const child = current[Number(part)];
      if (child === undefined) throw new Error(`${pointer}: missing array index`);
      current = child;
    } else if (current !== null && typeof current === 'object') {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(current, part)) {
        throw new Error(`${pointer}: missing object member`);
      }
      current = current[part];
    } else {
      throw new Error(`${pointer}: non-container traversal`);
    }
  }
  return current;
}

export function setPointerValue(root: Json, pointer: string, replacement: Json): void {
  const separator = pointer.lastIndexOf('/');
  if (separator < 0) throw new Error(`${pointer}: non-root pointer required`);
  const parentPointer = pointer.slice(0, separator);
  const encoded = pointer.slice(separator + 1);
  const part = encoded.replaceAll('~1', '/').replaceAll('~0', '~');
  const parent = parentPointer === '' ? root : pointerValue(root, parentPointer);
  if (Array.isArray(parent)) {
    if (!/^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(part) || Number(part) >= parent.length) {
      throw new Error(`${pointer}: missing array index`);
    }
    parent[Number(part)] = replacement;
  } else if (parent !== null && typeof parent === 'object'
      && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parent, part)) {
    parent[part] = replacement;
  } else {
    throw new Error(`${pointer}: missing object member`);
  }
}

function objectActualFromNormalized(domain: string, normalized: unknown): ObjectActual {
  return {
    canonical_cbor_hex: encode(normalized).toString('hex'),
    domain_hash: hash(encode([domain, normalized])).toString('hex'),
  };
}

function objectActual(domain: string, body: Json, rootPath = ''): ObjectActual {
  return objectActualFromNormalized(domain, normalizeProtocolObject(body, rootPath));
}

export function eligibleSetActual(
  body: 'Council' | 'AiIrb',
  eligible: Json,
  setPath: string,
): ObjectActual {
  return objectActualFromNormalized(
    'exo.decision_forum.eligible_set.v1',
    [body, normalizeProtocolObject(eligible, setPath)],
  );
}

function authorizationTarget(pkg: Record<string, Json>): Record<string, Json> {
  const reviews = cloneJson(pkg.review_bundle as Record<string, Json>);
  for (const review of reviews.signed_reviews as Array<Record<string, Json>>) {
    review.authorization_target_hash = ZERO_HASH;
    const signature = review.signature as Record<string, Json>;
    signature.signed_payload_hash = ZERO_HASH;
    signature.signature = '00'.repeat(64);
  }
  const receipts = pkg.receipt_manifest as Record<string, Json>;
  return {
    schema_version: pkg.schema_version,
    protocol_identity: cloneJson(pkg.protocol_identity),
    protocol_document: cloneJson(pkg.protocol_document),
    protocol_envelope: cloneJson(pkg.protocol_envelope),
    evidence_manifest: cloneJson(pkg.evidence_manifest),
    review_bundle: reviews,
    monitoring_plan: cloneJson(pkg.monitoring_plan),
    systemic_learning_manifest: cloneJson(pkg.systemic_learning_manifest),
    commercial_boundary: cloneJson(pkg.commercial_boundary),
    receipt_manifest: {
      preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts: cloneJson(receipts.preauthorization_lifecycle_receipts),
      prior_execution_receipt_chain: cloneJson(receipts.prior_execution_receipt_chain),
      genesis_adoption_receipt: cloneJson(receipts.genesis_adoption_receipt),
    },
  };
}

function normalizedPrepublication(pkg: Record<string, Json>): Record<string, Json> {
  const normalized = cloneJson(pkg);
  const receipts = normalized.receipt_manifest as Record<string, Json>;
  receipts.publication_authorization_receipt = null;
  receipts.final_package_root = ZERO_HASH;
  return normalized;
}

function normalizedFinal(pkg: Record<string, Json>): Record<string, Json> {
  const normalized = cloneJson(pkg);
  (normalized.receipt_manifest as Record<string, Json>).final_package_root = ZERO_HASH;
  return normalized;
}

function publicationSigningPayload(receipt: Record<string, Json>): Record<string, Json> {
  return {
    prepublication_root: cloneJson(receipt.prepublication_root),
    renderer_manifest_hash: cloneJson(receipt.renderer_manifest_hash),
    publisher_did: cloneJson(receipt.publisher_did),
    authorized_at: cloneJson(receipt.authorized_at),
  };
}

export function publicationPayloadActual(receipt: Record<string, Json>): ObjectActual {
  return objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.publication_authorization_receipt.v1',
    publicationSigningPayload(receipt),
    '/receipt_manifest/publication_authorization_receipt',
  );
}

function normalizedGenesis(receipt: Record<string, Json>): Record<string, Json> {
  const normalized = cloneJson(receipt);
  normalized.receipt_root = ZERO_HASH;
  return normalized;
}

export function normalizedGenesisActual(receipt: Record<string, Json>): ObjectActual {
  return objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.genesis_adoption_receipt.v1',
    normalizedGenesis(receipt),
    '/receipt_manifest/genesis_adoption_receipt',
  );
}

function normalizedReceiptChain(chain: Record<string, Json>): Record<string, Json> {
  const normalized = cloneJson(chain);
  normalized.chain_root = ZERO_HASH;
  return normalized;
}

export function normalizedReceiptChainActual(chain: Record<string, Json>): ObjectActual {
  return objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.protocol_execution_receipt_chain.v1',
    normalizedReceiptChain(chain),
  );
}

export function loadCommittedVector(id: 'df_protocol_full_v1'): FullVector;
export function loadCommittedVector(id: 'df_protocol_renderer_manifest_v1'): RendererVector;
export function loadCommittedVector(
  id: 'df_protocol_full_v1' | 'df_protocol_renderer_manifest_v1',
): FullVector | RendererVector {
  const path = join(process.cwd(), 'vectors', `${id}.json`);
  const parsed = parseVectorStrict(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'), path) as FullVector | RendererVector;
  if (parsed.vector_id !== id) throw new Error(`${id}: vector_id/file mismatch`);
  return parsed;
}

export function compareResultRecords(
  expected: ResultRecord[],
  actual: ResultRecord[],
): void {
  const key = (record: ResultRecord) => `${record.category}\u0000${record.vector_id}`;
  const actualKeys = actual.map(key);
  if (new Set(actualKeys).size !== actualKeys.length) throw new Error('duplicate result');
  if (expected.length !== actual.length) throw new Error('actual result count mismatch');
  const left = [...expected].sort((a, b) => key(a).localeCompare(key(b)));
  const right = [...actual].sort((a, b) => key(a).localeCompare(key(b)));
  if (JSON.stringify(left) !== JSON.stringify(right)) throw new Error('result mismatch');
}

function requiredArray(record: Record<string, Json>, field: string): Json[] {
  const value = record[field];
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error(`/mutation_records/${field}: array required`);
  return value;
}

function validateMutationRecords(records: FullVector['input']['mutation_records']): void {
  const expectedKinds = new Set([
    'ProgressiveEvent', 'AdverseEvent', 'UnanticipatedProblem',
    'AiSdlcTransgression', 'Estop',
  ]);
  if (records.protocol_events.length !== expectedKinds.size
      || new Set(records.protocol_events.map((event) => String(event.event_kind))).size
        !== expectedKinds.size
      || records.protocol_events.some((event) => !expectedKinds.has(String(event.event_kind)))) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/protocol_events: all five exact event kinds required');
  }
  for (const [index, event] of records.protocol_events.entries()) {
    for (const field of ['severity_basis_points', 'relatedness_basis_points'] as const) {
      const value = event[field];
      if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0 || value > 10000) {
        throw new Error(`/mutation_records/protocol_events/${index}/${field}: basis points out of range`);
      }
    }
    if (requiredArray(event, 'affected_claim_hashes').length === 0
        || requiredArray(event, 'evidence_hashes').length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`/mutation_records/protocol_events/${index}: committed evidence required`);
    }
    objectActual('exo.decision_forum.protocol_event.v1', event,
      `/mutation_records/protocol_events/${index}`);
  }
  if (requiredArray(records.capa_record, 'corrective_action_hashes').length === 0
      || requiredArray(records.capa_record, 'preventive_action_hashes').length === 0) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/capa_record: corrective and preventive actions required');
  }
  const activeProviders = requiredArray(records.estop_authorization, 'active_provider_classes');
  const approveProviders = requiredArray(records.estop_authorization, 'approve_provider_classes');
  const evidenceClasses = requiredArray(
    records.estop_authorization,
    'independent_evidence_classes',
  );
  const signedVotes = requiredArray(records.estop_authorization, 'signed_estop_vote_hashes');
  const providerOnly = (value: Json): value is string =>
    typeof value === 'string' && value !== 'IndependentNonProvider';
  const active = new Set(activeProviders.filter(providerOnly));
  const approve = new Set(approveProviders.filter(providerOnly));
  const required = Number((2n * BigInt(active.size) + 2n) / 3n);
  const evidenceFloor = evidenceClasses.length >= 2
    && evidenceClasses.includes('IndependentNonProviderEvidence');
  const fired = approve.size >= required && evidenceFloor;
  if (active.size === 0
      || active.size !== activeProviders.length
      || approve.size !== approveProviders.length
      || [...approve].some((provider) => !active.has(provider))
      || records.estop_authorization.required_provider_class_count !== required
      || signedVotes.length !== active.size
      || records.estop_authorization.threshold_result !== (fired ? 'Fired' : 'NotMet')) {
    throw new Error(
      '/mutation_records/estop_authorization: checked provider set/ceil/result/signature contract required',
    );
  }
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.capa_record.v1', records.capa_record,
    '/mutation_records/capa_record');
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.investigator_designation.v1',
    records.investigator_designation, '/mutation_records/investigator_designation');
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.aar_rca_attestation.v1',
    records.aar_rca_attestation, '/mutation_records/aar_rca_attestation');
  for (const [index, vote] of records.estop_dispositions.entries()) {
    objectActual('exo.decision_forum.estop_disposition.v1', vote,
      `/mutation_records/estop_dispositions/${index}`);
  }
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.estop_authorization.v1', records.estop_authorization,
    '/mutation_records/estop_authorization');
  for (const [index, attempt] of records.notification_attempts.entries()) {
    objectActual('exo.decision_forum.notification_attempt.v1', attempt,
      `/mutation_records/notification_attempts/${index}`);
  }
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.reset_authorization.v1', records.reset_authorization,
    '/mutation_records/reset_authorization');
  for (const [index, disposition] of records.phase_promotion_dispositions.entries()) {
    objectActual('exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion_disposition.v1', disposition,
      `/mutation_records/phase_promotion_dispositions/${index}`);
  }
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion.v1', records.phase_promotion,
    '/mutation_records/phase_promotion');
  const designationHash = objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.investigator_designation.v1',
    records.investigator_designation,
    '/mutation_records/investigator_designation',
  ).domain_hash;
  const aarHash = objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.aar_rca_attestation.v1',
    records.aar_rca_attestation,
    '/mutation_records/aar_rca_attestation',
  ).domain_hash;
  const capaHash = objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.capa_record.v1',
    records.capa_record,
    '/mutation_records/capa_record',
  ).domain_hash;
  const estopHash = objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.estop_authorization.v1',
    records.estop_authorization,
    '/mutation_records/estop_authorization',
  ).domain_hash;
  const exactFields = (
    left: Record<string, Json>,
    right: Record<string, Json>,
    fields: readonly string[],
  ): boolean => fields.every((field) => left[field] === right[field]);
  if (records.aar_rca_attestation.investigator_designation_hash !== designationHash
      || !exactFields(records.aar_rca_attestation, records.investigator_designation, [
        'tenant_id', 'protocol_id', 'protocol_version_hash', 'event_id', 'scope_hash',
        'investigator_did',
      ])) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/aar_rca_attestation: exact designation link required');
  }
  const derivedActive = new Set<string>();
  const derivedApprove = new Set<string>();
  const derivedVoteHashes = new Set<string>();
  const derivedSeats = new Set<string>();
  for (const [index, vote] of records.estop_dispositions.entries()) {
    if (!exactFields(vote, records.estop_authorization, [
      'tenant_id', 'protocol_id', 'protocol_version_hash', 'event_id', 'scope_hash',
      'eligible_ai_irb_set_hash',
    ])) {
      throw new Error(`/mutation_records/estop_dispositions/${index}: exact E-STOP context required`);
    }
    const seat = String(vote.seat_id);
    const provider = String(vote.provider_class);
    if (derivedSeats.has(seat) || derivedActive.has(provider)) {
      throw new Error('/mutation_records/estop_dispositions: distinct seat/provider required');
    }
    derivedSeats.add(seat);
    derivedActive.add(provider);
    if (vote.choice === 'Approve') derivedApprove.add(provider);
    derivedVoteHashes.add(objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.estop_disposition.v1', vote,
      `/mutation_records/estop_dispositions/${index}`,
    ).domain_hash);
  }
  const exactSet = (actual: Set<string>, expected: Json[]): boolean =>
    actual.size === expected.length && expected.every((value) => actual.has(String(value)));
  if (!exactSet(derivedActive, activeProviders)
      || !exactSet(derivedApprove, approveProviders)
      || !exactSet(derivedVoteHashes, signedVotes)) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/estop_authorization: exact signed-vote derivation required');
  }
  const destinations = new Set<string>();
  for (const [index, attempt] of records.notification_attempts.entries()) {
    const destination = String(attempt.destination);
    if (destinations.has(destination)
        || !exactFields(attempt, records.estop_authorization, [
          'tenant_id', 'protocol_id', 'protocol_version_hash',
        ])
        || attempt.source_kind !== 'Estop'
        || attempt.source_id !== records.estop_authorization.estop_id
        || attempt.source_hash !== estopHash) {
      throw new Error(`/mutation_records/notification_attempts/${index}: exact source and unique destination required`);
    }
    destinations.add(destination);
  }
  if (destinations.size === 0) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/notification_attempts: at least one attempt required');
  }
  const reset = records.reset_authorization;
  if (reset.tenant_id !== records.estop_authorization.tenant_id
      || reset.protocol_id !== records.estop_authorization.protocol_id
      || reset.source_estop_id !== records.estop_authorization.estop_id
      || reset.stopped_protocol_version_hash !== records.estop_authorization.protocol_version_hash
      || reset.source_estop_authorization_hash !== estopHash
      || reset.source_event_id !== records.estop_authorization.event_id
      || reset.stopped_scope_hash !== records.estop_authorization.scope_hash
      || reset.aar_rca_attestation_hash !== aarHash
      || reset.capa_record_hash !== capaHash
      || records.capa_record.event_id !== records.estop_authorization.event_id) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/reset_authorization: exact stop/AAR/CAPA graph required');
  }
  const councilPromotionHashes = new Set<string>();
  const aiIrbPromotionHashes = new Set<string>();
  const promotionSeats = new Set<string>();
  for (const [index, disposition] of records.phase_promotion_dispositions.entries()) {
    if (!exactFields(disposition, records.phase_promotion, [
      'tenant_id', 'protocol_id', 'protocol_version_hash', 'progressive_event_id',
      'from_phase', 'to_phase', 'envelope_hash',
    ])) {
      throw new Error(`/mutation_records/phase_promotion_dispositions/${index}: exact promotion context required`);
    }
    const seatKey = `${String(disposition.body)}:${String(disposition.seat_id)}`;
    if (promotionSeats.has(seatKey)) {
      throw new Error('/mutation_records/phase_promotion_dispositions: unique body/seat required');
    }
    promotionSeats.add(seatKey);
    const dispositionHash = objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion_disposition.v1', disposition,
      `/mutation_records/phase_promotion_dispositions/${index}`,
    ).domain_hash;
    (disposition.body === 'Council' ? councilPromotionHashes : aiIrbPromotionHashes)
      .add(dispositionHash);
  }
  if (!exactSet(councilPromotionHashes,
      requiredArray(records.phase_promotion, 'council_disposition_hashes'))
      || !exactSet(aiIrbPromotionHashes,
        requiredArray(records.phase_promotion, 'ai_irb_disposition_hashes'))) {
    throw new Error('/mutation_records/phase_promotion: exact signed disposition sets required');
  }
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.peer_review_signing_payload.v1', records.sealed_review,
    '/mutation_records/sealed_review');
  objectActual('exo.decision_forum.review_bundle.v1', records.reveal,
    '/mutation_records/reveal');
}

export function executeFull(vector: FullVector): ResultRecord {
  if ('expected' in vector || 'actual' in vector) {
    throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: input-only vector required`);
  }
  const input = vector.input;
  validateMutationRecords(input.mutation_records);
  const boundaryValues = input.u64_boundaries.map((boundary, index) => {
    const observed = pointerValue(input.v1_package, boundary.pointer);
    if (observed !== boundary.value) {
      throw new Error(`/input/u64_boundaries/${index}: pointer/value mismatch`);
    }
    return u64(boundary.value, `/input/v1_package${boundary.pointer}`);
  });
  if (new Set(boundaryValues.map(String)).size !== 3) {
    throw new Error('three distinct compared u64 boundary values required');
  }
  const v1 = input.v1_package as Record<string, Json>;
  const v1Segment = input.v1_receipt_segment as Record<string, Json>;
  const v2Segment = input.v2_receipt_segment as Record<string, Json>;
  const receipts = v1.receipt_manifest as Record<string, Json>;
  const genesis = receipts.genesis_adoption_receipt as Record<string, Json>;
  const disposition = v1.disposition_bundle as Record<string, Json>;
  const mutations = input.mutation_records;
  const final = objectActual(
    'exo.decision_forum.peer_reviewed_protocol_package.v1',
    normalizedFinal(v1),
  );
  const v1SegmentActual = normalizedReceiptChainActual(v1Segment);
  const v2SegmentActual = normalizedReceiptChainActual(v2Segment);
  if (v1SegmentActual.domain_hash !== v1Segment.chain_root
      || v2SegmentActual.domain_hash !== v2Segment.chain_root) {
    throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: stored receipt chain root is not normalized root`);
  }
  const actual: Record<string, FullActual> = {
    authorization_target: objectActual('exo.decision_forum.protocol_authorization_target.v1', authorizationTarget(v1)),
    protocol_version: objectActual('exo.decision_forum.protocol_version.v1', v1.protocol_identity),
    protocol_envelope: objectActual('exo.decision_forum.protocol_envelope.v1', v1.protocol_envelope),
    review_bundle: objectActual('exo.decision_forum.review_bundle.v1', v1.review_bundle),
    council_eligible_set: eligibleSetActual('Council', disposition.council_eligible_set,
      '/disposition_bundle/council_eligible_set'),
    ai_irb_eligible_set: eligibleSetActual('AiIrb', disposition.ai_irb_eligible_set,
      '/disposition_bundle/ai_irb_eligible_set'),
    prepublication: objectActual('exo.decision_forum.prepublication_package.v1', normalizedPrepublication(v1)),
    publication_authorization: publicationPayloadActual(
      receipts.publication_authorization_receipt as Record<string, Json>),
    normalized_final: final,
    final_package_root: { value: final.domain_hash },
    genesis_evidence: objectActual('exo.decision_forum.genesis_evidence_bundle.v1', genesis.evidence_bundle,
      '/receipt_manifest/genesis_adoption_receipt/evidence_bundle'),
    genesis_adoption: normalizedGenesisActual(genesis),
    v1_receipt_segment: v1SegmentActual,
    v2_receipt_segment: v2SegmentActual,
    accepted_receipt_chain_root: { value: v2SegmentActual.domain_hash },
    investigator_designation_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.investigator_designation_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.investigator_designation),
      '/mutation_records/investigator_designation',
    ),
    aar_rca_attestation_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.aar_rca_attestation_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.aar_rca_attestation),
      '/mutation_records/aar_rca_attestation',
    ),
    estop_disposition_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.estop_disposition_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.estop_dispositions[0]!),
      '/mutation_records/estop_dispositions/0',
    ),
    estop_authorization_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.estop_authorization_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.estop_authorization, ['receipt_root']),
      '/mutation_records/estop_authorization',
    ),
    notification_attempt_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.notification_attempt_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.notification_attempts[0]!, ['receipt_hash']),
      '/mutation_records/notification_attempts/0',
    ),
    reset_authorization_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.reset_authorization_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.reset_authorization),
      '/mutation_records/reset_authorization',
    ),
    phase_promotion_disposition_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion_disposition_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.phase_promotion_dispositions[0]!),
      '/mutation_records/phase_promotion_dispositions/0',
    ),
    phase_promotion_signing_payload: objectActual(
      'exo.decision_forum.phase_promotion_signing_payload.v1',
      exactSigningPayload(mutations.phase_promotion),
      '/mutation_records/phase_promotion',
    ),
  };
  assertExactKeys(actual, FULL_KEYS, vector.vector_id);
  return { vector_id: vector.vector_id, name: vector.name,
    category: vector.category, actual };
}

export function executeRenderer(vector: RendererVector): ResultRecord {
  if ('expected' in vector || 'actual' in vector) {
    throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: input-only vector required`);
  }
  const { input } = vector;
  if (input.renderer_domain !== 'exo.decision_forum.renderer_manifest.v1'
      || input.artifact_domain !== 'exo.decision_forum.publication_artifact_manifest.v1') {
    throw new Error(`${vector.vector_id}: renderer domain mismatch`);
  }
  const actual = {
    renderer_manifest: objectActual(input.renderer_domain, input.renderer_manifest),
    publication_artifact_manifest: objectActual(
      input.artifact_domain, input.publication_artifact_manifest),
  };
  assertExactKeys(actual, RENDERER_KEYS, vector.vector_id);
  return { vector_id: vector.vector_id, name: vector.name,
    category: vector.category, actual };
}

const invokedPath = process.argv[1];
if (invokedPath !== undefined
    && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(realpathSync(invokedPath)).href) {
  main();
}
```

Create `tools/cross-impl-test/index.test.ts` with the real executor tests (the
loader returns fresh parsed input-only vectors for each test):

```typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import {
  FULL_KEYS, RENDERER_KEYS, compareResultRecords, executeFull, executeRenderer,
  eligibleSetActual, loadCommittedVector, main, normalizedGenesisActual,
  normalizedReceiptChainActual, parseStrictJson, publicationPayloadActual, setPointerValue,
  type FullVector, type Json, type ObjectActual,
} from './index.js';

test('full_and_renderer_executors_emit_exact_production_keys', () => {
  const full = executeFull(loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1'));
  const renderer = executeRenderer(loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_renderer_manifest_v1'));
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(full.actual).sort(), [...FULL_KEYS].sort());
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(renderer.actual).sort(), [...RENDERER_KEYS].sort());
});

test('production_normalizations_ignore_only_self_roots', () => {
  const vector = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1');
  const receiptManifest = vector.input.v1_package.receipt_manifest as Record<string, Json>;
  const genesis = receiptManifest.genesis_adoption_receipt as Record<string, Json>;
  const genesisBaseline = normalizedGenesisActual(genesis);
  const genesisSelfRoot = structuredClone(genesis);
  genesisSelfRoot.receipt_root = 'ee'.repeat(32);
  assert.deepEqual(normalizedGenesisActual(genesisSelfRoot), genesisBaseline);
  const genesisCommitted = structuredClone(genesis);
  (genesisCommitted.evidence_bundle as Record<string, Json>).chronology_root =
    'ed'.repeat(32);
  assert.notEqual(normalizedGenesisActual(genesisCommitted).domain_hash,
    genesisBaseline.domain_hash);

  for (const field of ['v1_receipt_segment', 'v2_receipt_segment'] as const) {
    const chain = vector.input[field] as Record<string, Json>;
    const baseline = normalizedReceiptChainActual(chain);
    const selfRoot = structuredClone(chain);
    selfRoot.chain_root = 'ec'.repeat(32);
    assert.deepEqual(normalizedReceiptChainActual(selfRoot), baseline);
    const committed = structuredClone(chain);
    ((committed.receipts as Array<Record<string, Json>>)[0]).payload_hash = 'eb'.repeat(32);
    assert.notEqual(normalizedReceiptChainActual(committed).domain_hash, baseline.domain_hash);
  }
});

test('Council_AI_IRB_body_swap_and_publication_payload_are_distinct', () => {
  const vector = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1');
  const disposition = vector.input.v1_package.disposition_bundle as Record<string, Json>;
  const sameSeats = disposition.council_eligible_set;
  assert.notEqual(
    eligibleSetActual('Council', sameSeats, '/disposition_bundle/council_eligible_set').domain_hash,
    eligibleSetActual('AiIrb', sameSeats, '/disposition_bundle/council_eligible_set').domain_hash,
  );

  const manifest = vector.input.v1_package.receipt_manifest as Record<string, Json>;
  const publication = manifest.publication_authorization_receipt as Record<string, Json>;
  const baseline = publicationPayloadActual(publication);
  const normalizedAway = structuredClone(publication);
  (normalizedAway.signature as Record<string, Json>).signature = 'ea'.repeat(64);
  assert.deepEqual(publicationPayloadActual(normalizedAway), baseline);
  const committed = structuredClone(publication);
  committed.renderer_manifest_hash = 'e9'.repeat(32);
  assert.notEqual(publicationPayloadActual(committed).domain_hash, baseline.domain_hash);
});

test('module import is side-effect free', () => {
  assert.equal(typeof main, 'function');
});

test('duplicate JSON members fail before vector conversion', () => {
  assert.throws(
    () => parseStrictJson('{"vector_id":"a","vector_id":"b"}'),
    /duplicate JSON member \/vector_id/,
  );
});

test('number_valued_hlc_is_rejected', () => {
  const vector = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1');
  const identity = vector.input.v1_package.protocol_identity as Record<string, Json>;
  identity.created_at = { physical_ms: 9007199254740992, logical: 0 };
  assert.throws(() => executeFull(vector), /safe structural integer|pointer\/value/);
});

test('boundary values are in compared package bytes', () => {
  const vector = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1');
  const baseline = executeFull(vector);
  const changed = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1') as FullVector;
  const boundary = changed.input.u64_boundaries[0] as { pointer: string; value: string };
  setPointerValue(changed.input.v1_package, boundary.pointer, '9007199254740990');
  boundary.value = '9007199254740990';
  const mutated = executeFull(changed);
  assert.notEqual(
    (baseline.actual.protocol_envelope as ObjectActual).canonical_cbor_hex,
    (mutated.actual.protocol_envelope as ObjectActual).canonical_cbor_hex,
  );
});

test('safe_integer narrowing and out-of-range decimal are rejected', () => {
  const narrowed = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1');
  (narrowed.input.u64_boundaries[1] as { value: unknown }).value = 9007199254740992;
  assert.throws(() => executeFull(narrowed), /pointer\/value|noncanonical u64/);
  const overflow = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1');
  (overflow.input.u64_boundaries[2] as { value: string }).value = '18446744073709551616';
  assert.throws(() => executeFull(overflow), /pointer\/value|u64/);
});

test('expected_or_actual_fields_are_rejected', () => {
  const vector = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1') as FullVector & {
    expected?: unknown;
  };
  vector.expected = { final_package_root: 'forged' };
  assert.throws(() => executeFull(vector), /input-only/);
});

test('all five mutation-record event kinds and bounded scores are enforced', () => {
  const vector = loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_full_v1') as FullVector;
  const events = vector.input.mutation_records.protocol_events;
  assert.deepEqual(
    events.map((event) => String(event.event_kind)).sort(),
    ['AdverseEvent', 'AiSdlcTransgression', 'Estop', 'ProgressiveEvent', 'UnanticipatedProblem'],
  );
  events[0].severity_basis_points = 10001;
  assert.throws(() => executeFull(vector), /severity_basis_points|basis points/);
});

test('renderer and publication-artifact domains remain distinct', () => {
  const result = executeRenderer(loadCommittedVector('df_protocol_renderer_manifest_v1'));
  const renderer = result.actual.renderer_manifest as ObjectActual;
  const artifact = result.actual.publication_artifact_manifest as ObjectActual;
  assert.notEqual(renderer.domain_hash, artifact.domain_hash);
```

```bash
compare_vector_outputs() {
  local rust_output="$1" ts_output="$2" expected_count="$3"
  local rust_normalized ts_normalized
  rust_normalized="$(mktemp /tmp/exochain-rust-normalized.XXXXXX)"
  ts_normalized="$(mktemp /tmp/exochain-ts-normalized.XXXXXX)"
  jq -S -s -e --argjson count "$expected_count" \
    'if length == $count and (map(.vector_id) | unique | length == $count)
     then sort_by(.vector_id) else error("missing or duplicate Rust vector output") end' \
    "$rust_output" > "$rust_normalized" || { rm -f "$rust_normalized" "$ts_normalized"; return 1; }
  jq -S -s -e --argjson count "$expected_count" \
    'if length == $count and (map(.vector_id) | unique | length == $count)
     then sort_by(.vector_id) else error("missing or duplicate TypeScript vector output") end' \
    "$ts_output" > "$ts_normalized" || { rm -f "$rust_normalized" "$ts_normalized"; return 1; }
  local status=0
  diff -u "$rust_normalized" "$ts_normalized" || status=$?
  rm -f "$rust_normalized" "$ts_normalized"
  return "$status"
}
```

```bash
prepare_typescript_executor() {
  local executor_dir="$1"
  test ! -e "$executor_dir"
  mkdir -p "$executor_dir"
  cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/package.json" \
    "$SCRIPT_DIR/package-lock.json" \
    "$SCRIPT_DIR/index.ts" \
    "$SCRIPT_DIR/index.test.ts" \
    "$SCRIPT_DIR/tsconfig.json" \
    "$executor_dir/"
  cp -R "$SCRIPT_DIR/vectors" "$executor_dir/vectors"
  (
    cd "$executor_dir"
    npm ci >/dev/null
    npm run typecheck >/dev/null
    npm test >/dev/null
  )
}

run_typescript_vectors() {
  local executor_dir="$1" vectors="$2" output="$3"
  (
    cd "$executor_dir"
    node dist/index.js --vectors "$vectors" --output "$output"
  )
}
```

fn collect_rust_files(directory: &Path, output: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let mut entries = fs::read_dir(directory)
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("read {}: {error}", directory.display()))
        .map(|entry| entry.expect("protocol directory entry").path())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    entries.sort();
    for path in entries {
        if path.is_dir() {
            collect_rust_files(&path, output);
        } else if path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
            output.push(path);
        }
    }
}

fn protocol_files() -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("src/protocol");
    let mut paths = Vec::new();
    collect_rust_files(&root, &mut paths);
    assert!(!paths.is_empty(), "protocol source inventory is empty");
    let files = paths
        .into_iter()
        .map(|path| {
            let relative = path
                .strip_prefix(&root)
                .expect("protocol-relative path")
                .to_string_lossy()
                .replace('\\', "/");
            let source = fs::read_to_string(&path)
                .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("read {}: {error}", path.display()));
            (relative, source)
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let actual = files
        .iter()
        .map(|(name, _)| name.as_str())
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let expected = EXPECTED_RUST_MODULES
        .iter()
        .copied()
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    assert_eq!(actual, expected, "exact protocol module inventory drift");
    for production in PRODUCTION_MODULES {
        assert!(
            actual.contains(production),
            "missing production module {production}"
        );
    }
    files
}

fn joined_sources(files: &[(String, String)], prefix: &str) -> String {
    files
        .iter()
        .filter(|(name, _)| name == prefix || name.starts_with(&format!("{prefix}/")))
        .map(|(_, source)| source.as_str())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n")
}

fn compact_rust(source: &str) -> String {
    source
        .chars()
        .filter(|value| !value.is_whitespace())
        .collect()
}

fn section<'a>(source: &'a str, start: &str, end: &str) -> &'a str {
    let (_, tail) = source
        .split_once(start)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing plan section start: {start}"));
    tail.split_once(end)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing plan section end: {end}"))
        .0
}

fn gate_rows(source: &str) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
    source
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let cells = line
                .split('|')
                .map(str::trim)
                .filter(|cell| !cell.is_empty())
                .map(ToOwned::to_owned)
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let gate = cells.first()?;
            (gate.len() == 2 && gate.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())).then_some(cells)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn fenced_bash_after<'a>(source: &'a str, anchor: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    let (_, tail) = source.split_once(anchor)?;
    let (_, fenced) = tail.split_once("```bash\n")?;
    fenced.split_once("\n```").map(|(body, _)| body)
}

fn review_fixture(role: &str, outcome: &str, minor_rows: &[&str]) -> String {
    format!(
        "Review role: {role}\nOutcome: {outcome}\n## Minor findings\n{}\n",
        minor_rows.join("\n"),
    )
}

fn write_review_fixture(root: &Path, relative: &str, body: &str) {
    let path = root.join(relative);
    fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().expect("review fixture parent"))
        .expect("create review fixture parent");
    fs::write(&path, body).expect("write review fixture");
}

fn run_shell(
    root: &Path,
    label: &str,
    body: &str,
    environment: &[(&str, &str)],
) -> std::process::Output {
    let script = root.join(format!("{label}.sh"));
    fs::write(&script, format!("set -euo pipefail\n{body}\n"))
        .expect("write exact Gate 21 shell block");
    let mut command = std::process::Command::new("bash");
    command.arg(&script).current_dir(root);
    for (name, value) in environment {
        command.env(name, value);
    }
    command.output().expect("execute exact Gate 21 shell block")
}

fn write_hash(root: &Path, relative: &str) {
    let path = root.join(relative);
    let output = std::process::Command::new("shasum")
        .args(["-a", "256"])
        .arg(&path)
        .output()
        .expect("hash fixture");
    assert!(output.status.success(), "hash fixture {}", path.display());
    let digest = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
        .expect("hash fixture output is UTF-8")
        .split_whitespace()
        .next()
        .expect("hash fixture digest")
        .to_owned();
    fs::write(path.with_extension("sha256"), format!("{digest}\n"))
        .expect("write fixture hash");
}

fn refresh_hash_record(file: &Path, hash_record: &Path) {
    let output = std::process::Command::new("shasum")
        .args(["-a", "256"])
        .arg(file)
        .output()
        .expect("refresh fixture hash");
    assert!(output.status.success(), "refresh hash for {}", file.display());
    let digest = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
        .expect("refreshed hash output is UTF-8")
        .split_whitespace()
        .next()
        .expect("refreshed hash digest")
        .to_owned();
    fs::write(hash_record, format!("{digest}\n")).expect("write refreshed hash record");
}

fn fixture_hash(path: &Path) -> String {
    let output = std::process::Command::new("shasum")
        .args(["-a", "256"])
        .arg(path)
        .output()
        .expect("hash fixture path");
    assert!(output.status.success(), "hash fixture path {}", path.display());
    String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
        .expect("fixture path hash is UTF-8")
        .split_whitespace()
        .next()
        .expect("fixture path hash digest")
        .to_owned()
}

fn fixture_hash_record(path: &Path) -> String {
    fs::read_to_string(path)
        .expect("read fixture hash record")
        .split_whitespace()
        .next()
        .expect("fixture hash-record digest")
        .to_owned()
}

fn fixture_field(path: &Path, key: &str) -> String {
    let prefix = format!("{key}=");
    let values = fs::read_to_string(path)
        .expect("read fixture field source")
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|line| line.strip_prefix(&prefix).map(str::to_owned))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert_eq!(values.len(), 1, "fixture field must be unique: {key}");
    assert!(!values[0].is_empty(), "fixture field must be nonempty: {key}");
    values[0].clone()
}

        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let body = format!(
        "# DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 Observed Review Outcomes\n\n## Observed statuses\n- Implementer: {}\n- Specification validator: {}\n- Technical validator: {}\n- Whole-slice reviewer: {}\n\n## Frozen reviewed range\n- Review attempt ID: {}\n- Base: {}\n- Head: {}\n- Commit range: {}\n- Claim binding SHA-256: {}\n- Implementer report SHA-256: {}\n- Review validator SHA-256: {}\n- Specification report SHA-256: {}\n- Technical report SHA-256: {}\n- Whole-slice report SHA-256: {}\n- Finalized evidence manifest SHA-256: {}\n- Retained minor dispositions SHA-256: {}\n- Ordered review history root SHA-256: {}\n- Stable publication commit marker: verified\n\n## Retained minor findings and dispositions\n{}\n",
        status(&implementer, "Status: "),
        status(&specification, "Outcome: "),
        status(&technical, "Outcome: "),
        status(&whole, "Outcome: "),
        attempt.file_name().expect("attempt ID").to_string_lossy(),
        fixture_field(&claim, "repository_task_base"),
        fixture_field(&claim, "implementation_head"),
        fixture_field(&claim, "implementation_range"),
        fixture_hash_record(&attempt.join("claim.binding.sha256")),
        fixture_hash_record(&attempt.join("02-core-model-implementer.sha256")),
        fixture_hash(&validator),
        fixture_hash_record(&attempt.join("02-core-model-spec-review.sha256")),
        fixture_hash_record(&attempt.join("02-core-model-technical-review.sha256")),
        fixture_hash_record(&attempt.join("02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256")),
        fixture_hash_record(&attempt.join("finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256")),
        fixture_field(&manifest, "retained_minor_dispositions_sha256"),
        fixture_field(&manifest, "ordered_history_root_sha256"),
        rows.join("\n"),
    );
    write_review_fixture(root, outcomes_relative, &body);
    rows
}

fn rewrite_manifest_field(path: &Path, key: &str, value: &str) {
    let source = fs::read_to_string(path).expect("read manifest field fixture");
    let prefix = format!("{key}=");
    let mut replacements = 0_usize;
    let mut rewritten = String::new();
    for line in source.lines() {
        if line.starts_with(&prefix) {
            rewritten.push_str(&format!("{prefix}{value}\n"));
            replacements += 1;
        } else {
            rewritten.push_str(line);
            rewritten.push('\n');
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(replacements, 1, "manifest field fixture must be unique: {key}");
    fs::write(path, rewritten).expect("rewrite manifest field fixture");
}

fn prepare_review_root(fixture_root: &Path, label: &str, implementer_body: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let root = fixture_root.join(label);
    if root.exists() {
        fs::remove_dir_all(&root).expect("remove prior review fixture");
    }
    fs::create_dir_all(&root).expect("create review fixture");
    fs::create_dir_all(root.join("tools")).expect("create license fixture directory");
    fs::write(
        root.join("tools/license_headers.py"),
        "import sys\nsys.exit(0)\n",
    )
    .expect("write passing license fixture");
    write_review_fixture(
        &root,
        ".superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-implementer.md",
        implementer_body,
    );
    write_hash(
        &root,
        ".superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-implementer.md",
    );
    root
}

fn copy_fixture_tree(source: &Path, target: &Path) {
    let mut copied_inodes = BTreeMap::new();
    copy_fixture_tree_preserving_hard_links(source, target, &mut copied_inodes);
}

fn copy_fixture_tree_preserving_hard_links(
    source: &Path,
    target: &Path,
    copied_inodes: &mut BTreeMap<(u64, u64), PathBuf>,
) {
    fs::create_dir_all(target).expect("create copied fixture root");
    let mut entries = fs::read_dir(source)
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("read fixture tree {}: {error}", source.display()))
        .map(|entry| entry.expect("fixture tree entry").path())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    entries.sort();
    for source_path in entries {
        let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&source_path).expect("stat fixture tree entry");
        assert!(!metadata.file_type().is_symlink(), "fixture tree contains symlink");
        let target_path = target.join(source_path.file_name().expect("fixture entry name"));
        if metadata.is_dir() {
            copy_fixture_tree_preserving_hard_links(&source_path, &target_path, copied_inodes);
        } else {
            assert!(metadata.is_file(), "fixture tree contains non-regular entry");
            let inode = (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino());
            if metadata.nlink() > 1 {
                if let Some(first_target) = copied_inodes.get(&inode) {
                    fs::hard_link(first_target, &target_path).expect("preserve fixture hard link");
                } else {
                    fs::copy(&source_path, &target_path).expect("copy fixture file");
                    fs::set_permissions(&target_path, metadata.permissions())
                        .expect("preserve fixture file mode");
                    copied_inodes.insert(inode, target_path);
                }
            } else {
                fs::copy(&source_path, &target_path).expect("copy fixture file");
                fs::set_permissions(&target_path, metadata.permissions())
                    .expect("preserve fixture file mode");
            }
        }
    }
}

fn literal_closeout_verification_succeeds<S: AsRef<std::ffi::OsStr>>(
    root: &Path,
    finalized_arguments: &[S],
) -> bool {
    const REPORTS: &str = ".superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001";
    for (file, hash) in [
        (
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-review-validation.sh"),
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-review-validation.sha256"),
        ),
        (
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-implementer.md"),
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-implementer.sha256"),
        ),
    ] {
        if !run_validator(root, &["verify-hash", &file, &hash])
            .status
            .success()
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if !run_validator(root, finalized_arguments).status.success() {
        return false;
    }
    for (file, hash) in [
        (
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-spec-review.md"),
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-spec-review.sha256"),
        ),
        (
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-technical-review.md"),
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-technical-review.sha256"),
        ),
        (
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md"),
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256"),
        ),
        (
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest"),
            format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256"),
        ),
    ] {
        if !run_validator(root, &["verify-hash", &file, &hash])
            .status
            .success()
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

fn run_validator<S: AsRef<std::ffi::OsStr>>(
    root: &Path,
    arguments: &[S],
) -> std::process::Output {
    std::process::Command::new(root.join(
        ".superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-review-validation.sh",
    ))
    .args(arguments)
    .current_dir(root)
    .output()
    .expect("execute reusable Gate 21 validator")
}

fn ledger_temp_residue(root: &Path, progress_relative: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let progress = root.join(progress_relative);
    let parent = progress.parent().expect("progress parent");
    let prefix = format!(
        "{}.",
        progress.file_name().expect("progress file name").to_string_lossy(),
    );
    let mut residue = fs::read_dir(parent)
        .expect("read progress parent")
        .map(|entry| entry.expect("progress parent entry").file_name())
        .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .filter(|name| name.starts_with(&prefix))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    residue.sort();
    residue
}

fn pending_residue(root: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    fn walk(base: &Path, current: &Path, found: &mut Vec<String>) {
        let mut entries = fs::read_dir(current)
            .expect("read pending-residue directory")
            .map(|entry| entry.expect("pending-residue entry").path())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        entries.sort();
        for path in entries {
            let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&path).expect("stat pending-residue entry");
            if metadata.is_dir() {
                walk(base, &path, found);
            } else if path
                .file_name()
                .expect("pending-residue file name")
                .to_string_lossy()
                .contains(".pending.")
            {
                found.push(
                    path.strip_prefix(base)
                        .expect("pending residue below root")
                        .to_string_lossy()
                        .into_owned(),
                );
            }
        }
    }
    let mut found = Vec::new();
    walk(root, root, &mut found);
    found
}

fn durable_file_snapshot(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
    fn walk(base: &Path, current: &Path, found: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) {
        let mut entries = fs::read_dir(current)
            .expect("read durable-snapshot directory")
            .map(|entry| entry.expect("durable-snapshot entry").path())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        entries.sort();
        for path in entries {
            let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&path).expect("stat durable-snapshot entry");
            assert!(!metadata.file_type().is_symlink(), "durable snapshot contains symlink");
            if metadata.is_dir() {
                walk(base, &path, found);
                continue;
            }
            assert!(metadata.is_file(), "durable snapshot contains non-regular file");
            let name = path
                .file_name()
                .expect("durable-snapshot file name")
                .to_string_lossy();
            if name.contains(".pending.")
                || name.contains(".expected.")
                || name.contains(".stale.")
                || name.ends_with(".append-lock")
            {
                continue;
            }
            found.insert(
                path.strip_prefix(base)
                    .expect("durable snapshot below root")
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .into_owned(),
                fs::read(&path).expect("read durable-snapshot file"),
            );
        }
    }
    let mut found = BTreeMap::new();
    walk(root, root, &mut found);
    found
}

fn snapshot_is_preserved(before: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, root: &Path) -> bool {
    before.iter().all(|(relative, bytes)| {
        fs::read(root.join(relative))
            .map(|current| current == *bytes)
            .unwrap_or(false)
    })
}

fn assert_gate_21_executable_review_contract(plan: &str, gate: &str) {
    const REPORTS: &str = ".superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001";
    const ATTEMPTS: &str =
        ".superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/review-attempts";
    const TASK_BASE: &str = "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111";
    const HEAD: &str = "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222";
    const RANGE: &str =
        "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111..2222222222222222222222222222222222222222";
    let normalized_gate = gate.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
    let install = fenced_bash_after(
        gate,
        "Install the reusable validator once and verify the frozen bytes on every later attempt:",
    )
    .expect("Gate 21 must contain its exact validator installation block");
    let claim = fenced_bash_after(
        gate,
        "Claim the deterministic next attempt atomically before either reviewer authors a report:",
    )
    .expect("Gate 21 must contain its exact attempt claim block");
    let first_gate = fenced_bash_after(
        gate,
        "Validate and freeze the two attempt-scoped first-review reports:",
    )
    .expect("Gate 21 must contain its exact first-review gate block");
    let whole_gate = fenced_bash_after(
        gate,
        "Validate, freeze, finalize, and publish the completed whole-slice attempt immediately after it is authored:",
    )
    .expect("Gate 21 must contain its exact whole-slice gate block");
    let fixture_root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR"))
        .join("df-protocol-001-gate-21-review-contract");
    if fixture_root.exists() {
        fs::remove_dir_all(&fixture_root).expect("remove review-contract fixture root");
    }
    fs::create_dir_all(&fixture_root).expect("create review-contract fixture root");

    let none = ["MINOR: NONE"];
    let real = ["MINOR: M-01 | exact evidence | accepted-nonblocking"];
    let approved_spec = review_fixture("specification", "APPROVED", &none);
    let approved_technical = review_fixture(
        "technical",
        "APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS",
        &real,
    );
    let mut failures = Vec::new();
    let mut exercised_fault_points = BTreeSet::new();
    let root = prepare_review_root(
        &fixture_root,
        "first-review-block-then-retry",
        "Status: DONE\nRevision: first\n",
    );
    let environment = [
        ("DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID", "01"),
        ("DF_REVIEW_TASK_BASE", TASK_BASE),
        ("DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_HEAD", HEAD),
        ("DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_RANGE", RANGE),
    ];
    let install_output = run_shell(&root, "install-01", install, &[]);
    if !install_output.status.success() {
        failures.push(format!(
            "initial validator install failed: {}",
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&install_output.stderr),
        ));
    }
    let installed_validator_path =
        root.join(format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-review-validation.sh"));
    let installed_validator_bytes =
        fs::read(&installed_validator_path).expect("read installed review validator");
    if !installed_validator_bytes.starts_with(b"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n") {
        failures.push("installed review validator is not deterministically bound to Bash".into());
    }
    let installed_mode = fs::metadata(&installed_validator_path)
        .expect("stat installed review validator")
        .permissions()
        .mode()
        & 0o777;
    if installed_mode != 0o700 {
        failures.push(format!("installed review validator mode is {installed_mode:o}, not 700"));
    }
    let bash_syntax = std::process::Command::new("bash")
        .arg("-n")
        .arg(&installed_validator_path)
        .output()
        .expect("parse installed validator explicitly with Bash");
    if !bash_syntax.status.success() {
        failures.push("installed review validator failed explicit Bash syntax validation".into());
    }
    let installed_validator_source = String::from_utf8(installed_validator_bytes.clone())
        .expect("installed validator source is UTF-8");
    let registry = section(
        &installed_validator_source,
        "STEP10_OPERATION_BOUNDARIES=(\n",
        ")\nfor boundary in \"${STEP10_OPERATION_BOUNDARIES[@]}\"; do",
    )
    .lines()
    .map(str::trim)
    .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
    .map(str::to_owned)
    .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let annotated_operations = installed_validator_source
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|line| line.trim().strip_prefix("# STEP10_OPERATION "))
        .map(|tail| {
            tail.split_whitespace()
                .next()
                .expect("Step 10 operation label")
                .to_owned()
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if annotated_operations.len()
        != annotated_operations.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>().len()
        || annotated_operations.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>() != registry
    {
        failures.push(format!(
            "Step 10 actual-operation/registry mismatch: actual={annotated_operations:?} registry={registry:?}"
        ));
    }
    for operation in &registry {
        for side in ["before", "after"] {
            let call = format!("fault_point {side}_{operation}");
            if installed_validator_source.matches(&call).count() == 0 {
                failures.push(format!(
                    "Step 10 operation has no {side} fault call on any actual branch: {operation}"
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    for point in installed_validator_source.lines().filter_map(|line| {
        line.trim()
            .strip_prefix("fault_point ")
            .and_then(|tail| tail.split_whitespace().next())
            .filter(|point| point.starts_with("before_step10_") || point.starts_with("after_step10_"))
    }) {
        let operation = point
            .strip_prefix("before_")
            .or_else(|| point.strip_prefix("after_"))
            .expect("Step 10 point side");
        if !registry.contains(operation) {
            failures.push(format!(
                "actual Step 10 fault call is absent from the mechanical registry: {point}"
            ));
        }
    }
    let initial_fault_inventory = run_validator(&root, &["fault-inventory"]);
    assert!(
        initial_fault_inventory.status.success(),
        "read initial validator fault inventory"
    );
    let step10_fault_points = String::from_utf8(initial_fault_inventory.stdout)
        .expect("initial fault inventory is UTF-8")
        .lines()
        .filter(|point| {
            point
                .strip_prefix("before_")
                .or_else(|| point.strip_prefix("after_"))
                .is_some_and(|operation| registry.contains(operation))
        })
        .map(str::to_owned)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let expected_step10_fault_points = registry
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|operation| {
            [format!("before_{operation}"), format!("after_{operation}")]
        })
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    if step10_fault_points.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
        != expected_step10_fault_points
        || step10_fault_points.len() != expected_step10_fault_points.len()
    {
        failures.push(format!(
            "Step 10 derived fault inventory is not unique and exact: declared={step10_fault_points:?} expected={expected_step10_fault_points:?}"
        ));
    }
    match std::process::Command::new("dash")
        .arg("-n")
        .arg(&installed_validator_path)
        .output()
    {
        Ok(output) if output.status.success() => {
            failures.push("dash unexpectedly accepted the Bash-only review validator".into());
        }
        Ok(_) => {}
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
        Err(error) => panic!("execute dash compatibility guard: {error}"),
    }
    let installer_fault_points = [
        "before_review_validator_file_copy",
        "after_review_validator_file_copy",
        "before_review_validator_file_link",
        "after_review_validator_file_link",
        "before_review_validator_hash_compute",
        "after_review_validator_hash_compute",
        "before_review_validator_hash_file",
        "after_review_validator_hash_file",
        "before_review_validator_hash_link",
        "after_review_validator_hash_link",
    ];
    let emitted_installer_fault_points = install
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|line| {
            line.trim()
                .strip_prefix("install_fault_point ")
                .and_then(|tail| tail.split_whitespace().next())
        })
        .filter(|point| *point != "\"$1\"")
        .map(str::to_owned)
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    assert_eq!(
        emitted_installer_fault_points,
        installer_fault_points.iter().map(|point| (*point).to_owned()).collect(),
        "installer emitted fault-point inventory drift",
    );
    for (fault_index, fault_point) in installer_fault_points.iter().enumerate() {
        let fault_root = prepare_review_root(
            &fixture_root,
            &format!("installer-fault-{fault_index:02}"),
            "Status: DONE\nInstaller fault fixture\n",
        );
        let interrupted = run_shell(
            &fault_root,
            &format!("installer-fault-{fault_index:02}-interrupted"),
            install,
            &[("DF_REVIEW_FAULT_POINT", *fault_point)],
        );
        if interrupted.status.success() {
            failures.push(format!("installer fault point unexpectedly passed: {fault_point}"));
        }
        let before_retry_snapshot = durable_file_snapshot(&fault_root);
        let retry = run_shell(
            &fault_root,
            &format!("installer-fault-{fault_index:02}-retry"),
            install,
            &[],
        );
        if !retry.status.success()
            || !run_validator(
                &fault_root,
                &[
                    "verify-hash",
                    &format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-review-validation.sh"),
                    &format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-review-validation.sha256"),
                ],
            )
            .status
            .success()
        {
            failures.push(format!("installer exact retry did not converge: {fault_point}"));
        }
        if !snapshot_is_preserved(&before_retry_snapshot, &fault_root) {
            failures.push(format!("installer retry changed or deleted durable bytes: {fault_point}"));
        }
        let install_residue = fs::read_dir(fault_root.join(REPORTS))
            .expect("read installer-fault report directory")
            .map(|entry| entry.expect("installer-fault report entry").file_name())
            .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            .filter(|name| name.contains("review-validation.sh.pending")
                || name.contains("review-validation.sha256.pending"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if !install_residue.is_empty() {
            failures.push(format!("installer retry left pending residue: {fault_point}: {install_residue:?}"));
        }
    }
    let claim_output = run_shell(&root, "claim-01", claim, &environment);
    if !claim_output.status.success() {
        failures.push(format!(
            "attempt 01 claim failed: {}",
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&claim_output.stderr),
        ));
    }
    write_review_fixture(
        &root,
        &format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/02-core-model-spec-review.md"),
        &review_fixture("specification", "CHANGES_REQUIRED", &none),
    );
    write_review_fixture(
        &root,
        &format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/02-core-model-technical-review.md"),
        &approved_technical,
    );
    let blocked = run_shell(&root, "first-gate-01", first_gate, &environment);
    if blocked.status.success() {
        failures.push("blocking first-review attempt unexpectedly passed".into());
    }
    for relative in [
        format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/02-core-model-spec-review.md"),
        format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/02-core-model-spec-review.sha256"),
        format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/attempt-result.txt"),
        format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/attempt-result.sha256"),
    ] {
        if !root.join(&relative).is_file() {
            failures.push(format!("blocking first-review attempt did not preserve {relative}"));
        }
    }
    for current in [
        "02-core-model-spec-review.md",
        "02-core-model-spec-review.sha256",
        "02-core-model-technical-review.md",
        "02-core-model-technical-review.sha256",
        "02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md",
        "02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256",
        "02-core-model-stable-current.commit",
    ] {
        if root.join(format!("{REPORTS}/{current}")).exists() {
            failures.push(format!("blocking attempt populated stable current evidence: {current}"));
        }
    }

    let retry_environment = [
        ("DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID", "02"),
        ("DF_REVIEW_TASK_BASE", TASK_BASE),
        ("DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_HEAD", HEAD),
        ("DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_RANGE", RANGE),
    ];
    let blocked_claim_path = root.join(format!("{ATTEMPTS}/01/claim.binding"));
    let blocked_claim = fs::read(&blocked_claim_path).expect("read blocked-attempt claim");
    let mut tampered_blocked_claim = blocked_claim.clone();
    tampered_blocked_claim.extend_from_slice(b"tampered\n");
    fs::write(&blocked_claim_path, tampered_blocked_claim)
        .expect("tamper blocked-attempt claim without its sibling hash");
    let tampered_retry = run_shell(
        &root,
        "claim-02-with-tampered-blocked-history",
        claim,
        &retry_environment,
    );
    if tampered_retry.status.success() {
        failures.push("successor claim accepted a tampered first-review-blocked attempt".into());
    }
    let attempted_successor = root.join(format!("{ATTEMPTS}/02"));
    if attempted_successor.exists() {
        fs::remove_dir_all(&attempted_successor)
            .expect("remove incorrectly accepted successor fixture");
    }
    fs::write(&blocked_claim_path, blocked_claim).expect("restore blocked-attempt claim");

    write_review_fixture(
        &root,
        &format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-implementer.md"),
        "Status: DONE\nRevision: second\n",
    );
    write_hash(&root, &format!("{REPORTS}/02-core-model-implementer.md"));
    let verify_install = run_shell(&root, "install-02", install, &[]);
    if !verify_install.status.success() {
        failures.push(format!(
            "installed validator was not reusable: {}",
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&verify_install.stderr),
        ));
    }

set +e

OPERATION=${OPERATION#after_}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +e
target=''
for target in "$@"; do :; done
case "$target" in

    : > "$DF_REVIEW_STALE_TRIGGER"

"$DF_REVIEW_REAL_SHASUM" "$@"
WRAPPER

      test -f "$DF_REVIEW_STALE_TRIGGER" && break
      kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null || break

    done
    kill "$holder" 2>/dev/null
    wait "$holder" 2>/dev/null
    : > "$DF_REVIEW_STALE_RELEASE"
    wait "$child"
    child_rc=$?
    export PATH="$ORIGINAL_PATH"
    exit "$child_rc"
    ;;
  step10_commit_barrier_ready_write|step10_commit_barrier_release_observation)

"#;
        for (fault_index, fault_point) in step10_fault_points.iter().enumerate() {
