```bash
  test "$(count_matches '^- Implementer report SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Implementer report SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.sha256")" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Review validator SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Review validator SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(hash_file_value "$validator")" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Specification report SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Specification report SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(hash_value "$spec_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Technical report SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Technical report SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(hash_value "$tech_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Whole-slice report SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Whole-slice report SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(hash_value "$whole_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Finalized evidence manifest SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Finalized evidence manifest SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Ordered review history root SHA-256: ' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(sed -n 's/^- Ordered review history root SHA-256: //p' "$outcomes")" = \
    "$(manifest_field "$manifest" ordered_history_root_sha256)" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^- Stable publication commit marker: verified$' "$outcomes")" -eq 1 || return 1
  expected_rows="$({ rg '^MINOR: ' "$whole" || true; } | LC_ALL=C sort)" || return 1
  actual_rows="$({ rg '^MINOR: ' "$outcomes" || true; } | LC_ALL=C sort)" || return 1
  test "$actual_rows" = "$expected_rows" || return 1
  test "$({ rg '^MINOR: ' "$outcomes" || true; } | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -d | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 0 || return 1
}

freeze_review_report() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local role="$1" report="$2" hash_record="$3" label
  validate_review_report "$role" "$report" || return 1
  case "$role" in
    specification) label=spec_review_hash ;;
    technical) label=technical_review_hash ;;
    whole-slice) label=whole_slice_review_hash ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  atomic_write_hash_record "$report" "$hash_record" "$label" || return 1
}

verify_review_report() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local role="$1" report="$2" hash_record="$3"
  validate_review_report "$role" "$report" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$report" "$hash_record" || return 1
}

review_outcome() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  validate_review_report "$1" "$2" || return 1
  sed -n 's/^Outcome: //p' "$2"
}

validate_attempt_id() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  case "$1" in
    [0-9][0-9]) test "$1" != 00 ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

validate_git_sha() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "${#1}" -eq 40 || return 1
  case "$1" in *[!0-9a-f]*) return 1 ;; esac
}

validate_sha256() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "${#1}" -eq 64 || return 1
  case "$1" in *[!0-9a-f]*) return 1 ;; esac
}

attempt_report() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$1" role="$2"
  case "$role" in
    specification) printf '%s/02-core-model-spec-review.md\n' "$attempt_dir" ;;
    technical) printf '%s/02-core-model-technical-review.md\n' "$attempt_dir" ;;
    whole-slice) printf '%s/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md\n' "$attempt_dir" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

last_attempt_id() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" expected=1 entry name numeric previous='' last=00
  mkdir -p "$attempts_root" || return 1
  test -d "$attempts_root" || return 1
  test ! -L "$attempts_root" || return 1
  while IFS= read -r entry; do
    test -n "$entry" || return 1
    test ! -L "$entry" || return 1
    test -d "$entry" || return 1
    name="${entry##*/}"
    validate_attempt_id "$name" || return 1
    test "$name" != "$previous" || return 1
    numeric=$((10#$name))
    test "$numeric" -eq "$expected" || return 1
    previous="$name"
    last="$name"
    expected=$((expected + 1))
  done < <(find "$attempts_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C sort)
  printf '%s\n' "$last"
}

next_attempt_id() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" last next status
  last="$(last_attempt_id "$attempts_root")" || return 1
  if test "$last" = 00; then
    printf '01\n'
    return 0
  fi
  if ! verify_hash_record "$attempts_root/$last/attempt-result.txt" \
    "$attempts_root/$last/attempt-result.sha256"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$last"
    return 0
  fi
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$last" 1 || return 1
  status="$(manifest_field "$attempts_root/$last/attempt-result.txt" status)" || return 1
  if test "$status" = FINALIZED; then
    if ! verify_stable_publication "$attempts_root" "$last"; then
      printf '%s\n' "$last"
      return 0
    fi
    printf 'terminal_finalized task lifecycle at attempt %s; create a new Task ID for a new review lifecycle\n' \
      "$last" >&2
    return 3
  fi
  next=$((10#$last + 1))
  test "$next" -le 99 || return 1
  printf '%02d\n' "$next"
}

manifest_field() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local manifest="$1" key="$2" count value
  count="$(count_matches "^${key}=" "$manifest")"
  test "$count" -eq 1 || return 1
  value="$(sed -n "s/^${key}=//p" "$manifest")"
  test -n "$value" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$value"
}

verify_manifest_schema() {
  test "$#" -ge 2 || return 1
  local manifest="$1" key
  shift
  test -f "$manifest" || return 1
  test ! -L "$manifest" || return 1
  test "$(wc -l < "$manifest" | tr -d ' ')" -eq "$#" || return 1
  for key in "$@"; do
    manifest_field "$manifest" "$key" >/dev/null || return 1
  done
}

verify_exact_inventory() {
  test "$#" -ge 2 || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$1" entry name expected matches actual_count=0
  shift
  test -d "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  test ! -L "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  for entry in "$attempt_dir"/* "$attempt_dir"/.[!.]* "$attempt_dir"/..?*; do
    if test ! -e "$entry" && test ! -L "$entry"; then
      continue
    fi
    test ! -L "$entry" || return 1
    test -f "$entry" || return 1
    name="${entry##*/}"
    matches=0
    for expected in "$@"; do
      if test "$name" = "$expected"; then
        matches=$((matches + 1))
      fi
    done
    test "$matches" -eq 1 || return 1
    actual_count=$((actual_count + 1))
  done
  test "$actual_count" -eq "$#" || return 1
}

history_seed() {
  test "$#" -eq 0 || return 1
  printf 'df-protocol-001-review-history-v1\n' | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'
}

history_leaf() {
  test "$#" -eq 10 || return 1
  printf 'domain=df-protocol-001-review-attempt-v1\nattempt_id=%s\nstatus=%s\nclaim_binding_sha256=%s\nspec_report_sha256=%s\nspec_outcome=%s\ntechnical_report_sha256=%s\ntechnical_outcome=%s\nwhole_slice_report_sha256=%s\nwhole_slice_outcome=%s\nretained_minor_dispositions_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$2" "$1" "$3" "$4" "$5" "$6" "$7" "$8" "$9" "${10}" \
    | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'
}

extend_history_root() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  printf 'domain=df-protocol-001-ordered-review-history-v1\nprevious_root_sha256=%s\nattempt_id=%s\nattempt_history_leaf_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$1" "$2" "$3" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'
}

LIFECYCLE_FAULT_POINTS=()
register_fault_pair() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  LIFECYCLE_FAULT_POINTS+=("before_$1" "after_$1")
}
for boundary in claim_reservation_directory claim_directory; do
  register_fault_pair "$boundary" || exit 1
done
for label in claim_implementer; do
  register_fault_pair "${label}_copy" || exit 1
  register_fault_pair "${label}_link" || exit 1
done
for label in \
  claim_reservation claim_reservation_hash claim_implementer_hash \
  claim_binding claim_binding_hash spec_review_hash technical_review_hash \
  whole_slice_review_hash blocked_first_result blocked_first_result_hash \
  blocked_whole_result blocked_whole_result_hash attempt_finalized_manifest \
  attempt_finalized_manifest_hash attempt_finalized_result \
  attempt_finalized_result_hash attempt_stable_commit_marker \
  attempt_stable_commit_marker_hash; do
  register_fault_pair "${label}_file" || exit 1
  register_fault_pair "${label}_link" || exit 1
done
for label in \
  claim_reservation_hash claim_implementer_hash claim_binding_hash \
  spec_review_hash technical_review_hash whole_slice_review_hash \
  blocked_first_result_hash blocked_whole_result_hash \
  attempt_finalized_manifest_hash attempt_finalized_result_hash \
  attempt_stable_commit_marker_hash; do
  register_fault_pair "${label}_compute" || exit 1
done
for label in \
  stable_spec_report stable_spec_report_hash stable_technical_report \
  stable_technical_report_hash stable_whole_slice_report \
  stable_whole_slice_report_hash stable_finalized_manifest \
  stable_finalized_manifest_hash stable_commit_marker; do
  register_fault_pair "${label}_link" || exit 1
done
STEP10_OPERATION_BOUNDARIES=(
  step10_dead_temporary_cleanup_unlink
  step10_dead_lock_cleanup_unlink
  step10_lock_pending_write
  step10_lock_authoritative_link
  step10_lock_pending_cleanup_unlink
  step10_lock_disappearance_observation
  step10_stale_lock_arbitration_link
  step10_stale_lock_takeover_unlink
  step10_stale_snapshot_cleanup_unlink
  step10_lock_release
  step10_expected_ledger_write
  step10_progress_hash_pre
  step10_progress_hash_post
  step10_ledger_copy
  step10_ledger_append_write
  step10_commit_barrier_ready_write
  step10_commit_barrier_release_observation
  step10_ledger_commit_rename
  step10_expected_cleanup_unlink
  step10_pending_cleanup_unlink
)
for boundary in "${STEP10_OPERATION_BOUNDARIES[@]}"; do
  register_fault_pair "$boundary" || exit 1
done

fault_point() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local candidate declared=0
  for candidate in "${LIFECYCLE_FAULT_POINTS[@]}"; do
    if test "$candidate" = "$1"; then
      declared=1
      break
    fi
  done
  test "$declared" -eq 1 || return 1
  if test "${DF_REVIEW_FAULT_POINT-}" = "$1"; then
    printf 'injected review-publication fault: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    return 86
  fi
}

atomic_mkdir_exact() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local target="$1" label="$2"
  if test -e "$target" || test -L "$target"; then
    test -d "$target" || return 1
    test ! -L "$target" || return 1
    return 0
  fi
  fault_point "before_${label}" || return 1
  if ! mkdir "$target"; then
    test -d "$target" || return 1
    test ! -L "$target" || return 1
  fi
  fault_point "after_${label}" || return 1
  test -d "$target" || return 1
  test ! -L "$target" || return 1
}

cleanup_atomic_temporaries() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local target="$1" stale owner
  for stale in "$target".pending.*; do
    test -e "$stale" || continue
    test -f "$stale" || return 1
    test ! -L "$stale" || return 1
    owner="${stale##*.}"
    case "$owner" in *[!0-9]*|'') return 1 ;; esac
    if test "$owner" != "$$" && kill -0 "$owner" 2>/dev/null; then
      continue
    fi
    rm -f "$stale" || return 1
  done
}

atomic_write_text() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local target="$1" label="$2" content="$3" pending expected_hash stale
  pending="$target.pending.$$"
  expected_hash="$(printf '%s' "$content" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
  if test -e "$target" || test -L "$target"; then
    test -f "$target" || return 1
    test ! -L "$target" || return 1
    test "$(shasum -a 256 "$target" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash" || return 1
    cleanup_atomic_temporaries "$target" || return 1
    return 0
  fi
  fault_point "before_${label}_file" || return 1
  (umask 077; printf '%s' "$content" > "$pending") || return 1
  fault_point "after_${label}_file" || return 1
  test -f "$pending" || return 1
  test ! -L "$pending" || return 1
  test "$(shasum -a 256 "$pending" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash" || return 1
  fault_point "before_${label}_link" || return 1
  if ! ln "$pending" "$target"; then
    test -f "$target" || return 1
    test ! -L "$target" || return 1
    test "$(shasum -a 256 "$target" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash" || return 1
  fi
  fault_point "after_${label}_link" || return 1
  test -f "$target" || return 1
  test ! -L "$target" || return 1
  test "$(shasum -a 256 "$target" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash" || return 1
  rm -f "$pending" || return 1
  cleanup_atomic_temporaries "$target" || return 1
}

atomic_copy_exact() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local source="$1" target="$2" label="$3" pending stale
  test -f "$source" || return 1
  test ! -L "$source" || return 1
  if test -e "$target" || test -L "$target"; then
    test -f "$target" || return 1
    test ! -L "$target" || return 1
    cmp -s "$source" "$target" || return 1
    test ! "$source" -ef "$target" || return 1
    cleanup_atomic_temporaries "$target" || return 1
    return 0
  fi
  pending="$target.pending.$$"
  fault_point "before_${label}_copy" || return 1
  (umask 077; cp -p "$source" "$pending") || return 1
  fault_point "after_${label}_copy" || return 1
  test -f "$pending" || return 1
  test ! -L "$pending" || return 1
  cmp -s "$source" "$pending" || return 1
  fault_point "before_${label}_link" || return 1
  if ! ln "$pending" "$target"; then
    test -f "$target" || return 1
    test ! -L "$target" || return 1
    cmp -s "$source" "$target" || return 1
    test ! "$source" -ef "$target" || return 1
  fi
  fault_point "after_${label}_link" || return 1
  test -f "$target" || return 1
  test ! -L "$target" || return 1
  cmp -s "$source" "$target" || return 1
  test ! "$source" -ef "$target" || return 1
  rm -f "$pending" || return 1
  cleanup_atomic_temporaries "$target" || return 1
}

atomic_write_hash_record() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local source="$1" target="$2" label="$3" digest content
  if test -e "$target" || test -L "$target"; then
    digest="$(hash_file_value "$source")" || return 1
    printf -v content '%s\n' "$digest"
    atomic_write_text "$target" "$label" "$content" || return 1
    verify_hash_record "$source" "$target" || return 1
    return 0
  fi
  fault_point "before_${label}_compute" || return 1
  digest="$(hash_file_value "$source")" || return 1
  fault_point "after_${label}_compute" || return 1
  printf -v content '%s\n' "$digest"
  atomic_write_text "$target" "$label" "$content" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$source" "$target" || return 1
}

atomic_link_exact() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local source="$1" target="$2" label="$3"
  test -f "$source" || return 1
  test ! -L "$source" || return 1
  if test -e "$target" || test -L "$target"; then
    verify_hard_link_exact "$source" "$target" || return 1
    return 0
  fi
  fault_point "before_${label}_link" || return 1
  if ! ln "$source" "$target"; then
    verify_hard_link_exact "$source" "$target" || return 1
  fi
  fault_point "after_${label}_link" || return 1
  verify_hard_link_exact "$source" "$target" || return 1
}

verify_claim_core() {
  test "$#" -eq 5 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" previous_root="$3" previous_terminal="$4"
  local validator_hash="$5" attempt_dir claim claim_hash frozen_implementer frozen_implementer_hash
  local reports_dir reservation reservation_hash
  attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  reports_dir="${attempts_root%/review-attempts}"
  reservation="$reports_dir/review-claim-reservations/$attempt_id.binding"
  reservation_hash="$reports_dir/review-claim-reservations/$attempt_id.binding.sha256"
  claim="$attempt_dir/claim.binding"
  claim_hash="$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256"
  frozen_implementer="$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.md"
  frozen_implementer_hash="$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.sha256"
  verify_hash_record "$reservation" "$reservation_hash" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$claim" "$claim_hash" || return 1
  cmp -s "$reservation" "$claim" || return 1
  verify_manifest_schema "$claim" \
    attempt_id repository_task_base implementation_head implementation_range \
    implementer_report_sha256 validator_sha256 predecessor_terminal_sha256 \
    ordered_history_root_sha256 || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" attempt_id)" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  validate_git_sha "$(manifest_field "$claim" repository_task_base)" || return 1
  validate_git_sha "$(manifest_field "$claim" implementation_head)" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" implementation_range)" = \
    "$(manifest_field "$claim" repository_task_base)..$(manifest_field "$claim" implementation_head)" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$frozen_implementer" "$frozen_implementer_hash" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" implementer_report_sha256)" = \
    "$(hash_value "$frozen_implementer_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" validator_sha256)" = "$validator_hash" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" predecessor_terminal_sha256)" = "$previous_terminal" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" ordered_history_root_sha256)" = "$previous_root" || return 1
}

verify_closed_attempt() {
  test "$#" -eq 5 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" previous_root="$3" previous_terminal="$4"
  local allow_finalized="$5" reports_dir validator validator_hash_record validator_hash
  local attempt_dir result result_hash status claim_hash spec tech whole spec_hash tech_hash whole_hash
  local spec_hash_value tech_hash_value whole_hash_value spec_outcome tech_outcome whole_outcome
  local leaf ordered_root manifest manifest_hash retained_minor_hash
  reports_dir="${attempts_root%/review-attempts}"
  validator="$reports_dir/02-core-model-review-validation.sh"
  validator_hash_record="$reports_dir/02-core-model-review-validation.sha256"
  verify_hash_record "$validator" "$validator_hash_record" || return 1
  validator_hash="$(hash_value "$validator_hash_record")" || return 1
  attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  result="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.txt"
  result_hash="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.sha256"
  verify_hash_record "$result" "$result_hash" || return 1
  status="$(manifest_field "$result" status)" || return 1
  verify_claim_core "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" "$previous_root" "$previous_terminal" \
    "$validator_hash" || return 1
  claim_hash="$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256")" || return 1
  spec="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" specification)" || return 1
  tech="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" technical)" || return 1
  whole="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" whole-slice)" || return 1
  spec_hash="${spec%.md}.sha256"
  tech_hash="${tech%.md}.sha256"
  whole_hash="${whole%.md}.sha256"
  verify_review_report specification "$spec" "$spec_hash" || return 1
  verify_review_report technical "$tech" "$tech_hash" || return 1
  spec_hash_value="$(hash_value "$spec_hash")" || return 1
  tech_hash_value="$(hash_value "$tech_hash")" || return 1
  spec_outcome="$(review_outcome specification "$spec")" || return 1
  tech_outcome="$(review_outcome technical "$tech")" || return 1
  case "$status" in
    BLOCKED_FIRST_REVIEW)
      verify_exact_inventory "$attempt_dir" \
        02-core-model-implementer.md 02-core-model-implementer.sha256 \
        claim.binding claim.binding.sha256 \
        02-core-model-spec-review.md 02-core-model-spec-review.sha256 \
        02-core-model-technical-review.md 02-core-model-technical-review.sha256 \
        attempt-result.txt attempt-result.sha256 || return 1
      verify_manifest_schema "$result" status claim_binding_sha256 \
        spec_report_sha256 spec_outcome technical_report_sha256 technical_outcome \
        whole_slice_report_sha256 whole_slice_outcome \
        retained_minor_dispositions_sha256 attempt_history_leaf_sha256 \
        ordered_history_root_sha256 || return 1
      case "$spec_outcome:$tech_outcome" in
        CHANGES_REQUIRED:*|*:CHANGES_REQUIRED) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
      esac
      whole_hash_value=NONE
      whole_outcome=NONE
      retained_minor_hash=NONE
      ;;
    BLOCKED_WHOLE_SLICE)
      verify_exact_inventory "$attempt_dir" \
        02-core-model-implementer.md 02-core-model-implementer.sha256 \
        claim.binding claim.binding.sha256 \
        02-core-model-spec-review.md 02-core-model-spec-review.sha256 \
        02-core-model-technical-review.md 02-core-model-technical-review.sha256 \
        02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md 02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256 \
        attempt-result.txt attempt-result.sha256 || return 1
      verify_manifest_schema "$result" status claim_binding_sha256 \
        spec_report_sha256 spec_outcome technical_report_sha256 technical_outcome \
        whole_slice_report_sha256 whole_slice_outcome \
        retained_minor_dispositions_sha256 attempt_history_leaf_sha256 \
        ordered_history_root_sha256 || return 1
      case "$spec_outcome:$tech_outcome" in
        APPROVED:APPROVED|APPROVED:APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS:APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS:APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
      esac
      verify_review_report whole-slice "$whole" "$whole_hash" || return 1
      whole_hash_value="$(hash_value "$whole_hash")" || return 1
      whole_outcome="$(review_outcome whole-slice "$whole")" || return 1
      test "$whole_outcome" = CHANGES_REQUIRED || return 1
      verify_retained_minor_dispositions "$attempt_dir" || return 1
      retained_minor_hash="$(retained_minor_dispositions_hash "$attempt_dir")" || return 1
      ;;
    FINALIZED)
      test "$allow_finalized" -eq 1 || return 1
      verify_exact_inventory "$attempt_dir" \
        02-core-model-implementer.md 02-core-model-implementer.sha256 \
        claim.binding claim.binding.sha256 \
        02-core-model-spec-review.md 02-core-model-spec-review.sha256 \
        02-core-model-technical-review.md 02-core-model-technical-review.sha256 \
        02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md 02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256 \
        finalized-evidence.manifest finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256 \
        stable-current.commit stable-current.commit.sha256 \
        attempt-result.txt attempt-result.sha256 || return 1
      case "$spec_outcome:$tech_outcome" in
        APPROVED:APPROVED|APPROVED:APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS:APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS:APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
      esac
      verify_review_report whole-slice "$whole" "$whole_hash" || return 1
      whole_hash_value="$(hash_value "$whole_hash")" || return 1
      whole_outcome="$(review_outcome whole-slice "$whole")" || return 1
      case "$whole_outcome" in APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
      manifest="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest"
      manifest_hash="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256"
      verify_hash_record "$manifest" "$manifest_hash" || return 1
      verify_manifest_schema "$manifest" attempt_id claim_binding_sha256 \
        spec_report_sha256 spec_outcome technical_report_sha256 technical_outcome \
        whole_slice_report_sha256 whole_slice_outcome \
        retained_minor_dispositions_sha256 attempt_history_leaf_sha256 \
        ordered_history_root_sha256 || return 1
      verify_manifest_schema "$result" status finalized_manifest_sha256 \
        retained_minor_dispositions_sha256 attempt_history_leaf_sha256 \
        ordered_history_root_sha256 || return 1
      test "$(manifest_field "$result" finalized_manifest_sha256)" = \
        "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" || return 1
      test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" attempt_id)" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
      verify_retained_minor_dispositions "$attempt_dir" || return 1
      retained_minor_hash="$(retained_minor_dispositions_hash "$attempt_dir")" || return 1
      ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  leaf="$(history_leaf "$status" "$attempt_id" "$claim_hash" "$spec_hash_value" \
    "$spec_outcome" "$tech_hash_value" "$tech_outcome" "$whole_hash_value" \
    "$whole_outcome" "$retained_minor_hash")" || return 1
  ordered_root="$(extend_history_root "$previous_root" "$attempt_id" "$leaf")" || return 1
  if test "$status" = FINALIZED; then
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" claim_binding_sha256)" = "$claim_hash" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" spec_report_sha256)" = "$spec_hash_value" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" spec_outcome)" = "$spec_outcome" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" technical_report_sha256)" = "$tech_hash_value" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" technical_outcome)" = "$tech_outcome" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" whole_slice_report_sha256)" = "$whole_hash_value" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" whole_slice_outcome)" = "$whole_outcome" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" retained_minor_dispositions_sha256)" = \
      "$retained_minor_hash" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" attempt_history_leaf_sha256)" = "$leaf" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" ordered_history_root_sha256)" = "$ordered_root" || return 1
  else
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" claim_binding_sha256)" = "$claim_hash" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" spec_report_sha256)" = "$spec_hash_value" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" spec_outcome)" = "$spec_outcome" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" technical_report_sha256)" = "$tech_hash_value" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" technical_outcome)" = "$tech_outcome" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" whole_slice_report_sha256)" = "$whole_hash_value" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$result" whole_slice_outcome)" = "$whole_outcome" || return 1
  fi
  test "$(manifest_field "$result" retained_minor_dispositions_sha256)" = \
    "$retained_minor_hash" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$result" attempt_history_leaf_sha256)" = "$leaf" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$result" ordered_history_root_sha256)" = "$ordered_root" || return 1
  VERIFIED_HISTORY_ROOT="$ordered_root"
  VERIFIED_TERMINAL_HASH="$(hash_value "$result_hash")" || return 1
}

verify_ordered_history() {
  test "$#" -eq 3 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" last_id="$2" allow_finalized="$3" previous_root previous_terminal numeric attempt_id
  previous_root="$(history_seed)" || return 1
  previous_terminal=NONE
  if test "$last_id" = 00; then
    VERIFIED_HISTORY_ROOT="$previous_root"
    VERIFIED_TERMINAL_HASH="$previous_terminal"
    return 0
  fi
  validate_attempt_id "$last_id" || return 1
  numeric=1
  while test "$numeric" -le "$((10#$last_id))"; do
    attempt_id="$(printf '%02d' "$numeric")" || return 1
    verify_closed_attempt "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" "$previous_root" \
      "$previous_terminal" "$allow_finalized" || return 1
    previous_root="$VERIFIED_HISTORY_ROOT"
    previous_terminal="$VERIFIED_TERMINAL_HASH"
    if test "$(manifest_field "$attempts_root/$attempt_id/attempt-result.txt" status)" = FINALIZED; then
      test "$attempt_id" = "$last_id" || return 1
    fi
    numeric=$((numeric + 1))
  done
}

verify_claim_manifest() {
  test "$#" -eq 7 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" task_base="$3" head="$4" range="$5" implementer_hash="$6" validator_hash="$7"
  validate_attempt_id "$attempt_id" || return 1
  validate_git_sha "$task_base" || return 1
  validate_git_sha "$head" || return 1
  test "$range" = "${task_base}..${head}" || return 1
  test "$(last_attempt_id "$attempts_root")" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  local previous_id previous_root previous_terminal
  if test "$attempt_id" = 01; then
    previous_root="$(history_seed)" || return 1
    previous_terminal=NONE
  else
    previous_id="$(printf '%02d' "$((10#$attempt_id - 1))")" || return 1
    verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$previous_id" 0 || return 1
    previous_root="$VERIFIED_HISTORY_ROOT"
    previous_terminal="$VERIFIED_TERMINAL_HASH"
  fi
  verify_claim_core "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" "$previous_root" "$previous_terminal" \
    "$validator_hash" || return 1
  local attempt_dir claim
  attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  claim="$attempt_dir/claim.binding"
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" attempt_id)" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" repository_task_base)" = "$task_base" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" implementation_head)" = "$head" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" implementation_range)" = "$range" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" implementer_report_sha256)" = "$implementer_hash" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$claim" validator_sha256)" = "$validator_hash" || return 1
}

claim_attempt() {
  test "$#" -eq 9 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" task_base="$3" head="$4" range="$5"
  local implementer="$6" implementer_hash_record="$7" validator="$8" validator_hash_record="$9"
  validate_attempt_id "$attempt_id" || return 1
  validate_git_sha "$task_base" || return 1
  validate_git_sha "$head" || return 1
  test "$range" = "${task_base}..${head}" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$implementer" "$implementer_hash_record" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$validator" "$validator_hash_record" || return 1
  local implementer_hash validator_hash computed last previous_id previous_root previous_terminal
  local attempt_dir reports_dir current claim_content reservation_root reservation reservation_hash
  implementer_hash="$(hash_value "$implementer_hash_record")" || return 1
  validator_hash="$(hash_value "$validator_hash_record")" || return 1
  computed="$(next_attempt_id "$attempts_root")" || return 1
  test "$attempt_id" = "$computed" || return 1
  last="$(last_attempt_id "$attempts_root")" || return 1
  attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  if test -d "$attempt_dir" && test ! -L "$attempt_dir"; then
    if test "$attempt_id" = 01; then
      previous_id=00
    else
      previous_id="$(printf '%02d' "$((10#$attempt_id - 1))")"
    fi
  else
    previous_id="$last"
  fi
  if test "$previous_id" = 00; then
    previous_root="$(history_seed)" || return 1
    previous_terminal=NONE
  else
    verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$previous_id" 0 || return 1
    previous_root="$VERIFIED_HISTORY_ROOT"
    previous_terminal="$VERIFIED_TERMINAL_HASH"
  fi
  reports_dir="${attempts_root%/review-attempts}"
  for current in \
    02-core-model-spec-review.md 02-core-model-spec-review.sha256 \
    02-core-model-technical-review.md 02-core-model-technical-review.sha256 \
    02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md 02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256 \
    02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest \
    02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256; do
    test ! -e "$reports_dir/$current" || return 1
    test ! -L "$reports_dir/$current" || return 1
  done
  printf -v claim_content \
    'attempt_id=%s\nrepository_task_base=%s\nimplementation_head=%s\nimplementation_range=%s\nimplementer_report_sha256=%s\nvalidator_sha256=%s\npredecessor_terminal_sha256=%s\nordered_history_root_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$attempt_id" "$task_base" "$head" "$range" "$implementer_hash" "$validator_hash" \
    "$previous_terminal" "$previous_root"
  reservation_root="$reports_dir/review-claim-reservations"
  reservation="$reservation_root/$attempt_id.binding"
  reservation_hash="$reservation_root/$attempt_id.binding.sha256"
  atomic_mkdir_exact "$reservation_root" claim_reservation_directory || return 1
  atomic_write_text "$reservation" claim_reservation "$claim_content" || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$reservation" "$reservation_hash" \
    claim_reservation_hash || return 1
  atomic_mkdir_exact "$attempt_dir" claim_directory || return 1
  atomic_copy_exact "$implementer" "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.md" \
    claim_implementer || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.md" \
    "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.sha256" claim_implementer_hash || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.md" \
    "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.sha256" || return 1
  test "$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/02-core-model-implementer.sha256")" = "$implementer_hash" || return 1
  atomic_write_text "$attempt_dir/claim.binding" claim_binding "$claim_content" || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$attempt_dir/claim.binding" \
    "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256" claim_binding_hash || return 1
  verify_claim_manifest "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" "$task_base" "$head" "$range" \
    "$implementer_hash" "$validator_hash" || return 1
}

close_blocked_attempt() {
  test "$#" -eq 10 || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$1" status="$2" claim_hash="$3" spec_hash="$4" spec_outcome="$5"
  local tech_hash="$6" tech_outcome="$7" whole_hash="$8" whole_outcome="$9"
  local retained_minor_hash="${10}"
  local attempt_id previous_root leaf ordered_root attempts_root result result_hash result_content label
  case "$status" in BLOCKED_FIRST_REVIEW|BLOCKED_WHOLE_SLICE) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  attempt_id="${attempt_dir##*/}"
  attempts_root="${attempt_dir%/*}"
  previous_root="$(manifest_field "$attempt_dir/claim.binding" ordered_history_root_sha256)" || return 1
  leaf="$(history_leaf "$status" "$attempt_id" "$claim_hash" "$spec_hash" "$spec_outcome" \
    "$tech_hash" "$tech_outcome" "$whole_hash" "$whole_outcome" \
    "$retained_minor_hash")" || return 1
  ordered_root="$(extend_history_root "$previous_root" "$attempt_id" "$leaf")" || return 1
  case "$status" in
    BLOCKED_FIRST_REVIEW) label=blocked_first_result ;;
    BLOCKED_WHOLE_SLICE) label=blocked_whole_result ;;
  esac
  result="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.txt"
  result_hash="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.sha256"
  printf -v result_content \
    'status=%s\nclaim_binding_sha256=%s\nspec_report_sha256=%s\nspec_outcome=%s\ntechnical_report_sha256=%s\ntechnical_outcome=%s\nwhole_slice_report_sha256=%s\nwhole_slice_outcome=%s\nretained_minor_dispositions_sha256=%s\nattempt_history_leaf_sha256=%s\nordered_history_root_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$status" "$claim_hash" "$spec_hash" "$spec_outcome" "$tech_hash" "$tech_outcome" \
    "$whole_hash" "$whole_outcome" "$retained_minor_hash" "$leaf" "$ordered_root"
  atomic_write_text "$result" "$label" "$result_content" || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$result" "$result_hash" "${label}_hash" || return 1
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" 0 || return 1
}

verify_gate_binding() {
  test "$#" -eq 7 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" task_base="$3" head="$4" range="$5"
  local implementer_hash_record="$6" validator_hash_record="$7"
  local implementer_hash validator_hash
  implementer_hash="$(hash_value "$implementer_hash_record")" || return 1
  validator_hash="$(hash_value "$validator_hash_record")" || return 1
  verify_claim_manifest "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" "$task_base" "$head" "$range" \
    "$implementer_hash" "$validator_hash" || return 1
}

first_validator_gate() {
  test "$#" -eq 7 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" task_base="$3" head="$4" range="$5"
  local implementer_hash_record="$6" validator_hash_record="$7"
  verify_gate_binding "$@" || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id" spec tech spec_hash tech_hash
  spec="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" specification)" || return 1
  tech="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" technical)" || return 1
  spec_hash="${spec%.md}.sha256"
  tech_hash="${tech%.md}.sha256"
  freeze_review_report specification "$spec" "$spec_hash" || return 1
  freeze_review_report technical "$tech" "$tech_hash" || return 1
  local spec_outcome tech_outcome claim_hash_value spec_hash_value tech_hash_value
  spec_outcome="$(review_outcome specification "$spec")" || return 1
  tech_outcome="$(review_outcome technical "$tech")" || return 1
  claim_hash_value="$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256")" || return 1
  spec_hash_value="$(hash_value "$spec_hash")" || return 1
  tech_hash_value="$(hash_value "$tech_hash")" || return 1
  case "$spec_outcome:$tech_outcome" in
    CHANGES_REQUIRED:*|*:CHANGES_REQUIRED)
      close_blocked_attempt "$attempt_dir" BLOCKED_FIRST_REVIEW "$claim_hash_value" \
        "$spec_hash_value" "$spec_outcome" "$tech_hash_value" "$tech_outcome" NONE NONE NONE || return 1
      printf 'first-validator CHANGES_REQUIRED blocks whole-slice dispatch; use a fresh next attempt\n' >&2
      return 1
      ;;
    APPROVED:APPROVED|APPROVED:APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS:APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS:APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

verify_first_reviews() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$1" role report hash outcome
  for role in specification technical; do
    report="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" "$role")" || return 1
    hash="${report%.md}.sha256"
    verify_review_report "$role" "$report" "$hash" || return 1
    outcome="$(review_outcome "$role" "$report")" || return 1
    case "$outcome" in APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  done
}

publish_current_evidence() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2"
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  local reports_dir="${attempts_root%/review-attempts}" role source source_hash target target_hash label
  local manifest manifest_hash marker marker_source marker_source_hash
  test "$(last_attempt_id "$attempts_root")" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" 1 || return 1
  for role in specification technical whole-slice; do
    source="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" "$role")" || return 1
    source_hash="${source%.md}.sha256"
    case "$role" in
      specification) target="$reports_dir/02-core-model-spec-review.md"; label=stable_spec_report ;;
      technical) target="$reports_dir/02-core-model-technical-review.md"; label=stable_technical_report ;;
      whole-slice) target="$reports_dir/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md"; label=stable_whole_slice_report ;;
    esac
    target_hash="${target%.md}.sha256"
    verify_hash_record "$source" "$source_hash" || return 1
    atomic_link_exact "$source" "$target" "$label" || return 1
    atomic_link_exact "$source_hash" "$target_hash" "${label}_hash" || return 1
    verify_hash_record "$target" "$target_hash" || return 1
    test "$(hash_value "$target_hash")" = "$(hash_value "$source_hash")" || return 1
  done
  manifest="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest"
  manifest_hash="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256"
  atomic_link_exact "$manifest" "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest" \
    stable_finalized_manifest || return 1
  atomic_link_exact "$manifest_hash" \
    "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256" \
    stable_finalized_manifest_hash || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest" \
    "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256" || return 1
  marker="$reports_dir/02-core-model-stable-current.commit"
  marker_source="$attempt_dir/stable-current.commit"
  marker_source_hash="$attempt_dir/stable-current.commit.sha256"
  verify_hash_record "$marker_source" "$marker_source_hash" || return 1
  atomic_link_exact "$marker_source" "$marker" stable_commit_marker || return 1
  verify_hard_link_exact "$marker_source" "$marker" || return 1
}

verify_stable_publication() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" attempt_dir reports_dir marker marker_source marker_source_hash manifest manifest_hash
  local role source source_hash target target_hash
  attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  reports_dir="${attempts_root%/review-attempts}"
  marker="$reports_dir/02-core-model-stable-current.commit"
  marker_source="$attempt_dir/stable-current.commit"
  marker_source_hash="$attempt_dir/stable-current.commit.sha256"
  manifest="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest"
  manifest_hash="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256"
  verify_hash_record "$marker_source" "$marker_source_hash" || return 1
  verify_hard_link_exact "$marker_source" "$marker" || return 1
  verify_manifest_schema "$marker" attempt_id finalized_manifest_sha256 ordered_history_root_sha256 || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$marker" attempt_id)" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$marker" finalized_manifest_sha256)" = "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$marker" ordered_history_root_sha256)" = \
    "$(manifest_field "$manifest" ordered_history_root_sha256)" || return 1
  for role in specification technical whole-slice; do
    source="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" "$role")" || return 1
    source_hash="${source%.md}.sha256"
    case "$role" in
      specification) target="$reports_dir/02-core-model-spec-review.md" ;;
      technical) target="$reports_dir/02-core-model-technical-review.md" ;;
      whole-slice) target="$reports_dir/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md" ;;
    esac
    target_hash="${target%.md}.sha256"
    verify_hash_record "$target" "$target_hash" || return 1
    verify_hard_link_exact "$source" "$target" || return 1
    verify_hard_link_exact "$source_hash" "$target_hash" || return 1
  done
  verify_hash_record "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest" \
    "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256" || return 1
  verify_hard_link_exact "$manifest" \
    "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest" || return 1
  verify_hard_link_exact "$manifest_hash" \
    "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256" || return 1
}

finalize_attempt() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2"
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  verify_first_reviews "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  local whole whole_hash spec tech spec_hash tech_hash previous_root leaf ordered_root retained_minor_hash
  local manifest manifest_hash result result_hash manifest_content result_content
  local marker_source marker_source_hash marker_content
  whole="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" whole-slice)" || return 1
  whole_hash="${whole%.md}.sha256"
  verify_review_report whole-slice "$whole" "$whole_hash" || return 1
  local whole_outcome
  whole_outcome="$(review_outcome whole-slice "$whole")" || return 1
  case "$whole_outcome" in APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  verify_retained_minor_dispositions "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  retained_minor_hash="$(retained_minor_dispositions_hash "$attempt_dir")" || return 1
  verify_license_gate || return 1
  spec="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" specification)" || return 1
  tech="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" technical)" || return 1
  spec_hash="${spec%.md}.sha256"
  tech_hash="${tech%.md}.sha256"
  previous_root="$(manifest_field "$attempt_dir/claim.binding" ordered_history_root_sha256)" || return 1
  leaf="$(history_leaf FINALIZED "$attempt_id" \
    "$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256")" \
    "$(hash_value "$spec_hash")" "$(review_outcome specification "$spec")" \
    "$(hash_value "$tech_hash")" "$(review_outcome technical "$tech")" \
    "$(hash_value "$whole_hash")" "$whole_outcome" "$retained_minor_hash")" || return 1
  ordered_root="$(extend_history_root "$previous_root" "$attempt_id" "$leaf")" || return 1
  manifest="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest"
  manifest_hash="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256"
  result="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.txt"
  result_hash="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.sha256"
  printf -v manifest_content \
    'attempt_id=%s\nclaim_binding_sha256=%s\nspec_report_sha256=%s\nspec_outcome=%s\ntechnical_report_sha256=%s\ntechnical_outcome=%s\nwhole_slice_report_sha256=%s\nwhole_slice_outcome=%s\nretained_minor_dispositions_sha256=%s\nattempt_history_leaf_sha256=%s\nordered_history_root_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$attempt_id" "$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256")" \
    "$(hash_value "$spec_hash")" "$(review_outcome specification "$spec")" \
    "$(hash_value "$tech_hash")" "$(review_outcome technical "$tech")" \
    "$(hash_value "$whole_hash")" "$whole_outcome" "$retained_minor_hash" "$leaf" "$ordered_root"
  atomic_write_text "$manifest" attempt_finalized_manifest "$manifest_content" || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$manifest" "$manifest_hash" \
    attempt_finalized_manifest_hash || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$manifest" "$manifest_hash" || return 1
  printf -v result_content \
    'status=FINALIZED\nfinalized_manifest_sha256=%s\nretained_minor_dispositions_sha256=%s\nattempt_history_leaf_sha256=%s\nordered_history_root_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" "$retained_minor_hash" "$leaf" "$ordered_root"
  atomic_write_text "$result" attempt_finalized_result "$result_content" || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$result" "$result_hash" \
    attempt_finalized_result_hash || return 1
  marker_source="$attempt_dir/stable-current.commit"
  marker_source_hash="$attempt_dir/stable-current.commit.sha256"
  printf -v marker_content \
    'attempt_id=%s\nfinalized_manifest_sha256=%s\nordered_history_root_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$attempt_id" "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" "$ordered_root"
  atomic_write_text "$marker_source" attempt_stable_commit_marker \
    "$marker_content" || return 1
  atomic_write_hash_record "$marker_source" "$marker_source_hash" \
    attempt_stable_commit_marker_hash || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$marker_source" "$marker_source_hash" || return 1
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" 1 || return 1
  publish_current_evidence "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" || return 1
}

whole_slice_gate() {
  test "$#" -eq 7 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" task_base="$3" head="$4" range="$5"
  local implementer_hash_record="$6" validator_hash_record="$7"
  verify_gate_binding "$@" || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  verify_first_reviews "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  local whole whole_hash whole_outcome spec tech spec_hash tech_hash retained_minor_hash
  whole="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" whole-slice)" || return 1
  whole_hash="${whole%.md}.sha256"
  freeze_review_report whole-slice "$whole" "$whole_hash" || return 1
  whole_outcome="$(review_outcome whole-slice "$whole")" || return 1
  verify_retained_minor_dispositions "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  retained_minor_hash="$(retained_minor_dispositions_hash "$attempt_dir")" || return 1
  if test "$whole_outcome" = CHANGES_REQUIRED; then
    spec="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" specification)" || return 1
    tech="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" technical)" || return 1
    spec_hash="${spec%.md}.sha256"
    tech_hash="${tech%.md}.sha256"
    close_blocked_attempt "$attempt_dir" BLOCKED_WHOLE_SLICE \
      "$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256")" \
      "$(hash_value "$spec_hash")" "$(review_outcome specification "$spec")" \
      "$(hash_value "$tech_hash")" "$(review_outcome technical "$tech")" \
      "$(hash_value "$whole_hash")" "$whole_outcome" "$retained_minor_hash" || return 1
    printf 'whole-slice CHANGES_REQUIRED blocks ledger append and evidence commit; use a fresh next attempt\n' >&2
    return 1
  fi
  finalize_attempt "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" || return 1
}

resume_finalization_publication() {
  test "$#" -eq 7 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2"
  verify_gate_binding "$@" || return 1
  finalize_attempt "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" || return 1
}

verify_finalized_attempt() {
  test "$#" -eq 7 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" task_base="$3" head="$4" range="$5"
  local implementer_hash_record="$6" validator_hash_record="$7"
  verify_gate_binding "$@" || return 1
  test "$(last_attempt_id "$attempts_root")" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" 1 || return 1
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  local manifest="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest"
  local manifest_hash="$attempt_dir/finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256"
  local result="$attempt_dir/attempt-result.txt"
  verify_hash_record "$manifest" "$manifest_hash" || return 1
  verify_hash_record "$result" "$attempt_dir/attempt-result.sha256" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$result" status)" = FINALIZED || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$result" finalized_manifest_sha256)" = "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" attempt_id)" = "$attempt_id" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" claim_binding_sha256)" = \
    "$(hash_value "$attempt_dir/claim.binding.sha256")" || return 1
  verify_retained_minor_dispositions "$attempt_dir" || return 1
  local retained_minor_hash
  retained_minor_hash="$(retained_minor_dispositions_hash "$attempt_dir")" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" retained_minor_dispositions_sha256)" = \
    "$retained_minor_hash" || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$result" retained_minor_dispositions_sha256)" = \
    "$retained_minor_hash" || return 1
  local role report hash key outcome_key reports_dir="${attempts_root%/review-attempts}" current
  for role in specification technical whole-slice; do
    report="$(attempt_report "$attempt_dir" "$role")" || return 1
    hash="${report%.md}.sha256"
    verify_review_report "$role" "$report" "$hash" || return 1
    case "$role" in
      specification) key=spec_report_sha256; outcome_key=spec_outcome; current=02-core-model-spec-review.md ;;
      technical) key=technical_report_sha256; outcome_key=technical_outcome; current=02-core-model-technical-review.md ;;
      whole-slice) key=whole_slice_report_sha256; outcome_key=whole_slice_outcome; current=02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md ;;
    esac
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" "$key")" = "$(hash_value "$hash")" || return 1
    test "$(manifest_field "$manifest" "$outcome_key")" = "$(review_outcome "$role" "$report")" || return 1
    verify_review_report "$role" "$reports_dir/$current" "$reports_dir/${current%.md}.sha256" || return 1
    test "$(hash_value "$reports_dir/${current%.md}.sha256")" = "$(hash_value "$hash")" || return 1
  done
  verify_hash_record "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest" \
    "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256" || return 1
  test "$(hash_value "$reports_dir/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256")" = \
    "$(hash_value "$manifest_hash")" || return 1
  verify_stable_publication "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" || return 1
}

cleanup_ledger_temporaries() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local progress="$1" attempt_id="$2" stale owner lock
  for stale in \
    "$progress".expected."$attempt_id".* \
    "$progress".pending."$attempt_id".* \
    "$progress".append-lock.pending.* \
    "$progress".append-lock.stale.*; do
    test -e "$stale" || continue
    test -f "$stale" || return 1
    test ! -L "$stale" || return 1
    owner="${stale##*.}"
    case "$owner" in *[!0-9]*|'') return 1 ;; esac
    if test "$owner" != "$$" && kill -0 "$owner" 2>/dev/null; then
      continue
    fi
    case "$stale" in
      "$progress".append-lock.stale.*)
        fault_point before_step10_stale_snapshot_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        rm -f "$stale" || return 1
        fault_point after_step10_stale_snapshot_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        ;;
      *)
        # STEP10_OPERATION step10_dead_temporary_cleanup_unlink unlink
        fault_point before_step10_dead_temporary_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        rm -f "$stale" || return 1
        fault_point after_step10_dead_temporary_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        ;;
    esac
  done
  lock="$progress.append-lock"
  if test -e "$lock" || test -L "$lock"; then
    test -f "$lock" || return 1
    test ! -L "$lock" || return 1
    IFS= read -r owner < "$lock" || return 1
    case "$owner" in *[!0-9]*|'') return 1 ;; esac
    if test "$owner" = "$$" || ! kill -0 "$owner" 2>/dev/null; then
      # STEP10_OPERATION step10_dead_lock_cleanup_unlink unlink
      fault_point before_step10_dead_lock_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      rm -f "$lock" || return 1
      fault_point after_step10_dead_lock_cleanup_unlink || return 1
    fi
  fi
}

acquire_ledger_lock() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local progress="$1" lock="$progress.append-lock" pending snapshot owner iteration=1
  pending="$lock.pending.$$"
  while test "$iteration" -le 25; do
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_lock_pending_write write
    fault_point before_step10_lock_pending_write || return 1
    (umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$pending") || return 1
    fault_point after_step10_lock_pending_write || return 1
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_lock_authoritative_link link
    fault_point before_step10_lock_authoritative_link || return 1
    if ln "$pending" "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
      fault_point after_step10_lock_authoritative_link || return 1
      # STEP10_OPERATION step10_lock_pending_cleanup_unlink unlink
      fault_point before_step10_lock_pending_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      rm -f "$pending" || return 1
      fault_point after_step10_lock_pending_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      LEDGER_LOCK="$lock"
      return 0
    fi
    fault_point after_step10_lock_authoritative_link || return 1
    fault_point before_step10_lock_pending_cleanup_unlink || return 1
    rm -f "$pending" || return 1
    fault_point after_step10_lock_pending_cleanup_unlink || return 1
    if test -n "${DF_REVIEW_LEDGER_LOCK_RELEASE_BARRIER-}"; then
      local barrier="$DF_REVIEW_LEDGER_LOCK_RELEASE_BARRIER" barrier_iteration=1
      (umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$barrier") || return 1
      while { test -e "$lock" || test -L "$lock"; } && \
        test "$barrier_iteration" -le 25; do
        sleep 0.1 || return 1
        barrier_iteration=$((barrier_iteration + 1))
      done
      test ! -e "$lock" || return 1
      test ! -L "$lock" || return 1
      rm -f "$barrier" || return 1
      DF_REVIEW_LEDGER_LOCK_RELEASE_BARRIER=''
    fi
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_lock_disappearance_observation observe
    fault_point before_step10_lock_disappearance_observation || return 1
    if test ! -e "$lock" && test ! -L "$lock"; then
      fault_point after_step10_lock_disappearance_observation || return 1
      sleep 0.01 || return 1
      iteration=$((iteration + 1))
      continue
    fi
    fault_point after_step10_lock_disappearance_observation || return 1
    test -f "$lock" || return 1
    test ! -L "$lock" || return 1
    IFS= read -r owner < "$lock" || return 1
    case "$owner" in *[!0-9]*|'') return 1 ;; esac
    if ! kill -0 "$owner" 2>/dev/null; then
      snapshot="$lock.stale.$$"
      # STEP10_OPERATION step10_stale_lock_arbitration_link link
      fault_point before_step10_stale_lock_arbitration_link || return 1
      if ln "$lock" "$snapshot" 2>/dev/null; then
        fault_point after_step10_stale_lock_arbitration_link || return 1
        if test "$lock" -ef "$snapshot"; then
          # STEP10_OPERATION step10_stale_lock_takeover_unlink unlink
          fault_point before_step10_stale_lock_takeover_unlink || return 1
          rm -f "$lock" || return 1
          fault_point after_step10_stale_lock_takeover_unlink || return 1
        fi
        # STEP10_OPERATION step10_stale_snapshot_cleanup_unlink unlink
        fault_point before_step10_stale_snapshot_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        rm -f "$snapshot" || return 1
        fault_point after_step10_stale_snapshot_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      else
        fault_point after_step10_stale_lock_arbitration_link || return 1
      fi
    fi
    sleep 0.01 || return 1
    iteration=$((iteration + 1))
  done
  return 1
}

release_ledger_lock() {
  test "$#" -eq 0 || return 1
  local owner
  test -f "$LEDGER_LOCK" || return 1
  test ! -L "$LEDGER_LOCK" || return 1
  IFS= read -r owner < "$LEDGER_LOCK" || return 1
  test "$owner" = "$$" || return 1
  # STEP10_OPERATION step10_lock_release release
  fault_point before_step10_lock_release || return 1
  rm -f "$LEDGER_LOCK" || return 1
  fault_point after_step10_lock_release || return 1
  LEDGER_LOCK=''
}

expected_outcomes_ledger_block() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  local outcomes="$1"
  test -f "$outcomes" || return 1
  test ! -L "$outcomes" || return 1
  printf '## DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes\n\n'
  sed -n '/^## Observed statuses$/,$p' "$outcomes"
  printf '\n## END DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes\n'
}

verify_progress_outcomes_ledger() {
  test "$#" -eq 4 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" outcomes="$3" progress="$4"
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id"
  validate_attempt_id "$attempt_id" || return 1
  test -f "$progress" || return 1
  test ! -L "$progress" || return 1
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" 1 || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$attempt_dir/attempt-result.txt" status)" = FINALIZED || return 1
  verify_stable_publication "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" || return 1
  verify_outcomes_ledger "$attempt_dir" "$outcomes" || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^## DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes$' "$progress")" -eq 1 || return 1
  test "$(count_matches '^## END DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes$' "$progress")" -eq 1 || return 1
  sed -n \
    '/^## DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes$/,/^## END DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes$/p' \
    "$progress" | cmp -s - <(expected_outcomes_ledger_block "$outcomes") || return 1
}

wait_step10_commit_barrier() {
  test "$#" -eq 0 || return 1
  test -n "${DF_REVIEW_STEP10_COMMIT_BARRIER-}" || return 0
  local barrier="$DF_REVIEW_STEP10_COMMIT_BARRIER" iteration=1
  test ! -e "$barrier.ready" || return 1
  test ! -L "$barrier.ready" || return 1
  test ! -e "$barrier.release" || return 1
  test ! -L "$barrier.release" || return 1
  # STEP10_OPERATION step10_commit_barrier_ready_write write
  fault_point before_step10_commit_barrier_ready_write || return 1
  (umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$barrier.ready") || return 1
  fault_point after_step10_commit_barrier_ready_write || return 1
  # STEP10_OPERATION step10_commit_barrier_release_observation observe
  fault_point before_step10_commit_barrier_release_observation || return 1
  while test ! -f "$barrier.release" && test "$iteration" -le 25; do
    sleep 0.1 || return 1
    iteration=$((iteration + 1))
  done
  test -f "$barrier.release" || return 1
  test ! -L "$barrier.release" || return 1
  fault_point after_step10_commit_barrier_release_observation || return 1
}

append_progress_entry() {
  test "$#" -eq 2 || return 1
  local progress="$1" content="$2" rc
  test -f "$progress" || return 1
  test ! -L "$progress" || return 1
  test -n "$content" || return 1
  case "$content" in *$'\n'*) return 1 ;; esac
  cleanup_ledger_temporaries "$progress" 00 || return 1
  acquire_ledger_lock "$progress" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$content" >> "$progress" || {
    rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
  }
  release_ledger_lock || return 1
}

append_outcomes_ledger() {
  test "$#" -eq 4 || return 1
  local attempts_root="$1" attempt_id="$2" outcomes="$3" progress="$4"
  local attempt_dir="$attempts_root/$attempt_id" expected pending before_hash current_hash count
  local iteration=1 rc
  validate_attempt_id "$attempt_id" || return 1
  test -f "$outcomes" || return 1
  test ! -L "$outcomes" || return 1
  test -f "$progress" || return 1
  test ! -L "$progress" || return 1
  verify_ordered_history "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" 1 || return 1
  test "$(manifest_field "$attempt_dir/attempt-result.txt" status)" = FINALIZED || return 1
  verify_stable_publication "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" || return 1
  verify_outcomes_ledger "$attempt_dir" "$outcomes" || return 1
  cleanup_ledger_temporaries "$progress" "$attempt_id" || return 1
  expected="$progress.expected.$attempt_id.$$"
  # STEP10_OPERATION step10_expected_ledger_write write
  fault_point before_step10_expected_ledger_write || return 1
  (umask 077; expected_outcomes_ledger_block "$outcomes" > "$expected") || return 1
  fault_point after_step10_expected_ledger_write || return 1
  test -s "$expected" || return 1
  while test "$iteration" -le 25; do
    count="$(count_matches '^## DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes$' "$progress")" || return 1
    if test "$count" -gt 1; then
      rm -f "$expected" || return 1
      cleanup_ledger_temporaries "$progress" "$attempt_id" || return 1
      return 1
    fi
    if test "$count" -eq 1; then
      if ! verify_progress_outcomes_ledger "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" \
        "$outcomes" "$progress"; then
        # STEP10_OPERATION step10_expected_cleanup_unlink unlink
        fault_point before_step10_expected_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        rm -f "$expected" || return 1
        fault_point after_step10_expected_cleanup_unlink || return 1
        cleanup_ledger_temporaries "$progress" "$attempt_id" || return 1
        return 1
      fi
      fault_point before_step10_expected_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      rm -f "$expected" || return 1
      fault_point after_step10_expected_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      cleanup_ledger_temporaries "$progress" "$attempt_id" || return 1
      return 0
    fi
    pending="$progress.pending.$attempt_id.$$"
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_progress_hash_pre hash
    fault_point before_step10_progress_hash_pre || return 1
    before_hash="$(hash_file_value "$progress")" || return 1
    fault_point after_step10_progress_hash_pre || return 1
    acquire_ledger_lock "$progress" || return 1
    count="$(count_matches '^## DF-PROTOCOL-001 Slice 2 observed review outcomes$' "$progress")" || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    if test "$count" -eq 1; then
      release_ledger_lock || return 1
      # STEP10_OPERATION step10_pending_cleanup_unlink unlink
      fault_point before_step10_pending_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      rm -f "$pending" || return 1
      fault_point after_step10_pending_cleanup_unlink || return 1
      iteration=$((iteration + 1))
      continue
    fi
    test "$count" -eq 0 || { release_ledger_lock || return 1; return 1; }
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_progress_hash_post hash
    fault_point before_step10_progress_hash_post || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    current_hash="$(hash_file_value "$progress")" || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    fault_point after_step10_progress_hash_post || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    if test "$current_hash" != "$before_hash"; then
      release_ledger_lock || return 1
      iteration=$((iteration + 1))
      continue
    fi
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_ledger_copy copy
    fault_point before_step10_ledger_copy || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    (umask 077; cp -p "$progress" "$pending") || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    fault_point after_step10_ledger_copy || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    cmp -s "$progress" "$pending" || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_ledger_append_write write
    fault_point before_step10_ledger_append_write || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    {
      printf '\n'
      cat "$expected"
    } >> "$pending" || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    fault_point after_step10_ledger_append_write || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    wait_step10_commit_barrier || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    # STEP10_OPERATION step10_ledger_commit_rename rename-commit
    fault_point before_step10_ledger_commit_rename || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    mv "$pending" "$progress" || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    fault_point after_step10_ledger_commit_rename || {
      rc=$?; release_ledger_lock || return 1; return "$rc";
    }
    release_ledger_lock || return 1
    test -f "$progress" || return 1
    test ! -L "$progress" || return 1
    verify_progress_outcomes_ledger "$attempts_root" "$attempt_id" \
      "$outcomes" "$progress" || return 1
    fault_point before_step10_expected_cleanup_unlink || return 1
    rm -f "$expected" || return 1
    fault_point after_step10_expected_cleanup_unlink || return 1
    cleanup_ledger_temporaries "$progress" "$attempt_id" || return 1
    return 0
  done
  return 1
}

test "$#" -ge 1 || exit 64
command_name="$1"
shift
case "$command_name" in
  fault-inventory) printf '%s\n' "${LIFECYCLE_FAULT_POINTS[@]}" ;;
  verify-hash) verify_hash_record "$@" ;;
  hash-value) hash_value "$@" ;;
  validate) validate_review_report "$@" ;;
  next-id) next_attempt_id "$@" ;;
  claim) claim_attempt "$@" ;;
  verify-claim) verify_claim_manifest "$@" ;;
  outcome) review_outcome "$@" ;;
  first-gate) first_validator_gate "$@" ;;
  whole-gate) whole_slice_gate "$@" ;;
  resume-publication) resume_finalization_publication "$@" ;;
  verify-finalized) verify_finalized_attempt "$@" ;;
  verify-outcomes) verify_outcomes_ledger "$@" ;;
  verify-ledger) verify_progress_outcomes_ledger "$@" ;;
  append-progress) append_progress_entry "$@" ;;
  append-ledger) append_outcomes_ledger "$@" ;;
  *) exit 64 ;;
esac
# END GATE21 REVIEW VALIDATOR
SH
install_fault_point() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  if test "${DF_REVIEW_FAULT_POINT-}" = "$1"; then
    printf 'injected review-validator installation fault: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    return 86
  fi
}
VALIDATOR_PENDING="$REVIEW_VALIDATOR.pending.$$"
VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING="$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH.pending.$$"
if test -e "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH" || test -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH"; then
  test -f "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
  test ! -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
  test -f "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH" || exit 1
  test ! -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH" || exit 1
  cmp -s "$VALIDATOR_CANDIDATE" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
else
  if test -e "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || test -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR"; then
    test -f "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
    test ! -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
    cmp -s "$VALIDATOR_CANDIDATE" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
  else
    install_fault_point before_review_validator_file_copy || exit 1
    install -m 0700 "$VALIDATOR_CANDIDATE" "$VALIDATOR_PENDING" || exit 1
    install_fault_point after_review_validator_file_copy || exit 1
    cmp -s "$VALIDATOR_PENDING" "$VALIDATOR_CANDIDATE" || exit 1
    install_fault_point before_review_validator_file_link || exit 1
    if ! ln "$VALIDATOR_PENDING" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR"; then
      test -f "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
      test ! -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
      cmp -s "$VALIDATOR_CANDIDATE" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" || exit 1
    fi
    install_fault_point after_review_validator_file_link || exit 1
    rm -f "$VALIDATOR_PENDING" || exit 1
  fi
  install_fault_point before_review_validator_hash_compute || exit 1
  VALIDATOR_DIGEST="$(shasum -a 256 "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" | awk '{print $1}')" || exit 1
  install_fault_point after_review_validator_hash_compute || exit 1
  install_fault_point before_review_validator_hash_file || exit 1
  (umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$VALIDATOR_DIGEST" > "$VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING") || exit 1
  install_fault_point after_review_validator_hash_file || exit 1
  test "$(wc -c < "$VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING" | tr -d ' ')" -eq 65 || exit 1
  install_fault_point before_review_validator_hash_link || exit 1
  if ! ln "$VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH"; then
    test -f "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH" || exit 1
    test ! -L "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH" || exit 1
    cmp -s "$VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH" || exit 1
  fi
  install_fault_point after_review_validator_hash_link || exit 1
  rm -f "$VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING" || exit 1
fi
rm -f "$VALIDATOR_CANDIDATE" "$VALIDATOR_PENDING" "$VALIDATOR_HASH_PENDING" || exit 1
for STALE in "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR".pending.* "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH".pending.*; do
  test -e "$STALE" || continue
  test -f "$STALE" || exit 1
  test ! -L "$STALE" || exit 1
  STALE_OWNER="${STALE##*.}"
  case "$STALE_OWNER" in *[!0-9]*|'') exit 1 ;; esac
  if kill -0 "$STALE_OWNER" 2>/dev/null; then
    continue
  fi
  rm -f "$STALE" || exit 1
done
trap - EXIT INT TERM
VALIDATOR_MODE="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" 2>/dev/null || stat -c '%a' "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR")"
test "$VALIDATOR_MODE" = 700 || exit 1
"$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" verify-hash "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH"
```

The install is one-time and fail-closed: later attempts reconstruct the exact
candidate bytes, require `cmp` equality, and verify the original SHA-256. A
missing member of the validator/hash pair or any changed byte blocks every
claim. The validator and its hash are never rewritten after installation.

Claim the deterministic next attempt atomically before either reviewer authors a report:

```bash
REPORTS=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001
ATTEMPTS="$REPORTS/review-attempts"
REVIEW_VALIDATOR="$REPORTS/02-core-model-review-validation.sh"
REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH="$REPORTS/02-core-model-review-validation.sha256"
IMPLEMENTER="$REPORTS/02-core-model-implementer.md"
IMPLEMENTER_HASH="$REPORTS/02-core-model-implementer.sha256"
: "${DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID:?caller must supply the computed next two-digit attempt ID}"
: "${DF_REVIEW_TASK_BASE:?caller must supply the immutable repository/task base SHA}"
: "${DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_HEAD:?caller must supply the implementation head SHA}"
: "${DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_RANGE:?caller must supply the exact base..head range}"
"$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" verify-hash "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH"
"$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" verify-hash "$IMPLEMENTER" "$IMPLEMENTER_HASH"
test "$("$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" next-id "$ATTEMPTS")" = "$DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID"
"$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" claim "$ATTEMPTS" "$DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID" \
  "$DF_REVIEW_TASK_BASE" "$DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_HEAD" \
  "$DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_RANGE" "$IMPLEMENTER" "$IMPLEMENTER_HASH" \
  "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH"
```

The next-ID rule is executable and exclusive: with no attempt directory the
only valid ID is `01`; otherwise every directory name must be the complete,
gap-free sequence `01` through the greatest existing two-digit ID. A blocked,
fully verified greatest attempt advances to its zero-padded successor. A
reserved, claimed, review-frozen, or publication-incomplete greatest attempt
retains the same ID until its exact binding resumes. Fully published
`FINALIZED` is terminal for this Task ID: `next-id` emits the typed
`terminal_finalized` diagnostic and returns `3`, while `claim` rejects. A new
review after finalization requires a new Task ID and a new lifecycle; no prior
stable authority path is deleted, overwritten, or silently versioned.
Malformed names, symlinks, gaps, duplicate logical IDs, stale IDs, a
caller-supplied ID that differs from the computed value, an unverifiable closed
predecessor, conflicting bindings, or exhaustion after closed attempt `99`
fails closed.

| Greatest state | `next-id` | Exact same-binding `claim` | Authority/result |
|---|---|---|---|
| empty | `01`, exit 0 | claims `01` | reservation and claim become immutable |
| reserved only | same ID, exit 0 | completes the exact reservation; conflict rejects | non-terminal, non-authoritative |
| claimed/incomplete | same ID, exit 0 | exact retry resumes; conflict rejects | non-terminal, no successor |
| `BLOCKED_FIRST_REVIEW` | successor, exit 0 | successor claim succeeds | predecessor remains immutable |
| `BLOCKED_WHOLE_SLICE` | successor, exit 0 | successor claim succeeds | predecessor remains immutable |
| publication-incomplete `FINALIZED` | same ID, exit 0 | exact retry only; `resume-publication` completes aliases | no stable authority until marker identity verifies |
| fully published `FINALIZED` | `terminal_finalized`, exit 3 | rejects | terminal for this Task ID |

The executable transition matrix covers every row before and after blocked
closure, gap and malformed inventories, stale IDs, `99` exhaustion,
same-ID conflicting bindings, and concurrent exact/conflicting claimants. For
every zero-status `next-id`, it immediately executes the exact matching claim
and requires success. For every terminal state, both allocation and claim must
reject coherently.

The immutable `review-claim-reservations/<NN>.binding` and sibling digest are
atomically committed before the attempt directory. Concurrent callers with the
exact same binding converge; a conflicting task base, head/range, implementer,
validator, predecessor terminal hash, or history root cannot take over the ID.
Every later claim transition is an idempotent create-if-absent operation that
verifies pre-existing bytes, so interruption leaves visible evidence and the
same exact caller can resume without deletion, overwrite, or ID reuse. No
successor is authorized until that attempt closes and verifies.

compare-and-swap. Every plan-authorized writer of `.superpowers/sdd/progress.md`
uses the same finite PID-owned hard-link lock contract. Step 10 observes the
progress hash before and after lock acquisition, retries if another authorized

start/end outcomes block, and renames while retaining the lock. The lock makes
the final comparison and commit indivisible with respect to every authorized
writer in this plan. The source guard rejects any sibling progress write that
bypasses this contract.

Exact concurrent appenders converge on one byte-identical bounded block;
unrelated progress content may appear before or after it without becoming
review authority. A deterministic final-comparison/commit barrier starts an
authorized sibling writer and proves that both operations succeed without
lost bytes. Conflicting block content fails closed. Lock acquisition and the
barrier are each bounded to 25 iterations, success stops immediately, and the
same validation failure twice or exhausted acquisition escalates nonzero.
Every successful resume removes dead/current pending, expected, and lock
artifacts, while live-owned files remain untouched. Exact `verify-ledger`
revalidates finalized attempt/stable-marker identity, outcomes, both block
delimiters, and every byte inside the bounded block; no dashboard, detached
status, vote, or trailing progress prose can become evidence authority.

Reverify the finalized attempt binding and the implementer, specification,

No detached dashboard,
status, vote, duplicated/missing/invented ledger block, unrelated progress

```bash
set -euo pipefail
REVIEW_VALIDATOR=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-review-validation.sh
REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-review-validation.sha256

TECH=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-technical-review.md
TECH_HASH=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-technical-review.sha256
WHOLE=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.md
WHOLE_HASH=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-whole-slice-review.sha256
FINALIZED=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest
FINALIZED_HASH=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-finalized-evidence.manifest.sha256
OUTCOMES=.superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-review-outcomes.md
PROGRESS=.superpowers/sdd/progress.md
PLAN=docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-16-df-protocol-001-02-core-protocol-receipt-model.md
: "${DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID:?caller must supply the finalized two-digit attempt ID}"
: "${DF_REVIEW_TASK_BASE:?caller must supply the finalized repository/task base SHA}"
: "${DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_HEAD:?caller must supply the finalized implementation head SHA}"
: "${DF_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION_RANGE:?caller must supply the finalized base..head range}"
ATTEMPT="$ATTEMPTS/$DF_REVIEW_ATTEMPT_ID"
STEP12_LOCK="$PROGRESS.append-lock"
STEP12_LOCK_PENDING="$STEP12_LOCK.pending.$$"
STEP12_LOCK_HELD=0
step12_acquire_progress_lock() {
  local owner snapshot iteration=1
  while test "$iteration" -le 25; do
    (umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$STEP12_LOCK_PENDING") || return 1
    if ln "$STEP12_LOCK_PENDING" "$STEP12_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
      rm -f "$STEP12_LOCK_PENDING" || return 1
      STEP12_LOCK_HELD=1
      return 0
    fi
    rm -f "$STEP12_LOCK_PENDING" || return 1
    if test ! -e "$STEP12_LOCK" && test ! -L "$STEP12_LOCK"; then
      sleep 0.01 || return 1
      iteration=$((iteration + 1))
      continue
    fi
    test -f "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
    test ! -L "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
    IFS= read -r owner < "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
    case "$owner" in *[!0-9]*|'') return 1 ;; esac
    if ! kill -0 "$owner" 2>/dev/null; then
      snapshot="$STEP12_LOCK.stale.$$"
      if ln "$STEP12_LOCK" "$snapshot" 2>/dev/null; then
        if test "$STEP12_LOCK" -ef "$snapshot"; then
          rm -f "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
        fi
        rm -f "$snapshot" || return 1
      fi
    fi
    sleep 0.01 || return 1
    iteration=$((iteration + 1))
  done
  return 1
}
step12_release_progress_lock() {
  local owner
  test "$STEP12_LOCK_HELD" -eq 1 || return 1
  test -f "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
  test ! -L "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
  IFS= read -r owner < "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
  test "$owner" = "$$" || return 1
  rm -f "$STEP12_LOCK" || return 1
  STEP12_LOCK_HELD=0
}
step12_cleanup() {
  local status=$?
  if test "$STEP12_LOCK_HELD" -eq 1; then
    step12_release_progress_lock || status=1
  fi
  if test "$status" -ne 0; then
    git reset --quiet HEAD -- || status=1
  fi
  rm -f "$STEP12_LOCK_PENDING" "$STEP12_LOCK.stale.$$" || status=1
  return "$status"
}
step12_barrier() {
  test "$#" -eq 1 || return 1
  test -n "${DF_REVIEW_STEP12_BARRIER-}" || return 0
  test "${DF_REVIEW_STEP12_BARRIER_POINT-}" = "$1" || return 0
  local barrier="$DF_REVIEW_STEP12_BARRIER" iteration=1
  (umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$barrier.$1.ready") || return 1
  while test ! -f "$barrier.$1.release" && test "$iteration" -le 25; do
    sleep 0.1 || return 1
    iteration=$((iteration + 1))
  done
  test -f "$barrier.$1.release" || return 1
  test ! -L "$barrier.$1.release" || return 1
}
test -z "$(git diff --cached --name-only)"
git show "HEAD:$PLAN" | cmp -s - "$PLAN"
PLAN_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 "$PLAN" | awk '{print $1}')"
step12_acquire_progress_lock
trap step12_cleanup EXIT INT TERM
"$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" verify-hash "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" "$REVIEW_VALIDATOR_HASH"
"$REVIEW_VALIDATOR" verify-hash \
  .superpowers/sdd/reports/df-protocol-001/02-core-model-implementer.md \
  "$IMPLEMENTER_HASH"
```
