### Exact disposable real-workspace materialization, gate replay, and 23+2 parity validator

The command below is the sole disposable validator for this plan. It starts
from an exact `HEAD` archive, preserves the real workspace manifests, crate
root, lint policy, pre-existing modules, exo-core owner, and committed compare
scripts, and copies this reviewed plan into the archive for the Gate-20
self-guard. The materializer has a one-to-one owner ledger: every emitted
behavior fragment is assigned to its declared focused owner; duplicate,
unused, relocated, placeholder, or comment-only owners abort before Cargo is
invoked. The final assembly and every replay checkout remain under the trap.

```bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
PLAN="$ROOT/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-16-df-protocol-001-02-core-protocol-receipt-model.md"
ASSEMBLY="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-assembly.XXXXXX)"
TARGET="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-target.XXXXXX)"
PARITY="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-parity.XXXXXX)"
W19_EVIDENCE_DIR="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-evidence.XXXXXX)"
STATUS_BEFORE="$(mktemp /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-before.XXXXXX)"
STATUS_AFTER="$(mktemp /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-after.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$ASSEMBLY" "$TARGET" "$PARITY" "$W19_EVIDENCE_DIR"; rm -f "$STATUS_BEFORE" "$STATUS_AFTER"' EXIT

FROZEN_PLAN_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 "$PLAN" | awk '{print $1}')"
OWNER_MANIFEST_SHA256='UNMATERIALIZED'
AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST_FILE="$W19_EVIDENCE_DIR/author-command-digests.tsv"
W19_FAILURE_SIGNATURE_FILE="$W19_EVIDENCE_DIR/failure-signatures.tsv"
: > "$AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST_FILE"
: > "$W19_FAILURE_SIGNATURE_FILE"
AUTHOR_GATE_COUNT=0
LAST_AUTHOR_LOG=''
LAST_AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST=''

run_author_gate() {
  local gate="$1"
  local category="$2"
  local owner_path="$3"
  local symbol="$4"
  shift 4
  local command_digest output_log started_at ended_at started_ns ended_ns
  local elapsed_ns exit_status output_log_sha256 diagnostic_id failure_signature
  local first_gate failure_occurrence
  command_digest="$(python3 - \
    "$FROZEN_PLAN_SHA256" "$OWNER_MANIFEST_SHA256" "$PWD" \
    "${CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL+x}" "${CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL-}" \
    "${RUSTFLAGS+x}" "${RUSTFLAGS-}" \
    "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR+x}" "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR-}" \
    "${DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH+x}" "${DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH-}" \
    "$@" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import sys

record = {
    "frozen_plan_sha256": sys.argv[1],
    "materialized_owner_manifest_sha256": sys.argv[2],
    "cwd": sys.argv[3],
    "environment": {
        "CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL": [sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]],
        "RUSTFLAGS": [sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7]],
        "CARGO_TARGET_DIR": [sys.argv[8], sys.argv[9]],
        "DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH": [sys.argv[10], sys.argv[11]],
    },
    "argv": sys.argv[12:],
}
canonical = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
print(hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest())
PY
  )"
  if rg -q "^${command_digest}[[:space:]]" "$AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST_FILE"; then
    first_gate="$(awk -v digest="$command_digest" '$1 == digest { print $2; exit }' \
      "$AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST_FILE")"
    printf 'duplicate author command digest %s: first=%s duplicate=%s\n' \
      "$command_digest" "$first_gate" "$gate" >&2
    return 97
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$command_digest" "$gate" >> "$AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST_FILE"
  AUTHOR_GATE_COUNT=$((AUTHOR_GATE_COUNT + 1))
  output_log="$W19_EVIDENCE_DIR/$(printf '%03d' "$AUTHOR_GATE_COUNT")-${gate}-${command_digest}.log"
  started_at="$(python3 -c 'from datetime import datetime, timezone; print(datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds"))')"
  started_ns="$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())')"
  set +e
  "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$output_log"
  exit_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
  set -e
  ended_ns="$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())')"
  ended_at="$(python3 -c 'from datetime import datetime, timezone; print(datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds"))')"
  elapsed_ns=$((ended_ns - started_ns))
  output_log_sha256="$(shasum -a 256 "$output_log" | awk '{print $1}')"
  printf 'author_gate=%s category=%s owner=%s symbol=%s started_at=%s ended_at=%s elapsed_ns=%s exit=%s command_digest=%s frozen_plan_sha256=%s materialized_owner_manifest_sha256=%s output_log_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$gate" "$category" "$owner_path" "$symbol" "$started_at" "$ended_at" \
    "$elapsed_ns" "$exit_status" "$command_digest" "$FROZEN_PLAN_SHA256" \
    "$OWNER_MANIFEST_SHA256" "$output_log_sha256"
  LAST_AUTHOR_LOG="$output_log"
  LAST_AUTHOR_COMMAND_DIGEST="$command_digest"
  if test "$exit_status" -ne 0; then
    diagnostic_id="$(rg -m1 -o \
      'error\[E[0-9]+\]|error TS[0-9]+|FAILED|panicked at|test result: FAILED|error: [^[:cntrl:]]+' \
      "$output_log" || true)"
    test -n "$diagnostic_id" || diagnostic_id="exit-${exit_status}"
    failure_signature="$(printf '%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n' \
      "$gate" "$command_digest" "$diagnostic_id" "$owner_path::$symbol" \
      | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')"
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$failure_signature" "$category" "$gate" \
      >> "$W19_FAILURE_SIGNATURE_FILE"
    failure_occurrence="$(awk -v signature="$failure_signature" \
      '$1 == signature { count += 1 } END { print count + 0 }' \
      "$W19_FAILURE_SIGNATURE_FILE")"
    printf 'failure_signature=%s diagnostic_id=%s occurrence=%s\n' \
      "$failure_signature" "$diagnostic_id" \
      "$failure_occurrence" >&2
    if test "$failure_occurrence" -ge 2; then
      printf 'second identical signature; stop before a third execution\n' >&2
    fi
  fi
  return "$exit_status"
}

git -C "$ROOT" archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -xf - -C "$ASSEMBLY"
mkdir -p "$ASSEMBLY/docs/superpowers/plans"
cp "$PLAN" "$ASSEMBLY/docs/superpowers/plans/$(basename "$PLAN")"

python3 - "$PLAN" "$ASSEMBLY" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import textwrap

plan = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
root = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
text = plan.read_text()
rust = re.findall(r"^```rust\n(.*?)^```$", text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
json_blocks = re.findall(r"^```json\n(.*?)^```$", text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
typescript = re.findall(r"^```typescript\n(.*?)^```$", text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
bash_blocks = re.findall(r"^```bash\n(.*?)^```$", text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
wave18_delta_match = re.search(
    r"<!-- DF_WAVE18_LITERAL_AUTHORITATIVE_DELTA -->\n\n```jsonc\n(.*?)^```$",
    text,
    re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL,
)
if wave18_delta_match is None:
    raise SystemExit("missing Wave 18 authoritative delta literal")
wave18_delta = wave18_delta_match.group(1)
if (len(rust), len(json_blocks), len(typescript)) != (67, 7, 6):
    raise SystemExit(
        f"literal fence inventory drift: rust={len(rust)} json={len(json_blocks)} "
        f"typescript={len(typescript)}"
    )

crate = root / "crates/decision-forum"
ledger: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

def emit(relative: str, body: str, fragment: str) -> None:
    if not body.strip() or not any(token in body for token in ("{", "mod ", "pub use ")):
        raise SystemExit(f"empty or comment-only owner: {relative}")
    target = crate / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target in [Path(value) for paths in ledger.values() for value in paths]:
        raise SystemExit(f"duplicate owner emission: {relative}")
    target.write_text(body.rstrip() + "\n")
    ledger.setdefault(fragment, []).append(str(target))

def emit_root(relative: str, body: str, fragment: str) -> None:
    target = root / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(body.rstrip() + "\n")
    ledger.setdefault(fragment, []).append(str(target))

def line_start(body: str, token: str) -> int:
    offset = body.index(token)
    start = body.rfind("\n", 0, offset) + 1
    lines = body[:start].splitlines(keepends=True)
    while lines and (not lines[-1].strip() or lines[-1].lstrip().startswith(("#[", "///"))):
        start -= len(lines.pop())
    return start

def span(body: str, start: str, end: str | None = None) -> str:
    left = line_start(body, start)
    right = line_start(body, end) if end is not None else len(body)
    return body[left:right].strip() + "\n"

def item(body: str, token: str) -> str:
    start = line_start(body, token)
    brace = body.find("{", body.index(token))
    semi = body.find(";", body.index(token))
    declaration_line_end = body.find("\n", body.index(token))
    body_item = "fn " in token or token.startswith(("impl ", "macro_rules!"))
    if not body_item and semi >= 0 and (brace < 0 or brace > declaration_line_end):
        return body[start:semi + 1].strip() + "\n"
    if brace < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"unclosed Rust item: {token}")
    depth = 0
    for index in range(brace, len(body)):
        if body[index] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif body[index] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return body[start:index + 1].strip() + "\n"
    raise SystemExit(f"unclosed Rust item: {token}")

def without(body: str, fragment: str) -> str:
    if body.count(fragment) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("behavior fragment is not consumed exactly once")
    return body.replace(fragment, "", 1)

def owner_fragments(body: str, owner: str, include_initial: bool = False) -> str:
    pattern = re.compile(
        rf"// BEGIN OWNER: {re.escape(owner)} (?P<label>[^\n]+)\n"
        r"(?P<body>.*?)// END OWNER",
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    fragments = []
    for match in pattern.finditer(body):
        label = match.group("label")
        if "INITIAL" in label and not include_initial:
            continue
        if "REPLACEMENT" in label and include_initial:
            continue
        fragments.append(match.group("body").strip())
    if not fragments:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing owner fragments: {owner}")
    return "\n\n".join(fragments) + "\n"

# Preserve the real crate and workspace. Apply only the reviewed dependency move.
cargo = (crate / "Cargo.toml").read_text()
cargo = cargo.replace("serde_json = { workspace = true }\n", "", 1)
dependency_anchor = "serde = { workspace = true }\n"
dependency_insert = (
    dependency_anchor
    + "ciborium = { workspace = true }\n"
    + "serde_json = { workspace = true }\n"
    + 'serde_path_to_error = "=0.1.20"\n'
)
if cargo.count(dependency_anchor) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("Decision Forum dependency anchor drift")
(crate / "Cargo.toml").write_text(cargo.replace(dependency_anchor, dependency_insert, 1))
lib = (crate / "src/lib.rs").read_text()
if "pub mod protocol;" in lib:
    raise SystemExit("protocol module unexpectedly present at reviewed HEAD")
(crate / "src/lib.rs").write_text(lib.rstrip() + "\n\npub mod protocol;\n")

protocol_mod = rust[16].split("mod codec;", 1)[0] + '''mod codec;
mod commitment;
mod domains;
mod error;
mod lifecycle;
mod receipt;
mod trust;
mod types;
mod validation;
#[cfg(test)]

pub use codec::*;
pub use commitment::*;
pub use domains::*;
pub use error::ProtocolError;
pub use lifecycle::*;
pub use receipt::*;
pub use trust::{
    ForbiddenCurrentGenesisRootsV1, VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1, VerifiedGenesisAdoptionV1,
    VerifiedGenesisIssuerAuthorityV1, VerifiedHistoricalArtifactV1,
    VerifiedHistoricalReviewRevealV1, VerifiedPackageTrustRegistryV1,
    VerifiedSeatAuthorityRegistryV1, verify_genesis_adoption_receipt_semantics,
};

# Build literal per-gate RED and GREEN overlays. These are not a synthetic
# mini-crate: the replay below applies them, in order, to fresh commits made
# from the same exact HEAD archive as the final assembly.
python3 - "$PLAN" "$ASSEMBLY" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import sys
import textwrap

plan = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
root = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
text = plan.read_text()
rust = re.findall(r"^```rust\n(.*?)^```$", text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
json_blocks = re.findall(r"^```json\n(.*?)^```$", text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
wave18_delta_match = re.search(
    r"<!-- DF_WAVE18_LITERAL_AUTHORITATIVE_DELTA -->\n\n```jsonc\n(.*?)^```$",
    text,
    re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL,
)
if wave18_delta_match is None:
    raise SystemExit("missing Wave 18 authoritative delta literal")
wave18_delta = wave18_delta_match.group(1)
if len(rust) != 67:
    raise SystemExit(f"replay Rust fence inventory drift: {len(rust)}")

payload = root / "replay-payload"
if payload.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(payload)
payload.mkdir()
crate_prefix = "crates/decision-forum/"
crate = root / crate_prefix

def read(relative: str) -> str:
    return (root / relative).read_text()

def line_start(body: str, token: str) -> int:
    offset = body.index(token)
    start = body.rfind("\n", 0, offset) + 1
    lines = body[:start].splitlines(keepends=True)
    while lines and (not lines[-1].strip() or lines[-1].lstrip().startswith(("#[", "///"))):
        start -= len(lines.pop())
    return start

def span(body: str, start: str, end: str | None = None) -> str:
    left = line_start(body, start)
    right = line_start(body, end) if end is not None else len(body)
    return body[left:right].strip() + "\n"

def item(body: str, token: str) -> str:
    start = line_start(body, token)
    item_offset = body.index(token)
    brace = body.find("{", item_offset)
    semi = body.find(";", item_offset)
    declaration_line_end = body.find("\n", item_offset)
    body_item = "fn " in token or token.startswith(("impl ", "macro_rules!"))
    if not body_item and semi >= 0 and (brace < 0 or brace > declaration_line_end):
        return body[start:semi + 1].strip() + "\n"
    if brace < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"unclosed Rust replay item: {token}")
    depth = 0
    for index in range(brace, len(body)):
        if body[index] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif body[index] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return body[start:index + 1].strip() + "\n"
    raise SystemExit(f"unclosed Rust replay item: {token}")

def rust_item(body: str, name: str) -> str:
    return item(body, f"fn {name}")

def without(body: str, fragment: str) -> str:
    if body.count(fragment) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("replay fragment is not consumed exactly once")
    return body.replace(fragment, "", 1)

def owner_fragments(body: str, owner: str, include_initial: bool = False) -> str:
    pattern = re.compile(
        rf"// BEGIN OWNER: {re.escape(owner)} (?P<label>[^\n]+)\n"
        r"(?P<body>.*?)// END OWNER",
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    fragments = []
    for match in pattern.finditer(body):
        label = match.group("label")
        if "INITIAL" in label and not include_initial:
            continue
        if "REPLACEMENT" in label and include_initial:
            continue
        fragments.append(match.group("body").strip())
    if not fragments:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing replay owner fragments: {owner}")
    return "\n\n".join(fragments) + "\n"

def write_overlay(gate: str, kind: str, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    directory = payload / gate / kind
    for relative, body in files.items():
        target = directory / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(body.rstrip() + "\n")

def manifest_paths(gate: str) -> list[str]:
    line = next(
        line for line in text.splitlines()
        if line.startswith(f"| {gate} |") and len(line.split("|")) == 8
    )
    columns = [column.strip() for column in line.split("|")]
    field = columns[5].strip("`")
    field = field.replace(" [Cargo.lock only when changed]", "")
    return field.split()

def register(
    gate: str,
    red: dict[str, str],
    green: dict[str, str],
    target: str,
    test_name: str,
    test_file: str,
) -> None:
    expected = manifest_paths(gate)
    if set(expected) != set(green):
        missing = sorted(set(expected) - set(green))
        extra = sorted(set(green) - set(expected))
        raise SystemExit(f"Gate {gate} overlay/manifest drift missing={missing} extra={extra}")
    if test_file not in red:
        raise SystemExit(f"Gate {gate} RED omits selected test owner {test_file}")
    write_overlay(gate, "red", red)
    write_overlay(gate, "green", green)
    metadata = payload / gate / "metadata"
    metadata.write_text(
        f"GATE_TARGET={target}\nTEST_NAME={test_name}\nTEST_FILE={test_file}\n"
        + "REQUIRED=" + shlex.quote(" ".join(expected)) + "\n"
    )

def protocol_mod(gate: int) -> str:
    modules = ["mod codec;", "mod error;"]
    if gate >= 3:
        modules.append("mod types;")
    if gate >= 6:
        modules.extend(["#[cfg(test)]", "mod test_fixtures;"])
    if gate >= 8:
        modules.extend(["mod domains;", "mod validation;"])
    if gate >= 9:
        modules.append("mod commitment;")
    if gate >= 10:
        modules.append("mod trust;")
    if gate >= 14:
        modules.append("mod lifecycle;")
    if gate >= 15:
        modules.append("mod receipt;")
    if gate >= 18:
        modules.extend(["#[cfg(test)]", "mod cross_impl_tests;"])
    exports = ["pub use codec::*;", "pub use error::ProtocolError;"]
    if gate >= 3:
        exports.append("pub use types::*;")
    if gate >= 8:
        exports.extend([
            "pub use domains::*;",
            "pub use validation::{validate_monitoring_plan, validate_protocol_structure};",
        ])
    if gate >= 9:
        exports.append("pub use commitment::*;")
    if gate >= 10:
        exports.append(
            "pub use trust::{VerifiedAuthorityRegistryV1, VerifiedPackageTrustRegistryV1, "
            "VerifiedSeatAuthorityRegistryV1};"
        )
    if gate >= 14:
        exports.append("pub use lifecycle::*;")
    if gate >= 15:
        exports.append("pub use receipt::*;")
    return protocol_header + "\n".join(modules) + "\n\n" + "\n".join(exports) + "\n"

final_codec = read(crate_prefix + "src/protocol/codec/mod.rs")
codec_header = final_codec[: final_codec.index("mod cbor;")]
def codec_mod(gate: int) -> str:
    modules = ["mod cbor;", "mod fixed_bytes;"]
    exports = ["pub use cbor::*;", "pub use fixed_bytes::*;"]
    if gate >= 2:
        modules.append("mod uuid_hlc;")
        exports.append("pub use uuid_hlc::*;")
    if gate >= 3:
        modules.append("pub(crate) mod strict_set;")
    if gate >= 7:
        modules.append("mod json;")
        exports.extend(["pub use json::*;"])
    return codec_header + "\n".join(modules) + "\n" + "\n".join(exports) + "\n"

def commitment_mod(gate: int) -> str:
    names = ["identity", "projections"]
    if gate >= 11:
        names.append("package")
    if gate >= 12:
        names.append("events")
    header = commitment_header
    if gate < 11:
        header = header.replace("    trust::VerifiedPackageTrustRegistryV1,\n", "", 1)
    body = header + "".join(f"mod {name};\n" for name in names)
    body += "pub(crate) use identity::eligible_set_commitment;\n"
    body += "use identity::verify_package_self_consistency;\n"
    body += "pub use identity::protocol_version_hash;\npub use projections::*;\n"
    if gate >= 11:
        body += "pub use package::*;\n"
    if gate >= 12:
        body += "pub use events::*;\n"
    return body

FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL="${CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL-}"
FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS-}"
FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL_SET="${CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL+x}"
FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS_SET="${RUSTFLAGS+x}"
export CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL=1
export RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings'

# Formatting is the last materialization operation. Freeze the exact formatted
# owner ledger before the clean compile and Clippy prerequisites; no later step
# may edit the assembly.
(
  cd "$ASSEMBLY"
  cargo +nightly fmt --all
  cargo +nightly fmt --all -- --check
)
test -s "$ASSEMBLY/owner-consumption.tsv"
OWNER_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 "$ASSEMBLY/owner-consumption.tsv" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$FROZEN_PLAN_SHA256" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$PLAN" | awk '{print $1}')"

# W19_FAIL_FAST_BEGIN: both commands use the clean optimized target and the
# final formatted materialization. They are prerequisites for any exhaustive
# predecessor replay and also satisfy the retained final compilation/Clippy
# contracts because the frozen assembly is immutable after this point.
prior_pwd="$PWD"
cd "$ASSEMBLY"
run_author_gate \
  'fail-fast-all-target-no-run' 'rust-compile' \
  'crates/decision-forum' 'all-targets-no-run' \
  env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/optimized" \
  cargo test -p exochain-decision-forum --all-targets --no-run
run_author_gate \
  'fail-fast-warnings-denied-clippy' 'rust-clippy' \
  'crates/decision-forum' 'all-targets-clippy' \
  env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/optimized" \
  cargo clippy -p exochain-decision-forum --all-targets -- -D warnings
cd "$prior_pwd"
# W19_FAIL_FAST_END
if test "${DF_W19_FAIL_FAST_ONLY:-0}" = 1; then
  printf '__DF_W19_FAIL_FAST_ONLY__=PASS frozen_plan_sha256=%s materialized_owner_manifest_sha256=%s\n' \
    "$FROZEN_PLAN_SHA256" "$OWNER_MANIFEST_SHA256"
  exit 0
fi

# Genuine sequential predecessor replay. A RED overlay contains the selected
# test and only the reachability plumbing needed for an internal unit-test
# owner. GREEN then installs exactly the gate manifest's owners. The index
# assertion rejects an unchanged required owner and any unlisted staged path.
REPLAY="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-slice-2-replay.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$ASSEMBLY" "$TARGET" "$PARITY" "$REPLAY" "$W19_EVIDENCE_DIR"; rm -f "$STATUS_BEFORE" "$STATUS_AFTER"' EXIT
git -C "$ROOT" archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -xf - -C "$REPLAY"
git -C "$REPLAY" init -q
git -C "$REPLAY" config user.name "DF Protocol Replay"
git -C "$REPLAY" config user.email "df-protocol-replay@example.invalid"
git -C "$REPLAY" add -A
git -C "$REPLAY" commit -qm "replay: exact slice-1 base"
REPLAY_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS-}"
REPLAY_PRIOR_PLAN_PATH="${DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH-}"
REPLAY_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL="${CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL-}"
export RUSTFLAGS='-Awarnings'
export DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH="$PLAN"
export CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL=1

# Every RED/GREEN overlay is copied and then touched before Cargo runs, so
# Cargo invalidates the changed owners while retaining the unchanged compiled
# dependency graph. Every selected test and affected suite still executes.
for gate in $(seq -w 1 20); do
  metadata="$ASSEMBLY/replay-payload/$gate/metadata"
  test -s "$metadata"
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$metadata"
  red_dir="$ASSEMBLY/replay-payload/$gate/red"
  green_dir="$ASSEMBLY/replay-payload/$gate/green"
  test -d "$red_dir"
  test -d "$green_dir"
  replay_dirty="$(git -C "$REPLAY" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
  if test -n "$replay_dirty"; then
    printf 'Gate %s predecessor tree is dirty:\n%s\n' "$gate" "$replay_dirty" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  base_commit="$(git -C "$REPLAY" rev-parse HEAD)"
  base_tree="$(git -C "$REPLAY" rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"

  (cd "$red_dir" && find . -type f -print0 | tar --null -T - -cf -) | tar -xf - -C "$REPLAY"
  find "$red_dir" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' owner; do
    touch "$REPLAY/${owner#"$red_dir"/}"
  done
  test -s "$REPLAY/$TEST_FILE"
  test_symbol="${TEST_NAME##*::}"
  case "$GATE_TARGET" in
    node) test_pattern="test('${test_symbol}'" ;;
    *) test_pattern="fn ${test_symbol}(" ;;
  esac
  rg -n -F "$test_pattern" "$REPLAY/$TEST_FILE"
  if git -C "$REPLAY" ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$TEST_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    test -n "$(git -C "$REPLAY" diff -- "$TEST_FILE")"
    git -C "$REPLAY" diff -- "$TEST_FILE" | rg -n -F "$test_pattern"
  else
    test "$(git -C "$REPLAY" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all -- "$TEST_FILE")" = "?? $TEST_FILE"
    rg -n -F "$test_pattern" "$REPLAY/$TEST_FILE"
  fi

  red_log="$(mktemp /private/tmp/df-protocol-001-gate-${gate}-red.XXXXXX)"
  set +e
  case "$GATE_TARGET" in
    lib)
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --lib "$test_symbol" -- --exact --nocapture >"$red_log" 2>&1
      ;;
    integration:*)
      integration="${GATE_TARGET#integration:}"
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration" "$test_symbol" \
        -- --exact --nocapture >"$red_log" 2>&1
      ;;
    node)
      (cd "$REPLAY/tools/cross-impl-test" && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck && npm test) \
        >"$red_log" 2>&1
      ;;
  esac
  red_status=$?
  set -e
  if test "$red_status" -eq 0; then
    echo "Gate $gate RED unexpectedly passed" >&2
    sed -n '1,160p' "$red_log" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  test -s "$red_log"
  printf 'Gate %s RED base=%s tree=%s status=%s: ' \
    "$gate" "$base_commit" "$base_tree" "$red_status"
  rg -m1 'error\[E[0-9]+\]|error TS[0-9]+:|error:|FAILED|panicked|not found|Cannot find' "$red_log"
  rm -f "$red_log"

  (cd "$green_dir" && find . -type f -print0 | tar --null -T - -cf -) | tar -xf - -C "$REPLAY"
  find "$green_dir" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' owner; do
    touch "$REPLAY/${owner#"$green_dir"/}"
  done
  case "$GATE_TARGET" in
    lib)
      if ! list="$(CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --lib -- --list 2>&1)"; then
        printf '%s\n' "$list" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      full_name="$(printf '%s\n' "$list" | rg "(^|::)${test_symbol}: test$" | sed 's/: test$//')"
      test "$(printf '%s\n' "$full_name" | rg -c "(^|::)${test_symbol}$")" -eq 1
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --lib "$full_name" -- --exact --nocapture
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --lib
      ;;
    integration:*)
      integration="${GATE_TARGET#integration:}"
      if ! list="$(CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration" -- --list 2>&1)"; then
        printf '%s\n' "$list" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      if ! printf '%s\n' "$list" | rg -q "^${test_symbol}: test$"; then
        printf 'Gate %s GREEN list omitted %s:\n%s\n' "$gate" "$test_symbol" "$list" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      test "$(printf '%s\n' "$list" | rg -c "^${test_symbol}: test$")" -eq 1
      if test "$gate" = 20; then
        run_author_gate \
          'replay-gate-20-focused-green' 'source-guard' "$TEST_FILE" "$test_symbol" \
          env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" \
          cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
          -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration" \
          "$test_symbol" -- --exact --nocapture
      else
        CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
          -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration" "$test_symbol" -- --exact --nocapture
      fi
      # Gate 20's focused GREEN is retained. Its immediate full source-guard
      # suite is the same final owner/test inventory proved once by the later
      # optimized all-target run, so only this mechanically proven repeat is
      # deferred. Every earlier integration gate keeps its evolving-input suite.
      if test "$gate" != 20; then
        CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/replay" cargo test --manifest-path "$REPLAY/Cargo.toml" \
          -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration"
      fi
      ;;
    node)
      (cd "$REPLAY/tools/cross-impl-test" && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck && npm test && rm -rf dist)
      ;;
  esac

  git -C "$REPLAY" add -- $REQUIRED
  if test "$gate" = 01 && ! git -C "$REPLAY" diff --quiet -- Cargo.lock; then
    git -C "$REPLAY" add -- Cargo.lock
  fi
  actual_staged="$(git -C "$REPLAY" diff --cached --name-only | LC_ALL=C sort)"
  expected_staged="$(printf '%s\n' $REQUIRED | LC_ALL=C sort)"
  if test "$gate" = 01 && git -C "$REPLAY" diff --cached --name-only -- Cargo.lock | rg -q '^Cargo.lock$'; then
    expected_staged="$(printf '%s\nCargo.lock\n' "$expected_staged" | LC_ALL=C sort)"
  fi
  diff -u <(printf '%s\n' "$expected_staged") <(printf '%s\n' "$actual_staged")
  git -C "$REPLAY" diff --cached --check
  unexpected_worktree="$(
    git -C "$REPLAY" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all \
      | rg -v '^(M |A |D |R )' || true
  )"
  if test -n "$unexpected_worktree"; then
    printf 'Gate %s has unlisted or unstaged paths after GREEN:\n%s\n' \
      "$gate" "$unexpected_worktree" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  git -C "$REPLAY" commit -qm "replay: Gate $gate GREEN"
  replay_dirty="$(git -C "$REPLAY" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
  if test -n "$replay_dirty"; then
    printf 'Gate %s commit left a dirty tree:\n%s\n' "$gate" "$replay_dirty" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if test -n "$REPLAY_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS"; then
  export RUSTFLAGS="$REPLAY_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS"
else
  unset RUSTFLAGS
fi
if test -n "$REPLAY_PRIOR_PLAN_PATH"; then
  export DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH="$REPLAY_PRIOR_PLAN_PATH"
else
  unset DF_PROTOCOL_001_PLAN_PATH
fi
if test -n "$REPLAY_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL"; then
  export CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL="$REPLAY_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL"
else
  unset CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL
fi

# Exact final real-workspace inventory and runtime. The clean no-run and Clippy
# prerequisites already compiled this immutable assembly in the same optimized
# target. This section executes the complete touched-crate inventory exactly
# once and retains its list/output logs for the selected-test union proof.
export CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL=1
export RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings'
prior_pwd="$PWD"
cd "$ASSEMBLY"
run_author_gate \
  'final-all-target-manifest' 'rust-test-inventory' \
  'crates/decision-forum' 'all-targets-list' \
  env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/optimized" \
  cargo test -p exochain-decision-forum --all-targets -- --list
FINAL_ALL_TARGET_MANIFEST_LOG="$LAST_AUTHOR_LOG"
run_author_gate \
  'final-optimized-all-target-runtime' 'rust-test-runtime' \
  'crates/decision-forum' 'all-targets' \
  env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/optimized" \
  cargo test -p exochain-decision-forum --all-targets -- --nocapture
FINAL_ALL_TARGET_RUNTIME_LOG="$LAST_AUTHOR_LOG"
run_author_gate \
  'final-exo-core-cross-impl' 'rust-cross-implementation' \
  'crates/exo-core/tests/cross_impl_hash_vectors.rs' 'cross_impl_hash_vectors' \
  env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/optimized" \
  cargo test -p exochain-core --test cross_impl_hash_vectors
cd "$prior_pwd"

# Required default-profile proof: remove both validator overrides and compile
# every decision-forum target into a clean target directory. Its contract is
# compilation, so it does not create a redundant fourth runtime execution.
prior_pwd="$PWD"
cd "$ASSEMBLY"
run_author_gate \
  'final-default-profile-all-target-no-run' 'rust-default-profile-compile' \
  'crates/decision-forum' 'all-targets-no-run' \
  env -u CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL -u RUSTFLAGS \
  CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET/default-profile" \
  cargo test -p exochain-decision-forum --all-targets --no-run
cd "$prior_pwd"

# Replay the retained literal selected tests against the materialized owner
# graph. Gate 20 is intentionally absent here: its genuine predecessor RED and
# focused GREEN occurred above, and the all-target manifest/output prove that
# exact final target once. No selected target other than that proven duplicate
# is removed.
declare -a RETAINED_SELECTED_TESTS=()
while IFS='|' read -r gate target test_name; do
  test -n "$gate"
  RETAINED_SELECTED_TESTS+=("$test_name")
  case "$target" in
    lib)
      list="$(CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" cargo test --manifest-path "$ASSEMBLY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --lib -- --list)"
      full_name="$(printf '%s\n' "$list" \
        | rg "(^|::)${test_name}: test$" \
        | sed 's/: test$//')"
      test "$(printf '%s\n' "$full_name" | rg -c "(^|::)${test_name}$")" -eq 1
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" cargo test --manifest-path "$ASSEMBLY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --lib "$full_name" -- --exact --nocapture
      ;;
    integration:*)
      integration="${target#integration:}"
      list="$(CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" cargo test --manifest-path "$ASSEMBLY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration" -- --list)"
      test "$(printf '%s\n' "$list" | rg -c "^${test_name}: test$")" -eq 1
      CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" cargo test --manifest-path "$ASSEMBLY/Cargo.toml" \
        -p exochain-decision-forum --test "$integration" "$test_name" -- --exact --nocapture
      ;;
    node)
      (cd "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test" && node --test \
        --test-name-pattern "^${test_name}$" dist/index.test.js)
      ;;
  esac
done <<'GATES'
01|integration:df_protocol_001_wire|fixed_bytes_are_hex_in_json_and_bytes_in_cbor
02|integration:df_protocol_001_wire|uuid_and_hlc_reject_noncanonical_or_unknown_input
03|integration:df_protocol_001_identity_context|identity_types_round_trip_without_hashing
04|integration:df_protocol_001_review_graph|review_types_preserve_exact_links
05|integration:df_protocol_001_event_model|event_types_preserve_every_payload_field
06|integration:df_protocol_001_core_model|package_assembles_exact_slice_1_contract
07|integration:df_protocol_001_wire|nested_duplicates_fail_before_authoritative_conversion
08|integration:df_protocol_001_core_model|shape_errors_report_path_expected_and_actual
09|integration:df_protocol_001_identity_context|projection_hashes_use_recomputed_identity_context
10|lib|cross_binding_graph_rejects_rebound_and_early_failures_at_exact_layers
11|integration:df_protocol_001_core_model|receipt_and_genesis_structure_fail_closed
12|integration:df_protocol_001_event_model|event_commitment_covers_real_payload_and_sealed_reveal_fields
13|lib|every_authoritative_leaf_and_collection_is_committed_or_rejected
14|integration:df_protocol_001_bcts_mapping|every_canonical_bcts_state_has_exactly_one_protocol_milestone
15|lib|segment_rejects_gap_cycle_scope_root_and_local_replay
16|lib|root_history_lineage_rejects_disconnected_rebound_and_other_history_without_mutation
17|lib|history_rejects_replay_stale_successor_and_second_segment_without_mutation
18|lib|rust_emits_exact_production_commitment_outputs
GATES

test "${#RETAINED_SELECTED_TESTS[@]}" -eq 18
for test_name in "${RETAINED_SELECTED_TESTS[@]}"; do
  test "$(rg -c "(^|::)${test_name}: test$" "$FINAL_ALL_TARGET_MANIFEST_LOG")" -eq 1
done
test "$(rg -c '^source_guards_cover_every_canonical_owner: test$' \
  "$FINAL_ALL_TARGET_MANIFEST_LOG")" -eq 1
test "$(rg -c '^test source_guards_cover_every_canonical_owner \.\.\. ok$' \
  "$FINAL_ALL_TARGET_RUNTIME_LOG")" -eq 1
printf '__DF_W19_GATE20_ALL_TARGET_PROOF__=PASS\n'
printf '__DF_W19_COMMAND_DIGEST_COVERAGE__=PASS retained_selected=18 gate20_from_all_targets=1 author_gate_count=%s\n' \
  "$AUTHOR_GATE_COUNT"

LOCK_BEFORE="$(shasum -a 256 "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/package-lock.json" | awk '{print $1}')"
(
  cd "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test"
  npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
  npm ci --ignore-scripts
  npm run typecheck
  npm test
  npm audit --audit-level=low
)
LOCK_AFTER="$(shasum -a 256 "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/package-lock.json" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$LOCK_BEFORE" = "$LOCK_AFTER"

# Gate 19 is selected only after the pinned compiler/test package exists.
test "$(cd "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test" && node --test --test-name-pattern \
  '^full_and_renderer_executors_emit_exact_production_keys$' dist/index.test.js \
  | rg -c 'pass 1')" -eq 1

VECTORS="$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/vectors"
EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_HASH_VECTORS="$VECTORS" \
EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_DF_OUTPUT="$PARITY/rust-full.jsonl" \
CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" cargo test --manifest-path "$ASSEMBLY/Cargo.toml" \
  -p exochain-decision-forum --lib \
  protocol::cross_impl_tests::rust_emits_exact_production_commitment_outputs -- --exact --nocapture
EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_HASH_VECTORS="$VECTORS" \
EXOCHAIN_CROSS_IMPL_DF_OUTPUT="$PARITY/rust-renderer.jsonl" \
CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" cargo test --manifest-path "$ASSEMBLY/Cargo.toml" \
  -p exochain-decision-forum --lib \
  protocol::cross_impl_tests::rust_emits_both_renderer_outputs -- --exact --nocapture
(
  cd "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test"
  npm run vectors -- --vectors "$VECTORS" --output "$PARITY/typescript.jsonl"
)
for implementation in rust typescript; do
  inputs=("$PARITY/typescript.jsonl")
  if test "$implementation" = rust; then
    inputs=("$PARITY/rust-full.jsonl" "$PARITY/rust-renderer.jsonl")
  fi
  jq -S -c '
    select(.category == "df_protocol_full" or .category == "df_protocol_renderer") as $record
    | $record.actual | to_entries[]
    | {actual:.value,category:$record.category,key:.key,vector_id:$record.vector_id}
  ' "${inputs[@]}" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$PARITY/$implementation.normalized.jsonl"
  test "$(wc -l < "$PARITY/$implementation.normalized.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')" = 17
done
diff -u "$PARITY/rust.normalized.jsonl" "$PARITY/typescript.normalized.jsonl"

# The direct package tests and vector runner above intentionally compile in the
# disposable assembly. Remove that local toolchain residue before executing
# the committed comparison owners so their no-repository-node_modules/dist
# guard is tested rather than tripped by the validator's own setup.
rm -rf "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/node_modules" \
  "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/dist"
test ! -e "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/node_modules"
test ! -e "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/dist"

# Execute the exact materialized committed owners; the direct parity proof
# above is additional evidence and cannot substitute for these script owners.
CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" \
  bash "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/compare_unit_test.sh"
CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TARGET" \
  bash "$ASSEMBLY/tools/cross-impl-test/compare.sh" --verbose

# Keep the identical optimized test profile and warnings-denied Rust flags
# through the literal Rust runners and both committed scripts so they reuse
# the already validated artifacts.
# The default-debug all-target run already executed above in its clean target
# directory; retaining the optimized settings here lets the committed scripts
# reuse the previously validated artifacts without changing any assertion.
if test -n "$FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL_SET"; then
  export CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL="$FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL"
else
  unset CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL
fi
if test -n "$FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS_SET"; then
  export RUSTFLAGS="$FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS"
else
  unset RUSTFLAGS
fi
test "${CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL+x}" = "$FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL_SET"
test "${RUSTFLAGS+x}" = "$FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS_SET"
if test -n "$FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL_SET"; then
  test "$CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL" = "$FINAL_PRIOR_TEST_OPT_LEVEL"
fi
if test -n "$FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS_SET"; then
  test "$RUSTFLAGS" = "$FINAL_PRIOR_RUSTFLAGS"
fi

test -s "$ASSEMBLY/crates/exo-core/tests/cross_impl_hash_vectors.rs"
test -s "$ASSEMBLY/owner-consumption.tsv"
authoritative_plan_sha256_after="$(shasum -a 256 "$PLAN" | awk '{print $1}')"
materialized_owner_manifest_sha256_after="$(shasum -a 256 \
  "$ASSEMBLY/owner-consumption.tsv" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$authoritative_plan_sha256_after" = "$FROZEN_PLAN_SHA256"
test "$materialized_owner_manifest_sha256_after" = "$OWNER_MANIFEST_SHA256"
test ! -e "$ROOT/node_modules"
test ! -e "$ROOT/tools/cross-impl-test/node_modules"
test ! -e "$ROOT/tools/cross-impl-test/dist"
git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all > "$STATUS_AFTER"
diff -u "$STATUS_BEFORE" "$STATUS_AFTER"
printf 'authoritative_plan_sha256_after=%s materialized_owner_manifest_sha256_after=%s\n' \
  "$authoritative_plan_sha256_after" "$materialized_owner_manifest_sha256_after"
printf '__DF_W19_FROZEN_SHA_EQUALITY__=PASS\n'
printf '__DF_PROTOCOL_VALIDATOR_EXIT__=0\n'
```

---

## Execution and review order

Execute the single topological table exactly as **Gate 01 → Gate 02 → ... →
Gate 21**. Each gate begins from its own committed base, proves RED, implements
the complete listed owner, proves GREEN, passes its focused suite, and commits
only its listed paths. Gate 21 freezes final implementer truth before review,
dispatches specification and technical validation, and dispatches whole-slice
review only after both first outcomes are `APPROVED` or
`APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_FINDINGS`. Completion requires a nonblocking whole-slice
outcome, an unchanged implementer-report hash, and durable preservation of all
observed statuses and retained minor findings. Any `CHANGES_REQUIRED` follows
the fresh-fixer and original-validator-rereview loop above.

The plan sections are normative only through that gate number; no prose from an issue, PR,
workflow node, imported report, or prior agent output can authorize a skipped
test, widened path, authority claim, GitHub operation, secret access, or
constitutional conclusion.
